tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /dam pa'i chos dgongs pa gcig pa'i rnam bshad lung don gsal byed legs bshad nyi ma'i snang ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /
༄༅/ /dam pa'i chos dgongs pa gcig pa'i rnam bshad lung don gsal byed legs bshad nyi ma'i snang ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dam pa'i chos dgongs pa gcig pa'i rnam bshad lung don gsal byed legs bshad nyi ma'i snang ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

༄༅/ /dam pa'i chos dgongs pa gcig pa'i rnam bshad lung don gsal byed legs bshad nyi ma'i snang ba zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi rang bzhin gdod nas rnam dag lhun grub mkha' bzhin 'dus ma byas// ji lta ji snyed ye shes phul byung gzhan gyi rkyen gyis rnam mi rtog /tshogs gnyis goms pas rang don mthar son smon lam stobs kyis 'gro rnams sgrol// rnam grol rnam pa kun ldan thub rnams rnam pa kun tu phyag gi gnas/ 1 /rgyal kun thugs rje'i 'o mtsho las thon smon lam dag pa'i 'od dkar can// rgyal ba'i mtshan dpe yon tan kun gyi ri dwags lang tsho rnam bkra zhing*// rgyal kun mdzad phrin gcig tu bsdus pa'i bstan pa'i snying po bsil phreng can// rgyal ba 'bri gung pa zhes yongs grags 'gro blo'i ku mud srung der 'dud/ 2 /ji lta ji snyed shes rab mchog mnga' rgyal kun bstan pa'i 'byung gnas gtso// blo gros rdo rje'i shes rab mtshon gyis log smra'i ro 'dzin rtsad nas gcod// legs bshad rin chen chu gter che las byang chub mchog gi snying po sbyin// dgongs pa ji bzhin 'khrul med 'doms mdzad dge ba'i bshes rnams bdag gis bstod/ 3 /gang 'dir thub pa'i bstan pa zhes grags rnam gsum chos kyi 'khor lo mchog /rten cing 'brel 'byung rang gzugs snang ba 'dul mngon byang sems rdo rje'i theg /nges don lta ba rtogs par ldan pas 'bras bu sangs rgyas mngon byed pa// rdo rje'i gsung zhes sa gsum srid par nyi ma'i 'od ltar ches gsal mod/ 4 /de dag dgongs pa'i snying po mchog rnams zab cing rgya che gting mtha' bral// ches brling rtogs dka'i gnas su gyur tshe blo dman bdag 'dra'i spyod yul du// rnam pa kun tu ma gyur na yang 'grel byed mkhan po 'ga' zhig gis// 'khrul ba'i lam du drangs pa'i nyes bshad bod yul 'di na rlung ltar grags/

5 /dus 'dir rdo rje'i gsung zhes smra ba mkha' la skar ma'i tshogs pa ltar// nyes bshad legs bshad chol por smra zhing dgongs pa'i don la tshom por gcod// zhib mor dris na chu shing bzhin du yid brtan snying pos dben kho na// de 'dra'i tshul gyis rgyal ba'i bstan pa rnam par nyams pa ma bzod de/ 6 /nges pa'i don gyi dgongs pa mthar thug gsal por smra ba'i mthu thob cing*// rjes 'jug slob ma'i tshogs rnams kun kyang skal bzang lam du bkri ba dang*// shes ldan lam 'dir mos pa kun gyis rnam dag grub mtha'i tshul rtogs phyir// gang yin dgongs pa gsal por bshad 'di gzur gnas rnams kyis gus pas longs/ 7 /bdag gis nga rgyal shes rlom dag dang gzhan la phrag dog rnyed brtson dang*| |khengs grags spyi brtol mkhas 'dod phyir min dam pa'i gsung gi gsang ba'i gnad// ches cher zab pa rtogs par dka' phyir skal ldan rnams kyis go sla'i phyir// lhag bsam zla tshes gsar pa ltar dkar blo gros pad dkar bzhad pa'i rtser/ 8 /legs bshad sbrang rtsi'i dga' ston spel gyi nga rgyal chang gis rab myos shing*// rigs rus dpal 'byor 'khor tshogs kyis dregs yin rlom bsgyings 'gros nga ro can// phrag dog bum pa spyi bor bcings nas nyes bshad ro 'dzin cher bskyod de// chags sdang sug pa'i gar gyis 'joms 'dod gnyis 'thung tshogs rnams ring spangs nas/ 9 /blo gsal skal ldan bung ba'i tshogs rnams gsong po'i mchu yis legs myong na// blo gros kun dga' rgya cher spel ba'i gtam gyi dga' ston 'dir mchis kyi// blo ldan dga' ba'i gshog sgra'i glu dbyangs sa gsum skye dgu'i bcud len te// blo mun sel byed nyi ma'i snang ba log rtog mun pa 'joms phyir smra/ 10 /gang gi rdo rje'i gsung rnams gsal byed lung rigs 'od brgya'i gzi 'bar ba// legs bshad ji snyed gti ma'i 'jing las rnam dpyod gar gyis bsrubs pa'i dpyid// blo gros rta bdun stobs kyis nyer drangs skal bzang phrag par deng shar gyi// dad ldan slob ma'i mig yid blo gros kun dga' brtas pa'i snang ba spel/

11 /'dir yang bshad par bya ba'i chos ni/ ston pa nyid kyis yang dag par bsngags shing lung bstan pa mgon po klu sgrub ces shing rta'i srol 'byed chen por byon pa gang de nyid/ slar yang gangs ri'i khrod 'dir mgon po 'bri gung pa chen po rat+na shrī zhes mtshan 'dzin pa ni/ rje btsun sgrol mas kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po shākya shrī bha dra la dngos su gsungs pa rlung ltar grags pa dang*/ gzhan yang mdo rgyud du ma nas yang dang yang du lung bstan pa dang*/ siṅga gling gi dgra bcom pa chen pos kyang me tog pad+ma dkar po'i skyes bskur te bsngags pa sogs bsam las 'das pa'i phyir/ tshad mar gyur pa'i skyes bu blo gros kyi mig dang ldan pa rnams ni yid ches pa'i gnas kho nar gyur la/ de las gzhan pa'i skal ngan rnams ni rnam pa kun tu ma rig pa'i ling tog gis blo gros kyi mig bsgribs pas tshad ma'i yul ma mthong ba'i phyir bas pa nyid du zad de/ mngon rtogs rgyan las// lha yi rgyal pos char phab kyang*// sa bon mi rung mi 'khrungs ltar// sangs rgyas rnams ni byon gyur kyang*// skal ba med pas bzang mi myong*// zhes so// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po bla ma rin po che des ni gdul bya'i snod dang 'tsham par zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo ji snyed cig bskor ba dang*// gzhan yang snod ldan gyi skyes bu rnams la chos kyi gtam ji snyed cig gsungs pa rnams spyan snga shes rab 'byung gnas nyid kyis legs par 'doms par mdzad pa la rdo rje'i gsung ji snyed cig mchis pa las/ de dag gi nang nas rdo rje'i gsung brgya lnga bcu dang*/ lhan thabs gsung bzhi bcur bsdus te phyi rabs kyi gang zag rnams 'dzin bde bar mdzad pa 'di rnams 'chad par bya'o// 'chad lugs ji lta bu zhe na/ 'grel byed rdo rje shes rab dang*/ rin byang ma sogs ltar spyi bzhed dang rang bzhed sogs so sor bkod cing lung dang rigs pa'i tshogs du ma sbyar na go bde zhing legs bshad kyi phul chen por 'gyur na'ang*/

slob ma blo dman rnams kyi go yul du mi chud pa dang*/ rang nyid kyang yi ge'i ngal bas 'jigs te/ des na rdo rje'i gsung gi dgongs pa dpyis phyin pa 'khrul ba'i dri ma dang bral ba la lung gi rgyab rten dang bcas bshad pas spyi bzhed rnams rang shugs kyis rtogs par 'gyur ba dang*/ phyis kyi 'grel pa mkhan po 'ga' zhig gis tshig don bsdus pas don ma khrol ba dang*// 'ga' zhig gis rang gi zhe 'dod dang ma 'grigs pas rdo rje'i gsung 'ga' zhig slar bcos nas rtsa ba rul ba'i ljon shing la 'bras bu mi 'byung ba lta bu dang*/ 'ga' zhig gis spyan snga sher 'byung sogs 'grel byed snga ma gsum la 'khrul bar mthong zhing*/ rang 'dod rtsa ba dang bsres pas tshong 'dus kyi 'o ma ltar gyur pa sogs 'khrul ba'i lam du drangs pa 'ga' mthong bas de lta bu rnams rnam par spangs te rdo rje'i gsung gi dgongs pa rang gis rtogs pa dang*/ 'grel pa snga ma rnams kyi legs pa'i cha rnams bsdus shing*/ mdo sngags kyi lung gis tshad mar bsgrubs te/ mgon po 'bri gung pa chen po'i thugs kyi dgongs pa phyogs dus kyi rgyal ba thams cad dang dbyer med cing*/ bod rgan spyi brtol rnams kyi man ngag phyogs re la zab mor bsngags te brjod pa las dgar ba'i mdo rgyud kun gyi lam rim man ngag thams cad gang zag gcig 'tshang rgya ba'i lam gyi rim pa'i tshul du brjod par bya'o// de la gnyis/ spyir bstan bcos kyi lus rnam par bzhag pas mdor bsdu ba dang*/ bye brag so sor phye ste rgyas par bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad babs kyi gnas lugs bstan bya ba 'di'i khongs su 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos dang chos nyid thams cad 'du na bstan bcos 'di'i lus thams cad kyang 'di nyid kho nar 'du ste/ de yang 'khor ba'i rang bzhin thams cad kyang rang rang gi gshis sam babs ni kun gzhi bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po zab mo stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin las gang du yang ma 'das te/

rgyud bla ma las/ thog ma dbus mtha' med cing rnam dbyer med// gnyis med gsum bral dri med rnam rtog med// chos dbyings rang bzhin gang yin de rtogs pa// mnyam par bzhag pa'i rnam 'byor pa yis mthong*// zhes so// de lta bu'i sems can gyi gshis sam babs rang bzhin stong pa de nyid kyi snang ngor smon lam dag pa'i chos gsungs pa yang*/ sangs rgyas de nyid kyi gshis sam babs ni smon lam rnam par dag pa'i stobs las byang chub mchog gi rang gzugs su grub pa'i rang rtsal 'gag med du shar ba na/ des gsungs pa'i chos rnams kyi babs rang bzhin gyi gnas lugs gcig po de nyid bstan pa ma gtogs/ la lar drang don/ la lar nges don la sogs pa gsungs pa med mod/ 'on kyang sangs rgyas kyis babs kyi chos rnam pa gcig nyid gsungs pa na sems can rnams rang rang gi gshis babs gang yin gyi go lugs so sor byung bas na don yang so sor 'gal ba ltar snang ba bstan bcos mkhan pos mi 'gal ba'i phyir mtha' drug tshul bzhi sogs su bshad pa ste/ don du gshis sam babs de nyid las gzhan du gyur pa med de/ rgyud bla ma las/ ji ltar lha nang lha rnams kyi// rnga sgra rang gi las las byung*// de bzhin 'jig rten thub pa'i chos// gsungs pa rang gi las las byung*/ zhes dang*/ de nyid las/ ji ltar bsil dang zhim dang 'jam pa dang*// yang ba'i chu ni sprin de las thon pa// sa la ba tshwa la sogs gnas dbye bas// shin tu mang po'i ror ni 'gyur ba bzhin// de bzhin 'phags pa'i yan lag brgyad chu'i char// rab yangs brtse sprin snying po las thon te// 'gro ba'i rgyud kyi gnas kyi dbye ba las// rnam pa mang po'i ro dang ldan par 'gyur// zhes so// des na sangs rgyas rang gi sngon gyi smon lam dang tshogs gnyis mthar phyin pa'i stobs kyis gshis babs las byung ba'i chos kyi tshul rnam pa gcig las ma g.yos par gsungs pa yang rtog pa med par nyi ma'i 'od zer ltar spros pa/

sems can rnams kyi gshis babs so sor yod pa yang*/ mgon po 'bri gung pas sems tha dad pa'i dbang gis snang ba yang tha dad du gsungs pa ltar go lugs so sor byung ba las don gcig po las ma 'das pa ni/ dur khrod rgyan gyi rgyud las/ gsung gcig nyid du gsungs pa yang*| |du ma nyid du so sor go// zhes so// 'khor 'das kun gyi sems la gshis sam rang bzhin zhes brjod pa ci'i phyir zhe na/ rgyud bla ma las/ sems ni rtag tu rang bzhin 'od gsal 'dod// de ni glo bur dri mas ma rungs byas// chos nyid sems las gzhan pa'i sems gzhan ni// 'od gsal ma yin rang bzhin la brjod do// zhes so// de lta bu'i gshis babs de nyid kyang ngo bo dge ba'i rang gshis la bde ba dang*/ mi dge ba'i babs las sdug bsngal 'byung ba ni sangs rgyas kyis bsgyur du mi btub par de'i gshis babs rgyu 'di las 'bras bu 'di 'byung zhes pa mtha' gcig po 'di nyid gsungs pa ste/ mi'am ci'i rgyal po ljon pas zhus pa'i mdo las/ rgyu la brten pa'i mkhas pa bcom ldan 'das| |mtha' gnyis lta ba rtag tu mi mnga' zhing*// las kyi rnam smin 'bras bu kho nar gsungs// lta ba'i mun bral khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes so// des na 'khor 'das gnyis kyang dge sdig gi rang gzugs nyid de/ rang gzugs ni gshis babs las gzhan med pa yang*/ rdo rje gur las/ rin chen sems las phyir gyur pa'i// sangs rgyas med cing sems can med// gnas pa'i don dang rnam shes dag /phyi rol gyur pa 'ga' yang med// ces so// tshul de 'dra ba des bskal pa gcig nyid la bskal pa grangs med par ston pa dang*/ zhing khams mtha' yas pa rdul phra rab gcig gi nang du 'dzud pa sogs kyang mi shes pa'i snang ngor 'gal ba ltar snang yang don gyi ngo bo rang babs las gzhan du ma 'das pa nyid la chos kyi dbyings sam gshis babs zhes bya ste/

dbus mtha' rnam 'byed las/ chos kyi dbyings ni ma gtogs par// 'di ltar chos yod ma yin te// zhes sogs mtha' yas pa gsungs pa dang*| gzhan yang dam chos pad+ma dkar por/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bar bskal lnga bcur byang sems shes rab brtsegs sogs du ma'i don mdzad pa gling 'dir sda dro gcig las ma song ba sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ don 'di go na sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad go ba yin te/ 'di ni bstan bcos 'di'i don phyogs gcig tu dril ba lus rnam par bzhag pa'i tshul du bstan cing*| rdo rje'i gsung gzhan rnams 'di'i 'phros don lta bur yang 'gyur bas na 'di ni shin tu gal che ba ste/ dpal ldan ngad phu pas/ 'am bu ni gsung 'di gcig pu'i phyir yang 'jig rten mgon po'i zhabs drung du gtugs rin chog pa yin gsungs so// rnam bzhag spros pa de tsam gyis chog go// gnyis pa bye brag rgyas par bshad pa la spyi don brgyad de/ tshoms bdun dang lhan thabs gsung bzhi bcu pa rnams so/// / ༈ /spyi don dang po chos kyi 'khor lo spyi'i gnad bsdus kyi tshoms 'chad pa la rdo rje'i gsung sum cu mchis pa'i dang po ni/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad babs kyi gnas lugs bstan bya ba 'di la/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ni chos thams cad rnam par dag pa'i ngo bor sangs rgyas pas/ phya dang dbang phyug ltar byed po'i che ba ma yin pa dang*/ chos thams cad kyi gshis babs de brtse ba chen pos ston pa dang*/ gshis de sangs rgyas kyis bsgyur du med pa dkar nag zang thal rten cing 'brel 'byung yin pa dang*/ rgyu 'bras mtho dman gang du'ang mi bslu ba dang*/ gnas dang gnas ma yin pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes mnga' ba ste/ gtan tshig de lngas grub pa ni gshis sam babs kyi gnas lugs te/ dbang bcu mnga' ba'i sangs rgyas kyi chos yang dag pa ni mtha' gcig las mi mnga' ba'i phyir/ ji skad du/ gnyis med gnyis su med par ston// zhes so| |gshis babs ni sngar bshad ma thag pa ltar sems can gyi khams rgyud kyi chos kyi dbyings kho na las gzhan med de/

dbus mtha' rnam 'byed las/ stong pa nyid ni mdor bsdus na| |de bzhin nyid dang yang dag mtha'// mtshan ma med dang don dam dang*// chos kyi dbyings ni rnam grangs so// zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad sems can gyi bsam pa'i babs kyi gnas lugs don dam pa nyid bstan pa ni lung rigs du mas grub pa yin no// gnyis pa/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong yang sangs rgyas bsgrub pa'i thabs su gcig bya ba ni/ sems can rnams kyi khams rgyud la nyon mongs dug gsum mam ma rig pa kho na las byung ba'i nyon mongs brgyad khri bzhi stong gi gnyen por chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pa yang*/ sems can gcig gi gshis thog tu 'bab cing nyams su blang bya'i chos yin pa las gzhan pa'i chos phung re re las gzhan mi dgos pa ma yin te/ sems can gyi khams rgyud la nyon mongs phra rags thams cad 'dus pa'i bdag nyid ma gtogs/ sems can la lar gti mug /la lar 'dod chags sogs re re las gzhan med pa ma yin te/ slob dpon dpa' bos/ 'dod chags la sogs ma lus pa yi nad// rgyun du 'brel bas lus zungs khyab par gyur/ ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ nyon mongs thams cad kyi gnyen por chos phung thams cad kyang gang zag gcig 'tshang rgya ba'i thabs su gcig pa ni chos kyi phung po thams cad kyi rtsa ba bdag med gnyis rtogs pa'i thabs yin la/ bdag med gnyis po ni nyon mongs pa ma rig pa gti mug gi gnyen po yin pas na dper na nad gtso bo rlung la bad mkhris tsha ba ldan par byung na sman yang thams cad tshogs dgos pa dang 'dra ste/ sna gcig ma tshang yang de'i ngo skal gyi spang bya spong mi nus pa'i phyir/ des na nyon mongs re re las gzhan med pa mi srid pas/ chos kyang thams cad nyams su blang bya ma gtogs dor bya ye med pa yin te/ de yang chos thams cad rtsa ba phyag rgya chen po'i steng du 'bab pa'i phyir/

ji skad du/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dang*/ /bzhi stong gsungs pa gang yin pa| |chos nyid 'di la gzhol zhing 'bab// ces sogs gsungs pa dang*/ gzhan yang mdo sde bskal pa bzang po dang*/ glog thob kyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ chos phung de rnams kyang pha rol tu phyin pa brgyad khri bzhi stong du dbye ste bsgoms pas ting nge 'dzin gzungs spobs sogs grangs de snyed bdag don du brnyes nas gzhan don du gdul bya la chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong ston par 'gyur la/ de bsdu na phar phyin drug tu 'dus/ de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin par 'dus/ des na phar phyin brgyad khri bzhi stong bsdus pa'i drug po 'di dgos 'di mi dgos med par drug car nyams su blangs pas so so'i yon tan skye dgos te/ 'phags pa sdud pa las/ sbyin pas sdug bsngal gyur pa'i sems can yongs smin byed// khrims kyis dud 'gro'i 'gro ba du ma'i ngo bo dang*// mi khom brgyad spong de yis dal ba rtag tu rnyed// bzod pas gzugs bzang dam pa rgya chen 'thob 'gyur te// gser mdog sdug cing 'gro bas blta ba'i 'os su 'gyur// brtson 'grus kyis ni dkar po'i yon tan 'grib mi 'gyur// ye shes mtha' yas rgyal ba'i bang mdzod rnyed par 'gyur// bsam gtan gyis ni 'dod pa'i yon tan smad pa 'dor| |rig dang mngon par shes dang ting 'dzin mngon par sgrub// shes rab kyis ni chos kyi rang bzhin yongs shes nas// khams gsum ma lus pa las yang dag 'da' bar 'gyur| |mi yi khyu mchog 'khor lo rin chen bskor byas nas// sdug bsngal zad par bya phyir 'gro la chos kyang ston// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ gzhan yang mdo sde'i sde snod rnams nas/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi mtshan dpe sogs sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo rnams 'grub pa'i rgyu 'di las 'bras bu 'di 'byung so sor gsungs pa sogs mtha' yas pa'i phyir/

don gnyis ldan pa'i sangs rgyas bsgrub pa la nyon mongs brgyad khri bzhi stong gi gnyen por chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong nyams su blang dgos pa kho na las spang blang gcig kyang byar med/ dbye na 'dod chags nyi khri chig stong gi gnyen por 'dul ba nyi khri chig stong*/ de bzhin zhe sdang la mdo sde/ gti mug la mngon pa/ de gsum cha mnyam la sde snod gsum cha mnyam/ de bsdu na 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum la 'dul mdo mngon gsum/ de yang bsdu na gti mug gi gnyen por shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste/ des na chos kyi phung po thams cad kyang rang rgyud 'dul bar mi dgos ka med du go bar bya dgos so// gsum pa ni/ sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi lam skye ba'i rim pa bya ba 'di la/ rin byang mar sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi lam rgyud la skye ba'i rim pa zhes dang*/ rdo sher mar sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi lam bskyed pa'i rim pa zhes cung zad mi mthun pa ltar snang yang*/ 'dir rdor gsung gi 'dod tshul dang 'grel pa rnams 'thad mi 'thad dpyad pa'i skabs min pas btang snyoms su bzhag nas rdo rje'i gsung dngos kyi dgongs pa 'chad par bya'o// de la sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi la sogs pa mdo sngags kyi chos thams cad kyang gang zag gcig 'tshang rgya ba'i phyir lam dang sa'i yon tan rgyud la skye ba'i thabs su gcig par bzhed de/ mdo sde rgyan las/ mdo dang chos mngon 'dul ba dag /mdor na don ni rnam bzhir 'dod// blo dang ldan pas de shes nas// rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa 'thob// ces dang*/ brtag gnyis las/ dang por gso sbyong sbyin par bya// de rjes bslab pa'i gnas bcu nyid// ces pa nas/ sngags kyi rim pa kun shes nas// de rjes kye yi rdo rje brtsam// zhes so// 'di dag kyang so skye nas sdom gsum rgyud ldan man chad la khyad par ma mchis te/

'dul ba las bsnyen par rdzogs pa thob zin nas thob pa rgyu mtshan du byas te 'dul ba dang ma mo dang mdo sde sogs sde snod thams cad la bslab par gsungs pa dang*/ byang sems la ni/ zhi ba lhas/ rgyal sras rnams kyis mi slob pa'i// dngos de gang yang yod ma yin// zhes so// sngags la ni/ pad+ma rigs kyi dam tshig tu// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni gzung bar bgyi// zhes gsungs pas sdom gsum re re nas bzung gsum ga rgyud ldan can nam/ so skye yang rung rdzogs byang thob 'dod kyi blo can la mdo sngags gnyis lam rgyud la skye bar yang gcig la de gnyis ka med mi rung du bshad mod/ de'i tshul lung rigs mang du yod na'ang grags che bas de tsam gyis chog la/ mdor na mtshan nyid phar phyin theg pa'i chos nyams su blang ba dang*/ sngags bla med kyi lam bskyed pa dang rdzogs pa'i rim pa sogs nyams su blang ba'i 'thob bya ni stong pa nyid dam pa'i don rtogs pa las gzhan med pas na gcig ste/ dbus mtha' rnam 'byed las/ dmigs pa la ni brten nas su// mi dmigs pa ni rab tu skye// mi dmigs pa la brten nas su// mi dmigs pa nyid rab tu skye// zhes rnam bzhag du ma'i sgo nas gsungs so// bzhi pa ni/ chos kyi 'khor lo gsum 'khor gyi rtog pa'i khyad par bstan pa yin par bzhed do// de'i rgyu mtshan ni spyir chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba ni 'khor gyi rnam par rtog pa'i dbang gis go tshul tha dad 'byung ba ni sngar rgyud bla ma'i lung gis nam mkha'i char la khyad med kyang 'bab gnas kyi dbang gis so sor 'gyur ba de kho nas kyang 'grub la/ bye brag tu ston pas 'khor lo rim pa gsum du gsungs pa ni 'khor rnams rim gyis bkri ba'i dbang du mdzad de/ ston pas lnga sde sogs la/ dge slong dag /'di ni thog mtha' bar gsum du mi dge bas spang bar bya ba yin no// 'di ni thog mtha' bar gsum du dge bas bsgrub par bya ba yin no// zhes dgag sgrub kyi bslab pa ston pa bden bzhi'i chos kyi 'khor lo lan gsum du bzlas pas rnam pa bcu gnyis su bskor bas nyan thos de dag gis dgra bcom ma thag ting nge 'dzin khyad par can skyes pa 'phags pa kau ṇ+ḍin+ya la sogs pa lta bu ste/

de ltar smin par mdzad pa'i rjes la chos dang chos nyid thams cad med pa'i tshul gyis gtan la phab pa 'khor lo bar pa mtshan nyid med pa bskor te/ gong gi ting nge 'dzin rnams kyang lhag mthong gi shes rab kyis gtan la phab ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor rnams la/ nga yang dgra bcom pa yin la khyed rnams kyang dgra bcom pa yin zhes gsungs pa na/ 'khor rnams kyis bsam par/ dgra bcom mnyam pa la yon tan mi mnyam pa ci yin snyam ste 'phrig tshud par gyur te/ de lta na lhag mthong gi shes rab rtogs pas 'khor lo gnyis pas shin tu smin par mdzad do// de nas chos thams cad med pa stong nyid dgag pa dang*/ ston pas 'khor rnams la/ khyed rnams dgra bcom pa ma yin no zhes sogs kyis theg pa 'og ma sun phyung nas/ mthar sangs rgyas kyi yon tan ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa rnams kyi rgyu la 'jug pa'i phyir gnas lugs yang dag mngon sum sangs rgyas kyi ye shes gtan la phab pa 'khor lo tha ma nges don rnam par phye ba gsungs shing*/ gtsang*/ bdag /bde ba/ rtag pa'i pha rol tu son par mdzad nas 'khor de rnams bla na med pa'i byang chub chen por lung ston par mdzad pa ste/ de ni 'khor lo gsum pas shin tu rab tu smin par mdzad ces pa ste/ mgon po 'bri gung pa chen pos/ 'khor lo dang pos smin par mdzad nas kyang*// 'khor lo gnyis pas shin tu smin par mdzad// gsum pas shin tu rab tu smin mdzad pas// thub pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo gsum du snang*// zhes dang*/ ji skad du/ mdo sde'i sde snod rnams nas/ ston pas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i tshe/ nam mkha' nas lha rnams kyis/ kye ma sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dzam bu'i gling du chos kyi 'khor lo dang po bskor ro// de bzhin du gnyis pa bskor ro// gsum pa'ang bskor ro// zhes pa dang*/ gzhan yang 'khor rnams thog mar bden pa bzhis blo bsgyur/

de ltar rtag par rlom pa 'khor lo bar pa med dgag gis sun phyung*/ de nyid chad lta'i mtha' 'gog pa'i phyir 'khor lo tha ma mtha' bral zung 'jug gsal stong gi lta bas gtan la phab pa nyid du nges te/ dbu ma la 'jug pa las/ myang 'das dngos po'i blo can gyi// 'dzin pa bzlog par bya ba'i phyir// don dam mkhyen pas don dam pa| |stong pa nyid ni bstan par mdzad// ces 'khor lo dang por dngos po'i blo can gyi 'dzin pa bzlog par bya ba'i phyir 'khor lo bar pa gsungs shing*/ dbus mtha' rnam 'byed las/ stong pa ma yin mi stong min// de lta bas na thams cad bshad// yod pa med pas yod pa na// de ni dbu ma'i lam yin no// zhes 'khor lo bar pa stong pa med dgag gi blo can bzlog pa'i phyir mtha' bral zung 'jug tu bshad pas/ des na 'khor lo rim pa gsum po lnga sde la sogs pa'i 'khor rnams la blo dang 'tsham pa'i chos kyis gong nas gong du 'khrid par mdzad nas mthar thug theg pa mchog gcig po bstan pa'i gnad kyis 'khor lo gsum du mi 'ong ka med du yin no// lnga pa/ chos kyi 'khor lo re re la yang gsum ga tshang bar bzhed pa ni/ chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa gsum po'i dang po bden bzhi la yang bar pa dang tha ma'i rnam bzhag ches mang zhing de bzhin du gzhan gnyis la'ang shes shing rtogs par bya ba ste/ 'khor lo dang po bden bzhi la/ 'khor ba'i rgyu 'bras sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung*/ myang 'das kyi rgyu 'bras 'gog pa dang lam ston pa dang*/ bar pa mtshan nyid med par/ kun 'byung la gang zag dang chos gnyis te/ rang rgyud yon tan gyis dregs shing gzhan nyams su mi len pa la brnyas pa gang zag gi kun 'byung*/ tshul khrims srung ba sogs tshe 'dir bde skyid dang phyi mar mtho ris kyi yon tan bdun sogs grub 'dod chos kyi bdag dang 'dra ba chos kyi kun 'byung*/ 'khor 'das gnyis med chos thams cad stong nyid kyi ngang nas rgyu 'bras rten 'brel du 'byung ba dang*/

tha ma nges don gyi skabs dag pa'i sa la gnas pa'i byang sems kyis kun 'byung spangs shing*/ lam bden gnyis zung 'jug bsgoms pas dkon mchog gsum rtag brtan zhi ba theg pa gcig tu grub cing 'bras bu sku dang ye shes yon tan tshad med 'grub pa'o// mtshon byed tshig gis kyang 'khor lo re re la gsum ga tshang ste/ dang po'i skabs bden bzhi rtogs pas bdag gis bya ba byas so sogs gsungs pa dang*/ sdug bsngal spang du med sogs rnam thar gsum gyi mtshan ma med pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi rdzu 'phrul yid mgyogs dang stobs bcu sogs sangs rgyas kyi yon tan bstan pa rnams nges don/ bar pa'i skabs 'dod pa rnams dug gi lo ma lta bu zhes sogs dang*/ gzugs mi rtag pa yid la bya'o sogs dang*/ sems can dmyal ba'i rgyu shes par bya sogs sdug bsngal kun 'byung dang*/ sbyin pa dge'o sogs dang*/ sbyin pas rgyal rigs mtho zhing mthong thob sogs dang*/ byang phyogs so bdun bshad pa lam bden/ byang sems zhugs 'bras brgyad kyi 'gog bden gsungs shing*/ gzhan yang rang sems mi dge bar skye ba kun 'byung*/ de'i 'bras bu rigs drug tu sdug bsngal myong ba sdug bsngal/ yang rgyu rkyen rten 'brel gyis sems dge bar skye ba las dang bcas pa lam bden/ de'i 'bras bu bde ba 'byung ba lam bden las 'bras bu 'gog bden 'byung ba sogs 'khor lo dang po'i brjod bya/ rgyu 'bras de nyid kyi gshis gdod nas spros bral mtha' bral stong nyid du bstan pa 'khor lo bar pa'i brjod bya la stong nyid de'i ngang nas sangs rgyas kyi sku dang ye shes bral 'bras kyi yon tan gtsang bdag bde ba rtag par gsungs pa nges don gyi brjod bya/ de la mtho dman gang du bstan kyang rgyu 'bras gtso bor ston pa zhig 'dug na dang po'i brjod bya/ chos dbyings stong nyid rnam thar sgo gsum gtso bor ston pa gang du 'dug kyang bar pa'i brjod bya/

'bras bu sku gsum rtag pa'i 'khor lo gtso bor ston pa nges don gyi brjod bya/ yang sbyang gzhi sgo lnga'i rnam shes gang na 'dug pa dang po/ yid shes gtsor ston gang na 'dug pa bar pa/ sbyang gzhi nyon yid dang kun gzhi'i rnam shes ston pa gang na 'dug pa nges don/ yang nyan rang gi lam gtso bor ston pa dang po/ 'khor 'das mnyam nyid gtso bor ston pa bar pa/ sangs rgyas kyi sku bral 'bras kyi yon tan gtso bor ston pa tha ma/ de ltar na 'khor lo gsum po re re la brjod bya rjod byed gnyis ka'i cha nas 'khor lo gcig tu nges la/ de yang ston pa sangs rgyas ma thag /zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas| |bdud rtsi lta bu'i chos ni bdag gis thob// ces 'khor lo gsum ga'i brjod bya bstan pa ste/ mdor dril na/ 'khor lo dang po bden bzhi/ bar pa mtshan med/ tha ma nges don zhes dang*/ 'dul mdo mngon gsum sogs rjod byed tshig dang brjod bya don gyi ngo bo rnams ni re re la gsum ga tshang zhing gsum ga yang brjod bya gcig las gzhan med pa'i phyir/ 'dul ba las/ sdom pa'i ngo bo rnam par rig byed ma yin par gsungs pa dang*/ ji skad du/ 'dul bar dka' ba'i sems 'dul byed// ces dang*/ so thar las/ sems rta kha blan dka' ba la// mthun pa gzer gnon rgyab pa yi// srab 'di so sor thar 'di yin// zhes so// mdo sdud pa las/ gang zhig yod pa ma yin de ni med ces bya// byis pa rnams kyis de brtag yod dang med par byed// yod dang med pa 'di gnyis med pa'i chos yin te// byang chub sems dpa' gang gis 'di shes nges par 'byung*// zhes sogs dang*/ mdor na 'khor lo rnam gsum sogs chos thams cad kyang rnam pa gcig gi ngo bor tshul mtshungs shing 'gres can kho nar bzhugs te/ ji skad du/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing*// dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad// rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul// 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin// zhes bya ba 'di'i khongs su 'khor lo rnam pa gsum gyi brjod bya thams cad 'dus pa'i phyir tshul de lta bu sogs lung rigs du ma'i gtan tshig dang ldan pa'i phyir ro// drug pa/

chos kyi 'khor lo phyi ma phyi ma'i sa bon snga ma la gnas zhes bya ba ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ye shes ni rnam kun mchog dang ldan pa'i phyir des ni chos thams cad gcig las gzhan mi gsungs pa dang*/ 'khor lo gsum ga'i brjod bya'i gtso bo bshad ma thag pa'i zab zhi spros bral las gzhan med pa yang thog ma nyid nas gsungs pa ni 'khor lo gsum ga'i sa bon nam rtsa bar byung la/ gzhan yang 'khor lo dang po'i skabs bden pa bzhi gsum du bzlas pa'i tha ma'i skabs/ sdug bsngal shes par byar med/ kun 'byung spang du med/ 'gog pa mngon du byar med/ lam rgyud la bsten du med/ ces 'khor lo bar pa mtshan nyid med pa'i sa bon bzhag /'khor lo bar pa'i skabs tha ma nges don gyi sa bon ni/ 'phags pa sdud pa las/ gang la sems dang yid dang rnam shes mthong med pa// de ni chos mthong yin zhes de bzhin gshegs pas bstan// ces tha ma nges don rnam par nges pa'i rtsa ba bstan/ tha ma'i skabs lang kar gshegs pa las/ blo gros chen po sa mthar phyin// chos kyi dbang ni bskur nas su// 'og min stug po nyams dga' bar// yang dag sangs rgyas der sangs rgyas// sprul pa po zhig 'dir 'tshang rgya// zhes sngags kyi ston pa dang*/ ji skad du/ rgyu la mos pa rgyu'i chos kyi// 'khor lo rab tu bskor byas nas// 'bras bu'i theg pa nye lam zhig /ma 'ongs dus su 'byung bar 'gyur// zhes sngags kyi theg pa'i sa bon nam rtsa ba yang gsungs pa lta bu ste des na 'khor lo phyi ma'i sa bon snga mar gsungs pa ni shin tu mang ngo*// bdun pa/ mdo dang don gyi gnad kyis 'khor lo gsum du nges zhes gsungs pa ni/ chos kyi phung po rnams la phyogs ris dang sde tshan du dbye ba med mod/ 'on kyang 'dzin bde ba'i phyir chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa gsum zhes grags pa ni gnas dang dus dang 'khor sogs kyis dbye ba ma yin te|

dang po'i gnas wā rā ṇa sīr/ rdo rje'i mchu dang*/ dpal lha mo lung bstan pa'i mdo sogs theg chen dang gsang sngags kyi chos 'ga' zhig gsungs pa dang*/ bar pa'i gnas bya rgod phung rir/ theg pa chung ngu dang*/ 'khor lo tha ma'i gzungs kyi dbang phyug rgyal pos zhus pa'i mdo dang*/ 'jam dpal gyi zhing bkod pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po bstan pa'i mdo sogs mang du gsungs/ tha ma'i gnas rtswa can la sogs par/ 'du shes bcu bstan pa'i mdo sogs theg pa chung ngu dang*/ khye'u bzhis zhus pa sogs mtshan nyid med pa'i chos mang du gsungs la/ dus kyang sangs rgyas nas zhag bdun phrag dang po nas lnga pa'i bar la rdo rje rnam 'joms dang*/ so sor 'brang ma chen mo dang*/ sangs rgyas phal po che la sogs pa gsang sngags dang theg chen mang du'ang gsungs/ bar du'ang nor bzang gi rnam thar sdong po rgyan pa dang*/ dran pa nyer bzhag sogs bden bzhi'i khongs su gtogs pa mang du gsungs/ tha ma'i dus su bden bzhi'i tshul mang po dang*/ mya ngan las 'da' khar lung zhu ba dang phran tshegs kyi khongs su gtogs pa mang du gsungs/ 'khor yang 'khor lo dang po'i skabs lnga sde rkyang pa ma zad lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten rnams dang byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor dpag tu med pa yod la/ bar pa'i skabs su nyan thos kyi 'khor theg dman kyang bsam las 'das pa'i phyir/ des na 'khor lo gsum du 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan ni mdo'i don dang don gyi gnad kyis 'khor lo gsum du bzhag ste/ bden bzhi'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i tshe/ ji skad du/ nam mkha' nas lha rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu/ e ma sngon chad 'jig rten du dge sbyong ngam bram ze'am/ lha'am/ bdud dam/ tshangs pa'am/ sus kyang ma bskor ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo dang po bcom ldan 'das kyis bskor ro zhes bsgrags pas dang por bzhag go// zhes dang*/ mtshan nyid med pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i dus su/

yum rgyas pa las/ rab 'byor gyis de bzhin nyid kyi le'u bstan pa'i tshe/ gtsang ma ris kyi lha rnams nam mkha' la 'khod nas lha'i gos dang me tog 'thor zhing*/ lhung lhung ldeg ldeg gi sgra phyung nas/ e ma 'dzam bu'i gling du chos kyi 'khor lo gnyis pa bskor ba mthong ngo*// zhes bsgrags pas gnyis par bzhag go// nges don chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i dus na/ mdo sde dgongs pa nges 'grel las/ byang chub sems dpa' don dam yang dag 'phags kyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to// bcom ldan 'das kyis sngon yul wā rā ṇa sī drang srong lhung ba ri dwags kyi nags su nyan thos kyi theg pa la yang dag par zhugs pa rnams la 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi'i rnam pa bstan pas chos kyi 'khor lo ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba sngon chad 'jig rten du lhar gyur pa'am/ mir gyur pa'am sus kyang chos dang mthun par ma bskor ba rab tu bskor te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba de yang bla na mchis pa/ skabs mchis pa/ drang ba'i don/ rtsod pa'i tshig gi gnas su gyur pa lags so// lan gnyis su bcom ldan 'das kyis theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs pa rnams la chos kyi ngo bo nyid ma mchis pa las brtsams shing*/ skye ba ma mchis pa dang*/ 'gag pa ma mchis pa dang*/ gdod ma nas zhi ba/ rang bzhin gyis mya ngan las 'das pa las brtsams te spros pa'i rnam pas chos kyi 'khor lo shin tu ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba bskor te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi chos kyi 'khor lo de'ang bla na mchis pa/ skabs mchis pa/ drang ba'i don/ rtsod pa'i tshig gi gnas su gyur pa lags so// bcom ldan 'das kyis lan gsum du theg pa thams cad la zhugs pa rnams la chos kyi ngo bo nyid ma mchis pa las brtsams shing*/ skye ba ma mchis pa/ 'gag pa ma mchis pa/ gdod ma nas zhi ba dang*/ rang bzhin gyis yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa las brtsams te shin tu rnam par dbye ba'i bye brag gis ha cang yang ngo mtshar la/

ha cang yang rmad du byung ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba 'di ni bla na ma mchis pa/ skabs ma mchis pa/ nges pa'i don/ rtsod pa'i tshig gi gnas su ma gyur pa lags so// zhes gsungs pas gsum du nges so// de ltar na chos 'khor gsum po mthar thug gi 'thob bya dang*/ 'bras bur khyad med na'ang gnas skabs su brjod bya'i don dang rjod byed kyi tshig la mtho dman yod pa ltar ched du brjod mkhan yang dang po tshangs ris man chad/ gnyis pa gnas gtsang ma'i lha rnams/ gsum pa byang sems don dam yang dag 'phags sogs sa bcu la gnas pas brjod par zad do// don gyi gnad kyang rnam grangs gsum du nges te/ rgyu 'bras stong nyid du 'jug pa 'khor lo dang po'i don/ stong nyid rgyu 'bras su 'byung ba 'khor lo bar pa'i don/ de gnyis gnyis med du gnas pa ni 'khor lo gsum pa'i don yin te/ dbu ma la 'jug pa las/ chos rnams rang bzhin med pa nyid// mkhas pas stong pa nyid ces bsnyad// stong nyid de yang stong nyid kyi// ngo bos stong par 'dod pa yin// zhes gsungs pas legs par grub bo// brgyad pa/ 'dul ba'i sde snod ni bden bzhi'i chos kyi 'khor lo bya ba 'di la/ lung sde bzhi'i brjod bya dgag bcas dang sgrub bcas gnyis su 'du bas/ rnam 'byed dgag bcas te ltung ba sde lnga po ston pa dang*/ sgrub bcas gzhi bcu bdun bshad pa lung gzhi dang*/ phran tshegs de gnyis kyi lhan thabs dang*/ de la the tshom gcod pa zhu ba rnams kyis bden pa bzhi rgyas par 'chad pa yin la/ sems can rnams kyis 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la bde bar rlom pa la/ 'phags pa rnams kyis sdug bsngal bar gzigs pas sdug bsngal 'phags pa'i bden pa/ sems can rnams kyis sdug bsngal gyi rgyu kun 'byung la sdug bsngal 'ong ba ma shes shing*/ de mkhyen pas kun 'byung 'phags pa'i bden pa/ kun 'byung de spangs na 'bras bu 'gog pa 'ong bar sems can rnams kyis ma shes shing*/

'phags pas de mkhyen pas 'gog pa 'phags pa'i bden pa/ kun 'byung spong ba'i gnyen po lam brgyad nyams su len pa sems can rnams kyis ma shes pa/ 'phags pas mkhyen pas lam 'phags pa'i bden pa yin la/ de dag ni brjod bya rjod byed gnyis ka 'dul ba'i sde snod 'ba' zhig tu nges te/ chos kyi 'khor lo'i mdo dang*/ 'dul ba'i sde snod las/ dge slong dag /nga dang khyed cag kho na las// 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po dag /ji lta ba bzhin ma mthong bas// yun ring lam du 'khor bar 'gyur// bden pa de dag mthong nas ni| |srid pa'i srid pa rab bcad de// skye ba'i 'khor lo zad pa na// da ni srid pa gzhan med do// zhes dang*/ slob dpon 'phags pa'i mchod rten brgyad kyi bstod pa las/ kā shi ka yi wā rā ṇa sī ru// chos kyi 'khor lo rnam grol rmad byung bas// nyon mongs sgrib pa rnam par gcod mdzad pa'i// ye shes mchod rten bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro| |dgu pa/ theg pa sna tshogs ston pa nyid nges don chos kyi 'khor lo bya ba 'di la/ spyir yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos thams cad mnyam pa chen po'i ngo bor sangs rgyas nas sems can thams cad kyi gshis babs stong nyid rgyu 'bras su gsungs pa nyid yin la/ bye brag tu chos 'khor bar pa nges don dang tha ma theg pa sna tshogs su bstan par bzhed pa rnams ni rnam par ma brtag pa ste/ gong du byang chub sems dpa' don dam yang dag 'phags kyis zhus pa'i mdo'i lung drangs pas kyang 'khor lo bar pa mtshan nyid med pa rtsod pa'i gzhir gyur pa dang*/ tha ma nges pa'i don rtsod pa'i gzhir ma gyur par grub la/ de tsam du ma zad don gyi cha nas 'khor lo gsum ga nges pa'i don gcig pu las gzhan pa'i rnam grangs ma gsungs te/ ci'i phyir na/ sangs rgyas mtha' gnyis su mi gsung ba'i phyir myang 'das dngos po'i blo can bzlog pa'i phyir stong nyid gsungs te/

dbu ma la 'jug pa las| myang 'das dngos po'i blo can gyi// 'dzin pa bzlog par bya ba'i phyir// don dam mkhyen pas don dam pa// stong pa nyid ni ston par mdzad// ces stong nyid gsungs pa 'khor lo bar pa'i dgongs pa yin la stong pa de yang gshis babs las gzhan pa'i med dgag sogs gangs can pa phyi ma 'ga' zhig gis lta ba 'di 'dra ba la dgongs nas/ ji skad du/ stong pa nyid la lta nyes na// shes rab chung rnams phung bar 'gyur// zhes rtag chad kyi lta ba gnyis dug can du bzhag nas 'khor lo tha mar mtha' bral zung 'jug stong nyid rgyu 'bras kyi tshul du gsungs te/ mgon po byams pas/ 'di la bsal bya ci yang med// bzhag par bya ba cung zad med// yang dag nyid la yang dag lta// yang dag mthong na rnam par grol// zhes sogs mtha' yas par gsungs shing*/ ting 'dzin rgyal po dang*/ blo gros mi zad pas bstan pa dang*/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod sogs las gsungs pa rnams kyang 'di kho na'i nges pa nyid du zad do// bcu pa/ mtha' drug tu gsungs pa thams cad nges don 'ba' zhig tu bzhed pa ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyam nyid zhi ba chen po las gzhan du mi 'gyur ba'i phyir dam pa'i chos rnams kyang rnam pa gcig las gzhan du mi 'gyur zhing*/ la lar drang don/ la lar nges don sogs mtha' drug gi bden rdzun mang du gsungs pa mi srid de/ zla ba sgron ma las/ gzhon nu khyod la bsgo zhing bstan par bya// dad par gyis shig nga la mi bden med// bde gshegs rdzun gyi tshig ni mi smra ste// thugs rjes rgyal ba rtag tu bden par gsungs// sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bden par gsungs pa/ rigs par gsungs pa/ tshad mar gsungs pa/ nges par gsungs pa ste/ de bzhin gshegs pas chos thams cad rlabs po che gsungs pa'i dus su pha rol po'i log rtog bsal ba'i phyir/ ljags la dpang po mdzad nas/

ljags yangs shing srab la dmar bas/ zhing khams mtha' yas pa'am/ mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams sam/ 'khor 'dus pa de'am/ zhal gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad la khyab par mdzad nas/ kun dga' bo gang sems can rdzun du smra ba dag la ljags kyi dbang po 'di lta bu yod dam/ ljags kyi dbang po 'di lta bu dang ldan pas log par smra'am/ gzhan du smra bar 'gyur ram/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir| des na theg pa gsum gyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad nges don 'ba' zhig las gzhan med la/ sngags kyi rgyud rnams nas kyang brda dang rtags kyi sgo nas gsungs pa rnams la deng sang dgongs pa can dang dgongs min sogs kyi bshad pa byed pa mtha' yas mod/ de yang rnam par 'khyams te/ sngags gsar ma'i zhing bcu rlung dang rtog par gsungs pa sogs dang*/ mchod rten la phyag mi bya ba dang*/ sring mo las rgyar bsten pa sogs gsungs kyang*/ theg dman la phyag mi bya ba dang*/ shes rab kyi phyag rgya dang mi 'bral ba sogs brda'i sgo nas gsungs la/ sngags rnying mar/ dbus kyi ka ba bsgyel na brtan// shar gyi skar khung dgag na gsal// drin can pha ma bsad na dge// sogs gsungs pa yang las rlung rtsa dbu mar bcings pas ma dag pa'i rtsa rlung thig le ye shes su bsgyur ba dang*/ mthong ba'i yul yul can tha mi dad par bsgoms pas rang snang gi ye shes rgyud la skye ba dang*/ khams nyi zla'i 'gros rba rlabs kyis bcad pas thabs shes zung 'jug gi sku 'grub pa'am/ yang na zhe sdang dang 'dod chags bsre 'phos gnad du bsnun pas grol ba sogs la dgongs shing brda mdzad pa ni gsang sgrog la dgongs kyi/ de las gzhan du tshul mang po gsungs par sems pa rnams ni log pa'i rtog pa nyid du bas pas/ des na 'di ni drang don/ dgongs pa can/ sgra ji bzhin ma yin pa rdzun ma lta bu ste spang dgos/ 'di ni nges don/ dgongs min/ sgra ji bzhin pa bden pa ste blang ngo zhes/

rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gsung la bden rdzun gyi phyogs ris su bcad nas spang blang bya ba ni rnam pa kun tu mi zad pa sdig pa'i las rngam po che ste/ mgon po byams pas/ gang zhig rgyal las ches mkhas 'ga' yang 'jig rten 'di na yod min te// ma lus de nyid mchog ni tshul bzhin kun mkhyen gyis mkhyen gzhan min pas// de phyir drang srong rang nyid kyis bzhag mdo sde gang yin de mi dkrug /thub tshul bshig phyir de yang dam chos la ni gnod pa byed par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas/ rgyal bas rnam pa gcig po nyid du gsungs pa la phyi rabs pas mtha' drug sogs kyi bshad pa nges don du nyams su blangs nas spang blang byed cing drang nges dang mtha' drug zer ba'i rjod byed mchor chas su byas nas/ brjod bya rgyal ba'i bka' la bden rdzun gyi stangs gcod byed pa ni thar pa med pa'i las kho na te/ mgon po byams pas/ gang zhig yid ni chos la sdang ba de la thar pa ga la yod// ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro// bcu gcig pa/ sems tsam ston pa'i bka' nyid dbu ma ston zhes gsungs pa ni/ rgyu mtshan gsum gyis bshad de/ rgyal ba'i bka' dang*/ de'i dgongs 'grel mkhan po dang*/ mgon po phag mo gru pa'i gsungs dang gsum gyis gtan la phab ste/ dang po lang kar gshegs pa las/ sems tsam du ni rtogs pa dang*// dngos po thams cad rnam bsal bas// phyi rol rtog pa rnam bzlog ste// lam de nyid ni dbu ma'o| |zhes gsungs shing*/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad kyang thog mar sems tsam du go zhing*/ sems kyang ngo bo ngos bzung du ma grub la/ de yang yod pa dang med pa'i mtha' gnyis las 'das shing*/ rnam kun mchog ldan gyi chos kyi dbyings dbu ma chen po mngon du gyur pa'i phyir/ dper na tshes gsum gyi zla ba dang bco lnga'i zla ba gnyis yongs su rdzogs ma rdzogs las zla bar mtshungs pa dang*/ myu gu las 'bras bu 'byung phyir mtshungs pa lta bu ste/

mgon po byams pas/ sems las gzhan med pa ni blos rig nas// de nas sems kyang med pa nyid du rtogs// blo dang ldan pas gnyis po med rig nas// de mi ldan pa chos kyi dbyings la gnas/ zhes gsungs so// gnyis pa ni/ slob dpon klu sgrub dbu ma'i srol 'byed yin pa dbu ma'i bka' sher phyin sogs nas lung ma bstan par/ sprin chen po dang*/ rnga bo che dang*/ lang gshegs sogs nas lung bstan la/ dbu ma rtsa sher lang gshegs la brten nas rab byed nyer bdun pa mdzad pa dang*/ sangs rgyas phal chen gyi snying po sa bcu pa'i mdo slob dpon zla grags kyis dbu ma 'jug pa'i gzhung du bsdus pa'i phyir dang*/ gsum pa ni/ rdo sher mar mgon po phag mo gru pa'i gsung gis zla shod sman pa'i da li bdun pa'i dpe ltar gsungs pa sogs kyis bsnyon med du grub pa yin no// bcu gnyis pa/ log pa'i kun rdzob kyis kyang don byed nus par bzhed pa ni/ 'dir don byed ces pa las bzang ngan gyi mtha' gcig tu ma bzhag pas log pa'i kun rdzob kyis bzang ngan gnyis ka'i don byed nus pa 'ba' zhig ste/ bzang po ni chu nang du shar ba'i gzugs brnyan la brten nas btsun mo ri dwags ma'i bu lnga brgyas byang chub thob pa dang*/ bram ze chen po sa ra has thod chang gi nang du ldum ri'i rtsi shing sna tshogs pa'i gzugs brnyan shar ba mthong ba la brten nas gnas lugs gdod ma'i ngo bo nyid rtogs pa dang*/ sgyu ma mkhan gyi sgyu ma'i rnam rol mthong ba la brten nas skye bo mang po byang chub thob pa sogs dpag tu med pa bshad la/ ngan pa'i don byed ni/ 'dul ba lung las/ khron pa'i nang du zla ba'i gzugs brnyan shar ba spre'u lnga brgyas mthong bas de 'don pa'i ched du gcig la gcig 'jus te 'don par brtsams pas spre'u thams cad tshe'i dus byas pa sogs gsung rab rnams nas gleng gzhi mang du gsungs pas kyang shes la|

yang dag dang log pa'i khyad par ni/ rgyu nam mkha'i zla ba rkyen sa gzhi'i khron pa/ rten 'brel gyi babs kyis mi rnams kyi mthong yul du snang ba sogs gang gi cha nas kyang mi phyed la/ de dag ni rgyu dus dang de dus kyi kun slong gnyis ka dge bas kun nas bslangs shing spyad na rnam smin dge ba nyid 'byung ba yang dag pa'i kun rdzob ste/ slob dpon legs ldan 'byed kyis/ yang dag kun rdzob rnams kyi skas// med par don dam khang chen gyi// steng du 'gro bar 'dod pa ni// mkhas la rung ba ma yin no// zhes dang*/ zhi ba lhas/ yan lag 'di dag thams cad ni// thub pas shes rab don du gsungs// zhes so/ don gyi ngo bor chos thams cad gdod ma nas ma skyes pa'am/ ma byung ba'am yod ma myong ba'i phyir 'khor 'das thams cad kyang kun rdzob 'ba' zhig las don dam du yod par khas mi len zhing*/ kun rdzob des don dam rtogs pa'i rgyu byed de/ mgon po byams pas/ dmigs pa la ni brten nas su// mi dmigs pa ni rab tu skye// zhes dang*/ sdud pa las/ yod dang med pa 'di gnyis med pa'i chos yin te// byang chub sems dpa' gang gis 'di shes nges par 'byung*// zhes sogs gsungs pas mthar thug kun rdzob las gzhan pa'i chos med pa'i phyir ro// de la yang dbye na kun rdzob la gnyis su dbye ba ltar/ don dam la yang rnam grangs stong nyid bco brgyad sogs brjod byar bzhag pa rnams dang*/ rnam grangs ma yin pa skye med phyag rgya chen po brjod pa'i yul las 'das pa nyid yin no// jo bo rjes/ chu zla dang grub mtha' ngan pa'i rtog par gsungs pa ni 'khrul ba las nying 'khrul du 'gyur ba la dgongs kyi/ don byed mi nus pa la ma dgongs pas dgongs pa 'di dang mi 'gal lo// bcu gsum pa/ lam thams cad sa bcus bgrod bya ba ni/ mdo sngags gnyis kas sangs rgyas thob pa la lam sa bcus bgrod par mtshungs te/

rgyu mtshan sa dang por chos nyid kyi bden pa mthong nas/ sgom lam sa dgu bgrod cing sa bcu rgyun mtha' la shes sgrib spangs nas rdzogs byang thob dgos pa'i phyir/ de yang myur bul ni brtson pa che chung dang*/ snga ma'i las 'phro dang sbyang stobs sogs kyi dbye bas rnam pa sna tshogs su 'gyur te/ mtshan nyid kyi snying rje chen po'i rang bzhin gyi gzungs las/ rje btsun spyan ras gzigs sa dang po'i tshe/ sangs rgyas 'od zer stong gi rgyal po yang dag par gnas pa las gzungs de thos pa'i mod la sa brgyad pa thob par gyur pa dang*/ gsang chen thabs mkhas las/ byang sems dga' byed sa dang po'i dus su nyon mongs kyi ngo bo mthong bas sa brgyad pa thob par gsungs shing*/ sngags la rgyal po in+d+ra bhū ti lta bu tshe gcig la dbang bzhi pa'i ngo sprod thob pa tsam gyis mchog gi dngos grub thob pa sogs myur bul ni sngar bshad pa ltar yin la/ de'i dpe yang 'grel pa snga ma rnams su gos bcu brtsegs te bltabs par mda' 'phang na shugs che bas skad cig la 'bigs shing chung bas rim gyis 'bigs la myur bul las don du rim gyis ma gtogs snga ma ma phug pa phyi ma 'bigs mi srid par bshad pa ltar dang*/ 'dir ni yul 'di nas yul gzhan du 'gro bar mi'i rkang pas lam la phyin nas slebs pa dang*/ 'dab chags kyis nam mkhar 'phur te phyin pa gnyis/ mis lam bgrod pa dang 'dab chags nam mkhar 'phur nas lam la bgrod pa'i tha snyad 'dogs kyang*/ don du yul de gnyis kyi bar gyi mkha' la 'phur bas bgrod bya sa gzhi'i khyon de las gzhan med pa ltar mdo sngags dang*/ rim gyis pa dang cig car ba sogs gang yang myur bul tsam las gzhan pa sa bcu ma bgrod pa'i sangs rgyas 'byung mi srid pa'i phyir ro// gal te mtshan nyid theg par sa lam rim bgrod du mthun yang sngags bla med kyis lam brtsi mi dgos par skad cig mar 'dod na/

sngags lam gyi rtsa ba smin grol las gzhan med la/ smin lam gyi skabs bum dbang nas bzhi pa'i bar la sa lam gyi mngon rtogs 'grub tshul dang*/ grol lam gyi bskyed rdzogs nyams su blangs pa'i 'bras bu sa dang po nas bcu pa'i steng du gsum bsnan pa thob tshul rgyud sde rnams nas bshad pa la ci'i phyir bsnyon/ 'on te phyag rdzogs pa rnams kyang rtogs pa skad cig mas sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa yang sngar gyi dpe ltar myur bul las gzhan pa'i mdo sngags gnyis las tha dad pa'i lam zhig yod na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis ma gsungs pa'i lam du thal bas de 'dra ba'i lam gyi mdo ni blos gzhal bar dka' 'o// des na rdzogs byang thob pa ni rgyu dang 'bras bu'i tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i mthus grub pa'o| |yang rnal 'byor bzhi rim ltar rtogs pa gong nas gong du 'phos pa'am rtsal rdzogs pa'i tshe de dag gi lam rtags sa bcu dang lam lnga bgrod pa'i dbang du byas te/ 'di ni ming mang yang don mtshungs pa kho na ste dper na zan dang spags zhes pa dang tshul mtshungs pas/ des na mdo sngags gang la'ang lam thams cad sa bcus ma bgrod pa'i sangs rgyas mi srid de/ 'phags pa sdud pa las/ de dag dge ba'i rtsa ba ji srid ma rdzogs pa// de srid stong nyid dam pa de ni thob mi byed// ces gsungs la stong nyid dam pa ni rang re dpal ldan dwags po bka' brgyud rin po che 'di nyid kyi bzhed pa sgom med chen po'i rtogs pa sangs rgyas kyi sar bzhed pa dang don mthun pa'i phyir rnam par bshad pa dag go// 'ga' zhig gis tshogs ma bsags par sangs rgyas zhes zur ngom dang dpa' gtam du byed pa ni tshogs ma bsags pa'i sangs rgyas ni rgyu med pa'i 'bras bu ste tshul de 'dra ba da dung legs par soms shig /bcu bzhi pa/ lam thams cad rim gyis 'jug bya ba ni/ mtshan nyid phar phyin theg pa'i lam phar phyir drug sogs kyang rim gyis nyams su blang dgos par dgongs nas/

dbu ma la 'jug pa las/ skye bo 'di kun bde ba mngon 'dod cing*// mi rnams bde ba'ang longs spyod med min la// longs spyod kyang ni sbyin las 'byung mkhyen nas// thub pas dang po sbyin pa'i gtam mdzad do| |zhes sogs gsungs pa dang*/ sngags bla med la ni spyi dang bye brag gnyis te/ spyir sems can rnams rdo rje theg pa'i sgor 'jug pa ni rim gyis ma gtogs cig car du 'jug pa ni ches smad cing bkag ste/ brtag gnyis las/ dang por gso sbyong sbyin par bya// zhes sogs nas/ sngags kyi rim pa kun shes nas// de rjes kye yi rdo rje brtsam| |zhes pas dang po nyid nas bstan pa la ma zhugs pa'i so skye la thog mar bsnyen gnas nas bzung grub mtha' rnams dbu ma'i bar du bshad nas/ sngags kyi rim pa zhes pa dbu ma'i rjes su bya spyod rnal 'byor rnams bshad pas rgyud sbyangs pa la kye rdo rje sogs bla med ston gyi thog ma nyid nas byung rgyal du mi ston la/ bye brag bstan pa la zhugs zin so thar ris brgyad gang rung dang byang sdom sogs ldan rung la dbang bskur yang*/ gsol gdab dang sdom bzung gnyis kar nan chags kyis/ thog mar skyabs 'gro so thar gyi sdom pa/ de rjes smon 'jug gi sems bskyed/ khyad par sngags su sems bskyed pa zla rdor kyi rnam pa can/ de rjes rigs lnga spyi bye brag gi sdom bzung*/ de nas bum dbang nas bzhi pa'i bar rim gyis bskur zhing go don sprod pa lam rim go ma log pa dang*/ khyad par sngags la zhugs zin la yang smin lam ma bskur bar grol lam mi ston pa dang*/ rgyud kyi lung tsam gyi snga rol du yang dbang bskur ba sogs lam rim gyis pa la yang sgrig chags shin tu dam par mdzad pa dang*/ phyag chen lta bu la yang cig car ba zhes pa rtogs pa skye shin tu sla ba la dgongs kyang*/ sbyangs pa sngon song can zhig ma gtogs las 'phro med pa la mi srid pa'i phyir sngon nas lam rim gyis bsags sbyang byas pa zhig nges par dgos pa dang*/

de yang bram ze chen po sa ra ha cig car bar grags mod| de yang sngon nas sbyangs pa'i 'phro sad pa dang*/ rtogs pa ngo 'phrod pa yang rgyu med rkyen med ma yin par thod chang gi nang du rtsi ldum gyi gzugs brnyan shar ba'i rkyen des ngo 'phrod pa yang rgyu rkyen de la ltos pas rim gyis pa kho na yin la/ cig car ba'i dpe lung pa khad dog pa'i nyi ma dang 'dra/ rim gyis pa'i dpe lung pa khad yangs kyi nyi ma la sbyor ba ni dwags po bka' brgyud pa rnams la rlung ltar grags mod/ de la dpyad na lung pa khad yangs kyi nyi ma ri rtse nas thon 'phral dro 'jam gyi nus pa mi 'byin la rim gyis grang ba skyob pa sogs byed/ sa rong gi nyi ma shar ma thag dro 'jam bsil skyob kyi bya ba byed pa ltar/ rim gyis pa'i rtogs pa gnas 'gyu nas sgom med kyi bar rim can gyis 'bad rtsol la ltos shing yon tan skye dka' la/ cig car ba ngo 'phrod ma thag sems kyi rang ngo mthong zhing yon tan skye ba la shugs che bar dgongs mod/ gzhan gyi 'dod pa ltar na rim gyis pa'i dpe la 'dod pa gcig kyang*/ cig car ba'i don gyi go ba de la dpyad na dpe'i nyi ma de yang sa rong yin yang shar ri la 'dzeg pa sogs rim gyis 'char ba mi byed par skad cig de nyid la nam mkha'i dbus nas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'char ba zhig tu thal ba dang*/ skad cig dran rdzogs kyi dper chu las nya 'phar ba sogs bshad mod/ de yang zhib tu brtag na myur ba la skad cig ma'i brjod bya btags pa tsam las cung zad rim gyis lngang ba kho nar nges la/ gzhan yang dpal phag mo gru pas/ cig car 'jug pa'i gang zag de// tshogs bsags bsags pa yi gang zag yin// rgyud sbyangs sbyangs pa yi gang zag yin// blo btul btul ba yi gang zag yin// nyams skyes skyes pa yi gang zag yin// zhes gsungs pa ni skye ba 'di'i rim gyis par yang ma zad skye ba mang po'i snga rol nas bsags sbyang byas pa la dgongs pas tshe 'di'i rtogs pa skye myur ba cig car ba zhes bod pa de yang skye ba snga ma nas rim gyis sbyangs pa la dgongs so| |bco lnga pa/

shes bya'i sgrib pa sngon la spong ba'ang yod ces bya ba 'di ni'ang gi sgras sgrib gnyis byang nas rdzogs byang thob pa gang zhig /shes bya'i sgrib pa sngon la spong bas khyab ces mtha' gcig tu bzhag pa ma yin gyi/ sbyang bya sgrib pa gnyis las shes sgrib rjes kho nar spong ba'i nges pa yang med pas sngon la spong ba'ang yod ces pa la dgongs kyi/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni spyir sgrib pa gsum zhes bshad na'ang*/ nyon sgrib ni lhan skyes kyi sgrib pa yin la gzhan gnyis ni bsags pa'i sgrib pa ste des na gzhan gnyis la nyon sgrib kyis khyab cing rtsa ba lta bur 'dod la| nyon mongs dang shes bya'i sgrib pa gnyis kyi mtshan nyid ni/ mgon po byams pas/ 'khor gsum rnam par rtog pa gang*// de ni shes bya'i sgrib par 'dod// ser sna la sogs rnam rtog gang*// de ni nyon mongs sgrib par 'dod// ces shes sgrib kyi khongs su las sgrib kyang bsdus pas sgrib pa gnyis zhes bshad la/ rje sgam po pa mi la'i drung du byon dus yab sras gsung gleng mdzad pa'i tshe/ rje btsun gyis/ dbus pa ston pa khyod kyis chos ci shes gsungs pa la/ sgam po pas/ bka' gdams kyi blo sbyong sogs dang*/ gzhan yang tshogs lam la las sgrib spong*/ sbyor lam la nyon sgrib spong*/ mthong lam nas sa bcu pa'i bar shes sgrib spong dgos tshul zhus pas/ rje btsun gyis nga ni shes bya'i sgrib pa sngon la spong bar 'dod pa yin gsungs/ 'o na sgrib pa gnyis po ji ltar mchi zhus pas/ gnyis po sgrog rang brdal la 'gro gsungs pa dang*/ mgon po phag mo gru pas/ de yab sras gnyis ka bden zhes gsungs/ rje sgam po pas lhan cig skyes pa'i ma rig pa la ko long ma sol na rtogs pa mi skye gsungs pas/ rtogs bya'am shes par bya rgyu'i sgrib par shes sgrib zer/ de ni 'khor gsum gyi dri bcas phra rags su gcig pa ni mgon po byams pa'i gsungs de ltar yin la/

des na 'ga' zhig ni gzhan gyi 'dod pa ltar sgrib pa rags pa gnyis sngon la spong rjes la shes sgrib phra ba spong*/ 'ga' zhig thog mar mngon rtogs kyi khyad par gyis phra ba sngon la spong bas rags pa zhar byung du spong ba la dgongs/ de yang sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i phyag rgya bzhi'i skabs su gos btso glag mkhan gyis dri ma rags pa ni 'dag byed dang rtsol ba chung ngus 'dag la/ dri ma phra ba ni 'dag byed dang rtsol ba chen po dgos par gsungs pa dang 'dra bas| shes sgrib 'khor gsum rnam par rtog pa'i dri ma phra mo de 'bad rtsol chen pos thog mar spangs na ser sna sogs kyi rtog pa'i nyon sgrib dang des bsags pa'i las sgrib rnams rang shugs kyis 'dag pa kho nar nges la/ skabs 'dir mtshungs med nam blo ba'i mchan bur/ so sor rang rig gi lta ba mngon sum du rtogs pa'i tshe sgrib pa mtha' dag rang dwangs su 'gyur bas shes sgrib sngon du spong bar grub bo zhes pa shin tu legs la/ des na gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pas sgrib pa gnyis dang*/ chos kyi bdag med rtogs pas shes sgrib spong dgos pa'i phyir gang zag gi bdag med kyis shes sgrib mi spong bas/ chos kyi bdag med rtogs pas shes sgrib dag pa'i tshe/ gang zag gi bdag rang shugs kyis med par rtogs shing sgrib pa gzhan gnyis mi spong ka med la dgongs/ 'ang gi sgras shes sgrib sngon la spong ba kho nar mtha' gcig tu ma bzhag la/ gang zag so so'i nyams len gyi 'gros kyis skabs so sor 'gyur ba la dgongs so// bcu drug pa/ tshad ma sangs rgyas kyi mkhyen pa'i ye shes yin bya ba ni/ 'ga' zhig gis tshad ma zhes pa/ rtog ge'i gnas su 'dod mod/ de ni don la 'khrul ba ste/ thal phyir sogs tha snyad la zhen pa ni rtog ge'i gnas yin yang*/ tshad ma zhes pa ni mi bslu zhing drang po'i don yin la de ni thams cad mkhyen pa kho na'i spyod yul te|

tshad ma kun las btus par/ tshad mar gyur pa 'gro la phan bzhed pa// ston pa bde gshegs skyob la phyag 'tshal te// zhes tshad mar gyur pa ston pa kho nar nges pa dang*/ tshad ma rnam nges las/ phan pa dang mi phan pa thob pa dang spong ba ni nges par yang dag pa'i shes pa sdon du 'gro ba can yin pas/ de mi shes pa rnams kyi don du bdag gis 'di brtsams zhes 'byung ba dang*/ phung po gsum pa'i mdo las/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ye shes su gyur pa/ spyan du gyur pa/ dpang du gyur pa/ tshad mar gyur pa/ mkhyen pas gzigs pa zhes sogs 'byung bas kyang grub la/ rig pa ni khyi mgo rdo ril dang ri bong rwa sogs mi srid pa'i dpe dang*/ ka bum sogs dngos po gzhal bya dang*/ kha dog dkar dmar sogs dkar po la nag po'am dmar po'i mdog med par ston pa sogs gnas skabs su thal phyir rtog btags ltar snang yang*/ mthar thug gshis la med par bltas pas mi 'gyur zhing gshis babs kyi gnas tshul kho na bstan pa nyid yin pas kyang tshad ma ni dpe don gnyis ka'i cha nas sangs rgyas kyi mkhyen pa'i ye shes kho nar nges pa'i phyir lung rigs mang du 'byung yang yi ges 'jigs pas de tsam du bzhag go// bcu bdun pa/ tshad ma'i 'bras bu chos nyid stong pa nyid ston par bzhed pa ni/ rtog ge'i tshad ma la/ the tshom/ yid dpyod/ log shes/ dpyad shes/ snang la ma nges pa ste tshad ma ma yin pa'i blo lnga/ mngon sum tshad ma dang rjes dpag tshad ma ste blo rnam pa bdun du gsungs/ mngon sum la/ dbang po'i mngon sum/ yid kyi mngon sum/ rang rig mngon sum/ rnam 'byor mngon sum ste bzhi'i dang po gnyis kyis yul drug mngon sum byed na'ang skye med kyi don la tshad ma mthar thug min te/ zla ba sgron ma'am ting 'dzin rgyal por/ mig dang rna ba sna yang tshad ma min// lce dang lus dang yid kyang tshad ma min// gal te dbang po 'di dag tshad yin na// 'phags pa'i lam gyis su la ci zhig bya// zhes gsungs pas snga ma gnyis kyis don spyi tsam las mi rtogs/

phyi ma gnyis kyis zhi lhag zung 'brel sgrub tshul kho na yod pas chos nyid rtogs par dbu ma sogs thams cad dang mthun no// rnam 'byor mngon sum de ni 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag yin pas/ stong nyid rgyu 'bras don rang gi khong du chud cing*/ yid mngon gyis yul lnga mngon du ma gyur kyang sngar mngon du byas zin gyi yid chos gtan la 'bebs/ de'i khongs su ma 'dus pa'i sems dang sems kyi rang bzhin rang rig mngon sum gyis nges par byed pa'i phyir ro// yang na dbang po mngon sum gyis yul lnga yid chos rang rig gi tshor ba bde sdug btang snyoms rnams gtan la 'bebs pas so// rjes dpag tshad ma la rgyu'i rtags/ 'bras bu'i rtags/ rang bzhin gyi rtags/ mi dmigs pa'i rtags te bzhi las/ rgyus 'bras bu dpog pa ma nges pa'i rtags/ 'bras bus rgyu dpog pa yang dag pa'i rtags/ yod pas yod pa sgrub pa rang bzhin gyi rtags/ med pas med pa sgrub pa mi dmigs pa'i rtags te bzhi'i nang nas yang dag gi rtags des/ chos thams cad rgyu 'bras rten 'brel don mthun rjes su dpag pas go bar 'gyur bas rgyu 'bras la rmongs pa'i ma rig pa dang bral/ rgyu 'bras kyang rkyen bzhi la rags las pas rgyu rkyen rten 'brel gyi sgro 'dogs chod/ de yang skye med mngon sum tshad mas ji lta ba bzhin rtogs pas tshad ma'i 'bras bu stong pa nyid ston par grub la/ gzhan yang rnam 'grel las/ rtog pa'i dra ba rnam bsal zhing*// zab cing rgya che'i sku mnga' ba// kun tu bzang po'i 'od zer dag |kun nas 'phro la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas kyang bstan bcos 'di'i lus rnam bzhag zab mo stong pa nyid ston pa'i brjod bya yin la/ yang rnam 'grel las/ gang gi dngos po rnam dpyad na// de nyid du ni de dngos med// gang gi phyir na de dag la// gcig dang du ma'i rang bzhin med// ces gsungs shing rkang pa dang po'i dpyad na zhes par 'gyur 'ga' zhig tu brtag na zhes 'byung ba don 'dra bas/

lung 'di yang nges don phyag rgya chen po dang dbu ma'i don dpyis phyin pa'i lung yin pas na tshad ma'i 'bras bu stong nyid ston par nges shing*/ gzhan yang ji skad du/ tha snyad la ni ma brten par// dam pa'i don ni rtogs mi 'gyur// dam pa'i don ni ma rtogs par// mya ngan 'das pa 'thob mi 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa sogs mdor na tha snyad rig pa thams cad kyang chos nyid stong pa nyid kho na ston pa'i thabs su gsungs pa rnam grangs ches mang ngo*// bco brgyad pa/ grub mtha' 'dzin pa thams cad rang rgyud pa zhes gsungs pa ni/ spyir 'phags pa'i yul du phyi nang gnyis las phyi pa'i lta grub ni brjod ma dgos la/ nang pa la yang rtag chad kyi mtha' la zhen pa'i ming grub mthar btags pas blo bsgyur ba'i gang zag so so rang rgyud la lta ba de 'dra ba bdag gir 'dzin pas rang rgyud pa zhes bya la/ de yang dper na dman pa 'jig rten pa la yang nga pha 'di'i bu rigs rgyud 'di lta bu zhes rtag lta dang cha mthun pa dang*/ las kyi dge sdig mthong tshe nyes pa de lta bu yod na gom pa 'dor mi nus chos bya thabs ci yod ces dang*/ phan yon mthong tshe phan yon 'di 'dra ba yod na sangs rgyas sgrub pa las sla bsam pa'i rgyu 'bras la yid mi ches pa chad lta dang cha mthun pa dang*/ bzang ngan gyi las thams cad phywas bskos gnam gyis byas zer ba sogs byed pa po yod pa'i lta ba dang cha 'dra ba dang*/ chos pa rnams kyang nyan thos grub mtha' smra ba gnyis nas theg chen dbu sems kyi bar du nga'i grub mtha' 'di lta bu zhes nga yir 'dzin cing bstod pa dang*/ kho'i grub mtha' 'di 'dra'o zhes smod cing gshe ba sogs rang rgyud gnyis 'dzin gyi sgrog tu chud pa bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa rnam dag tu khas len pa dag rdzogs byang lta zhog |'khor bar 'khor ba'i las kyi gtso bo yang byed de/ dbu ma la 'jug par/ dang por nga zhes bdag la zhen gyur cing*// bdag gi 'di zhes dngos la chags gyur nas// zo chun 'phyan ltar rang dbang med pa yi// 'gro la snying rjer gyur gang de la 'dud// ces so/

des na chos thams cad bdag med dam pa'i don stong nyid mtha' dang bral ba dgongs pa'i zhe phugs yin pa dang*/ gzung 'dzin bdag dang bdag gir gyi rtog pa 'joms pa'i gnyen po dpyis phyin pa yin na/ gnyen po de nyid la 'dzin stangs grub mtha'i dngos por bzung bas sman dug tu song ba dang 'dra ste/ mdo sde rgyan las/ 'di ltar chos rnams thams cad ni// bdag med dam pa'i don du na// stong nyid bdag tu dmigs pa ni// nyes par bshad pa kho na'o// zhes so| |de ltar rang rang gi grub pa'i mtha' zhes nga yir 'dzin pa ni thar pa'i gegs yin la dmyal bar song ba las kyang ches dman te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ blo dang ldan pa dmyal bar gnas pa dus kun tu// byang chub dri med yangs pa'i bar du gcod byed min// theg pa gzhan la rab bsil rnam rtog bdag phan pa// rab tu bde bar gnas kyang bar du gcod par byed// ces so// deng sang gangs can 'dir bshad sgrub kyi bdag po 'ga' zhig don gnyis sgrub pa'i rgyal sras su khas 'che zhing*/ grub mtha' dang bshad sgrub kyi phyogs 'dzin nga bdag gis kun nas bslangs pa'i rang gi grub mtha' la bstod cing gzhan la dngos brgyud kyi sgo nas smod pa rlung ltar 'phyo ba 'di rnams ni rgyal sras lta zhog chos tshul tsam yang ma mthong bar nges te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ sgyu ma'i rgyal po'i sgyu ma yis// sgyu ma gzhan zhig pham pa ltar// gang dag gis ni chos mthong ba'i// rgyal sras de dag nga rgyal med| |ces bya ba la soms shig /gzhan yang gleng gzhi ni mauṅgal gyi bu'i las kyi rgyu ba bstan pa dang*/ dge slong nag po la bya rog zhar ma 'dra byas pa'i 'bras bu byung tshul dang*/ slob dpon chos mchog gi lo rgyus sogs rdo sher mar drangs pa ltar rtogs par bya zhing*/ dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su 'dzin pa'i mdo las/ bskal pa bye bar tshul khrims bsrungs byas shing*| |yun ring dus su bsam gtan sgom byed kyang*// yang dag nyid mtha' 'di ni ma shes na// bstan pa 'di la de dag blo yod min// zhes sogs gsungs pas mdor na gang zag dang chos kyi bdag gi dug ni bdag med pa'i shes rab kyis 'joms dgos te/

mtshan brjod las/ bdag med seṅge'i sgra dang ldan// mu stegs ri dwags ngan 'jigs byed// ces sogs mang du gsungs so// bcu dgu pa/ mu stegs pa la'ang gshis kyi dge ba'i bsgrub bya mang po yod par bzhed pa ni/ 'ang dang gshis skad kyis mu stegs la bden pa mthong ba'i nges don mthar thug gi lta ba rtogs pa dang ldan pa med kyang*/ gnas skabs su dge ba'i bsgrub bya mang po yod pas kho rang rnams gnas skabs su bde skyid dang mngon mtho'i 'bras bu thob pa'ang dge ba'i 'bras bu yin la/ mdor na mi dge ba sdug bsngal nyes pa'i rgyu sa bcu pa'i rgyud la 'dug kyang spong zhing*/ dge ba bde 'bras ni mu stegs la 'dug kyang byang chub 'dod pas blang dgos te/ de ltar ma zad gshis kyi dge ba bde 'bras thob byed dud 'gro la 'dug kyang bsten dgos pas so// mu stegs kyi dge ba'i bsgrub bya blang ba ni/ gzhi gsum gyi cho ga nang pa la med cing phyi rol pa la yod pas/ phyi rol pas 'phya ba la brten/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag /mu stegs byed rnams kyis 'phya ba ni thog tu bab pa yin pas/ de lta bas na da phyin chad dbyar gnas gso sbyong dgag dbye 'di rnams bya'o// zhes bcas pa lta bu dang*/ gzhan yang slob dpon chen po pad+ma saṃ bha was kyang mu stegs byed las srung ba dang zlog pa'i skor sogs gnas skabs kyi bar chad sel byed mang po len par mdzad pa sogs sngags gsar rnying gi lo rgyus rnams kyis kyang grub la/ don des na rnam pa kun tu dge ba'i las lam dngos brgyud rgyu dang dus kyi kun slong la ma ltos pa gang 'dug kyang*/ mthar thug rgyu 'bras dang mthun na blang zhing*/ mthar thug de las ldog pa ni spong dgos la/ de yang mchog dman gang yin yang brtags shing dpyad nas nyams su blang dgos te/ ji skad du/ dge slong dag gam mkhas rnams kyis// bsregs bcad bdar ba'i gser bzhin du// legs par brtags nas nga yi bka'// blang bar bya yi gus phyir min// zhes gsungs pas/

nyes pa zhig 'dug na bla ma'am rang rgyud dam mchog dman su la 'dug kyang 'dor la/ legs pa ni su la 'dug kyang blang*/ khyad par bla ma'i rgyud la ma legs pa 'dug kyang spong ba'i khar slar legs par bsgyur ba ni lhag par yang chos dang mthun te/ jo bo chen pos gser gling pa'i thugs rgyud kyi lta ba dbu mar bsgyur ba lta bu yin no// nyi shu pa/ phyi nang gi khyad par skyabs su 'gro bya ba ni/ 'ga' zhig gis phyi nang gi khyad par snying rje dang*/ bdag lta dang bka' rtags phyag rgya bzhi yod med dang spyod pa sogs kyis dbye bar 'dod kyang don min te/ rgyu mtshan nang pa la phyi pa las kyang dman pa'i rtag chad kyi lta ba 'dzin pa'ang yod pa'i phyir/ skyabs 'gros ni phyi nang gi dbye ba phyed pa tsam du'ang ma zad lta log dang theg dman sogs las skyob pa yang yin te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad dang*| |ngan song dang ni thabs min dang*// 'jigs tshogs theg pa dman pa las// skyob phyir skyabs kyi dam pa'o// zhes dang*/ mgon po phag mo gru pas/ de'i don 'grel pa la mkhas pa gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍi tas kyang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro bar mi byed na nang pa sangs rgyas par mi tshud la/ byed na blun po ba lang rdzi yi ge ka zhig mi shes pa'ang nang pa sangs rgyas par 'gyur bas/ de ltar na phyi nang gi khyad par skyabs su 'gro ba 'ba' zhig yin zhes gsungs/ skabs 'di'i skyabs yul la theg pa che chung dang mdo sngags kyi dbye ba la mi ltos/ ston pa shāka thub thugs chos sku mdzad pa dang bcas pa sangs rgyas/ gsung dang thugs la bzhugs pa'i gsung rab rnams chos/ sku mtshan dpe rdzogs pa dge 'dun nam 'khor rnam bzhi chos de rnams nyams su len pa dge 'dun te/ de dag la skyabs su 'gro ba ni nang pa/ de rnams la skyabs su mi 'gro ba ni phyi pa zhes dgongs so| |nyer gcig pa/ theg pa che chung gi khyad par sems bskyed bya ba ni/

theg pa che chung gi khyad par rgyu dang lam dang 'bras bu dang bdag med gnyis khas gang len sogs gang gis kyang mi phyed de/ de'i dbye ba ni byang chub kyi sems gcig po yod med kyis 'byed pa yin la/ de yang theg pa chen po zhes bya ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ dmigs pa che ba nyid dang ni| |de bzhin sgrub pa nyid dag dang*// ye shes brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang*// thabs la mkhas par gyur pa dang*// yang dag 'grub pa chen po dang*// sangs rgyas phrin las chen po ste| |chen po bdun dang ldan pa'i phyir// theg chen zhes ni nges par brjod// ces gsungs/ theg dman ni/ de nyid las/ ma tshang ba dang 'gal ba dang*// thabs min de ltar ma bstan phyir// nyan thos kyi ni theg pa 'di// theg chen chos zhes bya ba min// zhes theg pa chen po'i tshul ma tshang zhing gzhan phan gyi sems las 'gal ba sogs kyis nyan thos phyogs gcig pa theg dman du bzhag go// de lta bu'i dbye ba ni bshad ma thag pa'i lung ltar bla na med pa'i byang chub tu smon pa dang de la 'jug pa'i byang sems yod med kyi zlas phye ste/ jo bo rjes/ sems bskyed med na sngags bla med la zhugs kyang nyan rang gi byang chub las med cing sems bskyed dang ldan na 'tshang rgya ba la yun mi ring bar gsungs pa dang*/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir// yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod// ces dang*/ 'phags pa sdud pa las/ gzhan yang gzugs dang sgra dang de bzhin dri dang ro// reg dang 'dod yon lnga la mngon par spyod gyur kyang*// dgra bcom rang rgyal sems bral byang chub sems dga' na// dpa' bo rtag tu mnyam bzhag yin pa shes par bya// zhes so// de tsam du ma zad byang chub kyi sems las nyams na dgra bcom dang nyan rang gi sdom pa rnam par dag kyang tshul khrims 'chal ba zhes brjod la/ 'dod yon la sred kyang mchog gsum la skyabs su song zhing gzhan phan gyi ched du sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi smon 'jug dang ldan na tshul khrims dang ldan pa zhes bya ste/

sdud pa las/ chos gang nges pa'i byang chub yon tan 'byung 'gyur ba// de ni yon tan chos ldan rnams kyi tshul khrims don// chos gang phan byed rnams kyi byang chub yongs nyams pa// de ni tshul khrims 'chal zhes rnam par 'dren pas gsungs| |zhes dang*/ gal te byang chub sems dpa' 'dod yon lnga spyod kyang*// sangs rgyas chos dang 'phags pa'i dge 'dun skyabs song ste// sangs rgyas bsgrub bya snyam du kun mkhyen yid byed na// mkhas pa tshul khrims pha rol phyin gnas rig par bya// zhes so// nyan rang dang dgra bcom rnams kyang byang chub chen po thob par 'dod na rang rang gi sdom pa las nyams kyang byang chub kyi sems gnyis dang ldan pas mchog thob ste/ sdud pa las/ gal te rang rgyal dgra bcom byang chub reg 'dod na// tshul khrims 'chal zhing mi mkhas de bzhin spyod pa nyams// ci ste byang chub zhi ba mchog tu yongs bsngo na// 'dod yon brtson yang tshul khrims pha rol phyin la gnas// zhes so// byang sems dang mi ldan pa'i nyan rang ni rdzogs byang thob pa'i gegs la dmyal ba las kyang ches lhag ste/ ji skad du/ dmyal bar 'gro ba sangs rgyas pa'i// gtan gyi gegs byed ma yin te// nyan thos dang ni rang rgyal gyi// sa ni gtan gyi gegs yin no// zhes dang*/ ji skad du/ rang gi bu la'ang ma chags pa'i// nyan thos rnams ni skal pa dman// sems can thams cad bde mdzad pa'i// skal bzang phyag na rdo rje dpal| |zhes sogs gsungs so// gleng gzhi ni dkon brtsegs gsang chen thabs mkhas su dbang thob pa'i byang sems lta bu'o// nyer gnyis pa/ sngags mtshan nyid kyi khyad par dbang bya ba ni/ spyir sngags lam gyi dngos gzhi smin grol las gzhan med pa ste/ ji skad du/ smin pa dang ni grol ba'i lam// sangs rgyas byang chub bstan pa'i mchog /ces gsungs la/ mtshan nyid theg pa la ni de gnyis ka med pa'i phyir dang*/

smin grol gnyis kyang smin lam gtso che ba ni/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ gang zhig dkyil 'khor ma mthong bar// rnal 'byor pa ni dngos grub 'dod// mkha' la khu tshur gyis rdeg dang*// smig sgyu'i chu ni 'thung dang mtshungs// zhes dang*/ sa ra has/ dper na bu tsha med pa'i khyim// shi ba tsam gyis stong pa ltar// de bzhin dbang dang bral na ni// ye shes kun gyis stong pa nyid// ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na mdo sngags kyi khyad par dbang kho nar nges la/ de yang ji skad du/ don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang*// thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang*// dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas pas// sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags// zhes dbang de yang sems bskyed gnyis sogs gzugs can du bkod pa sogs kyis thabs la ma rmongs shing thabs mang ba dang*/ dam tshig las ma 'das na gzhan nyams len gang yang med na'ang skye ba bcu drug tshun la 'grub pas dka' ba med pa dang*/ don gyi ye shes brjod yul las 'das kyang tshig gis ngo sprod pa dbang rnon gyi gzhal bya ste tshul de lta bu sngags lam gyi dbang las mtshan nyid theg pa la med pa sogs kyi khyad par dbang kho nas 'byed par dgongs so// nyer gsum pa/ sngags dang mtshan nyid gang med kyang rdzogs pa'i byang chub mi thob par bzhed pa ni/ rang rgyud kyi dri ma rags pa rnams mtshan nyid theg pas spong*/ phra ba rnams sngags lam gyis spong ba'am/ yang na sngags sdom gyi rten du so byang gnyis med mi rung du dgos par gsungs pa dang*| jo bo rjes/ gsang sngags pha rol phyin pa la// brten nas byang chub sgrub par gsungs// zhes sogs dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma sgyu ma bde mchog las/ ri mo blug ma la sogs las| |rnal 'byor 'byung bar mi 'gyur te// byang chub sems la rab brtson na// de nyid rnal 'byor lhar 'gyur ro// zhes dang*/ sbyong rgyud las/ sangs rgyas kun gyi byang chub sems| |bla na med pa rtogs gyur na// rgyal bas gsungs pa'i ye shes gang*/

/de nyid dkyil 'khor snying por gsungs// zhes gsungs la/ rdo sher mar mtshan nyid ral gri dang sngags de la ngar btang ba'i dpe gsungs pa dang*/ gzhan yang sgrib pa rags pa spong bar mtshan nyid med na rgyal po in+d+ra bhū ti yang 'tshang mi rgya/ phra ba spong bar sngags med na byang sems nor bzang la sogs pa'ang 'tshang mi rgya ba'i phyir dang*/ gzhan yang jo bo rjes gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnal 'byor pa'am/ dgongs 'dus nas thar pa nag po'am/ nyan thos sen dha pa lta bu gsungs pa ste/ mdor na gsang sngags pas thog mar phar phyin theg pa la zhugs nas sa brgyad pa man thob par byas te/ sa brgyad pa nas sngags la zhugs shing sgrib pa phra ba rnams spangs te rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang byed pa ni/ bdag cag gi ston pas bskal pa mang por mgo dang yan lag sbyin pa gtong ba nas brtsams te mtshan nyid phar phyin theg pa'i spyod pa spyad pa'i mthar/ 'og min du rdo rje 'chang las dbang mnos te rdo rje 'dzin pa mngon du byas nas slar sprul pa rgyal bu don grub kyi lus rten la 'tshang rgya tshul bstan pa yang*/ ji skad du/ 'og min gnas ni nyams dga' bar// gtsang ma'i gnas kyi steng bzhugs te// yang dag sangs rgyas der sangs rgyas// sprul pa po zhig 'dir 'tshang rgya// zhes dang*/ dbang bskur ba'i tshe yang sdom pa gsum rim can du thob dgos pa'i phyir ro// nyer bzhi pa/ sdom pa gsum spang bya mi dge ba bcu spong bar gnad gcig bya ba ni/ go sla zhing grags che bas mdor bsdu na/ sdom pa gsum ga la mi dge ba gnang ba dang*/ dge ba bkag pa'i skabs mi srid cing gnad gcig tshul ni/ srog gcod la mtshon na mi bsad pa 'dul ba nas pham pa gsum par gsungs pa dang*/ byang sems la sdom pa nyi shu pa las/ gzhan gyis bshags kyang mi len par// khros nas gzhan la rdeg pa dang*// zhes dang*/ mngon par 'byung ba'i rgyud las| sems can la gnod pa byed pa'o// 'di dag ni rang bzhin gyi nyon mongs pa can te/

slar gsor mi rung ba'o zhes gsod pa bas rdeg pa yang rtsa ltung du bzhag pa dang*/ sngags la gsod pa'am rdeg pa sogs 'tshe ba byas na sdom pa 'og ma gnyis las bkag pa'i phyir rtsa ltung gnyis pa dang*/ bde gshegs snying po nang gi mched la 'tshe bas rtsa ltung gsum pa dang*/ sems can la byams pa spangs pas bzhi pa yang 'byung ba sogs shin tu nges pa'i phyir go sla'o// nyer lnga pa/ bdag po 'phos pas sdom pa gsum du 'ong bya ba ni/ spang bya blang bya thob bya so sor yod pas gsum du nges zer ba'i don min la/ rdo sher mar g.yu rdog rgyal blon 'bangs gsum gyi bdag po'i khyad par gyis g.yu gcig kyang rgyan gsum gyi ming du 'pho bar bshad pa ltar dang*/ de bzhin du kha zas la yang sbyar la mi dge ba spong zhing dge ba sgrub par gcig mod/ rten gyi gang zag so so'i dbye bas phye ba dngos bstan du byung bas de'i shugs kyis rjod byed sdom pa gsum so sor byung yang brjod bya dge sgrub sdig spong du gcig la/ de'i bslab bya rtsa ba dang yan lag tu 'jog lugs grangs mang nyung dang*/ sdom pa'i ngo bo dman 'bring mchog gi go rim dang*/ cho ga'i byed tshul gnas dus dpon slob kyi khyad par dang*/ sdom pa skye tshul sogs la ltos nas ming sdom pa gsum du bzhag pa ni rlung ltar grags mod/ don du gnad gcig pa'i phyir ro/ /nyer drug pa/ khams rang bzhin gyi rnam dag bral 'bras yon tan dang ldan par bzhed pa ni/ khams zhes pa dhā tu'i sgras rgyu'am| dbyings sam/ khams sogs la 'jug pa yin la/ khams 'di ni gdod ma nas bral ba dang rnam par smin pa'i yon tan thams cad dang dbyer med du gnas pa de nyid glo bur gyi nyes pas bsgribs la/ nyes pa des kyang rnam pa kun tu nyon mongs par mi 'gyur te/ de ni theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i rdo rje'i gnas bzhi par dpe don rgyas bshad kyis gsungs te/

ji skad du/ rdzogs sangs sku ni 'phro phyir dang*// de bzhin nyid dbyer med phyir dang*// rigs yod phyir na lus can kun// rtag tu sangs rgyas snying po can// zhes so// de yang glo bur gyi dri mas bsgribs pa'i khyad par ni/ ji skad du/ ma dag ma dag dag pa dang*// shin tu rnam dag go rim bzhin// sems can byang chub sems dpa' dang*// de bzhin gshegs pa zhes brjod do// zhes dang*/ ji skad du/ ngo bo nyid la sogs pa yi// 'di drug gis ni bsdus pa yi// khams ni gnas skabs gsum dag tu// ming gsum gyis ni bstan pa yin// zhes so| |khams de ni skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba ste/ ji skad du/ sems kyi rang bzhin nam mkha' yi// khams ltar rgyu med rkyen med de// tshogs pa med cing skye ba dang*| |'jig dang gnas pa'ang yod ma yin// zhes so// glo bur gyi dri mas kyang ngo bo la mi bsgribs te/ ji skad du/ sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal gang yin pa// de ni nam mkha' bzhin du 'gyur med de// yang dag min rtog las byung 'dod chags sogs// glo bur dri mas de nyon mongs mi 'gyur// zhes so// gnas skabs su sgrib tshul ji lta bu zhe na/ ji skad du/ sangs rgyas pad ngan sbrang rtsi sbrang ma la// sbun la snying po mi gtsang nang na gser// sa la gter dang myug sog 'bras chung dang*// gos hrul nang na rgyal ba'i sku dang ni// bud med ngan ma'i lto na mi bdag dang*// sa la rin chen gzugs yod ji lta bar// sems can rnams la bde gshegs khams 'di gnas// zhes so// dri ma de da lta spong mi nus pa ci yin zhe na/ ji skad du/ des na sangs rgyas ma thob bar// mya ngan 'das pa mi 'thob ste// 'od dang 'od zer spangs nas ni// nyi ma lta bar mi nus bzhin// de ltar rgyal ba'i snying po 'di// rnam bzhag rnam pa bcu zhes brjod// nyon mongs sbubs nang gnas pa de// dpe dag gis ni shes par bya// zhes so// rim pa ji lta bur bsgrib na/

ji skad du/ dri 'di dag gis byis rnams dang*// dgra bcom slob pa blo ldan rnams// rim bzhin bzhi dang gcig dang ni// gnyis dang gnyis kyi ma dag nyid// ces so// glo bur zhes pa thog ma nyid nas bsgribs pa yin nam zhe na min te/ ji skad du/ sems can khams kyi nyon mongs sbubs// ma 'brel thog ma med pa na// sems kyi rang bzhin dri med ni// thog ma med pa yin par brjod| |ces so// de yang rnam dbyer bcas pa'i glo bur gyi dri ma ni rang gi ngo bos stong la/ rnam dbye med pa'i mtshan nyid can khams rang bzhin snying po ni ngo bos mi stong ste/ ji skad du/ rnam dbyer bcas pa'i mtshan nyid can// glo bur dag gis khams stong gi// rnam dbyer med pa'i mtshan nyid can// bla med chos kyis stong ma yin// zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir lung 'di rnams la go ba'i 'phros don byas na/ mtha' las 'das pa zhig mchis kyang yi ger 'jigs pas/ blo ldan rnams kyis lung la brtags shing dpyad pas don go bar 'gyur la/ gzhan yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i mdor/ nyon mongs nye ba'i nyon mongs sbubs nang na// zag med mkhyen pa'i ye shes rin po che// sangs rgyas chos kyis gang zhing mdzes par 'dug |ces dang*/ lha mo dpal phreng seṅge'i sgra las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po ni rnam par dbyer yod pa/ shes pa glo bur gyi nyon mongs pa mtha' dag gis stong pa/ rnam par dbye ba med pa/ bral mi shes pa/ sangs rgyas kyi gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed las 'das pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa'o// zhes sogs dang*/ sangs rgyas phal po cher stong gsum gyi tshad dbyibs dar yug la bris pa rdul phra mo'i sbubs su bcug pa sus kyang ma mthong ba phye ba ltar/ snying po yon tan de bzhin gshegs pas gsal bar mdzad pa'i dpe dang*/ gzungs dbang rgyal pos zhus par/ nor bu rin po che bkru ba dang phyi ba'i dpes rgyas par bstan pa yin la/

khams de ni gdod ma nas bsal bzhag med pa de mngon du gyur pa na/ lta ba med pa'i mig gis mthong ba med pa'i don gzhi dus kyi ngo bo de nyid mthong ba las gzhan med de/ mgon po byams pas/ 'di la bsal bya ci yang med// sogs dang*/ de nyid las/ nyes pa glo bur dang ldan dang*// yon tan rang bzhin nyid ldan phyir// ji ltar sngar bzhin phyis de bzhin// 'gyur ba med pa'i chos nyid do// zhes dang*/ bram ze chen pos/ gdod nas skye med rang bzhin yin pa la// de ring dpal ldan bla mas bstan te rtogs// zhes sogs bka' brgyud rin po che 'di'i grub thob chen po rnams kyis rnam pa du ma'i sgo nas gsungs la/ de dag gi don bshad na dbu ma chen po'i rang gzhan gyis stong pa'i bzhed lugs dang*/ gangs can 'di na bod rgan spyi pa'i grub mtha' rnam grangs mang zhing don ma mthong ba mang po'i tshul yang zhar byung du smra bar sems kyang yi ges ngal bas skabs don de tsam gyis go bar zad do// nyer bdun pa/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying por yod ces gsungs pa ni/ bshad ma thag pa ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po la gzhi lam 'bras bu'i yon tan thams cad tshang bar yod de/ dri bcas kyi lam la'ang sangs rgyas kyi chos gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed las 'das pa sngar drangs ma thag pa ltar yod par gsungs na/ byang phyogs so bdun tshang ba lta ci smos/ lam bzhi por spyi bzhed dang mthun par so bdun tshang bar mdo sngags du ma nas bshad cing*/ 'bras bu'i skabs byang chub kyi yan lag bdun gyis phyug pa zhes sogs nges pas lam gyi yon tan mthar thug pa rnams mnga' ba mngon rtogs rgyan sogs las bshad pa ltar go bar bya zhing*/ mdo sde gtan la dbab par de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po de thams cad tshang bar gsungs pa yod kyang gzhan la gsang ba yin zhes grags chung la/
