nges par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma las/ byang chub phyogs ni sum cu bdun// chos kyi rnam par dag pa yin// zhes gsungs/ mdo sngags gnyis kar chos de lta bu yod pa yang phar phyin theg pa'i tshul go sla zhing*/ sngags su dpyid thig gi 'grel par/ g.yas g.yon rtsa rlung gi rgyu ba dang*/ rnam shes drug la dga' ba bzhis phye ba nyer bzhi dang*/ de 'khor lo bzhi por 'jug gnas ldang gsum po dga' bzhi'i zlas phye bas bcu gnyis te so drug /yan lag thams cad tshims pa dang so bdun byang chub kyi phyogs chos dang sbyar ba rgyu'i skabs dang lam dus lha so bdun/ 'bras dus rnam par dag pa'i ye shes dpal he ru ka'i ngo bor gsungs pa dang*/ mdor na 'khor 'das thams cad rang sems las ma 'das na byang phyogs so bdun ci'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying por med par grub ste/ rdo rje gur gyi rgyud las/ rin chen sems las phyir gyur pa'i// sangs rgyas med cing sems can med// gnas pa'i don dang rnam shes dag /phyi rol gyur pa 'ga' yang med// ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro// nyer brgyad pa/ tshad med pa bzhi de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po dang sangs rgyas kyi ngo bo nyid bya ba 'di ni/ gzhi khams bde gshegs snying po la tshad med pa bzhi tshang bar yon tan gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dang ldan par gsungs pas kyang grub la/ mgon po phag mo gru pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po kun rdzob kyi cha nas ngos 'dzin na/ khra dang spyang ki la sogs gcan gzan dag kyang rang gi bu smad la byams snying rje skye ba de yin zhes gsungs| gzhi khams rang bzhin rnam dag la yod pa lam du byas nas nyams su blang ba sngags mtshan nyid gnyis kar gsungs la/ 'dir sngags la mtshon na/ dpal bde mchog 'byung ba las/ gzhan la phan pa'i sems ni byams pa ste// gzhan gyi sdug bsngal 'joms byed snying rje yin// gzhan gyi bde bas tshim byed dga' ba ste// sems can kun snyoms btang snyoms rnam par bsam// zhes lam dus su nyams su blangs pas/

'bras dus su sangs rgyas pa'i tshe na'ang tshad med bzhi'i ngo bor 'tshang rgya ste/ rgya cher rol ba las/ gang gi don du stobs bcu po// sems can rnams la byams pa bsgom// byams pa'i stobs kyis rgyal gyur pa// ngas ni bdud rtsi'i nying khu 'thungs/ zhes gsungs pas/ gzhi dus su tshad med bzhi ldan rung*| lam dus su nyams su blang bya'i snying po/ 'bras dus su bdud kyi sde 'joms pa dang*/ 'khor rnams smin grol la 'god pa sogs tshangs gnas bzhi po 'di kho nas mdzad pa yin te| mdo sde rgyan las/ sems can rnams la brtse ba can// zhes sogs tshangs gnas bzhi po chos sku'i yon tan du sbyar nas bstod pa yang don 'di'i dgongs pa dpyis phyin pa yin no| |nyer dgu pa/ rgyal ba'i dgongs pa rigs gcig theg pa gcig bya ba ni/ spyir sems can gyi rigs la gsung rab rnams su gsum du 'dus par gsungs te/ yang dag par nges pa dang*/ log par nges pa dang*/ ma nges pa'i phung po gsum du gsungs pa sogs dang*/ rgyud bla mar gnas pa dang sgrub pa'i rigs gnyis su gsungs pa sogs skabs don tsam la dgongs kyi/ yang dag par rigs gcig las gzhan pa med de khams bde gshegs snying po la mi 'dra ba med pa'i phyir/ 'phags pa sdud pa las/ 'das pa'i de bzhin nyid gang ma byon de bzhin nyid// da ltar de bzhin nyid gang dgra bcom de bzhin nyid// chos kun de bzhin nyid gang rgyal ba'i de bzhin nyid// chos kyi de bzhin nyid 'di thams cad bye brag med// ces dang*/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ chos kyi dbyings la dbyer med phyir// rigs ni tha dad rung ma yin// zhes so// de ltar khams rigs gcig nyid la theg pa yang chen po 'ba' zhig las gzhan med de/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod yul gyi thabs kyi rnam par 'phrul ba bstan pa'i mdo las/ 'dren pa sems can rnams la mnyam pa'i thugs// nga la tha dad 'du shes nam yang med// theg pa dman pa gzhan la ngas bstan na// de la nga ni ser sna'i skyon du 'gyur// zhes dang*/

de nyid las/ nga yi mya ngan 'das gcig theg pa gcig / nga yi theg pa tha dad med pa ste// yang dag tu ni theg pa gcig tu bstan// de ni thabs kyi yul du shes par gyis/ zhes dang*/ dam chos pad+ma dkar po las/ shā ri'i bu ngas kyang theg pa gcig la brtsams te sems can rnams la chos bstan pa 'di lta ste sangs rgyas kyi theg pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi mthar thug pa ste/ theg pa gnyis sam gsum zhes bya ba gang yang med do| |phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten thams cad na'ang chos nyid ni 'di'o/ /'di ltar phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten thams cad na'ang theg pa gnyis su gdags pa'ang med na gsum du lta ga la yod/ ces dang*/ mdo dgongs pa nges 'grel las/ theg pa che dang theg pa dman pa las// rang bzhin sna tshogs chos rnams gang bstan pa// de dag nyid ni tshul gcig yang bstan te// de phyir theg pa sna tshogs nga mi smra// zhes dang*/ 'phags pa rnam par thar pa thams cad bsdus pa'i mdo las/ ngas 'di ni nyan thos kyi theg pa dang ldan pa'am rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa dang ldan pa'am theg pa chen po dang ldan par chos tha dad par bstan pa gang yang med na/ mi blun po de dag dam pa'i chos 'di la 'di ni nyan thos rnams la bshad pa/ 'di ni rang sangs rgyas rnams la bshad pa'o// zhes tha dad du 'byed de/ de tha dad pa'i 'du shes kyis dam pa'i chos spong ba'o/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa dang*/ dam chos pad dkar nas phyis ded dpon thabs la mkhas pas 'brog dgon par grong khyer sprul pa'i dpes bstan pa sogs dang*/ mdor na sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad kyi ya gyal gcig 'du shes sna tshogs mi mnga' ba yin pa'i phyir des na theg pa thams cad rigs gcig theg pa gcig tu nges so// sum cu pa/ log sred can dang nyan thos kyang mthar byang chub chen por 'gyur zhes gsungs pa ni/ log sred can bdud dang legs skar lta bu dang*/ nyan thos dang rang rgyal phyogs gcig pa sangs rgyas pa'i gegs su gsungs pa dang*/

rgyud bla mar chos la sdang ba la thar pa med par gsungs pa dang*/ gzhan yang rigs chad pa sogs kyang byang chub tu mi 'gyur ba sogs gsungs pa rnams ni/ de rnams dus ma 'ongs pa ring po zhig gi bar du byang chub snying por mi 'gyur ba la dgongs kyi/ rtsa ba nas byang chub gtan du mi 'thob pa ni ma yin te bde gshegs snying po yod pa'i phyir dang*/ bskal pa shin tu mang po'i grangs 'dren pa'i tshe grangs med ces bod pa dang 'dra bas/ nyan rang sogs lhag med du zhugs pa rnams kyang rgyal ba'i 'od zer gyis bskul nas byang chub kyi lam la bslabs te 'tshang rgya ba dang*/ bdud dang legs skar sogs log sred can rnams kyang las kyi 'phro de zad nas rigs khams bde gshegs snying po de rnams la yod pas theg pa chen po la zhugs nas 'tshang rgya bar de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod yul gyi thabs kyi rnam par 'phrul ba bstan pa'i mdo las/ dper na me stag chung ngu 'phel gyur na// me lce chen po 'bar zhing mched pa ltar// nyan thos ye shes me yi me stag kyang*// de nyid sangs rgyas yon tan me lce skye// zhes dang*/ slob dpon 'phags pas/ nyan thos de dag ji srid du// sangs rgyas rnams kyis ma bskul tshe// de nyid ye shes lus gcig gis// ting 'dzin dregs pas myos te gnas// bskul nas sna tshogs gzugs kyis ni// sems can don la mngon dga' zhing*| |sangs rgyas byang chub 'thob 'gyur te// byang chub bar du nying mtshams sbyor// zhes so// de ltar nyan rang gi theg pa yang ngal gso'i theg pa lta bu yin te/ ji skad du/ ngal gso'i don du theg pa cher// 'byung ba ye shes gnyis po yang*// gsungs pa yin gyi don dam min// zhes so// des na bdud dang legs skar yang byang chub snying por ston pa nyid kyis lung bstan pa'i phyir don 'dis sems can thams cad 'tshang mi rgya ba mi srid la/

sems can thams cad sangs rgyas pa'i dus mi srid pa sogs chos skad rnying pa rnams kyang 'byung ngo*// zhes chos kyi 'khor lo spyi'i gnad bsdus kyi tshoms gsal bar byed pa ste spyi don dang po'o/// / ༈ /spyi don gnyis pa kun la phan pa rten 'brel gyi gnad bsdus kyi tshoms 'chad pa la rdo rje'i gsung bco lnga mchis pa las/ dang po/ dge mi dge gnyis su thag bcad nas lung ma bstan med bya ba ni/ sems nyon mongs pa'i rjes su 'brangs pa'i las thams cad ni mi dge ba ste dug gsum gyi 'dres yod tshad mi dge ba'i rgyu mtshan du 'gro bas so// slob dpon 'phags pas/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// des bskyed las ni mi dge ba// ma chags zhe sdang gti mug med// des bskyed las ni dge ba'o// zhes gsungs/ 'o na mdo sde rnams su/ gcig tu dkar ba la 'bras bu bde ba/ gcig tu nag pa la 'bras bu sdug bsngal/ 'dres ma'i las la 'bras bu yang 'dres mar gsungs pa yang 'gal lo zhe na/ de yang mi 'gal te 'dres ma zhes pa dper na zhing gcig la nas sran bsres te btab na zhing 'dir nas sran 'dres ma zhes tha snyad 'dogs kyang ngo bo nas la nas dang*// sran ma la sran ma las gzhan mi smin te 'bras bu 'dres ma mi srid pas grub la| chos mngon pa kun btus las/ lung ma bstan gyi dbye ba bcu gsum gsungs pa yang rtsa ba las 'byin pa'i las la dge sdig gnyis las lung ma bstan med kyi las mi 'byin pa rnams ma smos pa'i phyir dang*/ las 'byin pa'i lung ma bstan bshad kyang dge sdig gnyis las gzhan pa'i las med cing*/ 'bras bu bde sdug gnyis las gzhan 'byung rgyu med pa'i phyir dang*| dper na khyo shug gnyis la bu mo gcig yod na nang tshang du bgrang na gsum yod kyang pho mor bgrang na gnyis las med pa lta bu sogs lung rigs rnam dag mang pos grub pa 'dis dkar nag zang thal gyi dgongs pa dpyis phyin pa yang ston pa nyid de/

'ga' zhig gis/ las dkar rnam smin nag pa dang*// las nag rnam smin dkar ba dang*/ zhes kha mkhas kyi bshad rtsod lung rnam dag 'khyog po'i don gyis rgyab tu drangs pa mang mod/ de lta na rgyu 'bras mi bden par khas len nam/ khyod 'dod pa de tshul ci 'dra/ sngar khyod kyis log pa'i grub mtha' mang po rlung ltar bsgrags zin mod/ da dung tshul de 'dra ba rnams la soms shig /gnyis pa/ rtog gnyis cig car du mi 'jug cing sems 'grogs par mi skye zhes pa ni/ gang zag gcig la shes rgyud gnyis med pa dang*/ chos thams cad skad cig ma yin pa'i phyir yud tsam re la'ang spang gnyen gyi tshogs mang po skye 'gag byed pa dag snga ma snga ma 'gags nas phyi ma phyi ma skye ba ste/ tsha reg gam grang reg gam nyi ma dang mun pa ltar spang gnyen lhan cig tu mi gnas/ dge sdig gi rtog pa'ang lhan cig tu mi skye ste/ lha mo dpal phreng gis zhus pa'i mdo las/ dge ba'i sems kyang skad cig ma// mi dge'i sems kyang skad cig ma// zhes dang*/ yum rgyas pa las/ sems kyis sems mi mthong zhing sems gnyis 'grogs par mi skye zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir go sla'o// gsum pa/ sems las byung ba las kyang sems 'byung zhes bya ba ni/ gzhi skye ba med pa sems yin/ de la rtog dpyod byed pa sems byung yin/ sgro 'dogs chod pa de sems yin pa'i phyir sems byung las kyang sems 'byung ba ste/ lang kar gshegs pa las/ sems ni kun gzhi'i rnam shes te// ngar 'dzin nyon mongs yid yin zhing*// gang zhig yul la 'dzin byed pa// de la rnam par shes zhes brjod// ces so// de'i dpe yang sa bon du nas btab par rgyu rkyen mang du 'du byas pas slar 'bras bur nas nyid 'ong ba dang mtshungs so// de yang gzhi ma rig pa sems yin la/ de la brten nas sems byung 'du byed rnams 'byung*/ 'du byed las kyang rnam shes 'byung ste/

dbus mtha' rnam 'byed las/ de la don mthong rnam par shes// de yi khyad par sems las byung*// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// bzhi pa/ 'khor bar lus 'khor bya ba ni/ mgon po phag mo gru pa'i zhal nas/ de ring khong gis 'phags pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa klog pa kho bos gsan pas/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho lus 'di yin gsungs nas gda'/ de ji ltar yin snyam du dgongs pas phyi'i rgya mtsho chen po srog chags du ma'i gzhir gyur pa ltar/ lus 'di 'khor ba'i gzhi dang rtsa ba ste thog ma med pa'i bag chags yul rkyen dang 'phrad pas rnam rtog bzang ngan sna tshogs skye/ de bsags pa'i las kyis lus de dang rjes mthun grub pas 'khor bar lus 'khor ba yin te/ spyod 'jug las/ yid ni lus can ma yin pas// sus kyang gang du'ang gzhom mi nus// lus la mngon par zhen pas na// lus ni sdug bsngal dag gis gnod// ces so// khams gsum rigs drug tu 'khor ba yang lus yin la/ 'bras bu rdzogs byang thob nas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i sprul sku yang lus yin pas las bzang ngan gang smin yang lus la brten dgos te/ ji skad du/ lus can rnams kyi las rnams ni// bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi 'dza'/ zhes so// bar dor lus med dam snyam na der yang bag chags kyi lus shig nges par yod de// mngon pa mdzod dang*/ rje phag mo gru pas/ sngon byung srid pa'i sha tshugs can// dbang po kun tshang thogs med rgyu// zhes sogs gsungs so// gzhan yang rig pa drug cu pa las// gal te phung po ma 'gag na// nyon mongs zad kyang 'da' mi 'gyur// gang tshe de'ang 'gags gyur pa// de yi tshe na grol bar 'gyur// zhes so// lnga pa/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis thams cad ma rig pa'i g.yos bya ba ni// ma rig pa yod na rga shi'i bar yod la/ ma rig pa 'gag na rga shi'i bar 'gags pas grub ste/ 'phags pa sdud pa las/ sems can tha ma 'bring dang mchog gyur ji snyed pa// de kun ma rig las byung bde bar gshegs pas gsungs// zhes gsungs la/

ma rig pa de ni dran med du brgyal ba'am mig gis mi mthong ba lta bu la mi bzhed de/ de kho na nyid kyi don la bsgribs pa'i gti mug mtshan 'dzin dug lnga'i rtsa bar gyur pa de nyid ma rig pa yin/ gzhan du na don dam rnam par nges pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs sogs las sngon dang phyi ma'i mtha' la sogs pa mi shes pa la ma rig par bshad mod/ de ni snga ma las gzhan du gzung bya med pas so// drug pa/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis skad cig ma gcig la'ang tshang bar bzhed de/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis/ lug gcig gsod pa'i bar la'ang rten 'brel bcu gnyis tshang bar gsungs pa dang*/ de bas kyang dus nye ba klu dge tshul dang*/ shud ke'i slob ma klur skyes pa dang*/ sbyor ba 'go rtsom pa nyon mongs pa'i dum bu/ dngos gzhi longs spyod pa las kyi dum bu/ rjes thim pa sdug bsngal gyi dum bu ste dum bu gsum sbyor dngos rjes gsum du 'ong*/ de ltar na rtog pa skad cig ma se gol gtogs pa'i yud tsam la'ang rten 'brel bcu gnyis thams cad tshang ba yin/ 'di go na skyon spong ba dang yon tan sgrub pa thams cad dus ring po la ltos mi dgos/ skad cig ma'i 'khor lo'i tshul gyis sgrub chog par gsungs te gnad zab kyang go sla'o// bdun pa/ sems tha dad pa'i dbang gis snang ba yang tha dad ces gsungs pa ni/ dper na chos mngon pa/ dus 'khor/ phal po che/ 'dul ba/ 'jig rten gdags bzhag sogs nas gling bzhi ri rab kyi tshad dbyibs sogs gsungs pa 'gal ba ltar go ba dang*/ de bzhin du mchog dman bar ma 'gro drug gang gi yang rang gi go tshod snang tshod de ltar yin no bden no// gzhan rnams kyi tshul de 'dra ba min no zhes bden zhen gyis rgyal ba'i bka' la nang 'gal dang ris su gcod pa ni rnam par ma dag pa kho na ste/ dper na ngo bo chu gcig po la lhas bdud rtsi/ mis chu/ yi dwags kyis rnag khrag tu mthong ba ltar dang*/

don dam stong pa bden grub kyi dbang du gang yang ma grub kyang*/ kun rdzob bden pa'i 'khrul ngor rang rang gi las dang khams dang mos pa dang bsam pa'i dbang gis tha dad par snang ba nyid yin te/ rdo rje gur las/ yul dang dbang po'i bye brag rnams// rnam pa tha dad ma mchis te// gzugs sogs snang bar gyur pa ni// rang sems kho na snang ba'o| |zhes dang*/ rje phag mo gru pas/ dmyal ba dang ni sangs rgyas bar// spros bral sems kyi snang ba ste// stong nyid yin pa'i gnad ka des// cir yang bsgyur du btub pa yin| |zhes so// mdor na 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad sems las gzhan du grub pa med de/ rdo rje gur las/ gzugs dang tshor dang 'du shes dang*// 'du byed dang ni rnam shes nyid// thams cad sems 'di'i dngos po las// thub pas gzhan du ma gsungs so// zhes so// de ltar thams cad sems su gcig par rtogs na 'khor 'das zhes pa'i ming tsam yang stong pa ste/ dpal rnyog pa med pa'i rgyud las/ 'khor bar 'khor bar mi 'gyur ste// mya ngan 'da' bar yongs mi 'gyur// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa ni// chu zla bzhin du bden pas stong*// zhes so// de ltar ma rtogs pa'i snang ngor tha dad du snang ste/ ji skad du/ lcags sreg sa gzhi su yis byas// mo tshogs 'di dag ci las byung*// de 'dra de dag thams cad kyang*// sdig sems yin par thub pas gsungs// zhes dang*// mgon po phag mo gru pas/ res 'ga' ni ngam shod kyi klung 'di 'og min gyi gnas yin/ res 'ga' ni lcags sreg gi sa gzhi yin zhes gsungs pa yang don 'di la dgongs/ de ltar na bsod nams bsags pa rab 'bring tha ma'i snang ngor tha dad du snang ba yin gyi don du ngo bo ma grub pa'i phyir/ rdo rje gur nas rgyas par gsungs pa dang*/ phug khru bco brgyad pa'i nang du 'khor los bsgyur ba bu dang btsun mo dpung bcas shong ba'i dpe dang*/

'jam dpal gyi zhing bkod las byams pas khri bshams pa'i tshad dang*/ sdom gsum bstan pa'i mdor bya rgod phung ri'i yon tan gsungs pa rnams da lta bya rgod phung ri la med pa yang sems tha dad pa'i snang tshul tha dad yin/ gzhan yang 'ga' zhig gis/ dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo dang*// mngon pa'i gzhung las gsungs pa yi// gangs ri gser gyi bya skyibs dang*| |'dzam bu'i shing dang sa srung bu// zhes pa nas/ de ltar min pa'i gang zag gis// yul der 'gro ba rgyud las bkag /ces rgyu mtshan du mas bkag mod/ dpyad nas bshad kyi/ dri ma med par grags pa'i mdo las/ btsun pa shā ri'i bus smras pa/ bdag gis sa chen po 'di mtho dman dang g.yang sa dang ljan ljin gyis gang bar mthong ngo*// zhes zer ro// sangs rgyas mya ngan med pa'i zhing nas 'ongs pa'i tshangs pa ral pa can gyis smras pa/ bdag gis bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i zhing 'di nyid gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha'i gnas kyi bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa bzhin du dag par mthong ngo zhes zer ro// de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rnams la sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di'i rang bzhin ston par mdzad pas thams cad kyis shar phyogs kyi sangs rgyas rin po che'i rgyan bkod pa'i zhing khams bzhin yongs su dag par mthong bar gyur pas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ nga'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di ni rtag tu 'di 'dra ste khyed rnams kyis mi mthong ngo*// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ma dros pa dang ti se dang*/ tsā ri sogs kyang sngon gyi bshad tshod dang da lta mi mtshungs pa yang tshul de lta bu kho nar nges so// yang kho na re/ de la kha cig 'di skad du// bya rgod phung po'i ri la yang*// dkon brtsegs bzhin du da lta med// dus kyi stobs kyis yul kun yang*// rnam par 'gyur bar snang zhes zer// 'di yang phye ste bshad kyis nyon// zhes pa nas/

thams cad 'khrul bar ga la srid// ces pa'i bar gyis snyan ngag gi bstod pa dang gnas lugs brjod pa sogs gtan tshigs su byas mod kyi de yang lung des rnam par nyams par byas so// yang kho na re/ dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo dang*// mngon pa'i gzhung las gsungs pa yi// zhes bris mod/ dus 'khor dang mngon pa'i gnas kyi rnam bshad mtshungs par 'dren pa yang rnam par 'khyams so// rtogs ldan du khas blangs pa 'ga' zhig rnam rtog khyim pa tha ma las rags pa'i ru nga can rnams dang*/ mkhas par khas len pa'i phyogs gcig bden 'dzin 'khrul zhen can rgyal ba'i bka' la stangs gcod byed pa dag yod mod| rang gi gnas tshul de 'dra ba soms la gcom bskyungs nas kha rog 'dug cig /brgyad pa/ da lta nyid du gang bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu la longs spyod par bzhed pa ni/ sngon gyi las kho na yang nges pa ma yin te/ da lta nyid du bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu la longs spyod pa 'di yang yod de/ ma skyes dgra'i 'gyod pa bsal ba'i mdo las/ chos thams cad ni rgyu'i rjes su 'gro ba/ rkyen la rag las pa/ srid pa'i rtsa ba can/ smon lam gyis thog drangs pa'o// zhes dang*/ ji skad du/ rgyu gcig gis ni kun grub pa'i// 'bras bu gang yang yod min te| |lha rnams kyis ni byas pa yang*// rgyu rkyen gzhan la ltos dgos so// zhes dang*/ rje btsun mi las/ brkos par gyur na sa las chu yang thon// bsrubs par gyur na shing las me yang 'bar// mis ni brtson 'grus dang 'bad byas gyur na// mi 'grub pa ni gang yang med par gsungs// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ rgyu rkyen gyi rten 'brel thams cad ji ltar bsgrigs pa ltar da lta nyid du 'byung ba mgon po 'bri gung pa chen po lta bu dang*/ dper na zhing la so nam mkhan gyis bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu lta bu ste rtogs sla'o// dgu pa/ dus kyi 'phel 'grib da ltar yang byar yod/

ces gsungs pa ni/ 'phel 'grib byed pa'i rgyu dge ba dang mi dge ba yin te/ byed pa pos byas pa dang*/ rang bzhin gyis byung ba dang*/ dus kyis byas pa ma yin te| sngon bskal pa dang po rdzogs ldan gyi dus 'od gsal gyi lha bab ma thag pa'i bcud sogs dpal yon du ma la longs spyod pa yang nyon mongs 'phel bas tshe lo bcu pa'i bar du 'grib la/ bcu pa'i dus rgyal ba ma pham pa'i sprul pas dge bcu'i khrims bcas pa bsrungs bas brgyad khri'i bar du 'phel bar bshad pa dang*/ snying rje pad dkar las/ sngon 'jig rten gyi khams yang dag 'dren du skye dgu tshe lo brgyad khri las 'grib nas brgyad cu pa'i nang du bdag cag gi ston pa 'di byang chub sems dpa'i tshe gdol ba stobs chen du 'khrungs shing*| des stobs dang rdzu 'phrul gyis skye dgu mi chos bcu drug dang ldan par bkod pa'i mthus tshe lo lnga brgya bar 'phel bar gsungs pa lta bu yin pas/ da lta snyigs ma lnga bdo 'dir yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen nam chos kyi rgyal po phyogs lhung dang bral ba dag gis skye dgu rnams rnam par dag pa'i mi chos bcu drug la bkod na tshe bsod longs spyod thams cad yar ldan du 'byung ba dang*/ de lta ma byung yang yul gru'am/ khyim gang ngam/ rang rgyud gcig po tsam yang mi chos bcu drug la bkod na de'i ngo skal nas rdzogs ldan ltar 'byung ba sngon gyi gleng gzhis grub pas de ltar 'byung mod/ rang 'dod dang rnyed brtson khengs grags gtam don byus nor la dmigs nas dge ba'i las lam du bdag gzhan bkol yang ne tso kha'i chos bshad dang mtshungs pas snying pos dben mod/ 'ga' zhig gis de ltar byas ma byas med ces blo bsad nas sdod pa la ni chu rnams rgya mtshor 'du ba ltar mi mthun pa thams cad sdig can de'i phyogs sam grong ngam khyim der 'ong ba chos nyid yin pas/ des na dus kyi 'phel 'grib dge sdig gi 'dor len gyis da lta kho nar 'byung ngo*// bcu pa/

tshe 'di rang du mthong chos gtso bor 'byung bya ba ni/ 'dul ba lung dbyen gzhi bam po brgya rtsa bdun pa las/ bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po ma skyes dgras mthong chos gang yin zhus pa'i lan du/ khyod kyi 'bangs go re long zhig nga'i bstan pa la rab tu byung nas dge slong tshul khrims sogs yon tan du ma dang ldan par gyur na/ phyis khyod kyis de la g.yog 'chol lam zhes dris pas ma skyes dgras de lta ni ma lags so// bdag gi phyag dang bkur sti'i gnas su 'gyur ro zhes gsol ba la de mthong chos kyi 'bras bur gsungs pa dang*/ spyod 'jug las/ byang chub sems bskyed gyur na skad cig gis// 'khor ba'i brtson rar bsdams pa'i nyam thag rnams// bde gshegs rnams kyi sras zhes brjod bya zhing*// 'jig rten lha mir bcas pas phyag byar 'gyur// zhes dang*/ dbang bskur ba'i 'bras bur yang*/ ji skad du/ de ring khyod rnams bde bar gnas// zhes sogs mang du gsungs la/ mthong chos da ltar yang 'byung ba dpal phag mo gru pas/ tha na 'jig rten mi chos gcig gis gcig la khyod mda' tsha zhes smras na nga bas kyang khyod tsha zhes zer la/ pha rol por smad na tshur yang smod par 'gyur/ mthong chos de nyid kho na yin gsungs pa ltar go bar sla'o// bcu gcig pa/ mi chos bcu drug la sogs pa dang lha chos gnad gcig bya ba ni/ srog gcod/ ma byin len/ 'dod log |rdzun/ myos 'gyur sogs spong bar bsngags pa dang*/ sgrub par smod pa dang*/ pha ma dge sbyong slob dpon sogs la rim gro bya ba dang*/ phar phyin drug sogs spyod pa la bsngags pa dang mi spyod pa la smod pa sogs mdor na mi chos bcu drug lha chos dang gnad gcig pa a cang che ste/ mi chos ni lha chos kyi rtsa ba rmang rdo lta bu yin pa yang*/ slob dpon 'phags pa'i shes rab brgya par/ mi yi chos lugs legs spyad na// lha yul bgrod pa thag mi ring*// lha dang mi yi them skas la// 'dzegs na thar pa gam na 'dug

/ces dang*/ slob dpon legs ldan 'byed kyis/ yang dag kun rdzob rnams kyi skas// med par don dam khang chen gyi// steng du 'gro bar 'dod pa ni// mkhas la rung ba ma yin no// zhes gsungs so// bcu gnyis pa/ phal che chung las 'bras bu thob pa rgyun mi 'chad pa 'byung bya ba ni/ da lta snyigs ma'i dus 'dir brtson 'grus byas kyang 'tshang mi rgya zer ba rnam par ma dag pa ste/ phar phyin la yang dkon mchog gsum rtag pa'i gnad kyis nyams su gang blangs la 'bras bu 'byung bas dus kyi dbye ba mi rigs te/ zla ba snying por bstan pa nub khar dgra bcom pa des pa 'byung bar gsungs la/ tshe lo bcu pa nas yar 'phel te drug brgya pa'i dus kyi bar du bstan pa 'di gnas shing gnas brtan chen po bcu drug byon nas gsung rab bsdus pa'i mchod rten byas te mya ngan las 'da' bar dgra bcom pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rtogs brjod las gsungs pa sogs kyis phal che chung gi 'bras bu dang*/ sgrub pa/ lung gi dus so sor bstan gyi/ bsgrubs shing nyams su blangs na 'bras bu thob par 'gyur ba'i 'phros ni/ siṅga gling gi dgra bcom pa la zhus nas/ dus 'khor dang bstun pa'i kha che paṇa chen gyi bstan rtsis las bstan pa yun ring du gnas par bshad pa la/ rje 'jig rten mgon po shin tu mnyes nas bstan pa gnas pa la bsngags shing*/ lnga brgya'i tha mar sher phyin gyis sangs rgyas kyi bya ba byed par gsungs pa sogs spyi bzhed las bye brag gi bzhed par bstan la/ khyad par gsang sngags ni rdzogs ldan las rtsod dus 'dir shin tu bsngags pa'i phyir 'bras bu 'byung bar myur ba ste/ ji skad du/ ma 'ongs phyi ma'i dus kyi tshe// dus mthar dngos grub mi 'thob ste// chos 'di de ltar shes nas su// bsam pa thams cad rdzogs byed yin// zhes sogs gsungs la lung 'di'i phyi mar dngos grub mi 'byung zhes pa ni snyigs ma'i dus phar phyin theg pa'i chos nyon mongs pa spang byar byed pa sgrub mkhan dkon gyi/

gsang sngags nyon mongs lam byed sgrub pa mang bas de'i phyir dgongs so// des na phal che chung la dgongs nas 'bras bu'i dus gong du bzhag gi phyis ye mi 'thob pa ma yin te/ ma bsgrub na 'bras bu'i dus su'ang 'bras bu thob pa mi srid pa'i phyir dang*/ 'bras bu'i dus/ sgrub pa'i dus/ lung gi dus/ rtags tsam 'dzin pa'i dus te bzhir bzhag pa ni shas che chung la dgongs pas de ltar go dgos so| |bcu gsum pa/ lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa sngon du 'gro ba'ang yod bya ba ni/ bslab gsum rim can du bshad mod/ 'ang gi sgras kho nar yang ma nges te/ bla ma mtshan ldan gyis slob ma snod ldan la man ngag bstan pas de'i rgyud la mngon rtogs skyes pa lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa/ de'i rgyun skyong ba ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa/ rtogs pa mthar phyin nas stong nyid rgyu 'bras su ldang ba tshul khrims kyi bslab pa yin te/ dper na rje 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po sgom med kyi rtogs pa 'khrungs nas bsnyen par rdzogs pa dang*/ lnga sde bzang po ye shes khong du chud nas dge slong gi bslab bya blangs pa dang*/ rigs kyi gtso bo'i bu grags pa khyim pa'i cha lugs kyis dgra bcom pa thob rjes rab byung gi rtags dang bslab pa blangs pa lta bu dang*/ deng sang yang khyim pas bsam gtan bsgoms nas ye shes mthong rjes gzod so thar gyi sdom pa nod pa lta bu yin la/ 'phags pa sdud pa las// sbyin pa sbyin pa'i sngon du 'gro ba shes rab ste| |tshul khrims bzod pa brtson 'grus bsam gtan de bzhin no// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir bslab pa gsum la go rim gcig kho nar yang ma nges so zhes pa'i dgongs pa'o// bcu bzhi pa/ lam rim thams cad thun gcig gi nang du nyams su blang bya ba ni/ nyin mtshan gyi cha thun drug bzhi gnyis gang ltar byed kyang thun khong re rer lam rim thams cad tshang bar nyams su blang dgos par dgongs/

de'i tshul ni thun gyi 'gor 'chi ba mi rtag pa dang*/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' ba dang*/ rgyu 'bras dang*// 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs sogs skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim sngon du btang nas/ dngos gzhi phar phyin theg pa la bdag med gnyis kyi don bsgom/ gsang sngags pas lam rim gnyis bsgom pa la spyir dgongs/ bye brag thugs kyi bzhed pa ni thun gcig la yang mdo sngags gnyis ka'i lam gyi snying por dril ba mgon po phag mo gru pa'i thugs kyi brnag pa phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan du dril nas nyams su blangs| der ma zad nyon mongs kyi rtog pa phra ba re re spong ba dang*/ dkar po'i chos phra mo re re sgrub kyang lam lnga ldan gyi skya bar nas 'don pa ni mgon po 'bri gung pa chen po'i zab chos kyi nying khu yin pas tshul de lta bu la dgongs shing*/ gzhan yang ji skad du/ rtag tu 'chi bsam las su bsags pa bgrang*// dkon mchog gsum mchod ngo bo gnyis med bsgom// zhes sogs mang du gsungs pas kyang grub la/ tshul 'di rnams ni jo bo rje bod du byon phyin chad byung zer mod/ de ni min te/ rje btsun mar rngog sogs bka' brgyud rin po che 'di nyid spyi sgos kyi nyams len byed tshul mtha' dag kyang 'dir ma 'dus pa med cing de rnams kyi dgongs pa'i bcud kyang 'di kho na yin pas so// bco lnga pa/ sangs rgyas mang po zhing gcig tu rgyun mi 'chad pa 'byung bya ba ni/ tshogs gnyis goms pa'i phul gyis sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa ni sems can gyi khams dang mnyam la/ sems can gyi khams 'khor ba'i rang bzhin ni mtha' las 'das te/ dbu ma la 'jug pa las/ thog ma dang po tha ma mtha'// de dag med pas 'khor ba ni// thog ma tha ma med par brjod// ces gsungs pas sems can re re'i snang ngor sangs rgyas re re snang bar mdzad de/ mgon po byams pa'i rgyud bla ma las/ gang phyir gdul bya dag pa yi// chu yi snod ni thams cad la// bde gshegs nyi ma'i gzugs brnyan ni| |dpag tu med pa cig car 'char// zhes so// des na 'jig rten gyi khams re rer sems can de snyed kyi grangs kyi sangs rgyas byon yang gcig gi go gcig gis 'gag par 'gyur ba'i skabs med pa'i dper/

ston pas 'dus pa rin po che'i tog gsung ba'i dus su phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'khor bcas byon pa dang*/ dam chos pad dkar gsung ba'i tshe sangs rgyas rin chen mang sogs sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams til gyi gong bu ltar gang ba dang*/ bcom ldan 'das dbang po'i phug tu dbyar gnas pa'i tshe bcom ldan 'das 'jug sred rgyal po'i zhing du sangs rgyas dpag tu med pa tshogs nas chos bgro ba mdzad pa dang*/ 'jig rten gyi khams kun tu 'od du phyogs brgya nas 'dus te/ de bzhin gshegs pa bgro ba'i mdo gsungs pa sogs dpag tu med pa gsungs la/ 'gran zla med pa'i las bsags pa'i don zhing der rtag tu bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas de gtsor gyur gyi don yin la| sangs rgyas rnams la chags pa dang sdang ba mi mnga' bas sangs rgyas gzhan rnams ni sangs rgyas de'i yab yum sras rim gro ba sogs dang*/ tha na mu stegs kyi tshul bzung nas che ba 'don pa dang*/ phrin las kyi grogs mdzad pa sogs kyang lung gis gsal la/ dgongs 'dus le'u gsum pa'i lung 'jig rten gcig gam gling gcig tu sogs gsungs pa ni rdo rje gdan du 'tshang rgya ba sogs mdzad pa bcu gnyis ston pa'i ston pa mchog gi sprul sku gnyis mi 'byung ba la dgongs la/ yongs grags dang bon 'bum gyi lung ni rang re'i lung du mi 'gro bas bzhag |yang na zhing gcig tu dus rtag tu bzhugs nas bslab gzhi bca' ba'i sangs rgyas ni gcig las gnyis dus mtshungs su mi 'byung bar yang 'gal ba med la/ rdo rje'i gsung 'di ni gong gi rgyud bla'i lung gi dgongs pa dpyis phyin pa yin no// zhes kun la phan pa rten 'brel gyi gnad bsdus kyi tshoms gsal bar byed pa ste spyi don gnyis pa'o/// / ༈ /spyi don gsum pa 'dul ba so sor thar pa'i gnad bsdus kyi tshoms 'chad pa la/ rdo rje'i gsung nyi shu mchis pa las dbye bsdu'i dbang gis bco brgyad du mdzad pa'i dang po/

'dul ba theg pa thun mong yin bya ba ni/ theg chung gnas skabs kyi zhi bde byis pa 'brid pa'i bde skyid kyang so thar la brten nas 'byung ste/ dkon mchog seṅges zhus pa las/ tshul khrims kyis ni bde 'gror 'gro| |zhes so// 'bring nyan rang gi theg pa yang so thar la brten te/ 'phags pa sdud pa las/ tshul khrims kyis ni zhi ba 'dod rnams 'phags par 'gyur// zhes so// mchog rdzogs byang gi 'bras bu yang so thar la brten te/ lung rnam 'byed las/ sangs rgyas rnams dang rang rgyal rnams kyis kyang*// byang chub gang brnyes thugs slob rnam dag pa// sems can dgra bcom yon tan ldan pa rnams// de yi rgyu ni 'dul ba yin par gsungs// zhes so// byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod kyi rtsa ba lta bu'ang so thar 'ong ste/ slob dpon dri med bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i so thar gyi 'grel pa bam po lnga bcu pa las/ so sor thar pa zhes bya ba ni dgag sgrub kyi bslab pa so sor ma 'dres par nyams su blangs pas thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa nyid mngon du byed pa'i phyir so sor thar pa zhes bya'o// gal te de ltar ma yin na byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod las byang chub sems dpa'i so sor thar pa'i gzhung de dag dang 'gal zhes dang*/ 'dul ba gtan la phab pa nye bar 'khor gyis zhus pa las/ byang chub sems dpa'i so sor thar pa zhes sogs gsungs so// gsang sngags la yang so thar gyi bslab bya thun mong du yod pa/ srog gcod/ ma byin len/ rdzun/ 'dod log rnams kyang phal cher 'dra la/ ngan song sbyong ba las/ chang ni btung bar mi bya zhing*// sha la sogs pa bza' mi bya// zhes sogs mang du gsungs/ mdo sder yang dga' ba can gyi mdo las/ chang gi nyes pa sum cu so drug dang*/ byang sems kyi sde snod na nyes pa so lnga gsungs pa sogs so thar theg pa thun mong yin la/ thun mong gis mi tshad sde snod thams cad kyi rtsa ba'ang yin te/

'dul ba lung las/ ji ltar 'di na shing rtsa gtso bo ste// rnam par 'phel dang kun 'dzin kun gyi gzhi// de bzhin dam chos tshogs rnams kun gyi yang*// gzhi dang rtsa ba 'dul ba yin par gsungs// zhes so// theg pa de rnams kyi 'bras bu sangs rgyas par myur bul yang brtson 'grus che chung yin te/ tshul khrims 'chal ba tshar gcod pa'i mdo las/ bdag cag gi ston pa bas mgon po byams pa sems bskyed pa bskal pa bye ba phrag bzhi bcus snga na yang bdag cag gi ston pa brtson 'grus che bas sngon la sangs rgyas par gsungs pa lta bu yin/ gzhan la gnod pa gzhi bcas las ldog pa yang sdom pa gsum ga 'dra ba sogs rgyu mtshan du ma'i sgo nas so thar theg pa thun mong du nges pa'i phyir bod rgan spyi'i rjes su mi 'brang gsungs so// gnyis pa/ lhag par theg pa chen por bzhugs pa gsal zhes gsungs pa ni/ snga ma'i 'dul ba theg pa thun mong du gsungs pa tsam yang gzhan dag bkri ba'i ched du re zhig gsungs mod/ bzhed pa'i snying po theg pa chen por bzhugs pa'i rgyu mtshan/ dang por byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa'i tshul yang 'dul ba nas gsungs te/ lung sman gyi gzhi las/ bdag cag gi ston pa sngon rgyal bu 'od ldan du sku skye ba bzhes pa'i tshe sangs rgyas zhes bya ba'i sgra thos nas byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa dang*/ lung de nyid las/ rdza mkhan yangs pa'i 'od du gyur pa'i tshe shākya thub pa chen po la bsod snyoms phul nas sems bskyed pa sogs lung mang pos grub/ bar du lam phar phyin drug rdzogs tshul yang 'dul bar gsungs pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i skyes rabs lnga brgyar gsungs pa dang*/ khyad par dmigs bsal du skyes rabs bcu gsal bar phar phyin drug rdzogs par mdzad tshul rgyal po 'od ldan gyi gleng gzhi sogs gsungs pas theg chen gyi bsngo ba'ang ches gsal/ so thar mdo'i zhabs su'ang*/

so sor thar pa bton pa yi// bsod nams grub pa gang yod pa// des ni 'jig rten ma lus pa// thub dbang go 'phang thob par shog / ces sogs theg chen gyi bsngo ba ches mang*/ mthar byang chub thob tshul yang*/ lung dbyen gyi gzhi las mdzad pa bcu gnyis dang*/ lung phran tshegs las mya ngan las 'das pa'i mdzad pa sogs ches mang ngo*// 'grel pa mkhan pos theg chen du bkral ba yang*/ slob dpon yon tan 'od kyi mdo rtsar lnga phrugs nyer gcig gi skabs su/ lhag pa'i tshul khrims dang*/ lhag pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ lhag pa'i shes rab slob tu 'jug pa nyid ces sogs gsungs/ theg chen ni gzhan gyi sdug bsngal bdag gis 'khur nus pa/ bdag dge gzhan la gtong ba la zer na/ 'dul ba'i sgor zhugs nas sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis la gnas pa byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa spyad pa de mchog tu gsungs pa dge slong mi 'khrugs pa'i sems bskyed dam bca' lta bu'o// lha mo dpal phreng gi mdo las/ bcom ldan 'das so sor thar pa dang 'dul ba zhes bya ba'i chos 'di gnyis ni don gcig ste yig 'bru ni tha dad pa lags so// de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di lta ste bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi slad du rab tu byung ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i slad du ste/ bcom ldan 'das de lta bas na 'dir 'dul ba zhes bgyi ba dang rab tu byung ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs pa ni theg pa chen po'i cho ga'i tshul khrims lags so// zhes gsungs so// theg chung zhes pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ rin chen phreng bar/ nyan thos theg pa de la ni// byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam dang*// spyod pa yongs bsngo ma bshad des// byang chub sems dpar ga la 'gyur// zhes dang*/ mdo sde rgyan las| ma tshang ba dang 'gal ba dang*// thabs min de ltar ma bstan phyir// nyan thos kyi ni theg pa 'di// theg chen chos zhes bya ba min// zhes gsungs shing*/ so sor thar pa ni de rnams las ldog pas theg pa chen por bzhugs la/

theg chen zhes pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ dmigs pa che ba nyid dang ni// de bzhin sgrub pa nyid dag dang*// ye shes brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang*// thabs la mkhas par gyur pa dang*// yang dag 'grub pa chen po dang*// sangs rgyas phrin las chen po ste// chen po bdun dang ldan pa'i phyir// theg chen zhes ni nges par brjod// ces sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ don 'di rnams so thar la dpyis phyin pa bzhugs pas theg chen du nges la/ theg pa che chung gi rgyu mtshan mi shes par ming la 'khrul ba 'di rnams ni ches blun pa'o// 'ga' zhig na re/ nyan thos kyi ni theg pa la// theg pa chen por 'chos pa dang*// de bzhin theg chen nyan thos su// 'chos pa tshul khrims ma dag pa// zhes smras mod soms dang*/ 'dul ba theg chen du bzhed pa ni/ lha mo dpal phreng gi mdos dngos su bshad mod/ de tshul khrims ma dag na mtshar che/ ston pa sangs rgyas tshul khrims rnam par ma dag na gzhan dag gi tshul khrims ci 'dra na ya cha'o// yang khyod kyis/ rang nyid tshul khrims bsrung na yang*// tshul khrims la ni mchog 'dzin cing*// gzhan la khyad gsod byed pa ni// ma dag pa yi tshul khrims yin// zhes smras shing bris mod/ shin tu bden che ste/ rang gis tshul khrims rnam dag bsrungs kyang*/ gzhan la khyad du gsod pa ni ma dag pa'i tshul khrims yin par ston pas kyang yang yang gsungs pa dang*/ byang sems la bdag bstod gzhan smod rtsa ltung du gsungs pa dang*/ gsang sngags la khyad du gsod pa yan lag gi ltung ba bdun par gsungs pa sogs ches shin tu mang mod/ de'i phyir na khyod rang gi bstan bcos na rang nyid ces pa nas tshul khrims yin gyi bar dang*/ des dngos dang shugs kyis bstan pa'i ltung ba de rnams khyed rang gis bdag gir mdzod cig /ci'i phyir na/ khyed rang gi bstan bcos de'i 'go nas mjug gi bar gyi tshig don rnams kyi go don dang bsam sbyor la yang dag par soms shig

/gsum pa/ tshul khrims rin po che thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes yin bya ba ni/ 'dul ba thams cad mkhyen pa nyag gcig gi spyod yul yin te sa bcu'i dbang phyug rnams kyis kyang chos 'dul ba'i bslab gzhi bca' bar mi nus na de man chad kyi byang sems rang rgyal nyan thos rnams kyis lta ci smos/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan ji lta ba 'khor 'das kyi gnas lugs rtogs pa/ ji snyed mkhyen pa ni de'i ngang las rgyu 'bras kyi rten 'brel thams cad so sor ma 'dres par mkhyen pa/ yang na stobs bcu'i ji lta ba mkhyen pa'i ye shes zag pa zad pa'i stobs yin/ lhag ma dgu ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i stobs yin pas/ de ltar stobs bcu'am dgus dgag sgrub kyi bslab tshul gsungs la/ tshul khrims bsrungs pas kyang mthar thug stobs bcu mnga' bar 'gyur te/ ji skad du/ tshul khrims la ni gnas na ting nge 'dzin rnams 'thob// ting nge 'dzin la gnas na shes rab shin tu bsgom| |shes rab kyis ni ye shes phun sum tshogs pa 'thob// ye shes rnam par dag na tshul khrims phun sum tshogs// zhes so// don de la dgongs nas lo tsā ba chen po rnams kyis kyang 'dul ba'i glegs bam gyi 'gyur phyag tu/ thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes smos pa dang*/ ston pa yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshe kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ nga 'das nas ston pa so sor thar pa la chol zhes gsungs pa dang*/ so sor thar mdo las/ nga ni mya ngan 'das 'og tu// 'di ni khyod kyi ston pa'o zhes// rang byung nyid kyis gus bcas par| |nan tan dge 'dun tshogs 'dun bstod// ces sogs mang du gsungs pa'i phyir legs par grub pa'o// bzhi pa/ skye ba'i bar chad thams cad 'bras bu thob pa'i bar chad yin gsungs pa ni/ sdom pa skye ba'i bar chad/ skyes pa gnas pa'i bar chad/ khyad par yon tan 'thob pa'i bar chad/ gzhan du mdzes pa'i bar chad de bzhi las/

dang po skye ba'i bar chad ces pa ni/ sdom pa mi skye bar bzhag pa min gyi/ de las 'bras bu mi 'byung bar bzhag pa yin te/ mtshams med kyi las pha dang ma bsad par 'gyod de rab tu byung ba sde snod gsum shes par gyur kyang*/ ston pas mtshams med byas pa de mi skye ba'i chos can du bka' stsal nas bskrad pas rgya mtsho'i 'gram du phyin nas gtsug lag khang byas te slob ma byung bar chos bstan pas dgra bcom thob/ kho rang tshe 'phos nas dmyal bar skyes kyang bsro khang gi 'du shes skyes pas dmyal srung gi tho bas bsnun nas bsad pa rgyal chen bzhi pa'i lhar skyes pa ston pa'i spyan sngar slar bden pa mthong ba de mtshams med byas pa'i lus des dgra bcom sogs 'bras bu ma thob pa dang*/ byang sgra mi snyan pa rnams kyang tshe de la sdom pa'i 'bras bu mi 'byin yang tshe 'phos nas thob pa dang*/ klu bye tshan gyi 'jigs pas rab tu byung ba gnyid log pa'i tshe rang gzugs sbrul du snang ba/ ston pas khyod kyi lus 'di la brten nas yon tan gang yang mi thob pas dge slong rnams la ma 'tshe bar song zhig gsungs pas rgya mtsho'i 'gram du song*/ bstan pa gnas kyi bar du dkon mchog la zhabs tog byed par dam bcas pa lta bu ste/ de ltar na lus rten de rnams la sdom pa phogs kyang lus de ma 'phos bar du dgra bcom sogs 'bras bu mi 'thob pa'i phyir skye ba'i bar chad nyid dang 'bras bu skye ba'i bar chad du 'gyur ba kho na ste/ rje rin po ches/ gling gsum dag tu skyes pa yi// skyes pa bud med ma gtogs pa'i// gzhan gyi rten la 'dod pa yi// bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab las| |seng ge glang chen ru ru dang*// lha dang gnod sbyin la sogs la// so sor thar pa'i rten du gsungs// zhes kyang gsungs so// ma skyes dgra'i 'gyod pa bsal bar ma bsad pa'i mi rab tu byung ba dgra bcom thob par bshad pa dang 'gal lo zhe na mi 'gal te de ni sprul pa yin par mdo las gsal bar gsungs so// lnga pa/

sdom pa'i ngo bo rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs bya ba ni/ kha che bye brag smra bas/ gzugs dang*/ sems dang*/ sems byung dang*/ mi ldan pa'i 'du byed dang 'dus ma byas te shes bya'i gzhi lnga'i gzugs la/ rgyu'i gzugs 'byung ba bzhi/ 'bras gzugs yul lnga/ dbang po lnga/ rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs te bcu gcig gi phyi ma la'ang*/ sdom pa/ sdom min/ bar ma'i dbye bas rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs te/ mdzod las/ rnam rig byed min gsum zhes bya// sdom dang sdom pa ma yin gzhan// sdom pa so sor thar zhes bya// de bzhin bsam gtan zag med skyes// so thar zhes bya rnam pa brgyad// rdzas su rnam pa bzhi yin no// mtshan las ming ni 'pho ba'i phyir// tha dad de dag 'gal ba med// spang bya lnga brgyad bcu dang ni// thams cad spong pa nod pa la// dge bsnyen dang ni bsnyen gnas dang*// dge tshul ched dang dge slong nyid/ ces pa'i sdom pa de rnams mngon gyur bcu sogs tshogs pa'i rkyen gyis dge slong sogs su gyur to snyam pa'i shes pa de rnams bstan du med pa/ thogs pa med pa/ dbang po lnga'i spyod yul du ma gyur pa/ chos khams skye mched kyis bsdus pa rnams rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs zhes sam/ bsam pa'i rang gzugs zhes btags so// rnam rig min pa'i gzugs de la rkyen mi dge bas zhig par rung bas mthun phyogs kyi dge ba nyams su blang*/ mi mthun phyogs kyi mi dge ba spong dgos zhes pa ni don dril ba mdor bsdus pa'i ngo bo'o// gzhan yang mdzod 'grel du/ sdom pa yang dag par blang ba'i rig byed dang*/ rnam par rig byed ma yin pa dang po dag ni so sor thar pa zhes bya ste/ des sdig pa las so sor thar pa'i phyir te spangs pa'i phyir zhes bya ba'i tha tshig go// zhes dang*/ de nyid las/ skad cig ma gnyis pa la sogs pa la ni so sor thar pa'i sdom pa kho na yin gyi/

so sor thar pa ni ma yin no// zhes sdom pa len pa rnam par rig byed/ sdom pa nyid rnam rig min pa/ yang na brje ba gsum las/ bsam pa brje ba rnam rig min pa/ rtags dang cha lugs brje zhing ming spo ba rnam rig sogs su dbye ba'ang zhar gyi 'phros so// 'ga' zhig gis| nyan thos sdom pa rnam rig min// zhes smra ba ni ha cang thal che ste/ rgyu mtshan nyan thos zhes pa sde pa bco brgyad spyi ming du btags pas bco brgyad po thams cad 'dod mthun du sdom pa rnam rig min par khas blangs pa khyod kyis mthong ngam thos/ 'di yod smra'i nang nas kha che bye brag smra ba'i lugs yin mod/ gzhan rnams kyis de ltar khas mi len no// drug pa/ ltung ba mtha' dag la 'du shes gtso bya ba ni/ yul bud med la spyad pa'i rjes su yul nor bar shes pa dang*/ gser rku bsam g.yu dang nor ba lta bu'i 'du shes ma yin gyi/ 'dir kun slong gnyis 'du shes yin pas de gtso bar bzhed/ rgyu mtshan mdo rtsa ba las/ smyo ba dang sems 'khrugs pa la ltung ba med do// zhes dang*/ de nyid las/ shes gtso 'du shes gzhan du gyur pa nyid na'o// zhes dang*/ slob dpon 'phags pa'i bshes spring las/ khyod kyi thugs 'dul mdzod cig bcom ldan gyis// sems ni chos kyi rtsa ba lags par gsungs// zhes so// gzhan yang dge slong ma'i rnam 'byed las/ ser skya'i bu mo bzang mo la rgyal po ma skyes dgras 'dod pa spyad par reg pa bdag gir ma byas pas ltung med du gnang ba dang*/ lung rnam 'byed las/ dge slong dgon pa ba gnyid log par tshogs can mas bkab pa dge slong gis bde ba bdag gir ma byas pa dang*/ g.yen pa na ba'i dge slong lci thun mas bkab pa bde ba bdag gir ma byas pas ltung med du gnang ba sogs lung dang gleng gzhi mang pos yang dag par grub bo// gzhan yang dge sdig gang yin yang sems gtso ba tshong dpon spobs pa'i blo gros kyi gleng gzhi la rgyal rigs dang bram ze'i khye'u gnyis kyi gtam rgyud dang*/

lha'i dbu la lham krad phul ba dang bsal ba gnyis ka rang sangs rgyas thob pa lta bu sogs ches mang la/ 'dir byas la ma bsags pa'i las sogs mu bzhi'i rgyas bshad 'byung yang rtsa ba'i dgongs pa lung rigs de tsam gyis grub pa dang yi ger 'jigs pas bzhag la/ spro na rdo sher ma las rtogs par bya'o// bdun pa/ gtso bor yid kyi gsum spong gsungs pa ni/ so sor thar pa'i spang bya'i gtso bo brnab sems 'dod chags/ gnod sems zhe sdang*/ log lta gti mug ste/ 'di gsum gtso bor spong dgos pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bzang sbyin dang mdzes dga' la bka' stsal pa/ ngas 'dod chags 'dod chags dang bral ba dang*/ zhe sdang 'dod chags dang bral ba dang*/ gti mug 'dod chags dang bral ba'i phyir sems dang shes rab rnam par grol ba'i chos bstan na/ ci'i phyir khyod kyis mi mdzes pa de lta bu byed/ ces bka' stsal pa dang*/ so thar mdo las/ sems rta kha blan dka' ba la// mthun pa gzer gnon rgyab pa yi// srab 'di so sor thar 'di yin// zhes dang*/ spyod 'jug las/ sems bsrung brtul zhugs ma gtogs pa// brtul zhugs mang pos ci zhig bya// zhes dang*/ gzhan yang rgyal rigs dang bram ze'i rigs kyi khye'u zas thob ma thob kyi dad pa dang*/ sems 'khrugs pa'i ngag gi 'bras bu 'phral du smin pa dang*/ dge tshul klu la sems khros nas log par smon pas lus de nyid du klur gyur pa'i dpes/ las dge sdig thams cad la yid gtso che ba kho nar nges te/ sor mo'i phreng ba la phan pa'i mdo las/ rin chen sems ni yongs su 'dul// 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin// zhes so| |mdor na 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad yid kyi cho 'phrul las byung ba ste/ rdo rje gur las/ rin chen sems las phyir gyur pa'i// sangs rgyas med cing sems can med// ces so// 'ga' zhig gis/ nyan thos sdom pa rnam rig min// lus ngag las ni skye bar 'dod// ces yid kyi brjod bya de gtso ba gzhir bzhag nas ma smos par lus ngag de'i yan lag tu bsams te smos srid/

de lta na 'gal ba med mod/ 'on kyang gtso bo mi smos pa mi srid/ des na lus ngag las skye yid las mi skye zhe na/ yid dang bral ba'i bem po la sdom pa skye ba khyod kyi khyad chos srid mtha'i bar du mtshar che/ 'on te slob dpon yon tan 'od kyi mdo rtsa bar/ shes gtso/ zhes sogs gsungs pa la cis bsnyon/ rtsa ba yid dor nas yan lag lus ngag smos pa dper na zhing sa med pa'i myu gu dang 'bras bu lta bu ches ngo mtshar/ yid dang bral ba'i sdom pa len pa'i gang zag des/ las chog gi skabs da res 'dir bsam pa rab bskyed de sogs dang*/ brjod pa tha ma'i dus thob pas thob bsam pa'i bsam pa bskyed cig zer ba sogs/ go don lus bem po dang ngag brag cha lta bu des 'dun pa de 'dra bsam shes pa mkhan po slob ma 'dul ba gsum gyi mdo ches ngo mtshar ro// brgyad pa/ gtong ba'i rgyu de dag gis mi gtong ba yang yod gsungs pa ni/ mdzod las/ bslab pa phul sogs rgyu dgur gsungs pa spyir bstan nas/ bye brag tu gtong ba'i rgyu de dag gis mi gtong ba yang yod de/ lung rnam 'byed las/ bslab pa phul la ma nyams pa/ nyams la ma phul ba| phul yang ma phul nyams kyang ma nyams pa/ phul yang phul nyams kyang nyams pa ste mu bzhi las/ tha mas gtong gzhan gsum gyis mi gtong la shi 'phos nas kyang mi gtong ba 'di la/ 'bri gung pa chen po'i dgongs pa/ tshul khrims kyis yid kyi nyon mongs pa bsdams te dbang po yul rjes su mi 'brang bas gang zag de'i tshul khrims kyi bag chags 'dris pa bar do dang skye ba phyi ma tshun chad du yang mi gtong ste/ rnam par shes pa 'pho ba'i mdo las/ bzang skyong*/ rnam par shes pa'i khams 'di ni lus yongs su btang nas dge ba dang mi dge ba'i rjes su 'jug ste/ de'ang ji ltar zhe na/ rnam par shes pa'i khams gzugs can ma yin pa 'dis lus 'di bor nas sngar gyi bsod nams dang bsod nams ma yin pa dag yongs su 'dzin to// zhes dang*/

dus 'khor bsdus rgyud las/ rnal 'byor dbang po rnam 'byor ma thob rab tu g.yo ba'i yid kyis gal te shi bar gyur pa na// dpal ldan mi yi 'jig rten du ni rab mchog thub pa'i rigs su rnal 'byor ldan par skye bar 'gyur// sngon gyi goms pa de yis slar yang ye shes rnal 'byor yangs pa dag ni kun tu 'dzin par 'gyur| |zhes dang*/ phal chen dang skyes rabs las/ dge dang mi dge'i las rnams goms byas na// mi rnams la ni 'dris pa nyid du 'gyur// de lta bu dag ched du ma sgrub kyang*| |srid pa gzhan la rmi lam lta bur spyod// ces sogs dus 'khor dang*/ mdo 'di dag gi lung gis kyang bag chags gang 'dris pa de la phyi mar yang spyod par gsungs pa dang*/ snying rje pad dkar las/ zhing khams dri sngo snang ba rdul bral dang*/ bde ba can du pad+ma la brdzus te skyes nas bya ma bum dang lhung bzed snam sbyar sogs rang chas su 'ong bar gsungs pa dang*| khri rkang gi gleng gzhi las/ dge slong khri la bsam gtan sgom pa gnyid bro ba phyogs gzhan du khrus la song ba'i skabs dug sbrul tshad pas gdung ba khri'i 'og tu bsil rlan la 'khor ba ma shes nas khri'i steng du 'dug pa na dug sbrul mnan pa ltar song nas khros te/ dge slong gi smin mtshams su so btab nas shi ba sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lhar skyes pa'i tshe lha'i 'dod yon la ma chags par dge slong gi dran pa ma nyams par bshad pa sogs mang du gsungs so// 'grel pa snga ma rnams su dbang po rab kyis mi gtong bar bshad mod/ lung don 'di rnams la dpyad na dbang po 'bring dang tha mas kyang mi gtong ba ches gsal te dbang po'i bye brag kha gsal du ma phye ba'i phyir ro// gzhan dag tu/ sdom pa gzugs can yin pa'i phyir// shi ba'i tshe na sdom pa gtong*// zhes mdzod kyi lung de'i rjes su 'brangs mod/ 'di la dpyad de sdom pa thob kyang bsrung sems med pa dag la bag chags med pas gtong ba bden du chug

/bsrung sems can ni bag chags des bar dor yang dge slong gi dngos po las gzhan mi 'gyur la/ min na bar dor bag chags kyis kha bsgyur bar bshad pa mi 'thad/ bar dor bag chags gzhan 'ong so thar gyi bag chags kho na mi 'ong ba ni mi srid pa'i phyir ro// bshad pa de 'dra ba ni lung gi rjes kho na mtha' cig tu 'brangs nas bar do sogs kyi nyams len la 'dris goms til 'bru tsam zhig kyang med par thal la/ tshe 'phos pas mi gtong ba'i gnad zab mo zab lam nā ro'i chos drug gi bar do'i mngal dgag pa la yod mod/ ma mthong zhing nyams su ma blang ba la cha ci yod yid kyi las gsum spong bas kyang mi gtong ngo*// 'di las 'phros pa paṇa chen zi lung ba'i gser thur la/ karma pa mi bskyod zhabs kyis gnas brtan bcu drug mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshe yang de rnams kyi thugs rgyud kyi sdom pa gtong bar thal bas/ gnas brtan bcu drug sdom pa gtong ba'i tshe rgan po shākya ba yang 'khar ba 'khur nas yong shog gsungs pa yang shin tu thugs mad do// gzhan yang skabs 'dir rje lo chen puṇ+ya sā gar se na'i mchan bur/ pham pa gcig byung yang lhag ma gsum mi gtong ste/ gal te gcig nyams pas gsum po gtong na bzhir phye ste gsungs pa la dgos pa med cing*/ gleng gzhi dga' ba can la pham pa dang po byung yang dge slong du bzhag pa dgra bcom thob nas sor chud pas kyang shes shing*/ mngon pa mdzod dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur las/ kha che dag ni byung ba la// bu lon nor bzhin gnyis su 'dod// ces so// des na mdzod lung ltar gtong byed kyi rgyu dgu po bzhis nges par gtong*/ shi 'phos chos nub mtshan 'das gsum gyis phyed gtong*/ bslab pa phul ba dang rtsa ltung byung bas bzhi cha re gtong*/ gtso bo yid kyi gsum spong ba 'di gal che'o// rdo rje'i gsung pham pa bzhi bu lon nor can dang 'dra zhes gsungs pa yang 'di nyid kyi nang du bshad zin pas go bar byos shig

/dgu pa/ sna gcig bsrungs pa'i 'bras bus mya ngan las 'da' zhes pa ni/ spyir sangs rgyas la ston pa/ chos la lam/ dge 'dun la lam grogs kyi dang ba'i sems dang ma bral na rdzogs byang thob pa thag mi ring*/ 'dun pa de nyid kho nas kyang byang chub thob na/ de'i steng du bslab gzhi'i nang tshan las sna gang rung zhig bsrung na ci'i phyir 'tshang mi rgya/ sngon 'od srung gi bstan pa la rab tu byung ba'i dge slong bslab pa nyams pa 'ga' zhig bdag cag gi ston pa'i dus rgyun zhugs nas dgra bcom gyi bar thob pa las brgya pa sogs las gsungs pa dang*/ snying rje pad dkar las/ nga'i bstan pa la bslab pa lhod pa chang ma'i khyim du bu'i lag pa nas bzung ste 'jug pa'ang sangs rgyas stong gi phyi ma tshun la myang 'das su lung bstan pa'i phyir ro| |zhes so// des na mgon po 'bri gung pa chen po'i zhal nas/ ston pa'i ma 'dres dam pa'i chos// dgag dang sgrub pa'i bslab pa la// sna gcig tsam zhig bsrung na yang*// mya ngan 'da' bas nga re skyid// ces gsungs so// gzhan yang dge bsnyen la/ sna gcig spyod pa/ sna 'ga' spyod pa/ phal cher spyod pa sogs 'dul ba'i brjod bya la rlung ltar grags so| |bcu pa/ bcas pa dang rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba'i sdig pa gcig pa yin zhes gsungs pa ni/ spyir mi dge ba'i las kyi ngo bo nyid ni rang bzhin gyis bcas pa la khyab/ bcas pas rang bzhin la khyab/ dper na kham bu'i sdong po gnyis gcig bdag pos bsrungs gcig ma bsrung yang*/ ngo bo de nyid kham bu las dbye ba med pa lta bu/ de yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das shes bya'i gnas ma lus pa mkhyen pas rgyu 'bras kyi rten 'brel bslu med du gzigs/ chos thams cad kyi ngo bor sangs rgyas/ phywa dang dbang phyug byed pa po ma yin/ sems can thams cad la thugs snyoms pa'i brtse ba rgyun mi 'chad pa dang*/ bar du brtson pa mi 'dor zhing phan bde'i lam la sbyor ba ste rgyu mtshan bzhi pos kyang gcig

/dge ba'i gshis kyi 'bras bu bde ba/ mi dge ba'i gshis kyi 'bras bu sdug bsngal las go log mi 'byung bas kyang mi gcig ka med yin/ don gyi ngo bo mi dge ba bcu la rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba zer/ bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba mi dge bcu las logs su med kyang rnam grangs nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum sogs ni lci yang dang rtsa ba dang yan lag gi zlas phye ba'i phyir ngo bo mtshungs la/ lkugs 'phye'i 'khor lnga brgya dang*/ sangs rgyas pa'i 'khor lnga brgyas lhag pa'i yo byad bcangs pa'i gleng gzhi sogs mtha' yas pa gsungs pas go sla'o// bcu gcig pa/ khams gsum gyi rgyal pos 'gro ba spyi la bcas bya ba ni/ bcas dang rang bzhin gcig na 'khor gyi nyan thos las 'gro ba gzhan la ma bcas so zer na min te/ ston pa la nye ring mi mnga' bas bcas pa'i tshogs thams cad 'gro ba spyi la bcas pa kho na yin te/ ston pas dang po thugs bskyed/ bar du tshogs bsags/ tha mar sangs rgyas nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan las 'da' ba phan chad sems can thams cad kyi don du mdzad pa las 'khor gyi nyan thos dge slong dge tshul sogs la bslab gzhi bcas pa de rnams kyi don kho na min te/ rgya cher rol ba las/ kun tu rgyu dang nyer 'tsho la// nga ni wā rā ṇa sīr 'gro// grong khyer gsal ldan der song nas// long ba lta bu'i sems can la// mtshungs pa med pa'i 'od bya'o// zhes sogs gsungs pa dang*/ tha na gang zag re re lung ston na yang*/ zhal gyi sgo nas 'od spros pas 'og min gyi bar snang bar byas nas sems can mang po'i don mdzad pa sogs ches mang la/ bcas pa bsrungs pa'i phan yon dang 'das pa'i nyes pa ni mtho dman kun la khyad med de/ gleng gzhi me'i shing rta 'dren pa'i dpe dang*/ gzhon nu ku sha dang*/ gzhon nu lkugs 'phye dang*/ legs 'ong sogs lta bu dang*/ gsog 'jog la mtshon na gzhon nu chu skyes lta bu yin/

sor phreng la gdams pa'i mdo las/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing*// dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad| |rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul// 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// 'dul ba bsdus te bstan pa yin// zhes 'dul ba'i rtsa ba dge sgrub sdig spong las med pas na bcas pa thams cad 'gro ba spyi la bcas pa nyid do// bcu gnyis pa/ sdig pa dang ltung ba tha dad med cing gcig pa yin bya ba ni/ bshad ma thag pa'i bcas pa dang rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba gcig pa'i phyir dang*/ bcas pa thams cad 'gro ba spyi la bcas pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis sdig ltung tha dad med cing gcig pa nyid grub ste/ so skyes sdig pa byas pa ngan song du 'gro/ sdom ldan gyis bslab pa nyams na dmyal bar 'gro bas khyad med de/ lung rnam 'byed du/ ltung ba re re'i mjug tu ngan song gsum du ltung zhes gsungs pas kyang 'dra/ sdom pa ma thob pas sdig pa zhes dang*/ thob pas ltung ba zhes ming tha dad mod/ ngo bo la khyad par dbye ba med pa'i phyir/ nyes pa che chung dang gnyen po stobs che chung sogs kyis mtshams med kyi las la'ang lci yang 'byung ba dang*/ ltung ba la yang yan lag rdzogs ma rdzogs kyis lci yang du bzhag pas khyad par med cing 'di go sla bas rnam bshad de tsam las mi dgos so// bcu gsum pa/ spyir bkag pa thams cad ye bkag gnang ba thams cad ye gnang yin gsungs pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa chos thams cad kyi ngo bor sangs rgyas shing gnas dang gnas min mkhyen pa shes bya'i gshis las gzhan du mi 'gyur ba'i ye shes kyis gzigs pa des thog mar bkag pa mthar gnang*/ thog mar gnang ba mthar 'gog pa sogs gang zag blun po'i spyod pa ltar mi mdzad pa nyid yin la/ dper na 'khrid mkhas kyis yang dag gi lam la sbyor ba shā ri'i bus khyi rkun rkang chag la lhag ma byin pas sems dga' ba'i mod shi ba mir skyes pa la chos bshad pas dgra bcom pa lta bu yin zhing*/

phyi dro'i zas bkag pa nad pa la yang zas la sred pas za na bkag la nad 'tsho sman gyi 'du shes la gnang ba yang*/ sred pa'i zas ni rnam pa kun tu bkag la/ nad 'tsho'i zas ni rnam pa kun tu gnang ba'i phyir dang*/ shā ri'i bus btsun mo dpal ldan ma la nyi ma nub par chos bstan pa ltung med ni/ gnyis ka'i sems la chos ldan las nyon mongs med pa dang*/ las chos bstan pa dang*/ mthar btsun mos bden pa mthong ba'i phyir/ de yang yul bud med la'ang nyon mongs med pas chos ston cing bden pa la 'khod pa ni thog mtha' gang du'ang ma bkag la/ nyon yid kyis bud med dang lhan cig las gsog pa ni thog mtha' kun tu ma gnang ba'i phyir dang*/ yang bud med chus khyer ba la sa'am bong ba'i 'du shes bskyed nas 'don par gsungs pa ni/ bud med la chags sems kyis 'ju ba ni thog mtha' kun tu bkag la/ bong ba dang sa la 'ju ba ni thog mtha' kun tu gnang ba'i phyir dang*/ 'di ni gzhan don la 'gyur phyir bud med sa bong du bsgoms nas thabs mkhas des reg pa nyes med mdzad cing thabs mang bas sgos theg chen du shugs kyis grub la/ bud med la chags sems kyis 'ju ba ni thog mtha' kun tu reg pa bas blta ba yang bkag nas/ chags sems med na sa bong du bsgoms nas reg pa nyes med dang*/ chags sems med pa'i gzhan don lhag bsam gyis dus tshod las 'das pa'i chos bstan pa ltung med du bzhag pa sogs kyis ltung ba mtha' dag la 'du shes gtso ba'ang yang dag par grub bo// gzhan yang 'phags pa legs 'ong la chang gi bcas pa dang mauṅgal gyi bu dang ma 'gags pa sogs la bud med dang lhan cig gnas gcig tu nyal ba'i bcas pa mdzad pa la/ gong ma ni dud 'gro'i rgyud la yod kyang gnang la/ des na las dang po pa la bkag phyis gnang ba min te/ las kyi cho ga'i gdams ngag brjod pa'i skabs de ring bsnyen par rdzogs pas gang la bslabs pa de la bsnyen par rdzogs nas lo brgya lon pas kyang bslab par bya'o// bsnyen par rdzogs nas lo brgya lon pas gang la bslabs pa de la de ring bsnyen par rdzogs pas kyang bslab par bya'o// zhes so// sems smyo ba dang 'khrul ba'i ltung ba nyes med du bzhag pa yang skabs gcig po der yin gyi rnam pa kun tu min no// skabs 'dir gzhan dag

/dkar nag zang thal zhes bya ba'i// chos skad ngo mtshar che bar grags// de dag gis ni drang don la// nges pa'i don du 'khrul bar snang*// zhes pa la brtag na/ mgon po 'bri gung pa chen po ni| rnam pa kun tu mi dge ba'i las 'bras sdug bsngal ba dang*/ dge ba'i las 'bras bde 'gro'i go 'phang du 'gyur ba sogs las gzhan pa'i go log mi 'byung bar dgongs mod/ khong dag rgyu 'bras de 'dra ba drang don du bzhed na/ mi dge ba spyad na bde 'gro dang*/ dge bas ngan song du 'gro ba khong pa'i nges don gyi bzhed par yod pa khong rang gi tshig des gsal por grub pas mtshar che'o// yang khong dag /ded dpon snying rje chen po yis// tshong dpon g.yon can bsad pa yi// zhes pa nas/ des na dgongs pa shes dgos so// zhes rgyas bshad dang bcas gsungs mod/ 'di yang dpyad kyi/ ded dpon des tshong pa g.yon can bsad pa'i las mang po ded dpon gyis nyams su myong ba'i mthar sangs rgyas nas kyang seng ldeng tsher ma zug pa sogs ni gdul bya la tshul bstan yin gyi don dam min/ sangs rgyas ni stug po bkod par sangs rgyas pa'i longs sku de yin/ shāka thub ni de'i sprul sku yin/ de rang rgyud min sprul sku yin pas tshul ston tsam las dngos su sangs rgyas kyis las de myong na longs skus myong dgos pas de mi srid/ sgyu ma'i sprul pas sdug bsngal myong ba ni sgyu ma mkhan gyis myong gi sprul pa la mi 'byung zhes 'dod mod/ de yang rnam par 'khyams te/ ji skad du/ skabs der ston pas/ gang du gnas kyang las kyis mi brdzi ba'i/ */sa phyogs de ni yod pa ma yin te/ */ zhes sogs 'khor lo gsum ga'i brjod bya'i gtso bo rgyu 'bras las gzhan bstan pa ci yod/ khyod kyi 'dod pa ston pa sprul sku la smin pa'i las de tshul ston drang don/ gzhan rnams kyi las myong ba nges don rtag brtan zhig tu gyur mod/

mgon po byams pas/ sems las gzhan med par ni blos rig nas// de nas sems kyang med pa nyid du rtogs// blo dang ldan pas gnyis po med rig nas// de mi ldan pa chos kyi dbyings la gnas// zhes drang ba'i don du thams cad med bzhin du snang la/ nges pa'i don du chos thams cad ngo bo nyid spros pa'i mtha' las 'das par gsungs pa ma thos sam/ yang khong dag gis/ ye bkag ye gnang zhes bya ba// sangs rgyas bstan dang mthun pa min// nyan thos dang ni theg chen gyi// gnang bkag thams cad gcig tu med// des na la lar gnang ba ni// la la'i bkag pa nyid du 'gyur// zer mod/ de dpyad kyi 'dul bar bkag pa byang sems su gnang ba med mod/ gnang na sdom pa gnyis 'gal khyab tu 'gyur te/ dper na rdo rje spun la khros na gsang sngags kyi rtsa ltung gsum pa dang*/ sems can la byams pa spangs pas bzhi pa/ byang sems kyi sems can la 'tshe ba dang*/ so thar gyi dge sbyong gi chos bzhi las nyams pa'i phyir dang*/ de'i steng du bde gshegs bka' 'das kyang 'byung ba'i dpes khyod kyi 'dod pa rnam par 'khyams so// yang khong dag /nyan thos rtsa ba'i sde bzhi la// 'dul ba mi 'dra rnam bzhi yod// ces dang*/ de las gyes pa bco brgyad la// 'dul ba'i dbye ba'ang bco brgyad yod| |ces pa nas/ mtho ris kyang ni 'byung re skan// zhes bstan bcos mnas blus pa'i rgyas bshad dang bcas 'byung mod/ rigs pa ma yin te/ skabs 'dir 'dul ba mi 'dra ba bzhi dang bco brgyad du khas blangs/ snga rol bstan bcos kyi 'gor/ nyan thos rnams kyi skyabs 'gro nas// dge slong gi ni sdom pa'i bar// ji srid 'tsho yi bar du yin// shi ba'i tshe na sdom pa gtong*// sdom pa rnams kyi 'bras bu ni// shi ba'i tshe na 'byung bar 'gyur// zhes dang*/ nyan thos sdom pa rnam rig min// lus ngag las ni skye bar 'dod// sdom pa gzugs can yin pa'i phyir// shi ba'i tshe na sdom pa gtong*// zhes nyan thos zhes spyi tshig dang*/

sdom pa rnams kyi zhes mang tshig sogs sbyar nas nyan thos so thar gyi sdom pa yin no cog skyabs 'gro nas dge slong gi bar ji srid 'tsho ba pa/ shi nas gtong ba/ 'bras bu shi nas gzod thob pa/ gzugs rnam rig min pa/ rten lus ngag las skye ba sogs thams cad mtshungs par khas blangs pa dang*/ skabs 'dir 'dul ba mi 'dra bco brgyad yod pa tha na byin len tshul mi 'dra ba so sor yod ces 'gal ba ltag sprod 'di yang mtshar che/ yang khong gis/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku rnams dang*/ zhes pa nas/ ltung ba thams cad spyod phyir ro// zhes pa'i bar yang ye bkag ye gnang la rgol bar sems kyang lugs de ni ye bkag ye gnang gi dgongs pa dpyis phyin pa ste/ rgyu mtshan longs sku rnams dbu skra rgyan cha sogs dang*/ grub thob rnams kyi cha lugs dang*/ spos ngad ldan pa'i dge slong rgyan gos dkar po can sogs ni ye nas de ltar gnang bas de ltar grub cing*/ bye smra ba'i 'dul ba la rtags cha lugs sogs ye nas 'di ltar gnang bas kyang ye gnang*/ longs sku sogs theg chen gyi chos la de 'dra ba'i rtags cha lugs bkag pas ye bkag tu grub mod/ khyod kyi ye bkag sogs dgag pa ltar byas nas sgrub pa ni ngo mtshar ro// yang khong dag /bu mo gser mchog 'od ldan gyis// blo gros chen po 'jam dpal la// rab tu byung bar zhus pa'i tshe// lus kyi rab byung bkag nas kyang*// sems kyi rab byung thob par mdzad// ces bris/ sngar sdom pa lus ngag las skye yid mi gtso bar bshad mod/ 'di gnyis kyi 'gal ba gang gis bsdum/ sho lo ka 'di ni 'bri gung pa chen po'i ltung ba mtha' dag la 'du shes gtso ba dang*/ gtso bor yid kyi gsum spong dgos pa'i gsal byed rnam dag tu 'dug pas rjes su yi rang ngo*// gzhan yang khong dag gi legs bshad du de 'dra ba'i 'gal ba ltag sprod dang*/ gzhan dgag pa'i tshig ltar bris na yang tshig don la dpyad tshe dgag bya de nyid sgrub pa'i legs bshad dpyis phyin pa mgo skyes kyi grangs las kyang ches mang ba zhig 'dug na'ang*/

yi ges ngal ba'i khur ma theg pas re zhig spros pa de tsam gyis chog go// bcu bzhi pa/ 'gro drug gang gis bsrung yang phan yon 'byung bya ba ni/ bde bar gshegs pas bcas pa'i bslab gzhi rnams 'gro ba rigs drug gang gis bsrungs kyang phan yon 'byung ba ste/ rdza mkhan dga' skyong rang gi lag gis sa brko ba spangs pa dang*/ kā shi'i nags su sems can chen po bzhis gtan khrims bsrungs pas kā shi'i rgyal po 'khor bcas la bde legs byung ba sogs ches mang zhing*/ mdor bsdu na/ dpung bzang gis zhus pa las/ rgyal ba ngas gsungs so sor thar pa yang*| |tshul khrims rnam dag 'dul ba ma lus las// sngags pa khyim pas rtags dang cho ga spang*// lhag ma rnams ni nyams su blang bar bya// de ltar sdig pa'i chos las rnam grol lam/ /bde bar gshegs pas legs par gsungs pa'i chos// dag cing grol ba dang ni ldan par 'gyur// zhes khyim pas kyang rab byung gi rtags cha lugs dang las kyi cho ga dor nas khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum bsrung na phan yon ches che bar gsung mod/ gzhan dag na re/ kha cig rab tu byung ba la// ltung ba ji snyed 'byung ba de| |khyim pa nas ni dmyal ba'i bar// zhes pa nas/ mtho ris kyang ni 'byung re skan// zhes pa'i bar rnams dpung bzang gi lung 'di dang ches 'gal lo// bco lnga pa/ 'gro drug gang gis bcas pa las 'das kyang nyes pa 'byung bya ba ni/ rdor gsung snga ma de nyid kyi phyir/ 'gro drug gang gis bcas pa las 'das kyang nyes pa 'byung ste/ lung dang bzhag pa las/ bskal pa dang po la ma rmos pa'i 'bras sā lu gsog 'jog gis 'grib pa dang*/ phyi rol pa'i drang srong lnga brgyas yo byad lhag po bcangs pas mngon shes lnga ma thob pa dang*/ glang khu yur dang sa ri la mi snyan pa brjod pas khyim bdag gi rgyan shor ba sogs ches mang zhing*/ brjod ma thag pa'i rdo rje'i gsung gi lung rig rnams kyis kyang 'di nyid grub pa'o// bcu drug pa/

bstan pa la cho ga lhag par gal che bar bzhed pa ni/ ltung ba la 'du shes gtso ba dang*/ yid kyi gsum spong ba dang*/ bcas dang rang bzhin gcig pa sogs kyis cho ga med par bsrung yang chog go snyam na chog mod/ 'on te bstan pa la 'jug na cho ga ches gal che ba yin te/ lung las/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang*// mkhan po slob dpon bsnyen rdzogs 'dod| |yo byad yongs su dag pa dang*// gsol dang las ni mngon sum mo// zhes mngon gyur bcu nges par dgos par gsungs pa dang*/ gzhan yang cho ga yod med kyis bstan pa yod med du 'jog pa nye bar 'khor gyis zhus par gsungs pa dang*/ lung las nga yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas cho ga phun sum tshogs pa la brten par bya'o// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa dang*/ cho ga'i phyag bzhes kyi blang dor shes pa dang*/ sku gzugs mkhan slob dge 'dun dang bcas pa'i mdun du khas blangs pas ngo tsha khrel yod shes pa sogs rgyu mtshan mang zhing*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ston pa so thar la chol gsungs pa dang*/ nga ni mya ngan 'das 'og tu// 'di ni khyod kyi ston pa'o zhes// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ brje ba rnam pa gsum sogs kyis nan tan du sdom pas bsam pa rnam dag srung sems g.yel med du 'byung ba sogs dgos pa ches mang zhing*/ gzhan yang dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin las bdud sdig can 'ching ba las grol ba'i phyir sems bskyed tshul sogs gleng gzhis kyang gsal lo// don 'di lta bu gsal bar mgon po 'bri gung pa chen pos gsung bzhin du/ 'dul 'dzin mkhan por rlom pa 'ga' zhig mngon gyur bcu la snang chung du 'jog cing dge 'dun yang bcu phrag sogs tshogs su ma longs kyang rang gis go chod pa byed cing*| gsol bzhi'i las sogs so thar gyi lag len zhib tu mi byed par/ 'ol tshod spyi brtol gyis mkhan po gnas brtan zhes pa'i ming thob pa gtso bor byed cing so thar gyi sdom pa sbyin no zhes pa'i mkhan po dang*/

de 'dra ba la sdom pa thob bo zhes bsrung mi dgos pa'i thob ming la sems pa'i mkhan bu rnams ni rnam par nyams so// bcu bdun pa/ mi shes pa gti mug lhag par nyes pa che bya ba ni/ spyir 'khor bar 'khor ba ni nyes pa ma rig pa kho na yin la ma rig pa ni dngos po sogs ma mthong ba la mi zer/ gti mug pa la zer ba yin/ 'dod chags dang zhe sdang sogs nyon mongs pa gzhan rnams ma rig pa las skye ba yin/ des na 'khor ba'i gzhi rtsa ma rig pa yin te/ 'phags pa sdud pa las/ sems can tha ma 'bring dang mchog gyur ji snyed pa// de kun ma rig las byung bde bar gshegs pas gsungs// zhes so// gzhan yang nye bar 'khor la/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'dod chags ni nyes pa chung la 'bral dka'/ zhe sdang ni nyes pa che la 'bral sla/ gti mug ni nyes pa'ang che la 'bral yang dka'o// zhes gsungs so// 'di'i khongs su rdo rje'i gsung*/ dud 'gro gti mug che bas lhag par dman bya ba yang 'du ste/ dmyal ba dang yi dwags kyi sems can rnams ni shes pa shin tu gsal bas snga ma'i las gang gis 'di 'dra bar skyes snyam pa'i 'gyod pa dang sdug bsngal 'byung zhing*/ phyis mi byed snyam pa'i dran shes kyang 'byung la de 'dra ba'i 'gyod pa dang dran shes ni stobs bzhi'i ya gyal gnyis po yin pas sdig pa 'dag pa'i thabs khyad par can yin la/ dud 'gro ni de 'dra bar skyes kyang glen lkugs kyis slar gcig la gcig za ba sogs nag po'i phyogs 'ba' zhig byed cing*/ de la der 'du mi shes pa sogs kyis shin tu dman te/ mdo dran pa nyer bzhag las/ sems can dmyal bar skyes pa ni sla'i/ dud 'gro'i skye gnas su skyes pa ni de lta ma yin no// zhes gsungs pas dmyal ba dang yi dwags ni de nas 'phos te bde 'gro'am las de sdug bsngal che bas zad myur bas mtho ris su skye la/ dud 'gro ni lus des bsags pa slar ngan 'gro gzhan gnyis su 'gro'am dud 'gror slar skye ba sogs 'bras bu myong dgos pas shin tu sdug bsngal yun ring ngo*// bco brgyad pa/

nyams pa'i nyes pa bas ma thob pa nyes pa lci zhes gsungs pa ni/ sngar thob nas nyams kyang 'gyod sems kyang 'byung bas yang la/ thob pa'i dus dang ji tsam bsrungs pa'i phan yon chud mi za ba yin la/ ma thob pas ni nyes pa la nyes par ma mthong ba'i steng*/ nga dge slong lta bu ni min pas 'di lta bu spyad byar 'os so snyam pa'i 'dun pa dran shes dang bcas pas spyad na sdig pa ches ma thob pa lci ste/ dbyig gnyen gyis/ mi shes sdig pa byas pa shin tu lci| |mkhas pas sdig pa byas pa yang bar 'gyur// lcags kyi gong bu chung yang gting du 'gro// de nyid snod byas che yang kha la 'phyo// zhes gsungs shing*/ gzhan yang gcung mdzes dga' bo/ sor phreng can/ ma skyes dgra/ bde byed sogs lta bu dang*/ pha ma bsad pa'i dge slong lta bu 'byung ba ni sngon gyi gleng gzhis kyang shes la/ bshes spring las/ gang zhig sngon chad bag med gyur pa las// phyis nas bag dang ldan par gyur pa na// zla ba sprin bral lta bur rnam mdzes te// dga' bo sor phreng mthong ldan bde byed bzhin// zhes dang*/ rab tu byung ba'i gzhi las/ gang zhig snga nas bag med pa// phyis nas bag dang ldan gyur na// nyi zla sprin nas byung ba ltar// 'jig rten 'dir ni de snang 'gyur// zhes dang*/ sa'i snying po 'khor lo bcu pa'i mdo las/ me tog tsam pa ka ni rnying gyur kyang*// me tog phal pa gzhan gyis do zla min// dge slong tshul khrims nyams shing sdig spyod kyang*// mu stegs byed dag gzhan gyis do zla min /zhes dang*/ de nyid las/ tshangs pa chen po de ltar tshul khrims nyams shing sdig pa byed pa'i dge slong de ngas bstan pa'i 'dul ba la mi ro lta bu'o// zhes gsungs mod kyi/ 'on kyang sngar rab tu byung ba dang tshul khrims bsrungs pa'i yon tan lhag pa'i mthu yod do// dper na khyu mchog gam gla ba lta bu shi ste rnam par shes pa dang bral na byol song gi nang na ro yin mod kyi/

khyu mchog la gi wang yod pa dang*/ gla ba la gla rtsi yod pa des sems can dpag tu med pa la phan pa dang bde ba'i don chen por 'gyur ba bzhin du/ tshul khrims nyams pa'i dge slong ro lta bu yin kyang*/ dper na rab tu byung ba dang tshul khrims kyi yon tan lhag pa'i mthus rang dang sems can dpag tu med pa la phan pa dang bde bar 'gyur ro// zhes dang*/ gzhan yang gnas pa'i grong gi shan pa dang smad 'tshong mas yan lag brgyad pa dang ldan pa'i gso sbyong blangs te/ mtshan mo dang nyin mo res mos kyi bsrungs pas de'i 'bras bu bde ba dang sdug bsngal res 'jog tu smin par gsungs pa'i gleng gzhi lung gzhi na bshad pa lta bu ches mang ngo*// 'phags pa gser 'od dam pa las/ gang gis bskal pa stong rnams su// shin tu mi bzad sdig bgyis pa// lan gcig rab tu bshags pa yis// de dag thams cad 'byang bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs so// de ltar na 'di rnams mdor bsdu na phyogs lngar yang 'du ste/ 'gro ba spyi la bcas pa dang*/ bcas dang rang bzhin gcig /sdig pa dang ltung ba gcig pa rnams rgyal ba'i bstan pa spyi la khyab phyogs/ 'gro drug gang gis bsrung yang phan yon 'byung la/ gang gis nyams kyang nyes pa 'byung ba dang*/ ye bkag ye gnang rnams/ blangs dang ma blang 'bras bu mnyam phyogs/ gang gis 'das kyang nyes pa che ba sogs bslab pa bral ba nyes pa che phyogs/ sna gcig bsrungs pa'i 'bras bu myang 'das 'thob pa sogs lan gcig blang pa phan yon che phyogs/ nyams las ma thob nyes pa che ba dang*/ mi shes pa gti mug nyes pa che ba sogs nyams las ma thob pa nyes pa che phyogs te phyogs lngar 'du/ rdor gsung gzhan rnams ni de rnams kyi gsal byed du 'gyur bas phyogs lngar 'dus pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang mu bzhi sogs kyi rnam par bshad pa mtha' yas pa skabs thob so sor spro na yang mang bas 'jigs te de tsam gyis chog par zad do// zhes 'dul ba so sor thar pa'i gnad bsdus kyi tshoms gsal bar byed pa ste spyi don gsum pa'o//

// ༈ /spyi don bzhi pa bslab pa byang chub sems kyi gnad bsdus kyi tshoms 'chad pa la rdo rje'i gsung nyer bzhi mchis pa las/ dang po/ snying rje dang byang chub kyi sems tha dad pa yin zhes gsungs pa ni/ snying rje zhes pa pha rol po ma nus pa sogs la rang bzhin gyis snying brtse ba'i sems dung ba de la zer/ byang chub kyi sems zhes pa ni rgyu tshad med pa'i snying rje chen po gnyis las skyes pa ste/ de yang rnam shes byang ba dang ye shes chub pa zhes pa'i go don thob ste/ rgyu mtshan byang bya rnam shes kyang*/ rnam byang dang po'i skabs su dbang shes lnga/ gnyis pa'i skabs su drug yid/ gsum par nyon yid/ bzhi par kun gzhi rnam smin gyi cha/ lnga par kun gzhi sa bon gyi cha yin la/ chub bya ye shes la yang lam dang 'bras bu gnyis su dbyer rigs te/ lam gyi ye shes slob pa'i skabs su rjes mthun dang*/ mi slob pa'i skabs su mtshan nyid pa yin la/ 'bras bu'i ye shes mthar thug pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes sogs lnga yin no// snying rje la gnyis gang zag dang chos la dmigs pa'o| |mdo sde rgyan las/ rtag tu sems can phan par sems// chos la mos dang de bzhin de'i// ye shes 'tshol bar dmigs pa'o// zhes so// gang zag la dmigs pa'i snying rje'i yul gang zag ji lta bu zhe na/ mdo sde rgyan las/ rab 'bar dgra yi dbang du song*// sdug bsngal gyis non mun pas bsgribs// bgrod dka'i lam la kun tu zhugs// 'ching ba che dang yang dag ldan// zas can dug dang 'dres la zhen// lam ni rab tu stor gyur pa// lam gol rab zhugs stobs chung ba'i// sems can rnams la snying rje'o// zhes dang*/ de nyid las/ bkren la brtse dang ma rungs pa la brtse// kun 'khrugs la brtse bag med rnams la brtse// yul gyi gzhan dbang can la snying rje dang*// log par mngon par zhen la snying rje'o| |zhes gsungs so// de 'dra ba'i sems can la snying brtse ba ni gang zag la dmigs pa dang*/

de rnams kyi las dge sdig gi blang dor la rmongs pa'i sdug bsngal ba bsam pa ni chos la dmigs pa'o// de 'dra ba'i snying rje gnyis pos kun nas bslangs te gzhan don gyi sems bskyed rgya chen po dang ldan pa ni byang chub sems kyi rtsa ba ste/ mdo sde rgyan las/ sems bskyed de ni sa rnams la// mos dang lhag bsam dag pa dang*// rnam par smin pa gzhan du 'dod// de bzhin sgrib pa spangs pa'o// de yi rtsa ba snying rjer 'dod// ces so// byang sems skye ba'i rgyu dngos ni bzhi ste/ skyabs 'gro khyad par can byas pa dang*/ tshad med bzhi la blo sbyangs pa dang*/ bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po bsags pa dang*/ rgyu'i gtso bo bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes bskyed pa dang bzhi po yin te/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ sangs rgyas rnams la bsnyen bkur byas// de las dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun| |dge ba'i bshes kyis mgon byas pa// 'di nyan pa yi snod yin no// zhes so// des na snying rje ni byang sems kyi rgyu yin la dngos min/ sngon mu stegs byed bcu ri bo gangs can du phyin pas dgu rlung gis shi/ gcig lus pa brgya byin gyis bgam pa'i phyir/ dar gyi khri stan nang tshang can rlung gi grang ba las skyob pa'i steng du khyi rgan nyam chung zhig sprul/ brgya byin mir byas nas/ de la khyi de bor la khri'i steng du sdod dang mi 'chi'o byas pas bdag lhags pas shi ba ni sla'i/ khyi 'di shi ba ni de lta ma yin no// zhes pa sogs mu stegs byed la'ang snying rje de 'dra ba yod pa dang*/ nang pa la'ang nyan rang la snying rje chen po yod kyang gzhan don gyi sems bskyed med pa'i phyir slar theg chen du sems bskyed dgos par gsungs pa yin te/ mgon po byams pas/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir// yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod// ces so// de ltar na snying rje phyi nang dang theg pa che chung thams cad thun mong du yod la|

byang sems ni theg pa chen po'i lam gyi rtsa ba yin pa'i phyir/ snying rje byang sems kyi rgyu yin yang dngos min/ de las de skye ba'i phyir myu gu dang 'bras bu bzhin no// gnyis pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa rten can du bzhed pa ni/ so thar gyi sdom pa gang rung ni byang sdom skye ba dang*/ gnas pa dang*/ bogs 'don pa'i rten yin te/ rgyu mtshan so thar sdom pa gzhan la gnod pa gzhi bcas las ldog pa dge sgrub sdig spong gi nyams len byed pa de ni smon pa byang sems kyi rten dang*/ 'jug sdom gyi ngo bo sdom pa'i tshul khrims kyis mi dge ba spong*/ dge ba chos sdud kyis dge ba sgrub/ sems can don byed kyis gzhan don mthu ldan du 'gyur ro// des na sngags sdom skye ba dang*/ gnas pa dang*/ bogs 'don par yang 'gro/ so thar sdom pa'i rten gling gsum gyi skyes pa dang bud med rab tu byung bar bshad mod/ 'gro ba gzhan la mi skye bar ma nges te/ mdzangs blun las ston pa gzi brjid yon tan gyi bstan pa la klu'i rgyal po 'khor bcas kyis bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad pa bsrungs pa dang*/ 'dul lung las/ bcom ldan 'das kyis klu rgyal sog ma med btul ba'i tshe srog gcod ma gtogs gzhan gsum khas blangs pa dang*/ klu'i rgyal po ri bo dang grogs mkhar gnyis kyis skyabs 'gro dang bslab gzhi lnga blangs pa dang*/ rgyal po byams pa'i stobs kyis gnod sbyin lnga la rang gi sha khrag byin nas/ sna 'ga' bsrungs pa'i dge bsnyen dang bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa phogs pa sogs mang du gsungs pas mtha' gcig tu ma nges so| |gzhan dag na re/ theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed la// dbu ma sems tsam rnam pa gnyis// zhes sogs nas 'bras nas kyi sa bon la dpe bzhag dbu ma'i sems bskyed kun la skye/ sems tsam su thod thod la mi skye ba sogs bshad mod/ rnam par 'khyams te/

de gnyis ka rten can yin/ rgyu mtshan skyabs 'gro sogs rgyu'i gtso bo bzhi po gnyis ka la tshang dgos pa'i phyir| khyod ltar na sems tsam la rgyu bzhi po dgos/ dbu ma la gang yang mi dgos par sems bskyed pas chog par thal lo// jo bo rjes/ so sor thar pa ris bdun gyi// rtag tu sdom gzhan ldan pa la// byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa yi// skal pa yod kyi gzhan du min// zhes pa jo bo sems tsam pa yin pas de ltar gsungs so zer mod/ dbu ma la mi dgos snyam na/ dbu ma sems bskyed kyi sdon du skyabs 'gro dgos sam mi dgos/ dgos na so thar sdom pa'i rtsa ba skyabs 'gro las ci yod/ mi dgos na skyabs su ma song ba'i sems bskyed de ya mtshan no| |yang gzhan dag /don dam sems bskyed ces bya ba// bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis skye mod kyi// cho ga'i sgo nas 'di mi skye// zhes pa nas/ 'di 'dra cir 'gyur brtag dgos so| |zhes pa'i bar rgyas par bshad mod/ dpyad nas smra'o// don dam sems bskyed ces pa khyod kyis gang du sems/ cho ga dang dam bca' sogs kyi dbye ba'ang mang du bris snang ba snag shog gron no// zag med kyi sdom pa las gzhan pa'i don dam sems bskyed gang du yod/ de ni dbang bzhi pa'i dus tshig tsam gyi ngo sprod de khyod rang gi lam 'bras la yang med dam/ ye shes 'di ni sogs gang du 'jog sems bskyed pa'i tshe don dam cho gar ma zad gzugs su ma bsgoms sam/ kun rdzob zla ba dang*/ don dam rdo rje'i gzugs su bsgoms pa khyod kyis dgyes rdor gyi dbang gi dus ma byas sam/ mdo sngags gnyis kyi khyad par ro zer na bden mod/ 'on kyang don dam byang sems la cho ga mi 'thad pa'i skabs khyod rang gis mdo sngags kyi dbye ba zur tsam yang ma phyed mod/ yang khong dag /mdor na sems kyi 'phen pa las// gzhan pa'i dge sdig yod ma yin// zhes pa'ang ltung ba mtha' dag la 'du shes gtso ba'i phyogs su ma thal lam/
