yang khong dag rmi lam gyi ni rjes 'brangs nas// sems can kun la sems bskyed byed// ces pa nas/ lugs de sangs rgyas bstan pa min| |zhes pa'i bar dang*/ phyi nas phag mo'i byin rlabs dang*// sems bskyed rmi lam ma la sogs// yi dam sgom pa dkrong bskyed dang*// dkar po chig thub la sogs pa// sangs rgyas bstan dang 'gal ba yi// chos log du ma deng sang 'phel// zhes sogs rgyu dus kyi kun slong gnyis rdzogs pa'i log shes mang du smras mod/ brtags shing dpyad de gzhan rnams gsang sngags tshoms sogs skabs thob tu sun 'byin la/ 'dir rmi lam du byung ba zhes yang yang smra ba mgon po 'bri gung pa chen po'i thugs bskyed chen mor grags pa sogs 'ga' zhig la sdang ngo*/ 'di la 'di ltar yang khams pa dbu se kam po gnas su sgom du bzhugs tshe dbus gtsang gi mi byung ba rnams la dbus gtsang dus e bde dris pas mi bde zer/ ci nyes dris pas| 'bri gung pa dang*/ zhang tshal pa 'khrug zer/ de gnyis kyi sdum khong min pa gzhan gyis mi 'ong bar dgongs te yar phebs nas thog mar bla ma zhang gi sar byon pas/ bla ma zhang gis dmag gi khrod dang*/ chos ra dang*/ gzims chung gsum du sku'i bkod pa gsum bstan/ thugs ches te 'bri gung du byon pa'i lam du 'jig rten gsum mgon gar bzhugs dris pas| dbyar gnas la bzhugs zhes thos/ yar byon pas 'jig rten mgon pos tshogs kyi ser sbreng dang bcas dbu se bsur phebs pas ston pa sangs rgyas nyan thos kyi tshogs kyis bskor ba dbu ses gzigs/ slar yol ba 'gag tu spyan snga brgyad dang 'bri gung pa nyid ston pa nyan thos mchog brgyad kyis bskor bar gzigs/ slar phebs pas nang du khri steng na 'jig rten mgon po bzhugs spyan snga grags 'byung dang*/ sher 'byung gnyis g.yas g.yon du 'greng ba ston pa dang shā ri'i bu mauṅgal bu gsum du gzigs/

bla ma 'di gnyis la log pa'i chos mi mnga' bar thag chod/ g.yul du shi ba rnams ci 'drar dgongs 'od gsal gyis gzigs pas/ g.yul du dbugs dang bral ma thag bar do med par bde 'gror 'gro ba gzigs/ ya mtshan te de'i rgyu ci yin 'jig rten mgon po la zhus pas/ nga'i sems bskyed yid bzhin nor bu 'di'i mthu yin gsungs/ shin tu dad de zhus pas gnang*/ da lta rnam thar du dbu se dang nyag se zhes dbu se 'ong ba yang don de yin/ zhes pa ni mgon po 'bri gung pa chen po'i rnam par thar pa ngo mtshar can gyi gtam so bdun zhes grags pa'i gcig 'di yin no// des na chos la chos su mos pa rnams la sems bskyed 'di nyid ches ngo mtshar ba nyi zla ltar grags mod/ 'on kyang rtog ge tha snyad la goms pas don la gol ba rnams log par rtogs pa ni ches blo med do// gsum pa/ so so skye bo la yang 'jug pa skye bar bzhed pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa ji snyed pa rnams slob dpon thogs med kyis byang sar bsdus| de zhi ba lhas bslab btus dang spyod 'jug tu bsdus/ bslab btus slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis sdom pa nyi shu par bsdus pa yin la/ de'i nang nas 'jug sdom la bslab bya bzhi bcu rtsa drug tu byas pa rnams sa dang po thob nas 'byung ba mi srid pas/ mthong spang brgyad cu rtsa gnyis spangs pas 'jig tshogs su lta ba med pa'i phyir dang*/ nyes pa che chung gi sdom pa slar len pa dang*/ bshags yul mang nyung bshad pa'ang so skye la dgongs/ slob dpon zhi ba lhas/ sor ma chud pa la'ang 'jug pa skye// zhes gsungs/ gzhan yang nam mkha'i snying po'i mdor byang sems kyi ltung ba rgyal blon 'bangs rnams la 'byung ba rten gyi sgo nas bco brgyad dang*/ ngo bo'i sgo nas bcu bzhir gsungs pa yang so skye la dgongs pa'i phyir ro// 'di go sla zhing deng sang 'jug sdom so skye la mi skye ba khas len pa nyung bas de tsam gyis chog go// bzhi pa/

ci rigs kyis tshul khrims kyi sdom par 'gyur bya ba ni/ sdom gsum mtha' dag nyes med du rdzogs pa ni sangs rgyas nyag gcig gi spyod yul yin/ byang chub sems dpas kyang mi 'ong ste/ byang chub sems dpa' nor bzang gi bla ma rnams sa bcu pa kho na yin yang so so rang nyid kyis nyams su blangs tshul re re bstan nas gzhan rnams shes par nus re skan zhes gsungs/ rdo rje'i gsung 'dir tshul khrims kyis srung ba gzhan du 'jug sdom du 'gyur zhes smos pa ste/ 'jug sems brtan po zhig yod na bsod nams rgyun chags su 'byung ste/ zhi ba lha'i spyod 'jug tu/ gang nas bzung ste sems can khams// mtha' yas rab tu dgrol ba'i phyir// mi ldog pa yi sems kyis su// sems de yang dag blang gyur na// de nas bzung ste gnyid log gam// bag med gyur kyang bsod nams shugs| |rgyun mi 'chad pa du ma zhig /nam mkha' mnyam par rab tu 'byung*// zhes dang*/ tshong dpon mes sbyin bu dang chung mar bcas pas mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob kyang srog gcod spong ba kho na khas blangs pa lta bu dang*/ dpal dbyig gis zhus pa las/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la sems bskyed pas mi dge ba bcu spong*/ de ma nus na bslab pa'i gzhi lnga bsrung*/ de ma nus na'ang gcig bsrung*/ de ma nus na'ang nam zhig na bsrung ngo snyam du dam bca'/ zhes so// tha na phyag gcig 'tshal na'ang 'jug sdom gyi tshul khrims su 'gyur te/ dang ba'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal ba dge ba chos sdud/ phyag de gzhan don du 'tshal ba sems can don byed/ phyag 'tshal bar le lo 'dor zhing lus ngag yid gsum bag dang bcas 'bad pas 'tshal ba sdom pa'i tshul khrims te tshul khrims gsum ga nges par tshang ba yin/ de lta min pa'i dge ba'i las 'ga' zhig la tshang 'ga' zhig la ma tshang ba'i tshul khrims gsum zhig byung na ngo mi mtshar ram/ gzhan yang gzhan don sogs dngos kyis mi nus kyang bsam pas bya ba ni byang sems dang*/

sngags su sbyin pa bzhi sbyin pa dngos kyi mthu med des na bsam pas bya ba ni byang sems dang 'dra bas de ltar mos na bsam pa rgya chen po de nar son nas yar ngo ltar dkar po'i chos thams cad rgyun shugs mi 'chad cing mthar dngos su 'grub ste/ ji skad du/ gzhan phan las la mthu med kyang*// de yi bsam pa rtag tu bya// gang la de yi blo yod pa// de yi rgyu ni 'byung bar 'gyur// zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir ro// lnga pa/ nyon mongs pa can ma yin pa'i ltung ba med par bzhed pa ni/ nyon mongs pa can gyi ltung ba dang*/ ltung ba med pa gnyis su thag bcad pas/ de gnyis kyi bar skabs su nyon mongs ma yin pa'i ltung ba bya ba mi srid/ 'khor 'das gnyis su thag bcad pas de gnyis kyi bar du chos gzhan med pa dang 'dra ba yin gsungs/ ltung ba ni pham pa nas nyes byas kyi bar nyon mongs pa can ma gtogs nyon mongs min pa mi srid la/ brjed ngas sogs kyang nye ba'i nyon mongs yin pa'i phyir/ mkha' 'gro sdom pa'i rgyud las/ mi shes pa dang bag med pa// ma gus pa dang nyon mongs pa// brjed ngas dran pa mi gsal ba// 'di drug dam tshig nyams pa'i rgyu// zhes so// brjed ngas kyis nyams pa ni ches lci ste/ ji skad du/ khams gsum sems can thams cad bsad pa bas// dran pa nyams par gyur pa sdig pa che// brjed ngas blo la he ru ka la sogs// sangs rgyas rnams kyis byin gyis rlob mi 'gyur| |zhes dang*/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ brjed ngas blo la 'od dpag med la sogs// bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis byin mi rlob// ces so// der ma zad ku re dang bzhad gad tsam gyis kyang nyams te/ 'dul ba las/ bzhad gad kyi dngos pos ni gang du'ang mi 'gyur ro// zhes so// kha cig na re/ ltung ba'i rnam bzhag mu bzhir gsung*// ltung med ltung dang ltung ba yi// gzugs brnyan ltung ba med pa yi// gzugs brnyan zhes pa rnam pa bzhi/

zhes pa nas/ dge sdig rnam bzhag de ltar gsungs// zhes pa'i bar yang 'phags pa lha'i lung dang bcas byung mod kyang*/ ltung med dang ltung ba gnyis mthun/ dge sems kyis bsad pa ltung ba'i gzugs brnyan dang*/ gzhan la gnod na rdzun min yang ltung ba med pa'i gzugs brnyan zhes pa'ang mkhas 'dod las 'bras bu med de/ dge sems kyis bsad pa kun slong dge ba/ sbyor ba mi dge ba/ gzhan la gnod pa mi dge ba/ rdzun min pa dge ba yin pas so sor bral na snga ma'i khongs su 'dus/ 'phags pa lha'i lung gis sems gtso ba ni ltung ba mtha' dag la 'du shes gtso ba'i dgongs pa yin pas de yang rnam par ma brtag pa'i legs bshad do| |drug pa/ nyes par mi 'gyur ba'i mi dge ba gnang ba med bya ba ni/ rgyu 'bras gshis sam babs kyi rten 'brel de lta bu nyes med du gnang ba ma yin/ byang sems rang bde dor nas gzhan don la sdig pa'i rnam smin sdug bsngal bzod nus pa'i ngor ma bkag pa ste/ de 'dra ba nyon mongs dug gsum gyi mi dge ba yin mod/ stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid kyi thabs kyis zin mod kyi/ byang chub sems dpa' de 'dra ba spyod pa ni nyes par mi 'gyur bas spyod pa min la/ bdag nyid yal bar dor nas gzhan don la brtson pas las de'i 'bras bu nyams su myong yang bzod pa'i go cha dang ldan pa'i byang sems spyod pa spyad nus la gnang gi byang sems gsar bu la ma gnang ngo*// mgon po phag mo gru pas/ gzhan don rlabs chen mdzad pa la// sa dang lam la gnas pa yi// byang chub sems dpa' chen po la// lus ngag mi dge bdun yang gnang*// zhes de 'dra bzod nus pa'i byang sems sa lam thob pa la gnang ba dang*/ gsang chen thabs mkhas las/ byang chub sems dpa' tshogs chen rab mchog rgyal pos bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ bcom ldan 'das/ sems can gcig gi rgyud la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' rnams la nongs pa 'di lta bu 'byung zhing*/

nongs pa byung ba des bskal pa 'bum gyi bar du sems can dmyal ba chen por gnas kyang sla'i/ sems can gcig pu de'i dge ba'i rtsa ba gtong ba ni de ltar ma lags so// zhes gsol bas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de la legs so zhes bka' stsal to// zhes sogs gsungs pa dang*/ gleng gzhi ded dpon snying rje chen pos srog bcad pas lo stong phrag mang por dmyal ba nyams su myong zhing*/ mthar yang seng ldeng gi tshal pa sogs mang du byung mod| rgyal po gser mdog gis ni ma byin len du mi 'gro ste/ khong rang sa chen po skye dgu'i tshogs dang bcas pa'i bdag por smon lam gyis dbang bsgyur ba'i bdag por skyes pas thams cad mnyam skyong las/ rang gtsigs kyi zhe 'dod med pa'i phyir 'gro ba de rnams kyi don du bsdus pas gzhan don thabs mkhas pa'i spyod par yang 'gyur/ bram ze'i khye'u skar ma ni lo bcu gnyis su bram ze mo la tshangs spyod btang bas bskal pa nyi khri'i 'khor ba bsnyil ba las/ las kyi 'bras bu 'di ma byung na de'i sngon du khong lo khri nyis stong du tshangs spyod la gnas nas slar chu 'chun ma'i lo bcu gnyis kyi mdza' bo byed pa'i tshe bdag gi brtul zhugs 'di bshigs nas sems can dmyal bar song yang sdug bsngal de bzod kyi/ bud med de shi bar 'ong gi bde bar bya'o snyam ste lo bcu gnyis 'grogs/ slar mngon par byung ste tshangs gnas bzhi bskyed nas shi 'phos pas tshangs pa'i 'jig rten du skyes pa ni/ sngar bshad pa ltar nyes par mi 'gyur ba'i mi dge ba gnang ba min mod/ rang nyid la nyes pa byung yang bzod pa'i go bgos te gzhan de bde bar byas pa gleng gzhi'i tshig gis gsal mod/ gzhan yang gleng gzhi 'di ni nyams las ma thob nyes pa che ba sogs 'dul ba'i rdor gsung 'ga' zhig gi gsal byed kyang dpyis phyin pa yin no// bdun pa/ thabs mkhas pa la mi dge ba 'ong na de'i 'bras bu 'byung bya ba ni/

byang chub sems dpa' dge ba'i lam la goms shing spyod pa/ mi dge ba'i lam kun nas spangs pa nyid yin na de'i spyod pa thams cad thabs la mkhas pa kho nar zad kyi mi mkhas pa med la/ de la mi dge ba'i spyod pa yod pa mi srid do// de yod na mi dge bas bdag gzhan gyi don mi nus te/ mun pas mun pa mi sel ba bzhin no// ded dpon snying rje chen pos ni rgyu dus kyi kun slong sems can de rnams kyi don yin yang*/ de dus kyi kun slong zhe sdang ma bskyed na mdung bsnun mi phod pas zhe sdang bskyed pa'i rnam smin phyis byung ba de tsho yin mod/ 'dul ba las/ bram ze khye'u bla mas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i don la bsams nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'od srung la/ dge sbyong mgo reg la byang chub ga la yod ces smras pas de'i 'bras bu byung ba sogs gleng gzhi ches mang bas so// yum rgyas pa las/ byang chub sems dpa' sems can dmyal ba nas bzung ste/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi bar du 'khor 'das thams cad kyi rgyu lam 'bras bu thams cad shes par bya'o// zhes gsungs pa'i 'khor ba ni spang bya yin yang thog mar shes nas spong dgos/ ma shes par spang blang mi 'byung ste sman za zhing dug mi za bar thog mar dug dang sman ngo shes dgos pa bzhin no// ston pa la yang seng ldeng gi tshal pa zug pa dang*/ mu ge'i grong du gshegs pa dang*/ lhung bzed stong pa dang*/ rad rod can du gzims pa sogs drang don yin pa la thams cad mthun mod/ 'on te drang don thams cad rdzun par bltas na log lta kho na ste rgyu 'bras mi bden par don gyi skur 'debs su 'gyur bas ha cang thal che ste/ gdags pa las/ med par lta ba mnar med ltung*// zhes sogs gsungs pas so// brgyad pa/ rang gzhan brje bar nyes par 'gyur ba'i skabs yod bya ba ni/ byang chub sems dpa' lam la zhugs pa 'phags pas bdag gzhan brje ba bkag pa min mod/

skabs kyi sgras lam tshogs sbyor gnyis man chad du bsam pa'i stobs rgya chen po bskyed nas sbyor ba gzhan don gang nus spyad/ rang gces pa'i dus yin/ mthong lam nas sa bdun pa man chad du bsam sbyor gnyis ka nar son pas bsam pa cher bskyed cing sbyor ba nus tshad spyad/ rang gzhan mnyam pa'i dus yin/ sa brgyad pa nas bcu pa'i bar du bsam sbyor gnyis ka stobs che bas gzhan don rgya chen po'ang 'grub/ spyod pa rlabs chen la'ang 'jug nus/ brtul zhugs kyang shin tu che/ sdug bsngal bzod pa'i stobs chen po yang thob pas bsam spyor gnyis ka phyogs gcig tu gtong ba chen po la 'jug dgos so// rgyu mtshan shes rab chung zhing dad pa che bas bdag gzhan brje ba'i 'dun pa bgyi na gegs su 'gyur te/ mgon po phag mo gru pa'i bsnyun nad lta bu yin| des na gsar bu rnams kyis shes rab lam gtong gi gdams pas gnad du bsnun pa gal che ste/ spyod 'jug las/ chos gos gsum ma gtogs pa sbyin// dam pa'i chos ni spyod pa'i lus// phran tshegs ched du gnod mi bya// de ltar byas na sems can gyi /bsam pa myur du rdzogs par 'gyur// snying rje'i bsam pa ma dag par// lus 'di gtong bar mi bya ste| |ci nas 'di dang gzhan du yang*// don chen sgrub pa'i rgyur gtong ngo*// zhes gsungs so// byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis ni/ snying rje pad dkar las/ bdag gi lus sangs rgyas kyi zhing rdul shin tu phra ba ji snyed 'byung zhing*/ lus re re'ang ri'i rgyal po ri rab dang mnyam pa'i che bar gyur nas/ lus de dag re res kyang sems can rnams kyi sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba'i bye brag ji snyed pa de snyed myong bar gyur cig /bdag gi dge ba'i chos ji snyed pa rnams ni sems can thams cad kyi don du bsngo ste/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag gis sems can rnams ni sdug bsngal nam yang mi myong zhing rtag tu bde bar gyur cig

/ces smon pa lta bur bya dgos/ dper na bdag cag gi ston pas byang chub sems dpa' gsar bu'i tshe shākya thub pa chen po la 'jam gang phul nas sems bskyed la phyis stobs chen por gyur nas rgyal po zla 'od sogs dbu dang rkang lag btang ba yang grangs med pa de 'dra skabs thob mi shes par/ da lta bdag gzhan brjes pas nyes par 'gyur ba'i skabs yod par gsungs pa la yang dgag la/ lag len du mgo lus lta zhog dngos po spus gtsang ba re yang ngo srung dang lan 'byung ba la ma gtogs/ lan dang rnam smin la mi re ba'i sbyin pa khab tsam yang gtong bar blo kyog kyog byed par bltas na rdo rje'i gsung shin tu ya mtshan mod/ gzhan yang sman shing skyes pa myu gu'i dus nas sems can gcig gi nad gso ba'i phyir bcad na rtsa ba med par 'gyur la/ de thabs mkhas kyis skyed bsring na rgyas pa'i tshe sdong po yal ga lo 'dab me tog 'bras bu shun lpags sogs thams cad kyis sems can dpag tu med pa 'tsho ba'i sman du 'gyur ba ltar/ byang chub sems dpas kyang skabs thob shes shing thabs mkhas par bya dgos te nam mkha' mdzod kyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ ji ltar sman shing ljon pa lta sdug pa// rtsa ba la sogs sa bon spyad 'os rnams// byin yang dus min spyod las bsrung bya ba// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sman shing de bzhin no// zhes so// gleng gzhi yang sngon 'phags pa shā ri'i bu byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa nas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa spyad pa bskal pa mang po'i dus na/ skabs shig mi zhig gis khyod kyi mig ya gcig nga la byin zer bas mig ya gcig phyung nas mi de la byin pas/ mi des mig gi steng du rkang pa bzhag nas car song ba la/ khyod de ltar byed pa ci yin dris pas/ car zer ba de la bltas pa yin zer bas/ shā ri'i bu yid mug ste sems can 'di rnams la'ang byed thabs mi 'dug snyam nas yid chad/

der dman pa'i bsam pa skyes pa'i dus su nyan thos su gyur pa lta bu yin no// gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa'i brtul zhugs chen po mi mnga' bzhin du lag len la mi khel bar mgo lus sbyin par mi gtong ngo*// lus mi gtsang ba 'di sbyin pa'i bsod nams thob pa yin zer rbad gam byed pa dag gis ni bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang sems med pa'i khar sngags kyi rtsa ltung brgyad pa phog nye'o// yang gzhan dag na re/ kha cig brje ba'i byang chub sems// bsgom du mi rung zhes su smra// zhes pa nas/ des na 'di 'dra'i byang chub sems// sgom pa de dag thabs mi mkhas| |nor ba chen po'i chos yin lo// zhes sogs nas/ byang chub sems kyi gnad 'chug na// chos gzhan gyis ni 'tshang mi rgya// zhes pa'i bar rgyas par bshad pas rdo rje'i gsung 'di sun 'byin par 'dod mod/ mtshar che/ 'bri gung pa chen pos skabs zhes dmigs phye nas gsungs mod/ bdag gzhan brje ba'i chos nor ba chen po yin zhes ci ste gsungs/ byang chub sems dpa' chen pos byang chub sems kyi gnad ma go na byang chub sems dpa' ltar bcos pas gnad ci zhig rtogs/ byang sems gsar bu nas chen po'i bar gyis bdag gzhan brje zhing srog gtong ba kho na lag tu blang gi bsam pas mi 'ong snyam na/ gong du drangs pa'i spyod 'jug dang nam mkha' mdzod kyis zhus pa'i mdo sogs lung du ma dang gleng gzhi ches mang ba la cis bsnyon/ yang khyod rang gis de ma thag /'on kyang thabs la mkhas pa yi// khyad par 'ga' zhig ma gsungs pas// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sgrub mi nus| |de phyir thabs mkhas shes rab nyid// sangs rgyas rgyu yi gtso bo yin// zhes smras mod/ mgon po 'bri gung pa chen po'i thugs kyi dgongs pa thabs mkhas kyis byang chub sems dpa' gsar bu 'bring chen po'i bar du bsam sbyor 'dris goms dang stobs rgyas ma rgyas kyi bar du bdag gzhan brje ba yang bsam sbyor lag len rim gyis byed pa la dgongs pas/

khyod rang gi tshig des rdo rje'i gsung gi dgongs pa de lung rigs grangs med las kyang dga' bar 'grub pa ngo mtshar che'o// de bas las dang po pas lam du gtong ba gnad che ste/ ded dpon mdza' bo'i bu mo'i gleng gzhi 'dul ba lung nas gsungs pa lta bu yin no// dgu pa/ byang chub sems dpa' la gnod pa byas pas bde bar 'brel mi srid/ ces gsungs te/ byang chub sems dpa' ni gnod lan du phan 'dogs pa dang*/ gnod pa byed pa la lhag par thugs brtse ba yin pas na/ spyod 'jug las/ gang la gnod pa byas kyang bde 'brel ba// bde ba'i 'byung gnas de la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes dang*/ 'jig rten mgon pos/ phongs par gyur kyang shin tu mi gtong zhing*// gnod par gyur kyang thugs rjes bde 'brel ba// zhes gsungs pa ni gnod pa byas kyang brtse ba ches shin tu che bas phan 'dogs shing de'i sgrib pa sbyong ba gtso bor 'bad de mdzad pa dang*/ nyes byed de yang 'gyod de bshags pas bde ba'i 'bras bu smin pa yin te/ rgyal po dpa' bas byin gyis chos smra ba me tog zla mdzes bkrongs kyang me tog zla mdzes la khro ba mi mnga' zhing*/ rgyal po 'gyod nas bshags shing gdung la mchod de gso sbyong blangs nas tshangs par spyad kyang*/ byang chub sems dpa' bkrongs pa'i rnam smin gyis dmyal bar skyes pa lta bu dang*/ spre'u byang chub sems dpa'i dbu la rdo brgyab pa lta bu yin/ gzhan yang spyod 'jug las/ gang zhig de 'dra'i rgyal sras sbyin bdag la// gal te ngan sems bskyed par byed pa de// ngan sems bskyed pa'i grangs bzhin bskal par ni// dmyal bar gnas par 'gyur zhes thub pas gsungs// zhes dang*/ dbu ma la 'jug pa las/ gang phyir rgyal sras rnams la khros pa yis/ */sbyin dang khrims byung dge ba bskal pa brgyar// bsags pa skad cig gis 'joms de yi phyir// mi bzod las gzhan sdig pa yod ma yin// zhes sogs gsungs pas byang sems la gnod pa byas pas bde ba thob pa lta ci smos/

gnod pa byas pa stobs bzhi'i sgo nas bshags pa'i mthus rjes su bzung nas bde bar 'brel ba yin no// bcu pa/ dge mi dge'i 'bras bu so sor 'byung bya ba ni/ 'phen rdzogs la dgongs te/ 'phen byed kyang dge ba/ rdzogs byed kyang dge ba/ dang po nas dkon mchog gsum la dad cing bar dang tha mar yang dad pa rgyal po gzugs can snying po lta bu'o| |'phen rdzogs gnyis mi dge ba/ dkon mchog gsum la thog mtha' bar gsum du log par lta ba lhas sbyin lta bu yin/ 'phen rdzogs go log mi srid de legs skar dad nas rab tu byung bas mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'bras bu thob par lung bstan/ log lta'i 'bras bus dmyal bar song ba grags che/ des mtshon nas ma skyes dgra dang*/ dpal sbas/ dpa' bas byin sogs lta bu yang yin/ gzhan yang rab byung gi gzhi las/ rna ba bye ba ri dang*/ gnas pa'i grong gi shan pa dang*/ smad 'tshong ma dang*/ sangs rgyas 'od srung gi dge 'dun lta bu yin pas 'phen rdzogs dang me chu go log mi srid pa'i lung ni/ rgyu 'bras kyi rnam par bzhag pa'i mdo sde thams cad du ches gsal la mang bar yod pas 'dir smos ma dgos la des na kun btus su yang*/ gnag la rnam smin gnag pa mi dge ba dang*/ dkar la rnam smin dkar ba khams gsum pa'i dge ba dang*// dkar nag tu gyur la 'bras bu dkar nag tu 'gyur bas 'dod pa dang ldan pa'i 'dres ma ste/ bsam pa nag la sbyor ba dkar ba dang*/ sbyor ba nag la bsam pa dkar ba dang*/ mi nag cing dkar la rnam smin du mi 'gyur zhing las zad par 'gyur ba sbyor ba dang*/ bar chad med pa'i lam rnams la/ zag pa med pa'i las su gsungs pa'i bsam sbyor dkar nag bstan pa 'dis kyang las dang rnam smin dkar nag 'chol ba bstan par mi snang mod/ 'ga' zhig na re/ gzhan yang las la rnam gnyis gsungs// 'phen byed las dang rdzogs byed las// de dag dbye ba mu bzhir yod// 'phen byed dge bas 'phangs pa la// rdzogs byed kyang ni de nyid dang*// zhes pa nas/

gnas skabs dge bas 'phangs par gsungs// zhes pa'i bar gyi 'phen rdzogs gnyis ka dge ba dang*/ gnyis ka mi dge ba las kyang bde sdug gnyis po 'byung bar mthun mod 'phen byed dge la rdzogs byed mi dge ba dang*/ 'phen byed mi dge la rdzogs byed dge ba'i las kyi rnam smin go log 'byung ba mi srid mod/ mdo mang rnams nas gcig tu dkar ba la 'bras bu bde ba gcig tu gnag pa la 'bras bu sdug bsngal/ 'dres ma'i las la 'bras bu yang 'dres mar 'byung zhes gsungs pa'i snga ma gnyis go sla/ phyi ma ni dkar po'i las la 'bras bu sdug bsngal dang*/ nag po'i las la bde ba 'byung bar dgongs pa min mod/ dge sdig 'dres mar bsags pa la 'bras bu yang bde sdug 'dres mar 'byung bar gsungs la/ de yang dpyad na dkar nag zang thal las gzhan du mi 'gyur ro// khyod 'dod pa'i las gnag rnam smin dkar ba sogs 'byung na/ sems can thams cad byang chub 'thob pa'i don du pha ma bsad na dge 'bras 'byung mi srid mod/ de bas chos lugs ya mtshan can de 'dra ba rnam par 'khyams so| |bcu gcig pa/ brjed pa'i rgyu las byang chub kyi sems 'chor mi srid ces pa ni/ bsod nams thams cad bsdus pa ting nge 'dzin gyi mdo las/ tshan po che dri ma med pa'i gzi brjid sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig gi bstan pa la byang chub tu sems bskyed pa nag po'i chos spyad pas byang chub kyi sems bskyed brjed kyang ston pas byang chub tu lung bstan pa dang*/ gzhan yang dkon brtsegs dang*/ sdong rgyan las kyang brjed pa'i rgyus byang chub sems mi 'chor bar mthun par gsungs te/ dmigs pa'i sangs rgyas de bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas yin pa dang*/ sangs rgyas la dmigs pa'i dge rtsa 'khor ba'i bde skyid kyis zad par mi nus pa dang*/ sems can thams cad la de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po rtag pa'i chos can du yod pa dang*/

sems bskyed pa'i bslab bya dge ba'i las ci rigs kyis kyang 'jug sdom du 'gyur ba ste/ gnad bzhi po 'dis kyang byang sems 'chor mi srid de/ rdo rje pha lam lta bu'i byang sems 'di lug rwa lta bu'i log rtog gis ma bcom na/ rdo rje pha lam de lto bar song yang pho ba'i mes mi 'ju bar phyir myur du 'ong ba dang 'dra bar byang sems kyang brjed pa'i rgyu las rtsa ba gtong ba mi srid pa yin te/ nag po'i chos bzhis ma gos pa bya gsungs pa sogs go sla'o// bcu gnyis pa/ sgrib pa gsum nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa bya ba ni/ rgyud bla ma las/ 'khor gsum rnam par rtog pa gang*// de ni shes bya'i sgrib par 'dod// ser sna la sogs rnam rtog gang*// de ni nyon mongs sgrib par 'dod// ces gsungs pa'i nyon mongs la rtsa ba dang yan lag gnyis su dbye ba'i rtsa ba ma rig pa'am gti mug pa des bskyed pa'i ser sna sogs nyon mongs pa ji snyed par bshad/ 'khor gsum gyi rnam par rtog pa yang rtsa ba ma rig pa'i g.yos yin pas na sgrib pa thams cad nyon mongs pa ma rig par gcig mod/ de dag bag nyal dang bcas pa spangs pa na rdzogs byang thob ste/ rgya cher rol pa las/ gti mug 'byung ba 'dod dang khro// de dag 'gro ba'i dgra 'dra ste// chom po chas ni bzang ba 'dra// de dag ma lus 'dir ngas bshig /ces dang*/ de nyid las/ nyon mongs rtsa ba bag nyal bcas| |sdug bsngal zug rngu 'byung de dag /ngas 'dir shes rab dam pa yi// mthong lcags kyis ni ma lus bton// zhes dang*/ dkon mchog sprin las/ byang chub snying por bzhugs pa na// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dang*// dri ma gzhan yang rnams mang po// khyod kyi ye shes me yis bsregs// zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir ma rig pa chos dbyings ye shes su rtogs dus sgrib pa gzhan rnams mi dag pa mi srid pa la dgongs/ shes sgrib kyang nyon sgrib kyi rgyur mtshungs te lus ngag la gnas pa'i sgrib pa spangs kyang*/

yid kyi nyon mongs pa phra mo ma spang ba'i tshe sa bcu pa rgyal po nor bzang lha mo yid 'phrog ma la chags pa dang*/ gzhon nu chu skyes tshe snga ma la nyon mongs drag po skyes pas rgyal srid chos min du bskyangs pa dang*/ dom byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ spre'u byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ ri dwags ru ru sogs su skyes pa yang sngon gyi 'bras bus dud 'gror skyes pa yin te/ skyes rabs las/ las kyi rnam par smin pa shin tu 'jigs// snying rje'i bdag nyid can dag dud 'gror skyes// de na'ang chos kyi 'du shes myong bar 'gyur// las med na ni skye ba'i mtshams mi sbyor// zhes gsungs so// lung 'di ni/ gzhan dag shākya thub pa'i sku la seng ldeng zug pa sogs las min tshul ston pa yin zer ba sogs kyang don gyis bkag par thal lo// bcu gsum pa/ bden pa ni grub pa'i mtha' ji snyed pas bsgrib bya ba ni/ don dam bden pa blo'i yul las 'das pa la/ grub mtha' blos byas ngar 'dzin/ bdag bstod gzhan smod kyi rtog pa ma dag pa 'dis bsgribs pa yin te/ 'phags pa sdud pa las/ gang zhig yod pa ma yin de ni med ces bya// byis pa rnams kyis de brtag yod dang med par byed| |yod dang med pa 'di gnyis med pa'i chos yin te// byang chub sems dpa' gang gis 'di shes nges par 'byung*// zhes dang*/ yang de nyid las/ byang chub sems dpa' sdon gyi mtha' dang phyi mtha' dang*// da ltar byung ba mi dmigs dus gsum dag pa ste// gang zag de ni 'dus ma byas yin spros med de// 'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin mchog spyod pa yin// zhes dang*| rtog ge 'bar ba las/ sgra dang gtan tshigs dang gso ba dang nang zhes bya ba'i rig pa'i gnas bzhi po dag la yongs su 'dris pa'i bdag nyid kyis thos pa las byung ba'i shes pa la yang mngon par brtson pa nyid du bya ste/ 'di ni de las gzhan pa bsam pa dang sgom pa las byung ba bla na med pa'i shes pa dag thob pa'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir ro// sems mnyam par bzhag pas de nyid rtogs par 'gyur gyi gzhan gyis ni ma yin no// zhes dang*/

spyod 'jug las/ don dam blo yi spyod yul min// blo ni kun rdzob yin par 'dod// ces dang*/ 'phags pa sdud pa las/ ji ltar 'dzin pa de ltar kun nas nyon mongs bstan// bdag dang bdag gir mi dmigs rnam par byang bar gsungs// zhes dang*/ mgon po phag mo gru pas/ grub mtha' tha dad mang gyur kyang*// rtog pa'i 'dod lugs ma gtogs pa// ngo bo nyid kyis grub pa med// rtog pa chos skur rtogs tsa na// grub mthar zhen pa'i 'dod 'dun zhi// zhes dang*/ 'jig rten mgon pos/ grub mtha' blo yi mdud pa la// sangs rgyas dgongs pa 'khrul ba rnams// de nyid rtogs par gyur nas kyang*// dran 'dzin rang sar dag mdzad gsol// zhes dang*| 'bri gung gling pa sher 'byung gis/ bsam sgom rtog pa'i shor gol dang gcig /chen pos reg pa'i rtog pa dang gnyis/ */bden pas bsgrubs pa'i grub mtha' dang gsum/ */ 'di stong nyid seng ge'i dgra gsum yin// zhes so// des na thog mar nga zhes pa'i ngar 'dzin dang*/ des btags pa'i nga'i chos/ nga'i grub mtha'/ kho'i grub mtha' zhes nga dang gzhan du btags pas 'khor bar 'gyur te/ dbu ma la 'jug pa las/ dang por nga zhes bdag la zhen gyur cing*// bdag gi 'di zhes dngos la chags bskyed nas// zo chun 'phyan ltar rang dbang med pa yi// 'gro la snying rjer gyur gang de la 'dud// ces dang*/ rnam 'grel las/ bdag yod na ni gzhan du shes// bdag gzhan cha las 'dzin dang sdang*// de gnyis dang ni 'brel ba las// nyes pa thams cad 'byung ba yin// zhes sogs gsungs so// bcu bzhi pa/ nyan thos kyis kyang phyogs gcig babs kyi gnas lugs mthong bya ba ni/ 'khor ba spong bar mngon rtogs dgos/ mngon rtogs skye ba sangs rgyas kyi gsung la brten/ gsung bzhin nyams su blangs pas babs kyi gnas lugs mthong bas nyan thos kyis kyang phyi gzung yul rags pa ma grub pa rdul phran cha med dang*/

nang 'dzin sems mi rtag pa skad cig mar shes pa la brten nas chags med kyi ye shes kyis 'khor ba spong bas phyogs gnyis po de'i babs kyi gnas lugs de rtogs pas dge sbyong gi 'bras bu bzhi dang rang rgyal gyi rtogs pa dang*/ mthar thug bla med byang chub kyi rgyur yang 'gyur te/ ji skad du/ nyan thos rnams kyi chos dbyings dang*// nga yi chos dbyings mtshungs par gcig /nyan thos rnams kyi rnam grol dang*// nga yi rnam par grol ba'ang gcig /ces dang*/ dbu ma rtsa bar/ bcom ldan 'das kyis chos gang zhig /bslu ba de ni rdzun zhes gsungs// 'du byed thams cad bslu ba'i chos// des na de dag rdzun pa yin// gal te bslu chos gang yin pa// de rdzun de la ci zhig bslu// bcom ldan 'das kyis de gsungs pa// stong nyid yongs su bstan pa yin// zhes dang*/ rin chen phreng bar/ stong nyid sangs rgyas che bdag nyid// de ltar rigs pas rjes bltas na// theg chen gcig shos las gsungs pa// mkhas pa rnams la ci mi mnyam// zhes sogs gsungs la/ 'dir grub mtha' smra ba'i nyan thos ma gtogs rtogs pa dang ldan pa ni dgra bcom la sogs te/ de rnams kyi mngon rtogs kyi sa mtshams ni 'di las 'das pas 'og tu 'chad do// bco lnga pa/ sa drug man chad nyan rang dang mngon rtogs thun mong yin bya ba ni/ byang sems sa drug pa man chad kyi mngon rtogs ni nyan rang dang rtogs pa thun mong du 'gyur te/ 'phags pa sa bcu pa'i mdor/ sa lnga pa bas 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi rtogs par gsungs pa dang*/ nyan thos dgra bcom gyis kyang de rtogs par mdo gzhan nas bshad la/ sa drug pa bas rten 'brel bcu gnyis rtogs par bshad pa dang*/ gzhan du rang rgyal gyis de rtogs par byung bas rtogs pa mnyam/ yang nyan thos 'bras bu bzhi'i rgyun zhugs kyi rtogs pa dang*/ byang sems sa dang po ba'i rtogs pa thun mong ste 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi mtshungs par rtogs pas so// de bzhin du 'phags pa'i bden bzhi'i 'bras bu 'gog bden dgra bcom gyi rtogs pa de/

byang sems sa lnga pa'i rtogs pa dang thun mong*/ rang sangs rgyas kyis mngon du byas pa'i rten 'brel lugs ldog gi tshul gyis myang 'das thob pa sa drug pa'i rtogs pa dang thun mong yin/ de lta na sems dang po bskyed pa'i byang sems des nyan rang zil gyis gnon par bshad pa dang mi 'gal lam zhe na mi 'gal te/ de'i dpe sa bcu pa'i mdor/ byang sems rnam grol zla bas dang po sa bslang bas/ byang sems rdo rje snying pos sangs rgyas kyi chos la lhag par dmigs pa'i che ba nyid kyis nyan rang gi spyod yul las 'das kyang rang gi blos rnam par dpyad pas ma yin pa/ rgyal po'i bu rgyal po'i mtshan dang ldan pa'i byin gyis blon po'i tshogs zil gyis gnon yang rang gi blos rnam par dpyad pa min la/ rgyal bu nam nar son pa na rang gi blo'i stobs bskyed pa blon po'i bya ba thams cad las shin tu 'das pa'i dpes/ byang chub sems dpa' yang sems bskyed ma thag tu lhag pa'i bsam pa che ba nyid kyis nyan rang thams cad zil gyis gnon gyi/ rang gi blos rnam par dpyad pa ni ma yin no// byang chub sems dpa'i sa bdun pa 'di la gnas pas ni rang gi yul shes pa la gnas pas nyan rang thams cad kyi bya ba las shin tu 'das pa yin no| |zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs la/ rin chen phreng bar/ theg pa che las skye med bstan// khyed kyi zad pa stong pa nyid// zad dang mi skye'i don du ni// gcig pas de phyir bzod par bgyi| |zhes nyan thos kyi zad pa mi skye ba dang*/ theg chen gyi skye med gcig par bshad pa dang*/ gzhan yang bu mo mya ngan med kyi gleng gzhi lta bu dang*/ yang brgyad stong 'grel par/ byang chub sems dpa'i mthong lam du nyan rang gi rtogs pa rdzogs pas/ mthong lam gyi dgra bcom pa zag pa zad pa zhes bshad pa dang 'gal lo zhe na/ mi 'gal te/ de dag gis spang rtogs rdzogs par bshad pa de sa bcu pa'i mdor/

bsam pa dang dmigs pa'i che bas nyan rang zil gyis gnon par gsungs pa dang dgongs rtse gtad la/ yang na mthong lam thob pa'i byang sems la chos thams cad mnyam par sangs rgyas pa zhes sangs rgyas su btags kyang sangs rgyas dngos ma yin gyi/ chos thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid ni rjes su rtogs pa la dgongs pa ltar ro// sa drug pa'i skabs su/ rin chen phreng bar/ de yi rnam par smin pa ni// lha yi rgyal po rab 'phrul 'gyur// nyan thos rnams kyis mi 'phrog la| |lhag pa'i nga rgyal can zhi byed// ces pa'ang sa drug pa rang rgyal gyi mngon rtogs dang thun mong du 'gyur bas nyan thos dgra bcom las ches lhag pa 'grub pa'i phyir dang*/ bdun pa ring du song ba ste// grangs ni ring du song ldan phyir// zhes pa'i nges tshig dang yang legs par 'brel ba'o// bcu drug pa/ sems tsam ni sa bdun gyi mngon rtogs ring du song bya ba ni/ theg chen sems tsam gyi lta ba gzung 'dzin gnyis stong gi don dam pa nyan rang gi spyod yul du ma gyur pas ring du song ba sngar smos pa bzhin te/ des na chos thams cad sems su rtogs na/ ded dpon snying rje chen po dang bram ze'i khye'u skar ma sogs thabs la mkhas pas bskal pa du ma'i tshogs bzlum nye ba lta bu yin te/ ye shes rgyas pa las/ ji ltar sgyu ma'i mkhan po dag / rang gis sprul pa'i sgyu ma la// dge dang mi dge'i 'du byed la// nyes pa gang gis mi gos ltar// thabs la mkhas pas rnam par spyod// ces so// de lta'i thabs mkhas ni/ sa bdun pa thabs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i spyod yul yin te/ rang gis dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal ni bzod sla'i/ rang mi nyams par pha rol po las mi bzad pa la 'jug pa la/ snying rje chen pos yal bar mi 'dor ba ni sa bdun gyi mngon rtogs sems tsam rtogs pa las 'byung ste/ lang kar gshegs pa'i mdo'i de bzhin gshegs pa rtag pa dang mi rtag par 'gyur ba zhes pa'i le'u lnga pa las/

sems tsam la ni bdun pa ste// snang ba med par sa brgyad yin// sa gnyis dag ni gnas yin te// bcu pa ye shes chen po nyid// de ni nga yi sa yin no// zhes dang*/ phal chen las/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /khams gsum po 'di ni sems tsam mo// zhes gsungs pas na/ sems tsam gyi mngon rtogs sa bdun pa la 'ong ba sems tsam ston pa'i mdo rnams su gsal bar 'byung ba bzhin no// bcu bdun pa/ chos kyi bdag med sa brgyad pa la mngon du byas zhes pa ni rgyas bshad ma dgos/ bsdu na/ gang zag gi bdag med pa dang po dang*/ chos kyi bdag med pa brgyad pa la mngon du byed de/ rgya cher rol ba las/ chos 'di thams cad rang bzhin bdag med pa'i// bzod pa bdag gis thob pa de yi tshe// sangs rgyas mar me mdzad kyis bdag lung bstan// zhes dang*/ gsang 'dus las/ dngos po thams cad dang bral zhing*// phung po khams dang skye mched dang*// gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam spangs pa// chos bdag med pa mnyam pa nyid// rang sems gdod nas ma skyes pa// stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no// zhes so// sa dang po la chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i brjod bya ni dag pa'i sa gsum gyi dang po sa brgyad pa la dgongs pas so// gzhan dag sa dang po rab dga' la chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa ni ma yin no// gzhan yang rnam par 'phrul ba'i rgyal pos zhus pa'i mdo dang*/ mar me mdzad lung bstan pa'i mdo las kyang chos kyi bdag med sa brgyad pa la mngon du bya bar gsungs so// bco brgyad pa/ rtogs pa gcig gis sa lam ma lus bgrod par bzhed pa ni/ 'od gsal don dam bden pa de dag ma dag gi rim pa'am/ sa dang po'i ming mngon rtogs mthong lam gyi ye shes de sangs rgyas pa'i bar du bgrod pa yin la/ ting nge 'dzin gyi ming rnams gtan la dbab pa las/ gcig la ming rnam grangs su bshad ces dang*/ brgyud pa 'di la rnal 'byor bzhi'i spros bral cung zad gsal ba la rtse gcig

/ngo bo mthong ba spros bral/ lus dang snang ba'am 'khor 'das thams cad de nyid du rtogs pa ro gcig /mnyam rjes sogs bral ba sgom med du gsungs pa lta bu ste/ slob dpon seng ge bzang pos/ ji skad bshad pa'i mthong ba'i lam gyis mngon sum du byas pa'i dngos po las tha mi dad pa la dmigs pa'i phyir mthong ba dang sgom pa dag tha dad du gyur pa med pas sgom pa'i lam mtshan nyid pa rnam par bzhag pa ni med ces dang*/ 'jug pa'i 'grel par/ ye shes kyi cha la sar brjod de/ */zhes sogs rgyas par bshad pa dang*/ mngon rtogs rgyan las| ji ltar skyes bus zo chun rgyud// rdog thabs gcig gis bskyod pa na// thams cad cig car 'gul ba ltar// skad cig ye shes de bzhin no// zhes dang*/ mtshan brjod las/ skad cig gcig gi bye brag gis// skad cig gcig la rdzogs 'tshang rgya// zhes dang*/ mgon po 'bri gung pas/ ji ltar smyug tshigs mang po la// bkas pa'i tshul gyis thams cad kyang*// gas pa gcig gis bkas pa ltar// de bzhin ye shes gcig nas gcig /ces dang*/ rgyal ba'i dbang po rat+na shrīs/ shākya'i rgyal po 'di nyid ma gtogs pa// grangs med gsum du nges pa ga na 'dug /mtshan ldan bla ma bsten pa tshogs lam ste// gdams ngag rjes bstan thob pa sbyor lam yin// rang gi sems nyid mthong ba mthong lam yin// rgyun chad med par bsgom pa sgom lam yin// rang sems mngon du gyur pa bar chad med// ces sogs gsungs pa'i phyir ro// bcu dgu pa/ sa'i yon tan 'byung ba mu drug tu bzhed pa ni/ sa thob nas yon tan de ma thag tu 'byung ba ma yin te/ mngon rtogs de yod kyang yon tan sgrub dgos/ rtogs pa de'i cha na tshul khrims dang*/ bsam gtan dang*/ byang chub kyi sems la sogs pas sa'i yon tan ji snyed pa bsgrub dgos/ de bsgrubs pas yon tan 'byung ba la mu drug ste/ rim gyis pa'i mu/

cig car ba'i mu/ 'ga' zhig yod la 'ga' zhig med pa'i mu/ yon tan gzhan gyis mi mthong ba'i mu/ rnal 'byor pa'i nyams kyi snang ba'i mu/ lung gi mu dang drug yin/ dang po rim gyis pa ni bdag cag gi ston pa lta bu/ gnyis pa cig car ba'i mu rje btsun spyan ras gzigs lta bu/ gsum pa 'ga' zhig yod la 'ga' zhig med pa byang chub sems dpa' nor bzang gi bla ma bcu po lta bu/ bzhi pa yod kyang gzhan gyis mi mthong ba slob dpon klu sgrub lta bu/ slob dpon 'di mdo rnga bo cher sa brgyad pa/ sprin chen por sa bcu pa/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud du sa brgyad pa/ laṅkar gshegs par sa dang por lung bstan pa sogs ches mang ngo*// chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po spyan ras gzigs yin yang dbu'i a mi de wa mthong mkhan nyung ba dang*/ slob dpon thogs med kyi phrag par byams mgon bzhugs pa dang*/ slob dpon zla grags kyi phrag par spyan ras gzigs bzhugs pa sogs snang ba dag pas kyang khyi ro tsam du mthong ba sogs lta bu/ lnga pa rnal 'byor pa'i nyams snang rje btsun mi la chu bar du bzhugs dus cho 'phrul bstan pa khong rang gis min pa ma gzigs/ khong gi yon tan 'ga' yang jo mo bkra shis tshe ring mas gzigs pa lta bu/ drug pa lung ni/ mthong lam thob pa dang yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis 'byung ba dus mnyam du ma gsungs pa ni/ sa bcu pa'i mdo las/ sa dang po de la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni phal cher 'dzam bu'i gling gi dbang por 'gyur zhing dbang phyug chen po la dbang du thob la/ zhes pa nas/ 'dod na brtson 'grus rtsom pa rnam pa ji lta bus khyim dang chung ma dang longs spyod thams cad spangs te de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa la rab tu 'byung ba dang*/ rab tu byung nas kyang skad cig yud tsam zhig la ting nge 'dzin brgya rab tu thob cing snyom par yang 'jug pa dang*/ sangs rgyas brgya mthong ba dang*/ de dag gis byin gyis brlabs par yang dag par shes pa dang*/

'jig rten gyi khams brgya g.yo bar byed pa dang*/ zhing brgyar 'gro ba dang*/ 'jig rten gyi khams brgya snang bar byed pa dang*/ sems can brgya yongs su smin par byed pa dang*/ bskal pa brgyar gnas par byed pa dang*/ bskal pa brgya la sngon gyi mtha' dang phyi ma'i mthar 'jug pa dang*/ chos kyi sgo brgya rnam par 'byed pa dang*/ lus brgya kun tu ston pa dang*/ lus re re yang 'khor byang chub sems dpa' brgya brgya dang ldan pa kun tu ston pa'i brtson 'grus rnam pa de lta bu rtsom mo// zhes gsungs pa gsal bas bsnyon du med do// nyi shu pa/ rgyu lam 'bras bu thams cad du tshogs gnyis zung 'jug tu bsag bya ba ni/ rgyu'i skabs su tshogs gnyis zung 'jug sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la bde gshegs snying po dri med dang rnam dbyer med pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa la ngos bzung bas/ rtsol bas ma bsags kyang gshis babs rang bsags su yod de/ rgyud bla ma las/ sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal gang yin pa// de ni nam mkha' bzhin du 'gyur med de// yang dag min rtog las byung 'dod chags sogs// glo bur dri mas de nyon mongs mi 'gyur// zhes dang*/ de nyid las/ rnam dbyer bcas pa'i mtshan nyid can// glo bur dag gis khams stong gi// rnam dbyer med pa'i mtshan nyid can// bla med chos kyis stong ma yin// zhes so// lam dus kyi tshogs gnyis ni thams cad dang mthun la/ 'bras dus su yang gzugs dang chos sku zung 'jug tu 'byung ba yang bsags pa'i 'bras bu babs kyis byung ba yin no// rgyu dus kyi bsags pa ni ldan pa'i don yin la/ 'bras dus kyi bsags pa'i sgra ni sam+bha ra'i sgras kyang tshogs pa dang dus la bab pa dang yang dag par 'dus shing tshogs pa zhes sogs su bsgyur dgos pas/ tshig don gnyis ka'i cha nas legs par 'grub la/ gzhan yang blo gros mi zad pas zhus pa'i mdor/ snag smyug sogs sbyin pa ye shes kyi tshogs su bshad pa sogs rgyas bshad mtha' yas so// nyer gcig pa/

mtho dman gang du yang zhing yar gdam pa gnad zab par bzhed pa ni/ bsam pa dang dngos gnyis te/ zhing dman pa ni tshogs gsog pa'i yul min te/ bshes spring las/ gang zag log par lta bas legs spyad kyang*/ */ thams cad rnam par smin pa mi bzad ldan// zhes so// zhing dman pa las ma rnyed na bsam pas bsgyur btub ste/ sngon byang chub sems dpa' glang po cher gyur pa na rngon pas gos ngur smrig gyon nas mda' bsnun pas glang pos rngon pa'i gos rgyu mtshan du byas nas mche srog byin te rang sems dag pa'i smon lam yang*/ sbyin pa kha cig len pa las 'dag cing*// de bzhin gzhan ni gtong ba po las 'dag /de yi phyir na 'dir ni rang sems las// yon gyi dam pa bskyed phyir yang dag 'bad// ces btang bas byang chub kyi rgyur gyur pa lta bu dang*/ sngon dge bshes bsam yas pa/ 'jig rten mgon po phag mo grur rten dge bsnyen du bzhugs dus/ khong gi ngan spyod la brten nas dge 'dun thams cad la byi po yin snyam pa'i 'du shes 'khrungs pa bar chad du mkhyen nas/ dge 'dun rnams yi dam lhar mos pa'i spyi bor 'gro ba'i mgon po re re bsgoms shing yan lag bdun pa 'bul bar dam bcas pas/ dang po tshul 'chos can zer| mthar mos gus mthar thug ces zer ba byung tshul lta bu'o// dngos su gdam pa ni/ snying po mdor bsags las/ sangs rgyas zhing sogs zhing rnams la// khyad par du ni sbyin pa spyad// dmangs rigs stong phrag gnyis dag kyang*// bram ze gtsang ma gcig dang 'dra// bram ze stong phrag gnyis dag ni// dge slong gcig la rab tu sbyar// dge slong stong phrag gnyis dag ni// rdul med pa ni gcig dang mnyam// rdul med stong phrag gnyis dag ni// ye shes ldan pa gcig dang mnyam// ye shes ldan pa stong phrag gnyis// slob dpon gcig dang mnyam par brtag /de ltar sbyin pa'i zhing byas nas// blo dang ldan pas rtag tu sbyin// rnal 'byor rtsa ba'i chos las ni// zhing bzang po la sa bon gdab// ces so// 'di'i slob dpon zhes pa ni/

nag po pa'i dgra nag 'grel pa las/ dam chos klog dang sbyin pa dang*// 'chad byed man ngag ston pa dang*// dbang bskur ba dang dkyil 'khor las// slob 'dod rnam pa drug tu 'dod// ces gcig ldan gnyis ldan gsum ldan sogs bshad pa'i rdo rje'i slob dpon yin pa'i phyir/ bka' brgyud rin po che'i phyag bzhes la zhing thams cad kyi mchog dpal ldan bla ma dam pa yin par bzhed pa ni phyag bzhes kyi snying po mchog ste rgyu mtshan de ltar gyis so// nyer gnyis pa/ ched du bdag tu bzung nas tshogs bsag pa thabs mkhas bya ba ni/ bdag 'dzin 'khor ba'i rtsa ba dang bdag med 'khor ba las sgrol byed yin mod/ bdag 'dzin spong ba la ched du bdag tu bzung nas tshogs gsog pa la thabs la mkhas par 'gyur gyi/ de med na chos gang yang bdag tu ma bzung ba'i btang snyoms gti mug gi cha yin pas/ slar bdag 'dzin 'gal tshabs can dam du 'gro bas des na bdag tu bzung ba'i dngos po lta ci smos/ bdag tu ma bzung ba'i chu dang me tog sogs kyang bdag tu bzung nas 'bul dgos te/ spyod 'jug las/ yongs su bzung ba med pa de dag kun// blo yis blangs nas thub pa skyes kyi mchog /sras dang bcas pa rnams la legs 'bul na// yon gnas dam pa thugs rje che rnams kyis// bdag la brtser dgongs bdag gi 'di dag bzhes// zhes so// gzhan yang rgyal po gsal rgyal dang mu to ba'i gtam rgyud lta bu'o// mdor na 'khor 'das thams cad sems kyi ngang du bsdus nas 'bul dgos pa'i phyir ro// nyer gsum pa/ 'khor 'das thams cad kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba zhes gsungs pa ni/ 'khor ba'i sems can thams cad kyi dus gsum gyi dge ba dang*/ 'das pa phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyis tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i dge ba rnams rang gi blos bsdus te gzhan don byang chub snying po'i rgyur bsngo ba yin te/

de'i bsngo rgyu'i rtsa ba ni 'khor 'das kyi byed po sems yin pas dang*/ 'khor 'das thams cad la de bzhin nyid dbyer med du bzhugs pa dang*/ sems bskyed 'khor 'das kyi bdag po yin pa dang*/ sangs rgyas byang sems thugs dang po bskyed pa nas dam pa'i chos ma nub kyi bar gyi dge rtsa rnams sems can kho na'i don yin phyir de ltar bsngo dgos te/ rgyud rdo rje rtse mo las/ ji ltar bcom ldan 'das kyis ni| |sngon gyi bsngo ba mdzad pa ltar// rnal 'byor las byung dge ba bsngo// byang chub sems kyi mthu yis ni// rang gi sems kyang bsngo bar bya// rdo rje chen po mthar phyin byed// byang chub sems kyis bsgral bar bya// chos kyi dbyings kyi snying po che// sems can thams cad dgos pa med// thams cad de bzhin gshegs snying po// nyon mongs 'dam gyis gos pa med// ces so// gzhan dag na re/ yod pa'i dge ba zhes bya ba// chos kyi dbyings la bsams nas ni// zhes pa nas/ bsngo ba dug dang bcas par gsungs| |zer mod dpyad na/ lung sher phyin gyi mdor/ rab 'byor yongs su bsngo ba gang yin pa de ni byang chub sems dpa' chen po chos kyi dbyings yongs su bsngo ba ste/ zhes dang*/ de nyid las/ sems gang gis sems bsngo ba'i chos nyid kyang de yin/ chos gang dag gis yongs su bsngo ba'i chos de dag gi chos nyid kyang de yin/ zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs pa dang*| rgyan stug po bkod pa las/ de bzhin kun gzhi'i rnam shes kyang*// bde gshegs snying po khams dge ba// zag med yon tan ldan pa de// bsngos na 'bras bu smin par 'gyur| |zhes dang*/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi bsngo ba las/ 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed sogs/ yang de nyid las/ rgyal ba'i sras kyis 'di la bslab bya ste// ji snyed gang yod mtha' dag ma lus dang*// khams rnams kun kyang yongs su bsdu byas te// ci nas bde gshegs stobs la 'jug pa bsngo// zhes sogs gsungs so// yang gzhan dag

/la la byams dang snying rje sogs| |gshis kyi dge ba yin zhes zer// zhes pa nas/ des na legs par soms la smros// zhes pa'i bar rgyas par smras mod/ dpyad de/ chos kyi dbyings la ji snyed kyi sgra mi thob pa yang min te/ rgyud bla ma las/ shes bya mthar thug rtogs pa'i blos// thams cad mkhyen pa'i chos nyid ni// sems can thams cad la yod pa// mthong phyir ji snyed yod pa yin| |zhes gsungs la/ yod pa'i sgra chos dbyings las 'gal na med pa'i sgra yang 'gal te mtha' las 'das pa'i phyir ro/ yang*/ bem po dang ni dngos med dang*// 'phags pa'i chos nyid cis mi bsngo// zhes pa yang don las gol te 'khor 'das gnyis ka bsngo bya'i lung sngar bshad pas so// yang*/ chos dbyings dge bar byas nas ni// de la bsngo ba'i rgyur byed pa| |bsngo bas 'gyur na 'dus byas 'gyur// mi 'gyur bsngo ba don med yin// zhes pa yang*/ rnam par ma brtag pa ste/ pa ri warti'i sgra don yongs su bsgyur ba yin pas bsngo rgyu 'dus byas las 'dus ma byas bkag pa ma yin pa lung mang pos grub pas khyod nongs la/ zag bcas zag med du bsgyur ba sogs don mang zhing*/ yang sems 'dus ma byas bsgyur du mi btub par khyod bsams na min te/ rgyud dgongs pa lung ston las/ rnam rtog sna tshogs lcags zhes bya// nyes pa gsum tshogs bdag nyid las| |gsang sngags skyes bu'i sbyor ba yis// de ni mi mchog dag tu 'gyur// gser 'gyur rtsi yi rnam pa yis// lcags ni gser du byed pa yin// de bzhin sngags kyi de nyid kyis| |mi ni bde gshegs byed pa yin// zhes so// yang gzhan dag /rig pa yin na rnam shes kyi// zhes pa nas/ sangs rgyas gsung bzhin gus pas sgrubs// zhes pa'i bar yang rnam par 'khyams te/ bde gshegs snying po sems las gzhan med pa lung gis grub kyang kun gzhi'i rnam shes kyi gsal cha la dgongs sogs mgo 'khor ba'i tshig mang du smras mod/

gsal cha sems byung yin/ sems min/ bde gshegs snying po min/ tshogs brgyad sems byung yin/ bde gshegs snying po 'dus ma byas yin pa des grub/ sems dang sems byung tsam dbye ba ma phyed pa'i sdom gsum ni bstan pa'i gsal byed mtshar che'o// sems can thams cad la bde gshegs snying po yod pa skyon lnga spang phyir gsungs pa la mthun mod kyang nges don du sems can gyi khams la bde gshegs snying po med na sems can ci'i phyir 'tshang rgya/ rgyu med na 'bras bu ci las 'byung*/ yang khong dag /dngos med yin na don byed med// ces sogs bsting tshig smras mod/ rgyud dgongs pa lung ston las/ dngos med pa las yang dag skye// sngags kyi skyes bu 'byung ba ste// 'di ni phyag rgya chen po zhes// 'gro ba'i don ni sgrub pa'o| |zhes lung rnam dag gis grub mod/ ci zhig gis bsnyon/ yang khong dag /des na de bzhin gshegs pa yi// snying po spros bral yin pa'i phyir// sems can rnams la sangs rgyas dang*// 'khor ba gnyis ka 'byung ba 'thad// ces tha tshig dang bcas smras mod/ don la gol te khams rang bzhin rnam dag gi steng du rnam shes dang ye shes gnyis ka tshang bas 'khor 'das tshang ste rang bzhin shes ma shes yin pa lung gis sngar mang du bsgrubs so// yang khyod kyi 'dod par bde gshegs snying po rang bzhin rnam dag ces bzang bzang po ye shes lnga rdzogs pa/ tha mal gyi shes pa zhes ngan ngan po zhig rnam pa kun tu bsam mod/ 'di lta ste/ sam+bu ṭa'i rgyud kyi brtag pa brgyad pa'i rab byed gnyis pa las/ kye bcom ldan 'das| ye shes kyi khyad par gang dag lags/ bka' stsal pa/ ye shes rnam pa lngar gsungs te// lha rnams ye shes gsal ba yin// lha min ye shes khro ba'o// yi dwags ye shes zhen pa ste// dmyal ba'i ye shes 'jigs pas non// byol song ye shes blun pa ste// brtan pa rnams ni sems med pa'o// lkugs shing glen pas bsgribs pa dang*// byas pa'i shes pas shes pa can// rnal 'byor lta chos khyad par gyi// ye shes de nyid bye brag shes// zhes dang*/

yang de nyid las/ ye shes de nyid khyad par gyi// ye shes chen po yang dag nyid// kun tu sems kyi bye brag gi// 'khor lo mnyam par bzhag par lta// zhes gsungs pas/ ye gdod ma'i shes pa la ye shes su btags/ de sems las gzhan med/ de nyid rtogs ma rtogs yin pa lung gis gsal por grub pas gcom skyungs shig /yang zhar la 'di lta ste/ khong na re/ la la zhi gnas cung zad dang*// snang stong rtog pa phra mo la// mthong lam yin zhes ngo sprod byed// ces pa nas/ 'od zer nangs par 'byung ba mtshar// zhes smras mod/ legs par soms dang*/ zhi gnas tsam dang snang stong tsam la mthong lam lta zhog /sems ngo mthong tsam la yang bka' brgyud rin po ches mi bzhed de/ de ni khyed rang gi lugs rnying pa yin mod/ sngon mgon po phag mo gru par zhi gnas kyi cha tsam la rje sa chen gyis mthong lam du ngo sprad/ dga' nas mnyam med dwags po'i rtsar byon nas don de zhus pas zan rdog las lod par sun phyung nas/ slar de'u mgor bsgoms pas gnas lugs kyi don ngo 'phrod da lta'ang ngo mthong de'ur grags/ sngar gyi bla ma de rnams la thugs ma ches zhes da lta rlung ltar grags mod bsnyon yang cung zad phyis so// yang khong gis/ tshe 'dir mthong lam skyes pa la// yon tan shi nas 'byung ba ni// blun po rnams kyi rdzun rib yin// mdo rgyud kun dang mi mthun pas// 'di 'dra'i chos lugs mkhas pas spangs// zhes pa la yang sa'i yon tan 'byung tshul mu drug dang*| sa bcu pa'i mdo sogs kyis sngar gsal bar bshad pas lugs 'di nongs par byas mod/ sa bcu pa'i mdo'i lugs sogs mkhas pas spang bya khyod kyi khyad chos su zad do// gzhan yang bde gshegs snying po bsngo bya don dam pa'i dge ba de bzhin nyid du chos mngon pa kun btus su/ shud+dha bha wa ti'i sgra don dang mtshungs par gsungs pa dang*| slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyi mdzod kyi rang 'grel du/

mchog tu bde ba'i phyir don dam par dge ba ste nad med pa bzhin no// zhes su kha bha wa ti'i sgra don dam pa'i dge bar shin tu gsal bar gsungs pa sogs kyang mtha' gcod du 'gyur ro// nyer bzhi pa/ sangs rgyas dang bla ma la'ang bsngo ba dgos bya ba ni/ phrin las rdzogs par 'gyur bas bsngo ba dgos par gsungs te/ lung dbyen gyi gzhi las/ dka' thub mdzad nas byang chub kyi shing drung du gshegs pa'i tshe bu mo dga' mo dang dga' stobs ma gnyis kyis ba stong gi 'o ma lan bcu drug tu nying khur byas pa drangs nas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba des byang chub sems dpa'i brtul zhugs 'grub par gyur cig /ces bsngos pa dang*/ lhas sbyin gyis sgyogs 'phang pa'i tshe bden pa'i stobs brjod pas rma'i 'dzag pa chad pa sogs lta bu dang*/ bdag cag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba med par mi 'gro bar bsngo ba byas pas ches cher 'phel ba dang*/ sangs rgyas kyis sngon gyi dam bca' 'gro phan mdzad pa myur du rdzogs pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' yang spang rtogs gong 'phel du 'gyur ba dang*/ bla ma yang so skye yin na sa lam myur du rdzogs pa dang*/ sa lam la gnas pa yin na bgrod myur ba sogs 'byung bar dgongs nas/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon pos/ nga 'bu mya ngan las 'das pa'i rjes su'ang khyed shul du yod pa rnams kyis bsngo ba byed dgos pa yin zhes yang yang gsungs pa'ang don de lta bu la dgongs la/ gzhan yang 'phags pa sdud pa las/ byang chub sems dpa' mkhas pa thabs mkhas gang zhig gis// de dag bsod nams bya ba'i dngos la yi rang nas// sems can don du byang chub mchog rab yongs bsngo na// yongs su bsngo bas sems can thams cad zil gyis gnon// zhes sogs kyang gsungs la| bsngo ba'i skabs 'dir 'khor gsum yongs su dag tshul sogs mgon po 'bri gung pa'i bzhed dgongs dpyis phyin pa rnam par bshad pa lung rigs gis gtan la phab na spro ba 'phel yang rtsa ba'i don rnams brda khrol tsam las yan lag gi rgyas bshad yi ges ngal zhing*/

glegs bam gyi bongs chung ba la bsams te de tsam du byas so// zhes bslab pa byang chub sems kyi gnad bsdus pa'i tshoms gsal bar byed pa ste spyi don bzhi pa'o/// / ༈ /spyi don lnga pa gsang sngags rig 'dzin sdom pa'i gnad bsdus kyi tshoms 'chad pa la rdo rje'i gsung nyer brgyad mchis pa las/ dang po/ sngags ni bstan pa gzhan la'ang 'byung zhes gsungs pa ni/ sangs rgyas rnams spang rtogs mnyam zhing rgyu'i dus su nyon mongs rags pa/ lam gyi dus rgyu'i theg pa dang phra ba 'bras bu'i theg pas spangs te 'og min du longs sku nges pa lnga ldan du sangs rgyas nas thugs rje phyogs ris su ma chad par sku dang ye shes mdzad pa phrin las sems can gyi khams dang mnyam par 'jug pas/ 'dul byed de lta bus gdul bya gsang sngags la mos pa rnams la sngags kyi chos nges par ston pa yin gyi/ sangs rgyas gzhan gyi bstan pa la gsang sngags mi 'byung ba min mod/ 'on kyang shas che chung dang*/ mngon mtshan che chung gi dbang gis de ltar grags pa ste/ des na sangs rgyas thams cad gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyis sangs rgyas pa sha stag ste/ rnam snang mngon byang las/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang*// de bzhin gang dag ma byon dang*// da ltar byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas// 'gro la phan phyir bzhugs pa rnams// de dag kun gyis gsang sngags kyi// cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen nas// dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du// thams cad mkhyen pa mtshan med brnyes// zhes gsungs/ sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa thams cad kyi bstan pa'i rtsa ba yang gsang sngags yin te/ rnam snang mngon byang las/ gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas pa'i// bdag nyid chen po kun gyi ni// bstan pa 'di la khyed rnams kun// yongs su bzung ste skye bzhin pa// zhes dang*/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ smin pa dang ni grol ba'i lam| |sangs rgyas byang chub bstan pa'i mchog

/ces gsungs/ des na gsang sngags ni dus gsum gyi bstan pa thams cad du 'byung ste/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ 'od srung zhes bya sngon byung ba// de dus de tshe sa steng 'dir// 'byung po rnams la legs don du// sngags mchog 'di ni gsungs pa yin// zhes dang*/ 'jam dpal mtshan brjod las// 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs// ma 'ongs rnams kyang gsung 'gyur la// da ltar byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas// yang dang yang du gsungs pa gang*// zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na shas che chung ngam gtso che chung tsam las/ bstan pa gzhan la yang gsang sngags 'byung ba kho na te/ 'on kyang bdag cag gi ston pa'i bstan pa 'di la gsang sngags shas che bar byung ba yin no// gnyis pa/ dbang gi don rgyud la skyes na thob ces gsungs pa ni/ rdo rje slob dpon rab dang 'bring la tshad bzung med/ tha mas cho ga'i rnam bzhag tsam bshad pas dbang thob par mi 'gro/ dbang don skyed byed dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i sta gon nas bzung*/ dngos gzhi rdzogs pa'i bar du slob ma'i rgyud la yon tan mi 'dra ba re re rim can du 'byung zhing*/ sgo gsum dang de gsum tha dad du 'dzin pa'i dri ma dag nas/ rdo rje bzhi bskyed cing bskyed rdzogs bsgom pa'i nus ldan du byed dgos pa'i phyir dbang don skye dgos te/ phyag rdor bstod 'grel las/ 'dir dbang bskur bar byed pa ni dbang ste bde ba'i sems dang ldan par byed pa'i phyir ro// zhes so// dbang don gang zhe na/ phung khams skye mched rgyal ba lnga sogs su ngo 'phrod cing nges shes skyes na bum dbang thob/ de bzhin du rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa dbyings su dag pa'i dga' ba dang bcas pa'i ting nge 'dzin skyes na gsang dbang*/ rang bzhin lhan skyes dga' bzhi'i rim pa kun rdzob zhu bde'i rkyen gyis 'od gsal nyams su myong na sher dbang*/ dbang gsum pa'i kun rdzob dpe'i ye shes de nyid tshig gis ngo sprad pas don de phyag chen rdo rje'i rnal 'byor yan lag bdun ldan rtogs na bzhi pa thob pa la dgongs la/

de yang gsum ste/ rab kyis dbang bzhi pa tshig tsam gyis ngo sprad ma thag rtogs te grol ba rgyal po in+d+ra bhū ti lta bu/ 'bring de dang de dag gi don nyams su len pa'i gnad shes shing rtogs pas grol lam la ma ltos par nyams su myong ba/ tha mas kyang de'i tshig don la go ba skye zhing mos pa yid la byed pa zhig byung na dbang thob pa zhes bya la/ dbang gi don tsam yang yid la mi byed na dbang bskur yang thob par mi 'gyur te/ sa rdo la bskur ba dang khyad med pa'i phyir ro// des na skabs 'dir dbang don zhes pa dbang bzhi'i don phyin ci ma log pa rgyud la skyes na thob la/ ma skyes na mi thob pa la dgongs pa min gyi/ de ltar yin na deng sang dbang thob pa mi srid mod/ 'dir ni rje nā ro pas/ dbang bskur gyi dus su mthong lam skye zhing de skad cig de la 'gag par gsung mod/ de ni dpe'i ye shes la mthong lam du btags kyi/ chos mchog gi rjes kyi mthong lam ni 'gag pa med par gsungs pa lta bu yin pas tshul de lta bu dang mtshungs so// 'dir dpyad par bya ba 'di ltar yang mchis te/ gzhan dag gis/ sngags kyi dbang bskur byed pa na// grangs nges med par dbang bskur byed// ces pa nas/ yongs su bzung bar mi shes so// zhes pa'i bar gyi slob ma nyer lnga man chad nges can dang*/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang de nyid las/ de bas lhag pa'i slob ma la// cho ga yongs su rdzogs pa ni// zhes pa nas/ mchod nas gshegs su gsol bar shis// zhes pa'i bar gyis mtshan gcig la dbang mi tshar ba'i nyes pa yod par bshad cing*/ gsang ba spyi rgyud kyi lung dang sbyar mod/ de yang min te/ spyi rgyud ni bya rgyud kho na yin te/ rgyud de nyid rang nas/ 'jig rten dag la brtse phyir ngas// rnam par gnon pa la sogs pa// dkyil 'khor sum stong dag dang ni// lnga brgyar bshad pa gang yin pa| |dkyil 'khor de dag rnams kyi spyi'i// cho ga 'di ni ngas bshad do// zhes gsungs pas bla med la grangs nges 'di dgos pa'i shes byed med la/

yang khong dag /bla med la lugs 'di 'gebs pa'i rgyu mtshan/ rgyud de nyid las/ gang du las ni yod gyur la// las kyi cho ga rnams med pa// de ni spyi yi rgyud dag las// gsungs pa'i cho ga mkhas pas bsten| |zhes dbang bskur ba'i las yod la dbang gi cho ga med pa la 'gebs par bshad mod/ de lta na deng sang dgyes rdor gyi dbang bskur la yang grangs sogs byed pa khyod kyi lugs la snang mod/ dgyes rdor la dbang cho ga med na bden du chug /rgya bod kyi mkhas grub du ma'i dbang chog ches mang ba yod bzhin du spyi rgyud kyi lugs ltar 'gebs pa khyod rang gi 'dod pa bstan bcos su bris pa dang lag len 'gal ba de yang ngo mtshar che'o// yang khong dag /ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur yang*// slob ma smin byed cho ga ru// rgyud sde kun las gsungs pa med| |ces bris mod/ dbang lha bskyed bstim sogs dbang gi bya ba mtha' dag ting nge 'dzin la brten bzhin du bab col 'di 'dra 'bri ba yang mtshar che la/ ji skad du/ mi bskyod bsam gtan gsum rdzogs pa// zhes sogs lung mang po la ci'i phyir rgol/ yang khong dag /deng sang gang zag rab 'bring kun/ rdul tshon gyi ni dkyil 'khor du/ dbang bskur bya bar gsung mod kyi// gzhan gyi smin byed rgyud las bkag /ces zer ba yang shin tu ma brtag pa ste/ gang zag rab 'bring tha gsum la rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba phun sum tshogs pa'i yan lag yin mod/ med mi rung ba min te/ brtag gnyis dang dza ya se na'i gsung las/ rdul tshon 'bri bar mi nus na// dkyil 'khor dang mnyam ras la ni// nges par bcom ldan he ru kaḥ /phyag rgya'i tshogs dang bcas par 'bri// zhes dang*/ ra li sku gsung thugs kyi rgyud las/ gdul bya dbang po'i bye brag gis// ting 'dzin me tog rdul tshon rim/ zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir ro// yang khong dag /la la sems nyid ma rtogs na// dbang bskur thob kyang mi phan zer// gal te sems nyid rtogs gyur na| |dbang bskur bya yang mi dgos lo// zhes zer yang*/

dbang gi rtsa ba mchog dbang gong ma gsum gyi nang nas kyang*/ dbang bzhi pa tshig dbang yin par mthun la/ de ni sems nyid rtogs pa'i thabs las gzhan pa med de/ brtag gnyis las/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing*// zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir// sems nyid ma rtogs na dbang thob kyang phan yon che mod grol bar mi 'gyur ba ni rgyal ba kun gyi chos lugs yin pas khyed ma 'dod kyang sha thang ngo*// yang khong dag /kha gcig cho ga med bzhin du// bla ma'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor las| |dbang bzhi rdzogs par len zhes zer// 'o na dge tshul dge slong yang*// bla ma'i sku las cis mi len// sems bskyed kyang ni bla ma yi// sku nyid las ni thob pa'i phyir| |sems bskyed cho ga ci zhig dgos// zhes zer ba yang don las gol te/ spyir bla ma'i sku las dbang bzhi len pa ni/ ye shes grub pa'i rgyud las/ bla ma'i sku yi dkyil 'khor du| |dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par zhu// rgyud sde'i dgongs pa gnad kyi mchog /ces gsungs la/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i tshe dbang bzhi len pa las gzhan med pa'i phyir/ de 'gog na khyed rang gi lam zab gang du 'jog /yang bla ma'i sku la lus dkyil bkod nas dbang zhu ba ni/ cho ga las bshad pa dril bu lus dkyil dang dgyes rdor gyi lus dkyil pho brang lnga sogs las dbang len pa ni kun mthun la khyed rang yang byed mod/ cho ga med pa kun rig sogs kyi dbang bla ma'i sku las ni nged kyang mi len pas tshul mthun/ dbang bzhi len pa'i dpe/ so thar dang byang sems la bkag pa de ni sdom pa gsum cho ga gcig tu bsgrub pa khyed kyi khyad chos rmad du byung bar mchis so// rdor gsung 'di'i 'grel pa snga ma 'ga' zhig tu dbang bzhi pa'i ngo bo spros bral dang skye med du mdzad pa ni/ nā ro mai tri mar rngog yab sras kyi bzhed pa dang ma mthun pa ste/ 'jig rten mgon po'i gsung bgros gtsang ma zhig cung zad ma 'khyor bas/

sa skya pa khu dbon gyi bzhed pa dang cha mthun du thal bas cung zhig nongs so// gsum pa/ lha phyogs gcig pas kyang dbang bskur du 'gro zhes gsungs pa ni/ slob ma'i rgyud la dbang bzhi bskur ba la dkyil 'khor gyi lha gdan gsum tshang ba zhig nges par dgos la/ de yang dngos su ma tshang bas dbang gi go mi chod na 'jam rdor dang dus 'khor ma gtogs rgyud sde phal cher la dngos su ma tshang bas ha cang thal che zhing*/ gdan gsum dngos su tshang ba dgos pa rgyud lung rnams su yang gsal por ma mthong bas/ des na gdan gsum don gyis tshang ba zhig yin la/ don gyi gdan gsum ni lha dpa' bo gcig pa la yang tshang ste/ de yang dbang bskur gyi tshe dbang bskur mkhan slob dpon gyi lus/ bskur gzhi mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor/ skur byed nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor/ bskur bya slob ma'i lus/ bskur rdzas bum chu sogs te/ de rnams la gdan gsum nges par tshang ba dpon slob gnyis kas shes pa zhig dgos la/ de la gdan gsum ma tshang ba'i tshang bar ma shes na dbang gi bya ba ma rdzogs pa'i phyir cho ga rnam par ma dag pa'o// gdan gsum ni sangs rgyas dang rig ma'i gdan/ byang sems dang lha mo'i gdan/ khro bo dang khro mo'i gdan rnams so// de yang nam mkhar spyan drangs pa'i rgyal ba lngas dbang bskur ba'i bya ba mdzad/ rig mas rdo rje'i glu len/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro bo dang khro mo rnams kyis bgegs skrod pa sogs mdzad par bsam pa dang*/ slob dpon dang slob ma'i phung po lnga rgyal ba lnga/ 'byung ba bzhi rig ma/ mig sogs nang gi skye mched byang sems/ gzugs sogs phyi'i skye mched lha mo/ tshigs chen brgyad khro bo dang khro mo'i rang bzhin du rnam par dag pa ni nges pa don gyi gdan gsum yin la/ mdun bskyed dang dbang rdzas kyi lha yang rigs thams cad kyi bdag po rdo rje sems dpa' gsang chen rigs gcig

/de las gsang ba rigs gsum/ rgyal ba rigs lnga/ dam pa rigs brgya'i bdag nyid can nam/ yang na rgyal ba rigs lnga po re re yang rigs lnga lnga'i bdag nyid can yin pas nyer lnga/ de nyid re re yang yum bzhi'i zlas phye bas rigs brgya'i bdag nyid yin pa'i phyir nges par gdan gsum tshang ste/ 'dus pa las/ mdor na phung po lnga rgyal ba// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad yin// rdo rje'i skye mched nyid dag kyang*// byang chub sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor mchog /sa ni spyan zhes bya ba ste// chu yi khams ni mā ma kī// dkar dang sgrol ma zhes bya gang*// me dang rlung du rab tu grags// zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs pa'i phyir ro// bshad rgyud thams cad gsang ba las/ dkyil 'khor zhes ni gang bshad pa// yid ni dkyil 'khor dam pa yin// gzhal med khang zhes bshad pa ni// sems ni gzhal med khang brtsegs 'phags// zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs pa'i phyir ro// gdan zhes pa ni ngo bo'am/ yang na zhes pa'i tshig ste sangs rgyas sogs gsum ngo 'dzoms pa'i don yin pas nges dgos so// 'dir kha cig gis/ dbang bskur chos sgo tsam yin gyi// 'tshang rgya ba yi chos gzhan zhig |sgom rgyu logs na yod do zhes// blun po rnams kyis mun sgom byas// zhes pa yang*/ snyad 'dogs klan ka tsam las gzhan pa'i dgos pa gyi na tsam yang med de/ dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs thob pa'i bsgom bya bskyed rdzogs las gzhan med pa la/ de ni dbang gis rtogs pa nyid yin par kun mthun pa la de 'dra'i khyad gsod kyi ngag kyang ches blun no// bzhi pa/ dpe don rtogs pa ma skyes na dpe don khong du mi chud ces pa ni/ dpe'i ye shes la brten nas don gyi ye shes rtogs dgos par bzhed pa mi 'thad de/ dpe ni 'dra bas 'dra ba mtshon pa ste/ don phyin ci ma log pa zhig rgyud la ma skyes na dpe don gnyis kar kha tshon gcod mi thub ste/

dper na nam mkha' ma mthong ba'i mi la bar snang bstan pa bzhin te/ nam mkha' yang stong gsal mtha' dbus med pa'i cha nas 'di dang 'dra'o zhes brjod kyang go yul yin rlom tsam las don dpyis phyin pa mi go ba dang 'dra la/ des na dpe don rtogs pa zhes pa'i go ba gting tshugs pa ni 'di lta ste/ dbang gsum pa'i dus kyi zag bcas 'jig rten pa'i lhan skyes gnas skabs bzhi dang stong pa bzhi dang dga' ba bzhi sogs kyi bde chen lhan skyes kyi ye shes de yang dpe'i ye shes yin zhes go yul du bzhag na don min pas/ de'i ngo bo bde stong lhan skyes brjod du med pa'i bde ba chen po de nyid kyi don rtogs par byas la| gzod dbang bzhi pa tshig tsam gyis ngo sprad ma thag /sngar gyi gsum pa'i ye shes brjod bral rgyud la skyes zin de nyid zung 'jug yan lag bdun ldan du yin pa la yin par ngo 'phrod pa'i nges shes thob pas dpe sher dbang gi ye shes dang*/ don bzhi pa'i ye shes gnyis ka'i don rgyud la skyes pa zhig ma byung na dbang don khong du mi chud pa la dgongs pas so// des na gsum pa dpe'i ye shes su bzhag pa la bzhi pa tshig gis ngo sprad pas rtogs pa rgyud la ma skyes par dpe la don tshig bshad tsam gyis ngo sprad na nyams myong yang blos byas kyi rtog btags las gzhan du ma gyur pas go mi chod do// des na dbang gsum pa'i ye shes de nyid don gyi bde chen du 'dod pa'ang min te/ ye shes grub pa las/ dbang po gnyis sbyor bde ba ni// de nyid yin zhes skye ngan smra// de ni bde ba che yin zhes// rgyal ba rnams kyis ma gsungs so// zhes so/ de yang cung zad dbye na/ rtsa ba shes rab las/ rang bzhin dag ni bcos min dang*| |gzhan la ltos pa med pa yin// zhes pa gzhi dus kyi rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes de nyid rtogs par bya ba'i slad du dbang gsum pa pho nya'i lam gyi bgrod pa la brten nas gzhi'i rang bzhin lhan skyes de nyid lam dus 'dir bde stong zung 'jug dga' ba bzhi'i rang bzhin du dbang po gnyis sbyor gyi bde ba 'pho med du bcings pa'i lam des rtogs par byed do| |phyag chen thig le las/

dga' ba zhes bya snang ba yin// snang ba med pa mchog tu dga'// khyad dga' nye bar thob pa ste// lhan cig skyes te 'od gsal ba'o// zhes dga' ba bzhi snang mched thob pa 'od gsal gyi rang bzhin dpe'i ye shes rgyud la rtogs par byas pa'i tshe ye shes de nyid tshig tsam gyis ngo sprad de/ brtag gnyis las/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing*| |rdo rje snying po mkha' dang mtshungs// rdul bral mtha' ster zhi ba nyid// khyod rang yang ni de yi pha// zhes dpe don sbyar te bshad cing*/ de'i don ni/ kun spyod las/ 'gro ba 'di dag sangs rgyas lnga'i bdag nyid// gar mkhan mchog dang ri mo bzang ltar gnas// gang du bde chen zhes bya gcig pu nyid// gcig pu nyid ni du ma'i brdar mdzad do// zhes sogs gsungs pas 'di ni gzhi la yod pa lam du byas pas 'bras bu mngon du byed pa nyid yin gyi/ rgyu la 'bras bu re ba min te rgyu kho na las 'bras bu 'byung ba'i nges pa med pa ni/ spyod 'jug las/ gal te rgyu la 'bras gnas na// zan za mi gtsang za bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o// 'ga' zhig gis/ la la dbang bskur mu bzhir 'dod| |dbang bskur byas kyang ma thob dang*// ma byas kyang ni thob pa dang*// byas na thob la ma byas na// mi thob pa dang rnam bzhir 'dod// ces bkag pa yang dpyad par bya ste/ cho ga nyams pa dang*/ dpon slob mtshan nyid ma tshang ba dang*/ dbang don rgyud la ma skyes pa sogs ni dpon slob gnyis kas dbang bskur thob kyi ming la bdag gir byas kyang dbang mtshan nyid pa thob par mi 'gyur la/ slob dpon thugs rgyud grol bas slob ma dad ldan la tshig gcig tsam gyis brda sprad pas lhan skyes kyi ye shes skyes pa'i tshe smin grol gyi lam thams cad skad cig la rdzogs pas dbang bskur cho ga dang rdzas la ma brten yang don gyis thob pa/ til+li pas nā ro pa la mchil lham gyis bsnun nas/

kye ho/ 'di ni rang rig ye shes te// sogs gsungs pa lta bu slob dpon mtshan ldan gyis slob ma snod ldan la dus deng sang lta bu sogs rgyud nas gsungs pa ji lta bar bskur na thob la ma bskur na mi thob pa ste de lta bu'i mu bzhi brtsi ba ni gsang sngags pa thams cad kyi spyi lugs yin la/ gsang sngags kyi rig pa so byang la sbyor ba ni ches mi 'thad do// mu bzhi dbang kho na la brtsi yi gzhan la mi brtsi ba ni chos 'di pa'i lugs te/ de yang gsang sngags la grags pa rnams chos gzhan kun la brtsi dgos pa'i shes byed med do// byas na thob pa'i gang zag la dbang byed pa ni deng sang khyed rang gi rjes 'brang rnams kyis kyang dpon slob mtshan ldan gyis cho ga yan lag tshang bar dbang bskur ba byed bzhin pa nyid ma yin nam/ nad med pas sman spong la/ nad pas mi spong ba ni khyod kyis rig par drangs kyang*/ lugs 'di pa'i rig pa phul du phyin pa ste/ dbang bskur na thob la ma bskur na mi thob pa'i dpe nad pa dang sman gyi rig pas grub bo// de 'dra ba bstan pa dkrug pa'i snyad ka dang bdud kyi byin rlabs yin par khas len na rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud lung rnams de 'drar thal bas ha cang chos spong gi las log par lta ba ma mchis sam/ lnga pa/ bskyed rim ni yongs su grub pa zhes gsungs pa ni/ gsang sngags 'bras bu lam du byed pas rang gi lus kyi phung khams skye mched 'byung ba rnams ni gdod nas lha dang lha mo'i rang bzhin du grub pa de nyid 'bras dus kyi lha'i ngo bo las gzhan du ma grub pa de nyid kyi zhal phyag gi rnam pa lam du byas te bsgoms pas 'bras bu lha de'i ngo bo nyid du 'tshang rgya ba ni dper na zhing pas nas kyi sa bon btab pa las 'bras bu nas nyid 'byung ba lta bu yin la/ de yang lus kyi lha rnams bcos ma'i dkyil 'khor bris 'bur lta bu ma yin par dper na 'khor lo sdom pa nas rtsa rnams dpa' mo/

khams rnams dpa' bor gsungs pa dang*/ gsang ba 'dus pa nas/ phung po lnga rgyal ba lnga/ 'byung ba bzhi yum bzhi'i rang bzhin du bzhugs pa nyid yin| gsang ba rgya mtsho las/ shes bya'i dkyil 'khor ma lus 'di dag thams cad ni// sku gsum yongs su grub pa gsang sngags theg pa ste// sku gsum nyid la 'jug pa lam gyi theg pa yin// sku gsum 'du 'bral med pa rdo rje'i theg pa'o// zhes dang*/ brtag gnyis las/ 'di dag dbang gis sems can rnams// sangs rgyas nyid du the tshom med// zla ba bcu yang sa rnams nyid// sems can sa bcu'i dbang phyug go// zhes dang*/ rnal 'byor ma kun spyod las/ 'gro ba 'di dag sangs rgyas lnga'i bdag nyid// ces dang*/ 'dus pa las/ mdor na phung po lnga rnams ni// sangs rgyas la ni rnam par grags// zhes so// des na gzhi la yod pa lam du byas pas 'bras bu mngon du byed pa gsang ba sngags kyi khyad chos yin gyi/ gdod nas med pa zhig btsal nas bsgoms pas 'bras bu logs shig thob pa min te/ bram ze chen pos/ theg pa chen po bla med snying po'i lam 'di ni// 'bras bu lam du 'khyer nas gdod nas 'bras bur gnas// gzhan don phun sum tshogs pa 'bras bu'i mchog yin te// sbyangs pa'i gtso bor gyur pa bsags pa las ni 'byung*// zhes gsungs so// gdod nas yongs grub yin pa la yin pa'i dran shes kyis bskyed rim mtshan nyid gsum ldan gyis gsal btab pa yin gyi/ gzhan du rang la med pa zhig bsgom par sems na rtsa ba'i ltung ba brgyad pa dang dgu pa nyams su myong bar yang 'gyur nyen che la/ gzhan yang ji skad du/ rgyu la 'bras bus rgyas gdab cing*// 'bras bu la yang rgyus rgyas gdab// sgom gyis gzhan du btub par ni// bskal pa bye bar 'byung mi 'gyur// zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs pas bskyed rim gdod nas yongs su grub pa nyid do// 'ga' zhig gis/ brgya la bskyed rim bsgom na yang*// sbyang gzhi sbyong byed legs 'phrod pa'i// cho ga'i yan lag kun spangs nas// rang bzo'i dkrong bskyed bsgom par zad// ces legs bshad du rlom mod/

dpyad nas bshad kyi/ spyir rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud rnams nas/ mngon byang lnga bskyed/ cho ga bzhi bskyed/ rdo rje gsum bskyed/ skad cig dkrong bskyed sogs bskyed tshul mi 'dra ba du ma gsungs pa rnams las/ gtso che ba bsdus na/ skye gnas bzhi sbyong ba la bskyed tshul bzhi bshad pa'i/ dang po mngal skyes sbyong ba la mngon byang lngas rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum bskyed pa rjes chags kyis 'od gsal du zhugs bzhu ba'i glus bskul bas 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin par bzhengs pa ste/ ji skad du/ mngal skyes glu yi sbyor ba yis/ bsgom pa rnams kyis yongs su brtag |ces so// sgong skyes sbyong ba ni mngon byang lngas rgyu 'bras kyi rdo rje 'dzin pa tha mi dad du bskyed pa ste/ ji skad du/ sgong skyes glu ni med pa ste// sgra dang sgra min spangs pa'o// zhes so// brdzus skyes sbyong ba ni nam mkha' la dar 'phyar ba'am/ chu las nya ldang ba lta bur skad cig gis bskyed pa ste/ ji skad du/ sems can brdzus te skye ba bzhin// sa bon med par rnam par bsgom// zhes so/ drod bsher las skyes pa sbyong byed ni bskyed tshul de gsum gang rung gi khongs su ma 'thus par dgongs la/ des na bskyed tshul phyi ma ni bshad ma thag pa'i lung de nyid dang*/ gzhan yang rgyud kyi rgyal po sgyu 'phrul dra ba las/ rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa// spro dang bsdu ba'i byed pa po// ye shes skad cig gis rdzogs pa// rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor zhes brjod do// zhes sogs rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud mang po'i lung gis grub pa dang*/ de'i man ngag rgyal ba kun gyi yab gcig dpal he ru ka'i ngo bo rdo rje rnal 'byor mas dngos su rjes su bzung ba'i slob dpon a bha yā ka ra gup+ta'i zhal snga nas kyi rnal 'byor rdzogs pa'i phreng bar/ lha thams cad skad cig gis bskyed pa la btags pa ba'i rdzogs rim mam zab mo bskyed pa'i rim pa zhes bsngags pa dang bcas te gsungs pa'i lugs 'di da lta gangs can gyi ljongs su nyi zla ltar grags pa 'di lta bu la yang ma sems par rang bzo zhes tshig rlon dang bcas te smras pa de 'dra ba ni rtsa ltung gnyis pa sbyor dngos rjes gsum nyams su myong bar ma byas sam/

drug pa/ rang byung rnams la 'jug pa'i cho ga gal che bar bzhed pa ni/ snga ma'i las 'phro sad pa'i ting nge 'dzin rang byung du byung ba rnams la ni skyabs 'gro nas brtsams so thar byang sems sngags lam gyi smin grol rnams rim gyis bstan te nyams su len du bcug na sngar gyi ting nge 'dzin de nyid ches gong du 'phel ba sogs 'byung la/ de lta bu la 'jug chog ma byas na ting 'dzin mi brtan pa'am/ glo bur du bar chad lam log gol sogs 'byung ba'ang srid la/ de 'dra ba 'ga' zhig bdud kyi las kyang yin srid pas de ltar yin na sngar gyi log sgom de yal nas ting nge 'dzin mtshan nyid pa rgyud la skye ba sogs gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi dgos pa ches mang ba sogs go sla bas rgyas par ma spros so// bdun pa/ lha thams cad mtshan dpe'i yon tan dang ldan par bzhed pa ni/ spyir sangs rgyas thams cad tshogs gnyis mthar phyin bral ba dang rnam smin gyi yon tan rdzogs pa'i phyir dang*/ khyad par sngags kyi lha rnams skyon spangs yon tan rdzogs pa'i ngo bo yin pas dang*/ bye brag tu rdo rje'i theg pa rten 'brel rmad byung gi bdag nyid yin pas mtshan dpe lta zhog /phyag mtshan dang gdan sogs kyang re res yon tan re re bskyed dgos pa'i phyir dang*/ gzhi'i dus nas sems can sangs rgyas kyi ngo bor bshad pas don gyi cha nas mtshan dpe rdzogs la/ lam dus su khams dkar dmar gyi rang bzhin zla nyi dbyangs gsal rnams mtshan dpe'i ngo bo yin par bsgom dgos pa'i phyir dang*/ 'bras dus su longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku mtshan dpes brgyan pa thob pa yin te/ rdo rje gur las/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ dpe byad brgyad cus brgyan pa'i sku de ni nga yin no// zhes dang*/ sdom pa'i rgyud las/ btsun mo'i bha ga bde chen du// ston pa sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan// mnga' bdag dpe byad brgyad cur ldan// zhes dang*/

brtag gnyis las/ btsun mo'i bha ga'i bde gnas su// ston pa sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan// gtso bo dpe byad brgyad cur ldan// zhes dang*/ dam pa dang po las/ rab mchog rgyal ba'i bdag po yi// mtshan ni sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*// dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu ste// 'di dag ma lus lus la ste// khyab bdag mchog gi go 'phang ni// sngags pa rnams kyis bsgom par bya// zhes so// des na gtso bo la lta ci smos/ 'khor rnams kyang mtshan dpe'i rnam pa can dang*/ 'khor mgo brnyan can rnams kyang mtshan dpe'i yon tan dang ldan par bsgom dgos te/ 'khor rnams kyang gtso bo'i ye shes kyi rol ba las byung gi rgyud tha dad pa ma yin te/ brtag gnyis las/ 'chad pa po nga chos kyang nga*| |rang gi tshogs ldan nyan pa nga*// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa nga*// 'jig rten ston pa bsgrub bya nga*// lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes nga*// zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ de dag gzhan gyi lugs la'ang yod mod ce na/ yod de cho ga bshad byang tsam byung yang*/ don go yul du ma byung bas sngags kyi lha rnams mtshan dpe ldan par bsgom mi dgos zer ba rnams la dgongs so// brgyad pa/ lha la sogs pa mdo rgyud nas gsungs pa gtso bor byed dgos par bzhed pa ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ma thob pa de srid du rang rgyud la las nyon gyi sgrib pa yod pa dang*/ 'du ba rnam bzhi'i khams kyis 'dus pa'i khyad par gyi mthong snang sna tshogs 'byung ba dang*/ mthong nyams tshad ma zhig yin yang chos zab mos kha ma bsgyur na lung ma bstan yin pas gar 'gro mi shes pa dang*/ rgyal ba'i bka' las 'gal ba rnams log shes yin pa'i phyir/ rgyu mtshan de bzhi po'i gnad kyis lha la sogs pa 'bri ba'am/ sgom pa'am gang byed kyang mdo rgyud nas bshad pa nyid gtso bor bzung gi /nyams myong dang*/ mthong rmis sogs gtso bor mi 'dzin la/ mthong rmis sogs rgyal ba'i bka' dang mthun na rung la/

mi mthun pa ni log shes yin par thag chod pa ste/ thams cad mkhyen pas lha thams cad kyi gshis babs rnam dag ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa dang*/ bsgrub pa'i thabs sems can rnams la phan phyir ji lta ba bzhin du bstan pa dang*/ bar gcod kyi chos kyis bar du gcod par gsungs pa de la/ bar gcod du mi 'gyur zhes sus kyang rgol du med pa dang*/ sgrub par dam bcas pa sgrub pa la gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bde legs mi 'byung bar khas blang du med pa ste rgyu mtshan de bzhis kyang mdo rgyud nas gsungs pa nyid gtso che ste/ mgon po byams pas/ ji ltar sgron glog nyi zla nor bu la// brten nas mig dang ldan pa blta ba bzhin// de bzhin don chen chos spobs 'od byed pa// thub la brten nas 'di ni rab tu bshad// ces dang*/ de nyid kyis/ gang zhig rgyal las ches mkhas 'ga' yang 'jig rten 'di na yod min te// ma lus de nyid mchog ni tshul bzhin kun mkhyen gyis mkhyen gzhan min pas// zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ lha la sogs pa thams cad mdo rgyud nas gsungs pa nyid gtso che bar 'dzin dgos pas so// des na rgyud sde'i lha zhig 'bri na'ang*/ rtsa ba'i rgyud dang*/ sdom 'byung nas bshad pa lta bu'i thig tshad rgyan cha sogs rnam dag dang mthun par 'bri ba'am 'bur du 'chos na'ang de 'dra ba nyid las gzhan pa'i thig tshad dang rnam dag sogs 'di 'dra bshad kyang*/ de bas 'di ltar mdzes so// 'thad do// zhes pa'i log shes dang rang bzo mi rung la/ bla ma'i sku zhig 'bri na'ang*/ bla ma sku 'bras legs na de 'dra 'bri/ mi legs na rang gi zhe 'dod kyi 'dra sku yin/ mos gus kyi dran pa slong byed yin zer ba'i 'dra 'bag skyug bro zhing mgo lus mi mtshungs pa mi bya bar ngo bo bla ma la rnam pa mtshar zhing dang ba 'dren pa mtshan dpe shugs la rdzogs pa gdan khri bkod pa sogs kyang mtshan nyid tshang zhing phun sum tshogs pa byed dgos kyi/
