deng sang 'ga' zhig gis/ bla ma'i 'dra 'bag dud 'gro'i mtshul pa lta bu dang*/ phyag zhabs bzhi'i mthil bstan pa khyi rgan ong tshugs byas pa lta bu la ming khyad 'phags btags pa dang*/ bla ma dge slong yin na chos gos rnam gsum sogs rang gzhung dang mi mthun par zhwa gos sogs mdog dbyibs dkar nag khra bo rnam pa sna tshogs pa dang*/ bla ma me rlung chu brag sprin shing sogs kyi dbus na dregs pa can gyi gzugs lta bu bris nas ming dang bshad pa ya mtshan can byed pa sogs ni rnam pa kun tu rgyal ba'i bka' dang 'gal ba'i log shes dbang yod spyi brtol rang bzo kho nar 'dug pas shes ldan rnams kyis yid brtan ci'i phyir rung*/ chu shing bzhin du snying pos dben par zad do// dgu pa/ dbang po rab la cho ga rgyas pa thams cad lhag par dgos zhes pa ni/ dbang po 'bring dang tha mas cho ga rgyas pa blo yul du chud dka' zhing*/ dbang po rab ni cho ga rgyas pa nyid gal che ste/ rab stong nyid rgyu 'bras su rtogs na cho ga'i rten 'brel sna res kyang yon tan re re bskyed pa'i phyir/ lhag par rgyas pa nyid gtso che la/ las dang po pa dbang po rab la yang rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor sogs cho ga yan lag dang bcas pa rgyas par byas pas/ de'i rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pas yon tan phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba sogs dgos pa ches mang la/ 'di ni gsung bzhi bcu pa'i drang nges thams cad la cho ga rgyas pa dgos tshul dang don mthun zhing go sla bas spros pa de tsam gyis chog go// bcu pa/ spros pa thams cad babs kyi rten 'brel gyis 'byung bya ba ni/ ji skad du/ phyi rol de bzhin nang de bzhin// zhes pas phyi 'jig rten kyi khams chags gnas 'jig gsum dang*/ nang rdo rje lus kyi chags gnas 'jig gsum rnams gshis babs kyi rten 'brel las 'byung gi bcos pa las ma yin la/

de bzhin du dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bskyed gnas sdud pa yang sbyang gzhi rdo rje'i lus kyi gshis babs de la sbyong byed bskyed rdzogs kyi rim pa gshis babs de 'dra bsgoms pa'i rten 'brel gyis 'bras bu zung 'jug yan lag bdun ldan thob pa yang gzhi de'i gshis babs mngon du byas pa yin la/ des na 'di ni sngar gyi gshis sam babs dang 'di nyid rang gi gdod nas yongs su grub pa sogs kyang 'di nyid kyis bshad pa ste/ slob dpon 'phags pas/ rten cing 'brel 'byung ma gtogs pa'i// chos 'ga' yod pa ma yin pas// de phyir stong nyid ma gtogs pa// chos 'ga' yod pa ma yin no// zhes dang*/ rdo rje phur pa'i rgyud nyi ma'i 'od zer las/ bsod nams ye shes stobs las skyes// gnas skabs rgyu 'bras ltos pa'i chos// rgyu mthun rgyu las 'das pa'i 'bras// thams cad chos kyi de bzhin nyid// rten cing 'brel 'byung gnas pa'i chos// rig pa'i ye shes gsal bar 'gyur| |gang zag chos kyi phyogs mthun pas// rgyu rkyen 'bras bu tshul mtha' yas// zhes gsungs pa'i rten dang brten pa'i tshogs thams cad spros pa che chung ci 'dra yang de dag gdul bya'i khams kyi gshis babs la dgongs nas rten cing 'brel 'byung du gsungs pa gshis babs kyi gnas lugs yin pas rang rang gi gzhung ltar bya dgos so// 'ga' zhig gis/ rgyas pa la bsdus pa/ bsdus pa la rgyas pa sogs/ rang gi zhe 'dod kyis bsre lhad byas pa la yid ches med cing 'bras bu mi 'byung ngo*/ /bcu gcig pa/ rdo rje lus kyi gnas lugs ni zab mo'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba ni/ rdo rje zhes bya ba mi shigs pa/ mi chod pa/ sra ba/ brtan pa/ gzhom gzhig dang bral ba ste/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ sra zhing snying po khong stong med// gzhig cing gzhom du med pas na// sreg par byar med 'jig pa med// stong pa nyid ni rdo rjer bshad// ces so// des na gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa pa rnams chos thams cad rdo rje'i sgra las drangs te/

rdo rje'i slob dpon/ rdo rje'i slob ma/ rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor/ rdo rje'i dbang bskur/ rdo rje'i dam tshig /rdo rje'i dmyal ba sogs rdo rje'i sgra sbyar ba ni/ bshad ma thag pa'i lung don ltar rdo rje ni zab mo stong pa nyid spros bral gyi ye shes chen po'i don yin la/ des na lus ngag yid gsum sku gsung thugs rdo rje las gang du yang mi 'gyur ba'i gnas lugs mngon du gyur pa dang*/ rdo rje zhes bya ba gnyis med zung 'jug chen po lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyang yin te/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon pos/ badz+ra zhes bya gnyis med snying po'i don// phyag na de yi rdo rje rab 'bar bas// nad dang gnod pa sdug bsngal rgya mtsho dang*// 'khor ba'i nyes tshogs spros pa'i mtshan ma kun// thams cad 'joms par byed pa rdo rje'i tshig /yang dang yang du nan tan bka' stsal gsungs// zhes so// des na rdo rje zhes pa zab mo gsang sngags kyi brda yin/ zab mo ni chos yin/ lus zhes bya ba zhe sa la sku yin pas/ rdo rje'i lus zhes bya ba chos sku yin/ 'khor lo zhes bya ba ni rtag pa rgyun gyi don yin pas chos kyi sku rtag pa zhi ba rmad byung yon tan mdzad pa dang bcas pa ste/ mgon po 'bri gung pa chen pos/ badz+ra badz+ra rdo rje ma go bas// phyogs gcig stong par rtogs pa'i blo mig gis// theg chen yangs pa'i gnad 'di ma mthong bas// rmongs pa'i byis pas ga chad ngu bar byed// ces so// 'di yang cung zad go bar sla'o// bcu gnyis pa/ gnas lugs 'ga' zhig rdo rje 'chang gis sbas par bzhed pa ni/ rnal 'byor pa nyams myong can gyis rtogs kyang*/ 'ga' zhig rang gar 'jug pa spong zhing*/ chos zab mo la lung dang man ngag brgyud pa slob dpon la ltos dgos pa'i ched du zab mo'i gnas lugs 'ga' zhig phyogs tsam bshad nas shas cher sbas pa mang ste/ rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud las/

chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dang*// bzhi stong gi ni grangs snyed kyi// mtshan gyi don rnams rgyud 'di ru// yang dag 'dus par ngas bshad de// gzhan du don 'di ma bsgrags pas// bla ma la ni gus pa yi// slob ma dag gis rtogs pa'i phyir// rgyud gzhan dag tu sbas pa'o// zhes so// sbas pa de ji ltar rtogs she na/ slob dpon slob ma gang yin yang nyams myong can gyis nyams su blang ba'i tshe don de rtogs par 'gyur te/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon pos e chung ri khrod du lam rim pa gnyis la gnad du bsnun pa'i tshe thog med nas bsags pa'i las ngan rnams stan de nyid du dag ste ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa'i shes bya'i chos ma lus pa thugs su chud de sbas don thams cad kyang mngon sum du gsal bar mdzad pa ni/ rje nyid kyis/ zhag gsum nyi ma dros bzhi na// mi kho bo'i las ngan rang sar dag /rgyu 'bras kyi rten 'brel tshan gcig go/ /zab mo gsang sngags kyi gter kha phye// gnyis med 'od gsal chen po la// mnyam rjes gnyis kyi 'dzin pa dag /nga rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug cig yin nam snyam| |zhes gsungs pa lta bu ste// sbas don thams cad ni rtog ge tha snyad mkhan rnams kyi spyod yul las 'das shing*/ rnal 'byor pa nyams myong can ye shes khong du chud pa rnams kyis nye bar rtogs bya longs spyod pa'i 'os su gyur pa nyid yin no// bcu gsum pa/ 'dug tshul dang*/ las 'ga' zhig sman zab par gsungs pa ni/ slob dpon dpa' bos mdzad pa'i sman yan lag brgyad par/ dang po lus chags pa'i dus nyon mongs pa dug gsum shas gang che ba la brten nas nad 'du ba rnam bzhi so sor 'byung ba/ de re re la'ang phye bas brgya rtsa rer 'gro/ de'i bye brag re re la'ang bcos thabs tha dad pa re res bcos dgos/ 'chos pa la'ang gzhi lus de'i rtsa rlung thig le gsum gyi gnas lugs ji lta ba rtogs par byas nas 'chos tshul gzigs pas shin tu zab par dgongs te/

ji skad du/ yan lag brgyad pa las/ 'dod chags la sogs ma lus pa yi nad// rgyun du 'brel bas lus zungs khyab par 'gyur// zhes sogs gsungs la/ sngon sgom chen lkog gyur mthong ba zhig gis mi zhig gi rgyab na ba la bltas pas/ der chu rgyus dang mnyam pa'i srog chags yod pa mthong ste sman pa zhig la bsnyad pas| sman pa des mi de'i rgyab kyi srog chags kyi lus kyi stod smad bar gsum du 'gro ba'i me btsa' re brgyabs pas nad las grol skad/ sman pa'i dpyad la 'chug pa med pa de 'dra ba 'byung la/ gzhan yang lus kyi rtsa che phra rnams dang*/ der rgyu ba'i rtsa ba dang yan lag gi rlung sogs dang*/ 'pho ba dang mi 'pho ba'i thig le la sogs pa rnams kyi gnas tshul nges par byas nas/ rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus pa tsha grang las gyur pa'i nad rnams blta reg gi dri bas ngos bzung*/ de'i steng du 'bab pa'i sman dpyad zas bcos bzhis gnad du bsnun pas 'tsho ba'i srog ster ba la bltas na/ las dang 'dug tshul 'ga' zhig ni sman dpyad kyi lugs zab par nges la/ de yang sngon gyi bde bar gshegs pa sman gyi bla dang*| drang srong mngon par shes pa mnga' ba rnams dang*/ slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub dang*/ slob dpon rta dbyangs sogs bde bar gshegs pa'i bka'i gnad rnams khong du legs par chud pa rnams kyis gzhan don du dgongs te legs par bkral zhing bshad pa'i lag len kha gsal la don 'dril ba 'di tsam ni rdo rje 'chang gis rgyud rnams su yang ma gsungs pas sman zab pa la dgongs so// bcu bzhi pa/ gzhan gyi zab pa mi zab la mi zab pa zab ces gsungs pa ni/ 'og ma'i rgyu ma bsgrubs na gong ma'i 'bras bu mi 'byung ba dang*/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po'i 'byor pa mtha' yas pa de yang thog mar rgyal rigs su skyes nas lus dang blo stobs rim gyis rdzogs pa la ltos pa lta bu dang*/ gzhan gyi mi zab pa skyabs 'gro dang so byang gi sdom pa sogs med na gzhan gyi zab pa rdo rje theg pa'i lam smin grol gnyis la rten med pa dang*/

sngags sdom skye ba la sdom pa 'og ma gnyis med mi rung yin pa dang*/ dbang la yang gzhan rnams dbang gong ma gsum zab pa 'dod kyang*/ 'dir bum dbang rtsa ba dang dbang gong ma de yi yan lag yin te/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon pos/ mchog dbang gong ma zab zer yang*| nga 'bu bum dbang la rtsi 'jog che// gzhi dang snod dang lus lta bu// gzhan rnams de yi khyad par chos// zhes so// gzhan yang brtag gnyis las/ dang por gso sbyong sbyin par bya// zhes pa nas/ de rjes kye yi rdo rje brtsam// zhes sogs gsungs la/ des na byis pa med par dar ma dang rgan po mi 'byung ba bzhin du/ gzhan gyi mi zab pa rnams zab pa gzhan gyi gzhi rten yin par dgongs shing 'og khang med na steng khang mi 'byung ba bzhin no// bco lnga pa/ mi zab pa'i gdams ngag med na zab mo rtsa rlung gis 'tshang mi rgya/ zhes pa ni/ bshad ma thag pa'i don las brtsams te mi zab pa'i gdams ngag pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa la sogs pa'am/ mdor na skyabs sems tsam yang med par rtsa rlung kho na la gnad du bsnun pas kyang mu stegs ci rigs dang thun mong gi rdzu 'phrul tsam 'ong srid/ sangs rgyas par mi srid de/ 'tshang rgya ba la bstan pa'i sgor 'jug dgos/ skyabs 'gro med na nang pa'i gral du mi tshud/ so thar sdom pa gang rung dang mi ldan na ston pa'i 'khor rnam bzhi'i grangs su mi 'gro/ sems bskyed rnam gnyis med na theg pa chen po'i lam gyi rtsa ba mi tshugs/ dbang don rgyud la ma skyes na rang rgyud smin pa'i go mi chod/ gdod nas yongs grub kyi bskyed rim dang mi ldan na tha mal gyi snang zhen mi bzlog cing gzhi lam 'bras gsum tha dad du 'dzin/ mtshan ma dang bcas pa'i rdzogs rim med na chad par gol/ mtshan med kyi rdzogs rim med na rtag par gol/ don des na chos ci 'dra zhig byed kyang sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang ba lam gyi 'gros ma log pa zhig gal che ste/

mgon po 'bri gung pa chen pos/ byang chub sems dang yi dam lha// bla ma phyag rgya chen po dang*// bsngo ba'i chos kyis nyams su blang*| |zhes dang po theg pa dman pa las grol zhing thabs chen po byang sems bsgom/ byang sems de las skyes pa'i yi dam gyi lha gdod nas grub pa gsal btab/ de yang rang sems bla mar ma rtogs na mos gus kyi rten phur mi tshugs pas bla ma bsgom/ de'i ngang las 'khor 'das dbyer med phyag rgya chen po la mnyam par 'jog /de lta'i dge ba thams cad khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas nas byang chub tu bsngo ba gnad zab kyi de 'dra ba'i lam rnams med par bzhag nas/ rtsa rlung 'byongs so zhes pham pa dang po bag yangs su spyod cing 'jig rten thams cad ku cos 'gengs pa'i rtogs ldan sgab nag rus pa'i rgyan can rgyu 'bras khyad du gsod pa rnams 'tshang rgya ba ni mo sham gyi bu dang nam mkha'i pad+ma dang mtshungs te| 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon pos/ chags pa spyod pa'i sbyor thabs sum brgya drug cu dang*// rtsa rlung thig le'i gnad rnams zab pa ma yin te// de dag 'od gsal dbyings su dag na thub pa'i chos// rgyal bas gsang sngags zab pa'i gnad du gsungs pa yin// gzhan du mu stegs 'khor ba'i sgrub thabs su// nan tan chen pos bka' stsal yang yang gsungs// zhes so| |bcu drug pa/ bka' dang 'gal ba'i myong rtogs ni log rtog yin bya ba ni/ 'ga' zhig gis lam nyams su blang ba'i tshe rang gi khams 'dus pa'i bye brag gis nyams snang rnam pa sna tshogs pa 'byung ba dang*/ 'ga' zhig la bdud kyis bar du bcad pa'i lung bstan dang dngos nyams rmi lam byung ba la sogs pa rgyal ba'i bka' na mi bzhugs pa'am| bka' dang 'gal ba dag la 'di 'dra ba bka' na mi bzhugs/ dgongs 'grel mkhan pos ma bkral/ sngon gyi grub thob rnams kyi thugs nyams su ma 'khrungs kyang 'di 'dra ba nga rang gi dngos nyams rmi lam du byung ngo zhes rang blo 'khrul ba la tshad mar bzung nas rjes 'jug rnams lam de 'drar 'khrid pa dang*/

gzhan yang mu stegs byed mngon shes can gyis brtags pas 'das pa'i skye ba lnga brgya dran pa dang*/ de phan ma dran pas skye ba'i thog ma des byas so zhes sngon mtha' dag pa'i lta ba dang*/ ma 'ongs pa'i skye ba lnga brgya dran/ de phan ma dran pas des skye ba'i tha mar byas pa phyi mtha' dag pa'i lta ba dang*/ mu stegs kyi lta log dang grub mtha' nyams myong phal cher ni/ sngon nang pa'i sgom nyes byung ba rnams yin te/ de ltar sgom chen pa'i nyams myong go log tu song ba rnams ni bdud kyi las su/ yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi bdud kyi le'u dang*/ gtsug tor bam po dgu pa dang*/ ye shes rgyas pa'i mdo sde rin po che'i mtha' phyin par gsungs pa'i phyir dang*/ gzhan yang rgyal ba'i bka' dang*/ dgongs 'grel mkhan po'i bstan bcos kyi don rnams rang gi zhe 'dod dang ma 'grig pas 'di rnams drang don ldem dgongs yin pas bsgyur dgos zhes log par 'chad pa yang bdud kyi las te/ mgon po byams pas/ gang zhig rgyal las ches mkhas 'ga' yang 'jig rten 'di na yod min te| |ma lus de nyid mchog ni tshul bzhin kun mkhyen gyis mkhyen gzhan min pas// de phyir drang srong rang nyid kyis bzhag mdo sde gang yin de mi dkrug /thub tshul bshig phyir de yang dam chos la ni gnod pa byed par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir go bar bya dgos so// bcu bdun pa/ bka'i dgongs pa thams cad dang 'gal med du 'gro dgos zhes pa ni thog ma nyid nas rgyal ba'i bka' tshad ma zhig gi lam la zhugs na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni drang por gsungs pa bden par gsungs pa gsang bar gsungs pa yin pas/ gang zag gcig gi rgyud kyi nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong gi gnyen por chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pas de rnams nang 'gal bar mi srid la/ des na lam gyi gnad tshang la ma nor ba zhig nyams su len pa ni sdom pa gsum gnad gcig pa'i sgo nas chos lnga ldan gyis nyams su len pa 'di yin/

'di ni rgyal ba'i dgongs pa thams cad phyogs gcig tu rtogs pa yin te/ rgyu mtshan chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba nges don phyag rgya chen po las bsgom rgyu gzhan med de/ zla ba sgron ma las/ 'jig rten khams ni stong dag tu// ngas ni mdo sde gang bshad pa| |tshig 'bru tha dad don gcig ste// tshig gcig rnam par bsgoms pas na// de dag thams cad bsgom par 'gyur// zhes dang*/ jo bo chen pos/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dang*| |bzhi stong gsungs pa gang yin pa// chos nyid 'di la gzhol zhing 'bab// ces sogs gsungs so// gzhan yang chos kyi 'khor lo re re la gsum ga tshang ba dang*/ phyag rgya chen po dang tshul khrims gnad gcig pa dang*/ sngags la tshul khrims med ka med du dgos pa sogs kyi gnad kyis kyang don 'di kho nar grub bo// bco brgyad pa/ gdams ngag ltar mi 'ong bka' ltar 'ong zhes pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad la dbang bsgyur bas shes bya thams cad la sgrib pa med pa'i phyir/ mkhyen pa'i ye shes des dbang byas pa'i chos de la slob dpon gzhan gyi dpe mkhyud dang zer zlos la ltos mi dgos par 'gro ba thams cad kyi khams dang bsam pa dang dbang po dang bag la nyal ba mkhyen pas gang la gang 'dul gyi gegs sel dang bogs 'don lam gyi gnad thams cad ma bsgribs par gsungs pas na bka' kho na ltar 'ong gi /bshad ma thag pa ltar so skye'i go yul dang nyams myong gdams ngag phyogs re ba ltar mi 'ong ba yin te/ phyogs gcig la mtshon na/ dkon brtsegs 'od zer bkye ba'i 'dus pa las/ ngas ni bsam gyis mi khyab par// dge ba'i las kyi rgyu rkyen gyis// rmongs pa rnams kyi rab spangs pas// 'od zer sna tshogs grub pa yin// zhes sogs mtshan re re 'grub byed la rgyu phun sum tshogs pa re re gsungs pas na de 'dra ba thams cad mkhyen pa'i spyod yul las gzhan su la'ang med pa'i phyir/

mgon po byams pa'i gsung sngar bshad ma thag pa des kyang nges par gsal bar byas so// bcu dgu pa/ skyon med kyi ting 'dzin gsum khams gsum 'khor ba'i rgyu zhes gsungs pa ni/ rnal 'byor pa 'ga' zhig ting nge 'dzin bsgoms pas bde gsal mi rtog pa gsum gyi nyams skye na yang*/ bde nyams chags par ma song bas 'dod khams/ gsal nyams 'dzin par ma song bas gzugs khams/ mi rtog pa'i nyams blos byas su ma song bas gzugs med grub/ de lta min yang de gsum kho na yun bsrings nas bsgoms kyang khams gsum du skye ba las 'os med/ yang de gsum la 'dzin pa zhugs na 'dod lha sogs su gol/ rgyu mtshan phyag rgya chen po spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba/ ma bcos bzo med rang babs su skyong ba la/ de gsum blos byas su song ba'i phyir ro// yang las dang po pa la de gsum skye ba shas cher mang yang de'i yun bskyangs pas rtogs pa gsha' ma mi skye/ nyams de gsum dag nas gzod rtogs pa gsha' ma skye ba yin te/ dper na me 'bud pa'i tshe sngon du du ba 'byung ba chos nyid yin yang*/ du ba byung tshe me 'bar ro zhes bzhag na me 'chi ba las 'os med/ du ba la ma ltos pa bud pas gzod me 'bar ba yin te/ ji skad du/ nyams na bun dang 'dra bas yal nas 'gro// zhes gsungs la/ mgon po phag mo gru pas kyang*/ bde gsal la chags pa spangs byas te// sems sangs rgyas su rtogs pa bsgom par bya// zhes so/ bla ma 'dis nyams de gsum zhen med du bskyangs na nyan rang thob srid ces gsungs pa ni myang stod rgad po'i blo brid yin gyi don min no// nyams de gsum gyi don rang gi mtshan nyid nyan rang yang mi thob na sangs rgyas lta ci smos| nyams de gsum dag nas rtogs pa skye yi/ de las skye ba min te/ nyams kyis rtogs pa thob pa dang*/ rtogs pa nyams phyir shor ba'i khyad ches che bas shes dgos so// 'ga' zhig gis/

blun pos phyag rgya che bsgoms pas// zhes pa nas/ bskal pa grangs med dgos par gsungs// zhes pa'i bar yang mi 'thad de/ blun pos phyag chen bsgoms pas dud 'gro sogs gsum thob la/ shes ldan gyis bsgom na de las gzhan thob pa'i lung rnam dag khyod la gang na yod/ blun po ba lang rdzi la chos bstan nas grol ba sngon gyi gtam rgyud na gsal la| 'dir dud 'gro sogs gsum thob pa de gang zag de'i skyon yin na chos mdo sngags gang yin yang 'dra/ lam 'bras kyis kyang 'bras bu de las mi 'byung*/ chos kyi skyon yin na blun po zer ci dgos/ shes ldan gyis bsgoms kyang lam log tu 'gro ba las 'os med/ thub pas gti mug gi 'bras bus dud 'gro dang*/ skyon can gyi bsam gtan gyis 'gog pa dang*/ stong lta had pos gzugs med du gol ba rgyu 'bras kyi spyi lugs yin mod/ spros bral zung 'jug gi ye shes bsgoms pas dud 'gro sogs thob na rgyal ba'i gsung rab la bskur ba ma btab bam/ phyag rgya ba rnams stong nyid rtogs par tshogs gnyis rdzogs mi dgos pa'i bzhed pa gang du 'dug /nged kyi phyag rgya chen po dbang las byung*/ rim gnyis las byung zer zhing*/ rang byung ye shes yin zer ba dngos 'gal/ rang sems phyag rgya chen po rang byung gi ye shes yin/ gzhan byung min/ dbang dang rim gnyis kyang de nyid rtogs pa'i thabs yin/ bsgoms pas rtogs kyi/ kha bshad kyis mi rtogs/ dbang don rgyud la ma skyes pa'i khyod kyi dbang las byung ba'i ye shes de ya mtshan/ rdzogs byang 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pa rim gnyis kyis dus 'da' bar dgos pa rdo rje theg pa'i gzhung thams cad nas ches nan tan du gsung mod/ khyod rjes 'brang dang bcas pas rim gnyis kyi nyams len la bza' btung byed pa'i dus tshod ltar dus su bcad nas khral chos kha gsag re byas rjes rnam pa kun tu sgo gsum tha mal du 'jog pa'i gsang sngags pa 'di 'dra ya mtshan che'o// yang khong dag

|da lta'i phyag rgya chen po dang*// zhes pa nas/ phal cher rgya nag chos lugs yin// zhes zer mod/ 'di yang dpyad de/ rtogs pa skye ba myur bul gyis cig car ba dang rim gyis pa zhes tha snyad mdzad mod/ don la mda' 'phangs pas gos rim pa mang po phyogs gcig tu phug ces zer yang*/ rim gyis bgrod dgos kyi de dag phyogs gcig tu phug pa mi srid pa ltar/ rtogs pa skad cig la skyes zhes zer yang myur ba tsam la dgongs pas/ don du cig car ba mi srid pas so// khyod 'dod pa rgya nag lugs kyi rdzogs chen chos log tu smra na yang*/ de la skyabs sems yi dam phyag chen bsngo ba sogs theg pa chen po'i lam srol rmad du byung ba zhig 'dug na chos min par khas len nam/ de rnams las log pa zhig la chos rnam dag tu khas len/ khyod rang gis kyang sangs rgyas bstan pa 'khrul bar spyod pa la mi dad/ rnam dag la dad par khas ma blangs sam/ lam de lnga las gzhan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa zhes gang la ngos 'dzin/ mkhan po zhi ba 'tshos rgyal po la ma 'ongs pa'i dus log chos 'byung bar lung bstan pa phyag rgya chen po la ngos bzung ba 'di phyag rgya chen po zhes 'phags pa'i yul du do ha skor gsum dang yid la mi byed pa'i chos skor sogs nyi zla ltar grags pa rnams mkhan po zhi ba 'tshos rgyal po la lung bstan pa ltar smra ba 'di snying phod ma ches sam/ yang khong dag /nā ro dang ni mai tri yi// phyag rgya chen po gang yin pa// zhes pa nas/ gsungs pa de nyid khong bzhed do// zhes nā ro dang mai tri'i phyag chen gang yin zhes bzhed pa ni/ las/ chos/ dam tshig /phyag chen bzhi po yin/ zhes smras mod/ de yo ga la grags kyi/ bla med la/ gtum mo rtag pa'i phyag rgya/ dman pa las kyi phyag rgya/ ye shes kyi phyag rgya/ phyag rgya chen po zhes grags kyi/ snga ma bzhi po ma grags mod/ yo ga dang bla med kyi sa mtshams mi phyed pa'i gzhan lugs sun 'byin 'dod pa sha thang ngo*// slob dpon klu sgrub kyi phyag rgya bzhi pa'i lung drangs nas smin grol rim can du dgos par 'dod pa de ni 'dir yang 'dod do// khong dag gis snga ma rgya nag lugs kyi yas 'bab dang mas 'dzeg gnyis ming bsgyur nas phyag rgya bas cig car ba dang rim gyis pa yin/

mkhan po zhi ba 'tshos lung bstan pa ltar log chos yin zhes khas blangs/ de ma thag tu cig car ba'i lam ka ma la shī las sun phyung nas rim gyis pa dar bar mdzad/ slar rgyal khrims nub nas rgya nag gi gzhung lugs la brten nas cig car ba'i lam la dkar po chig thub ces btags nas dar ro zhes zer ba yang*/ khong rang gi snga ma cig car rim gyis gnyis ka bkag de ma thag rim gyis sa lam rnam dag tu khas blangs pas 'gal lo// yang khong dag /deng sang 'ga' zhig bla ma yi| |mos gus tsam gyis sems bsgyur nas// rtog pa cung zad 'gag pa la// phyag rgya chen po'i ngo sprod byed// de 'dra bdud kyi yin pa'ang srid// yang na khams 'dus 'ga' la'ang 'byung*| |zhes pa'ang klan ka ste/ rtog pa 'gags pa la phyag rgya chen por ngo sprad na shi ba dang brgyal ba la bya yi/ phyag rgya chen po ni/ slob dpon tog tse pas/ dub pas sems nyid kyi 'gron po dag /spros dang bral bar ngal sos shig /so ma gnyug ma rang babs 'di// blo 'das phyag rgya chen po yin// zhes gsungs pa ltar ngo sprod byed kyi/ rtog pa 'gag pa la phyag rgya chen por 'dod pa phyag rgya pa'i lugs la med do// nyi shu pa/ sku gsum re re la'ang gsum ga'i bdag nyid ces pa la/ spyir btang du chos sku la/ stong pa'i cha nas chos sku/ gsal ba'i cha nas sprul sku/ zung du 'jug pa longs sku/ longs sku la thugs spros bral chos sku/ nges pa lnga dang ldan pa longs sku/ 'gag med du snang ba sprul sku/ sprul sku la thugs spros bral zhi ba chos sku/ gsal snang ma 'gag pa longs sku/ sku de nyid sprul sku zhes bya zhing*/ bye brag tu/ sgrub pa po'i lus la rten dang brten pa gdod nas grub pa phyi nang gzhan gsum dbyer med kyi gnad kyis nyams su blangs pa'i 'bras bu dag pa'i ngo bor gcig pa yin te/ ji skad du/ lus kyi 'khor lo nyams dga' ba// ji skad gsungs pa'i sgo bzhir ldan// rang gi yan lag las byung ba'i// ka ba brgyad kyis brten pa yin// dngos po kun tu mnyam pas na// gru bzhi bar ni rab tu grags// sku gsung thugs kyi tshul gyis ni// de nyid 'khor lo gsum du brjod// bla ma brgyud pa'i rim gyis ni// rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor nyid du gsal// zhes gsungs pa lus dkyil la dgongs shing*/

lus dkyil gyi gtso bo yang sku gsum ga'i bdag nyid yin pa sngar longs sku'i skabs ltar dang*/ 'khor la'ang des 'gre ba'am/ yang na gtso bo'i thugs zab gsal gnyis med kyi ye shes de chos sku/ de las 'khor lo 'i dbang phyug tu bzhengs pa longs sku/ gtso bo'i rnam rol las 'khor rnams snang ba sprul sku yin la/ phyi dkyil la gzhal yas khang sprul sku'i yon tan/ brten pa lha gtso 'khor rnams longs sku/ des dag pa byang phyogs so bdun sogs chos sku yin par grub chen lū hi pa sogs bzhed/ de bzhin du rdzogs rim la yang skye 'chi bar do gsum la sku gsum lam 'khyer du bzhed pa dang*/ lha gtso 'khor dang zhal phyag mang yang rung nyung yang rung gang zag gcig gi rgyud kyi dug gsum sbyong byed la dgongs pas/ sku mdog mthing nag sogs gti mug gi gnyen po/ yab yum zhal sbyor 'dod chags/ mtshon cha bsnams pa zhe sdang gi gnyen po'am/ de dag dag pa'i rang bzhin la 'chad dgos pas/ skabs 'dir| dkyil 'khor dbus 'gyur mtha' mi 'gyur gyi bshad pa gal mi che/ der ma zad gang zag gi rgyud la yang rnam shes dang ye shes kyi cha gnyis las/ stong pa chos sku/ gsal ba sprul sku/ zung du 'jug pa longs sku'am/ sems skye 'gag dang bral ba chos sku/ sna tshogs su 'char ba longs sku/ 'gag med tu snang ba sprul sku/ zhes pa don gyis thob pas go bar gal che'o// nyer gcig pa/ gsang sngags la tshul khrims med ka med du bzhed pa ni/ sdom pa rten can gyi dbang gis so byang sngags sdom rnams rim nod dgos pa dang*/ khyad par du sngags lam sbyin pa'i tshe na sdom pa gnyis dang ldan rung la yang skyabs sems kyi sdom pa bsdus pa 'bogs dgos pa dang*/ brtag gnyis las/ dang por gso sbyong sbyin par bya// zhes pa nas/ de rjes kye yi rdo rje brtsam// zhes pa'i bar dang*/ dus 'khor dang rdo rje snying 'grel sogs su/

rdo rje 'dzin pa rab 'bring tha ma/ dge slong dge tshul khyim pa gsum gyi zlas phye ba dang*/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ so sor thar dang byang chub sems// rig 'dzin sngags kyi sdom pa'o// zhes dang*/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ tshul khrims 'chal pas sngags mi 'grub// ces sogs gsungs la/ bsrung rgyu yang*/ dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa dang khyim pa rdo rje 'dzin pa gnyis rtags dang cho ga'i khyad tsam ma gtogs bslab par bya ba la khyad med de/ dpung bzang gis zhus pa las/ rgyal ba ngas gsungs so sor thar pa yi// tshul khrims rnam dag 'dul ba'i bslab pa la// sngags pa khyim pas rtags dang cho ga spang*| |lhag ma rnams ni nyams su blang bar bya// zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir ro// nyer gnyis pa/ 'dod pas bar du gcod gsungs pa'i steng du gcig bya ba ni/ rdo rje'i gsung gong ma'i don mi go na yang*/ 'dir yang ye bkag ye gnang gi dgongs pas/ 'dod pa bsod snyoms kyi mtha' spong ba'i phyir gyi na tsam las ma gnang la/ lhag par rnyed na zhen med du longs spyad pas chog par dgongs nas gang yang gnang ba la chog shes dgos par gsungs pa dang*/ lhag par du sngags su 'dod yon rnams zhen med du rim pa gnyis kyi ngang nas spyod pa ni| gzugs sogs phyi'i skye mched rnams lha mo'i rang bzhin du gsungs la/ de dag kyang lha mchod pa sogs dgos pa gal che na zhen med du spyad kyi/ 'dod pa la 'chums pas spyad bya min te/ rdo rje snying po rgyan gyis zhus pa/ bcom ldan 'das ma dag pa ni gang lags/ bka' stsal pa/ gzugs la sogs pa lnga'o// ci'i phyir zhus pa/ gzung ba 'dzin pa dngos po'i phyir ro// zhes dang*/ yum rgyas pa las/ 'dod pas ni tshangs pa'i 'jig rten du skye ba la'ang bar du gcod na mya ngan las 'das pa la lta smos kyang ci dgos/ zhes gsungs so// dgos pa gal po che gzhan don la 'gyur nges pa la ni theg pa gsum ga nas ma bkag ste/

dang po 'dul ba kā ri kā las/ dge slong gang zhig gser dngul len byed pa// nyes byas 'gyur ro gos dang brgyags phyir dang*// chos ldan phyir ni rtag tu blang bar bya// zhes so// byang sems kyi skabs su ni/ 'phags pa sdud pa las/ gzhan yang gzugs dang sgra dang de bzhin dri dang ro// reg dang 'dod yon lnga la mngon par spyod gyur kyang*// dgra bcom rang rgyal sems bral byang chub sems dga' na// dpa' bo rtag tu mnyam bzhag yin par shes par bya// zhes dang*/ de nyid las/ gal te byang chub sems dpa' 'dod yon lnga spyod kyang*// sangs rgyas chos dang 'phags pa'i dge 'dun skyabs song ste| |sangs rgyas 'grub bya snyam du kun mkhyen yid byed na// mkhas pa tshul khrims pha rol phyin gnas rig par bya// zhes dang*/ spyod 'jug las/ de ltar rig byas gzhan don la| |rtag tu brtson par gnas par bya// thugs rje mnga' ba ring gzigs pas// bkag pa rnams kyang de la gnang*// zhes so/ sngags kyi skabs lha mchod pa'i rjes gnang sogs la/ deng nas brtsams te bu khyod kyis/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg la sogs// 'dod yon lnga la spyod par gyis// zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ mdor na chos ldan gyi bya ba'i bar chad du 'gro na ni sdom pa gsum gar 'dod yon rnams ye nas bkag la/ chos ldan gyi bya ba'i grogs su 'gro na ni 'dod yon rnams ye nas gnang ba ste rgyal po in+d+ra bhū ti lta bu sogs so// de yang yul dang gnyen po gnyis med du rtogs pa la ni spros med kyi spyod pa zhes gang yang gnang bkag gi skabs med pa ni grub pa'i mtha' mchog tu bzang ba yin la/ gong du bshad pa ni de ltar ma rtogs pa'i dbang du byas so// nyer gsum pa/ sngags kyis mi dge ba dge bar 'gyur pa'i gnas med bya ba ni/ bzhed pa snga ma'i yan lag nyid de/ gsang sngags 'bras bu lam byed gzhi sbyong ba'i lam pa ste/

rang nyid gdod nas lhar grub pa glo bur gyi dri ma gos pa sbyangs nas sangs rgyas su byed mod/ gzhi la med pa 'tshol ba'am bsgyur ba ni min te/ des na gzhi sbyong ba'i chos nyid ma gtogs sgyur ba min pa ni phar phyin theg par yang mtshungs pa bcom ldan 'das kyis stong gsum dar yug gi dpe mdzad nas thabs mkhas kyis sgrib pa sbyong tshul gsungs pa ltar yin la/ sngags kyi mi dge ba rtsa ba'i ltung ba rnams gzhan don dge bar 'gyur ba'i phyir spyad pa'i skabs nam yang med pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa dug lnga gnas bsgyur ye shes lnga zhes pa yang snam bu dkar po tshos kyis bsgyur ba ltar min gyi/ rtogs pa dang ma rtogs pa la brjod bya de ltar byas pa yin te/ ji skad du/ 'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das// gnyis su yod pa ma yin te// 'khor ba'i rang bzhin shes pa la// mya ngan 'das zhes brjod pa yin// zhes gsungs so// nyer bzhi pa/ 'dul bar dge ba de sngags su yang dge la mi dge ba de mi dge bar gsungs pa ni/ 'dul bar mi dge ba'i pham pa bzhi ni sngags su dge bar gsungs pa med la/ rtsa ba'i dam tshig bzhi po dgongs pa can gyi brjod bya sbas nas gsungs pa ni/ bshad rgyud dgongs pa lung ston las/ ma byin pa la byang chub sems// kun rdzob ston pa rdzun smra ba// phung po srog chags gyur pa ste// tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bud med yin// dgongs pa yis ni bshad pa la// byis pa rnams ni yi ger rtog /rdo rje theg par gnas 'dod kyang*// chos nyid de yis mi shes so// zhes gsungs pa de rnams ni 'dul bar yang ma bkag la/ 'dul bar chang bkag pa nyid sngags su yang tha mal chang 'thung bkag pa ni/ bde mchog 'byung ba'i rgyud las/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes bya sngags kyis| |rtag tu byin gyis brlab par bya// zhes pa nas/ cho ga yang dag ldan pas spyad// ces pa'i bar gyis bdud rtsir bsgyur nus na 'thung gi mi nus na dngos grub nyams shing bgegs 'byung ba sogs kyi nyes pa dpag tu med pa gsungs pa lta bu dang*/

brtag gnyis las/ dag pas dug med byas nas ni// zhes myos pa'i nus pa dang 'bral nus na btung byar gsungs pa dang*| gzhan yang 'grel pa dri med 'od las/ las dang po pas rnal 'byor pa'i spyod pa mi bya/ rnal 'byor pas grub pa thob pa'i spyod pa mi bya/ grub pa thob pas thams cad mkhyen pa'i spyod pa mi bya/ zhes gsungs so// brtan pa thob pa'i gang zag snang ba dbang bsgyur zhing 'gro ba 'dul ba'i thabs tshul du ma ston pa ni 'dul bar yang ma bkag ste/ ma ga dha bzang mo'i rtogs brjod nas gsungs pa lta bu dang*/ gzhan yang*/ grub pa thob na slob dpon in+d+ra bhū ti dang*/ rdo rje dril bu pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dga' byed lta bu yang yin la/ gang zag gi rigs kyi 'dod yon gyis mi gnod pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis nga'i nyan thos rnams kyis mi sdug pa bsgoms pa la brten nas rnam par grol ba thob pa la/ dge slong seng ge ni sdug pas rnam par grol ba thob bo zhes sogs mtha' yas par gsungs so// nyer lnga pa/ nyon mongs dag pa'i 'bras bu bde bar gshegs pa zhes gsungs pa ni/ dug gsum dang dug lnga'i bral 'bras sku gsum dang lngar bzhed kyi/ nyon mongs nyid sku dang ye shes su mi bzhed pa ste/ gnad mi shes pa'i nyon mongs pa ni 'khor ba'i rgyu yin la/ gnad dang ldan pa nyon mongs pa nyid nyon mongs pa'i gnyen po ste/ 'od srung gis zhus pa'i mdo las/ ji ltar grong khyer dbus kyi mi gtsang lud// de ni bu ram shing pa'i zhing la phan// de bzhin byang chub sems dpa'i nyon mongs lud// rgyal dang rgyal ba'i chos la phan par byed// ces so// nyon mongs de spangs pa min mod/ de nyid sbyang gzhi la rig dbang lnga sogs kyis sbyangs pas sbyangs 'bras sku lnga 'grub pa ste/ dpal kun tu kha sbyor gyi rgyud las/ gti mug rnam dag bsgoms pa yis// rnam par snang mdzad nyid du 'gyur// zhe sdang rnam dag bsgoms pa yis// mi bskyod pa ni nyid du 'gyur// 'dod chags rnam dag bsgoms pa yis// snang ba mtha' yas nyid du 'gyur// phrag dog rnam dag bsgoms pa yis| |dpa' po don yod grub par 'gyur// nga rgyal rnam par dag pa yis// rin chen 'byung ldan nyid du 'gyur// zhes dang*/

mgon po 'bri gung pa chen pos/ dgra gnyen du chad pa'i dpa' po dang*// gnyen stong par rtogs pa'i mkha' 'gro gnyis// sems 'gyur ba med pa'i rnal 'byor la// dus rgyun chad med par sgor ro ro// zhes sogs gsungs so// nyer drug pa/ sngags kyi mthu bstan pa las mngon spyod gnang ba med par bzhed pa ni/ spyir btang du sman rdzas sngags ting 'dzin rigs sngags sogs kyis srog 'phrog pa ni bkag pa ste/ kā ri kā las/ sman dang sngags dang rig pa dang*// 'chi ba'i phyogs su gang btang ba// de btang sdom pa zhig par 'gyur// zhes dang*/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ snying rje mchog ldan sangs rgyas dang*// byang chub sems dpa' rdzu 'phrul che// sngags rnams mthu bstan don du ni// las rnams thams cad bstan pa yin// zhes sogs gsungs pa dang*/ /dpal nā ro pa'i gtam rgyud du/ mngon spyod brtsams pa mkha' 'gro mas bshol ba dang*/ yi dam gyi lha bsgom pa la brtan pa thob pas mngon spyod byas pa dmyal bar skyes pa'am/ yi dwags rdo rje 'jigs byed lta bu dang*/ gshin rje'i gshed la brtan pa thob pa'i rnam 'byor pa bram ze tsa na kya zhes pas rgyal po'i dgra la mngon spyod byas pas dmyal bar skyes pa lta bu yin pas drag po mngon spyod kyi phrin las de shin tu sdig che ba yin pas bdag cag rnams las ci la thug kyang 'di mi bya/ khyed mthu che zer na dga' la/ khyed la sdom pa med zer na mi dga' ba'i las 'di spong dgos pa yin gsungs/ dmigs bsal ni drag po mngon spyod byed pa'i yul/ spyir zhing bcu tshang zhing bstan pa 'jig pa/ bye brag rdo rje theg pa la 'khu zhing rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku dgra byed pa/ de nyid bsgral na phyis bde bar 'gro nges pa zhig bya dgos la/ bsgral mkhan ni bsad pa gso nus pa/ bskyed pa dang rdzogs pa'i lam la goms pa mthar phyin pa/ yul de bsgral nas rnam par shes pa byang chub kyi lam la spar nus pa zhig gi spyod yul yin te/

phur pa rtsa ba'i dum bu las/ snying rjes bsgral ba'i dam tshig ni| |bsad cing mnan pa ma yin te// phung po rdo rjer bltams byas nas// rnam par shes pa rdo rjer bsgom// zhes dang*/ gshin rje me ru rtse'i rgyud las/ rang rig gsal ba'i thugs rje yis| |nyon mongs bsgral ba ma gtogs pa// zhe sdang gdug pa'i sems kyis sgrol// mnar med dmyal bar skye ba len// zhes dang*/ spyod pa'i rgyud las/ bla ma smod brtson ma rungs dang*| |dkon mchog gsum la gnod byed la// bzod pa bsgom par mi bya'o// zhes so// bslab pa kun las btus par thabs la mkhas par mdo'i lung drangs par/ gal te rab tu byung ba'i byang chub sems dpa' ltung ba'i rtsa ba bzhi po thams cad zhig par gyur kyang thabs la mkhas pa 'dis sel bar byed pa lta na byang chub sems dpa' la ltung bar mi 'gyur bar nga smra'o| |zhes dang*/ dkon mchog sprin las/ mtshams med byed par 'dod pa'i mi bsad pa gnang bar bya'o// zhes dang*/ 'phags pa sdud pa las/ dper na sgyu ma mkhan gyis bzhi mdor sprul byas te// skye bo phal cher mgo mang bye ba gcod byed pa// bsad bya de dag ci 'dra de ltar byang chub sems// 'gro kun sprul 'drar rab shes de la nyes pa med// ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ yul yul can de 'dra bas mngon spyod ma byas na rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu pa 'byung bar nges so// nyer bdun pa/ rdo rje'i dmyal ba ni mnar med pa yin bya ba ste/ 'di ni mnar med ces nyams su myong bya'i sdug bsngal de las che ba gzhan gang du'ang med pas mnar med ces grags la/ rdo rje'i sgra sbyor ba ni sngar bshad pa ltar gsang sngags pa rnams chos thams cad la rdo rje'i sgra sbyor ba thabs shes mnyam rol gyi don yin la/ der skye ba'i rgyu ni/ bla ma lnga bcu pa las/ mnar med la sogs 'jigs rung ba'i| |dmyal bar bstan pa gang yin pa// slob dpon la ni smod pa rnams// der ni nges par gnas par bstan// zhes dang*/

rdo rje gur las/ de tshe dbang bskur mchog thob pa'i| |slob mas bla ma'i bka' 'das na// 'jig rten 'dir yang sdug bsngal zhing*// 'jig rten pha rol mnar med gnas// zhes dang*/ rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud las/ mdo sogs bstan pa'i dmyal ba ru// slob dpon smod par byed pa de// gnas par 'gyur ba nga yis bstan// zhes sogs gsungs la/ gsang sngags su ngu 'bod la rdo rje'i dmyal ba mnar med du bzhag pa yang yod de/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i 'grel pa dri med 'od las/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su ngu 'bod dang*/ de'i steng du mun pa chen po dang*/ de bzhin du me dkyil la me'i dmyal ba dang du ba mi bzad pa/ chu dkyil la 'dam gyi chu dang bye ma'i chu/ sa dkyil gyi phyed 'og ma la gseg ma'i dmyal ba ste/ gnas bdun la tsha grang gi dmyal ba 'khor bcas 'du bar yang gsungs so// nyer brgyad pa/ rdo rje slob dpon rgyud tshod mtho na de nyid kyis 'dren bya ba ni/ rdo rje slob dpon smin grol gyi rtogs pa mthar phyin pa zhig la/ blo ngan gyi slob ma dam las nyams na sngar ye shes phab pa'i tshe ye shes sems dpa' slob ma'i snying la bcug pa de nyid dam las ma 'das na de'i ye shes sems dpa' yin la/ dam las 'das na de nyid dam nyams kyi gshed mar gyur nas de'i tshe bstungs te rdo rje'i dmyal bar ltung la/ de nyid slob dpon des cis kyang 'dren pa ni sems can blos mi gtong ba yin pas gzhan pa'i dmyal ba'i tshe tshad las myur bar 'dren pa ni slob dpon de'i mthu yin te/ dan 'bag gis thar pa nag po dmyal ba nas drangs pa dang*/ legs skar dmyal bar song ba bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis 'dren par gsungs pa dang*/ byang sems nyi ma'i snying pos gdul bya ngan song nas bton pa lta bu dang*/ gzhan yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen po to bas sa la 'gyel ba sa la brten nas langs pa ltar/

yul dkon mchog gsum la nongs pa bgyis pa yul de nyid la brten nas bshags dgos par gsungs pa ltar/ rdo rje slob dpon ye shes ldan pa la dam nyams na de nyid kyis 'dren gyi/ gzhan gang gis kyang 'dren mi nus par dgongs pa yin la/ de'i rgyu mtshan sngags kyi dam tshig gi rnam bshad rnams su yang*/ slob dpon la dam nyams na de nyid la bshags nas gnang ba ma byin bar du bshags pa la 'bad/ slob dpon sku gshegs nas mi bzhugs na/ de'i bu'am chung ma'am/ de med na de'i 'dra 'bag dang de'i lhag pa'i lha'i drung du bshags dgos par bshad pa yang don 'di yin no// 'di ni byang sems tshoms kyi byang sems la gnod pas bde bar 'brel mi srid pa dang 'gal lo zhe na mi 'gal te/ 'dir yang gnod pa'i las kyis dmyal bar skye/ sngon bzang po'i 'brel ba smin grol thob pa de nyid kyis drangs pa yin pas 'di ni dkar nag zang thal yang dpyis phyin pa yin la| rgyu 'bras la mu bzhir 'ga' zhig gis brtsi ba de yang rnam par nyams par byas so// zhes gsang sngags rig 'dzin sdom pa'i gnad bsdus kyi tshoms gsal bar byed pa ste spyi don lnga pa'o/// / ༈ /spyi don drug pa lta sgom spyod pa'i gnad bsdus kyi tshoms 'chad pa la rdo rje'i gsung nyi shu mchis pa'i dang po/ brgyud pa nas brgyud pa'i chos zab cing ngo mtshar ba yin zhes gsungs pa ni/ rdol chos pe dkar bu bzhi lta bu/ shing chos gso sbyong yan lag brgyad pa ka ba'i nang nas phyung ba lta bu dang*/ gnam chos tan+t+ra sde bco brgyad rgyal po dza'i khang thog tu bab pa lta bu/ de la sogs pa rnams ni tshig don phun sum tshogs kyang*/ bla ma brgyud pa med pas 'bras bu mi 'byin pa dang*/ gzhan yang brgyud pa yid ches shing dam nyams dang 'dres khyer la sogs pa mi bar khyis ma chod pa zhig dang*/ de dag kyang bshad pa'i chos yin na rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du nyan bshad kyi rgyun ma chad cing lung rigs kyi zam ma chad pa/

sgom sgrub kyi chos yin na dbang gi chu bo ma nub/ byin rlabs kyi dad pa ma yal/ nyams len gyi gnad ka ma log pa zhig dgos te/ de yang gsang sngags snga 'gyur yin na/ rgyal ba dgongs brgyud/ rig 'dzin brda brgyud/ gang zag snyan rgyud/ smon lam dbang brgyud/ mkha' 'gro gtad brgyud/ shog ser tshig brgyud de brgyud pa drug dang ldan pa/ sngags gsar ma yin na rdo rje 'chang nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar dang*/ phar phyin theg pa yin na ston pa sangs rgyas nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du zhal dang snyan du brgyud pa'i gdams pa de ni zab cing ngo mtshar bar bzhed de/ sam+bu ṭi'i rgyud las/ yon tan thams cad rab rdzogs kyang*// bla ma med na srid mthar min// zhes dang*/ mdo ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ gzhon nu bla na med pa'i byang chub kyang dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi kha la rag lus na/ ting nge 'dzin 'di lta ci smos/ zhes dang*/ mgon po phag mo gru pas/ dang po nyams myong skyes na yang*// mi rtag sprin dang glog dang mtshungs// nyon mongs nga rgyal skye ba'i rgyu// gdams ngag la kha tsho che na yang*// brgyud pa med pa mu stegs lam// zhes gsungs so// 'ga' zhig na re/ gter nas byung ba'i glegs bam dang*// gzhan nas brkus pa'i chos lugs dang*// brtsams chos dang ni rmi lam chos// blos bzos pa yi chos lugs la// rdo rje 'chang la brgyud pa snyeg /de la'ang gzhan dag lung len pa// chos dang 'gal ba lta ci smos// rang tshig dang yang 'gal ba yin// zhes pa yang rnam par ma brtag pa ste/ gter nas byung pa'i glegs bam ni/ phal cher slob dpon pad+mas sbas par zad mod/ de rdo rje 'chang la brgyud pa mi bsnyeg pa la rgyu mtshan med/ gter de rdo rje 'chang gi snga rol nas sbas na khyed bden du chug /de dag phyis sbas pa'i phyir rdo rje 'chang la brgyud pa snyeg dgos pa las 'os med/ gter gyi glegs bam rnams zog chos rdo rje 'chang las 'gal bar khas len na/

rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog gter du bzhugs myong ba dang*/ dpal mgon phyag bzhi pa'i rgyud rnams mchod rten chos bzang sprin gyi yang rdzong nas spyan drangs pa dang*/ bde gshegs 'dus pa'i rgyud lung rnams mchod rten bde byed brtsegs pa nas spyan drangs pas khyod kyi khas len de thal ches la/ brtsams chos kyang rgyal ba'i bka' la brten nas paṇa grub kyis brtsams pa rdo rje 'chang la brgyud pa mi snyeg na/ lam 'bras kyi brgyud pa gang la gtugs/ des 'gre mod/ mgon po byams pas/ gang zhig rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'ba' zhig gi/ /dbang byas rnam g.yeng med yid can gyis byas// thar pa thob pa'i lam dang rjes mthun pa// de yang drang srong bka' bzhin spyi bos blang*// zhes ma gsungs sam/ rmi lam gyi chos kyang rgyal ba'i bka' dang mthun na brgyud pa de nyid la snyeg pa las 'os ma mchis la/ brkus pa'i chos ni rnam par ma dag mod/ blos bzos pa'i chos kyang rgyal ba'i bka' la brten nas bcos na rung la/ ma bcos na mi rung ba kun gyis 'dod des na de 'dra ba yang bris pa la dgos pa mi snang ngo*// gnyis pa/ 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang gi sems yin bya ba ni/ lang kar gshegs pa las/ rnam rtog bag chags 'khrul ba la// mi rnams la ni phyi rol snang*// phyi rol snang ba yod med de// sems ni sna tshogs nyid du snang*// zhes dang*/ de nyid las| rkyen las skyes pa'i snang ba las// rtog pa rang gis rtogs byed pa// phyi rol don mthong log pa ste// don med sems ni 'ba' zhig go// zhes dang*/ slob dpon 'phags pa'i sems kyi rdo rje'i bstod pa las/ sems rtogs pas ni byang chub ste// sems ni 'gro ba lnga po yin// bde dang sdug bsngal mtshan nyid dag /sems las ma gtogs cung zad med// ces sogs gsungs pas don 'dis snang ba rang sems go na sangs rgyas thob par byed pa'i rgyu sa bon grung po byang chub kyi sems dgra gnyen phyogs ris su ma chad pa zhig 'byung ste/

mgon po byams pas/ bdag dang sems can mtshungs mthong yang*// zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir ro// gsum pa/ chos thams cad bsam pa skad cig ma'i rang gzugs yin gsungs pa ni/ chos nyid mi bsam pa'i rang gzugs dang*/ chos can bsam pa'i rang gzugs gnyis las/ snga ma ni phyag rgya chen po nyid yin/ phyi ma la gsum las/ da lta dang*/ tshe 'phos pa dang*/ tshe ma 'phos kyang lus 'gyur ba dang gsum las/ dang po da lta bsam pa skad cig ma'i rang gzugs ni/ rang rgyud la dge mi dge'i rtog pa gang rung re re skyes pa na de dang mthun pa zhig yid snang la rang gzugs su grub la/ des dge mi dge'i 'bras bu smin par 'gyur ba/ bram ze to'u t+ya'i bu ne tsho dang khyi dkar po dung lta bu ste/ rgyal sras zhi ba lhas| lcags sreg sa gzhi su yis byas// mo tshogs de dag ci las byung*// de 'dra de dag thams ca da kyang*// sdig sems yin par thub pas gsungs// zhes so// gzhan yang lha bsgoms pas kyang de'i bsam pa'i rang gzugs su 'gyur ba'i 'dam pa ya po dang*/ rtsa thu 'bag pa'i sngags lta bu yin no// gnyis pa tshe 'phos pa skad cig ma'i rang gzugs ni bzhi ste/ sngar gong dge ba'i las dpag tu med pa byas kyang 'chi khar mi dge bas mtshams sbyar na ngan song du 'gro ba chos rgyal mya ngan med lta bu yin/ gzhan yang deng sang bshad sgrub kyi chos lugs 'ga' zhig gis dge ba'i bshes gnyen las kyi mtha' log nas 'gong por skyes pa mang du mchis pa 'di rnams lta bu/ yang sngar gong sdig pa 'ba' zhig la spyad kyang 'chi khar dge bas mtshams sbyar na bde 'gro thob pa yul 'phags rgyal gyi rngon pa lta bu dang*/ deng sang yang sdig can 'ga' zhig 'pho ba sogs kyis mtshams sbyar bas mi lus thob nas skye ba 'chad pa lta bu/ yang sngar gong dge sdig gi las cher bsags pa med kyang 'chi khar dge bas mtshams sbyar na bde 'gro thob pa yul kā shi ka'i rgyal po tshangs sbyin gyi bran mo lta bu/

yang sngar gong dge sdig cher ma bsags pa 'chi khar mi dge bas mtshams sbyar na ngan 'gror 'gro ba sogs lta bu ste/ tshul des na bsam pa skad cig ma'i rang gzugs yin te/ 'jam dpal mtshan brjod las/ skad cig gcig gis bye brag phyed// skad cig gcig la rdzogs 'tshang rgya// zhes so// 'di bzhi dang dkar nag zang thal 'gal lo zhe na mi 'gal te/ 'chi kha'i mtshams sbyor stobs che zhing 'phen pa drag pas mtshams sbyor de'i dge sdig gi las zang thal du lus rten phyi ma der byung la/ snga gong bsags pa'i las dkar nag gi 'bras bu chud mi za bar rim gyis zang thal du byung ste/ ji skad du/ gang du phyin kyang las kyis mi brdzi ba'i// sa phyogs de ni yod pa ma yin te// zhes sogs gsungs so// gsum pa tshe ma 'phos kyang lus 'gyur ba bsam pa skad cig ma'i rang gzugs ni/ dge tshul klur gyur pa dang*/ shud ke ban rgan rgya mtsho'i slob mas klu bsgrubs pas klur gyur pa lta bu yin no| |de lta na sems dang*/ las dang*/ 'bras bu gsum gyis bsdus pa bsam pa skad cig ma'i rang gzugs yin te/ gsum tshogs kyi rten 'brel las 'byung ba dran pa nyer bzhag nas gsungs pa ri mo mkhan gyi dpe dang 'dra bar gsungs pa gnad zab pa yin/ rje 'jig rten mgon pos/ rje phag mo gru pa'i snang ba rang sems kyi khrod nas 'am 'bus bsam pa'i rang gzugs 'di rnyed pa yin gsungs des na rgyu 'bras mthong chos su 'byung ba dang*/ skyes nas dang*/ lan grangs gzhan myong ma nges pa sogs go ba'i phan yon gsum gyis kyang bsam pa skad cig ma'i rang gzugs 'di nyid 'byung ste/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ ji ltar skyes bu zo chun rgyud// rdog thabs gcig gis bskyod pa na// thams cad cig car 'gul bar ltar// skad cig ye shes de bzhin no// zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ rdo rje'i gsung 'dis snang ba rang sems gsal por bstan pa yang yin no// bzhi pa/

gshis la mi gnas na bltas pas mi 'gyur bya ba ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa gnas dang gnas ma yin pa mkhyen pa dang*/ rten 'brel rgyu 'bras shes bya'i gshis dang 'gal ba dang*/ dpal chos kyi grags pa'i tshad ma rig pas kyang 'di mi 'grub pa dang*/ rang blo 'khrul ba la tshad mar byas pa log shes yin pa ste/ rgyu mtshan 'di bzhi pos gsung 'di grub pa yin la/ de yang chos nyid don dam pa'i bden pa'i gshis mtha' thams cad dang bral ba dang*/ de'i gnad kyis rang sems kyi gshis babs las gzhan du ma gyur pas yod pa la med pa dang*/ med pa yod par bltas kyang mi 'grub/ me la rlan gsher dang*/ chu la tsha sreg gi gshis med pa dang*/ sa la g.yo ba dang*/ rlung la sra brtan gyi gshis med pas/ de rnams go bzlog nas de ltar bltas kyang don byed de mi 'grub/ mthong khung la kom bur bltas nas bsdad kyang gshis de med pas g.yang la rdeg 'chos pa las 'os med/ dug la sman du bltas nas zos kyang srog 'dor la/ dge bas bde ba dang*/ mi dge bas sdug bsngal bar 'gyur ba yang gshis yin/ de go log tu bltas kyang bsgyur du mi btub/ rgyu 'bras de ni mtho ba sa bcu pa sogs la yang bslu med du 'ong ste/ 'khor los bsgyur rgyal nga la nu lta bu yin/ log shes kyang mi 'grub pa legs skar gyis sangs rgyas 'gro ba mgo skor mkhan du bltas kyang gshis la mi gnas pas der 'gyur mi srid kyang*/ kho rang log rtog des dmyal bar song ba yang de yin/ yang grub pa thob pa rnams kyis rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs ston pa rnams 'gal ba ltar snang ba zhe na/ de yang don dam du 'khor 'das thams cad rang sems las gzhan du med cing rang sems spros pa'i mtha' dang bral bar gsungs pa'i phyir/ sems la dbang bsgyur ba'i gshis kyis de ltar nus pa yin/ gshis de rgyu yin pas rgyu la 'bras bu bsgyur du mi btub pas/ 'dul ba lung las/ gnas 'jog sbrang rtsi byed kyis 'dod na rgya mtsho chen po sbrang rtsir bsgyur btub pa'ang rgyu sngon song gi 'bras bu bslu med du 'byung ba rgyu 'bras kyi gshis yin/

mdo sde las brgya pa las/ dge slong sgur chung gis thal skyo sbrang rtsir bsgyur ma btub pa rgyu sngon du ma song ba'i gshis yin/ des na gsung 'di ni chos 'khor tshoms kyi gshis sam babs kyi skabs dang*/ dkar nag zang thal gyi skabs sogs su lung rigs mang du bshad zin pas 'dir dpe don tsam bstan pas go bar byos shig /lnga pa/ mtshan nyid dang mi ldan pa'i bla mas yon tan skyed par mi nus zhes pa ni/ slob ma'i rgyud la yon tan skye bar byed pa la rgyu rkyen gyi rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa las 'byung gi /rgyu'i gtso bo ni bla ma mtshan ldan dang slob ma dad ldan yin te/ dus 'khor bsdus rgyud las/ nga rgyal dang ldan khro bas zil mnan rdzas la brkam zhing thos pa dag kyang med// slob ma rnams ni bslu ba don du gnyer zhing mchog gi bde ba'i gnas las sems nyams dbang ma bskur// longs spyod dag la kun chags bag med rtsub mo'i tshig dang bcas shing dbang po'i don du 'dod ldan pa// de nyid dmyal ba bzhin du slob ma mkhas pa rnams kyis rdzogs pa'i byang chub rgyur ni spang bar bya// zhes pas mtshan ldan las log pa'i bla ma ni bsten par mi bya ba smos ci dgos dmyal ba bzhin du spang byar gsungs pa'i phyir ro// bla ma mtshan ldan min yang sngar ma brtags par gdams pa zhus zin la log par bltas nas phyis bla ma mtshan ldan la gtugs nas mos gus sogs phun sum tshogs kyang sngar nyams pa'i nyes pas yon tan mi skye ba nag shod rgyal 'byung lta bu yin pas/ des na chos kyis ma 'brel gong du dpon slob legs par brtags nas gzod 'brel bar bya yi/ 'brel ba thogs zin nas spangs na mtshan ldan yin yang rung min yang rung rtsa ltung dang po 'gyur bas thog ma nyid nas brtag pa gal che ba ni mdo sngags kyi dgongs pa dpyis phyin pa yin no// drug pa/ rtogs pa skye ba'i thabs mos gus kho nar nges bya ba ni/

bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan yang*/ slob ma'i rgyud la dad pa med na yon tan mi 'byung ste/ dus kyi 'khor lo las/ bskal pa dus gsum thams cad du// dkon mchog gsum la mchod pa dang*// srog chags bye ba'i tshe bskyabs pas// tshe 'dir sangs rgyas mi 'thob ste// yon tan rgya mtsho bla ma la// dang ba'i yid kyis mnyes byas na// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ni// tshe 'di nyid la nges par 'thob/ ces dang*/ mgon po byams pas/ rang byung rnams kyi don dam ni// dad pa nyid kyis rtogs bya yin// nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od 'bar ba// mig med pa yis mthong ba med/ ces dang*/ mgon po 'bri gung pa chen pos/ rdo rje 'chang chen bla ma la// chos sku'i 'du shes ma bskyed na// sems nyid rtogs pa'i kha ta yang*| |rang dang gong mas khrel bar zad// ces dang*/ til+li pas/ mi brjed gzungs thob nā ro pas// bcu gnyis bar du nga mnyes byas// zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ rtogs pa skye ba'i thabs kyi gtso bo mos gus yin par bzhed do// bdun pa/ lta ba rtogs pa dang ldan pa zhes bya ba ni/ grub mtha' lung rigs bshad pas gtan la phab pa'i gnas lugs kyi lta ba ni go yul tsam yin la/ nyams su blangs pas rang rgyud la spros med mtha' bral gyi rtogs pa skyes pa ni lta ba mtshan nyid pa rtogs pa la dgongs te/ de yang rang re'i brgyud pa 'di lung rigs gis gtan la phab pa'i ngo bo rang gzhan stong par khas blangs kyang*/ mtshan 'dzin bden zhen gyi sgrog gis bcings pa'i lta ba de 'dra ba mi bzhed de/ slob dpon 'phags pas/ gang gi thugs brtses nyer bzung nas// lta ba thams cad spang ba'i phyir// dam pa'i chos ni ston mdzad pa// gau tam de la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes dang*/ rje mi la ras pa la lta ba gang yin zhus pas/ nga la lta ba med ces gsungs pa lta bu dang*/ yum las/ sems ni sems su ma mchis te sems kyi rang bzhin ni 'od gsal ba'o// zhes dang*/

mgon po phag mo gru pas| lta ba'i mthar thug blta bya lta byed bral/ zhes gsungs pas/ rang re'i brgyud pa 'di ni lta ba zhes pa'i tha snyad spyir mi 'dogs la/ 'dogs na yang gnas lugs nges pa don gyi snying po 'khor 'das gnyis med zung 'jug ye shes kyi rang ngo rtogs pa la lta ba tsam du ming 'dogs kyi/ de las gzhan pa'i mtha' bral mthar lhung gi lta ba de 'dra ba mi bzhed pa yin no| |brgyad pa/ chen po gsum gyis ma reg pa'i rtogs pa bya ba ni/ dang po dbu ma chen po mtha' bzhi dang bral ba rang gzhan stong pa'i lugs 'di gnyis kyang sems kyi mngon rtogs la ma reg ste/ ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ yod dang med ces bya ba mtha' yin te// de bzhin gtsang dang mi gtsang 'di yang mtha'// de phyir mtha' 'di dag ni rnam spangs nas/ mkhas pas dbus la'ang gnas par mi bya'o// zhes so// phyag rgya chen po chos thams cad dngos po gshis kyi gnas lugs gsal stong du 'dod pa des kyang sems kyi mngon rtogs la ma reg ste/ sdud pa las/ phung 'di stong zhes rtog na'ang byang chub sems dpa' de// mtshan ma la spyod skye med gnas la dad ma yin// zhes so// rdzogs pa chen po chos thams cad ma rdzogs pa med pa de las gong du yang 'gro rgyu med pa snang ba la bdag tu bzung ba des kyang sems kyi mngon rtogs la ma reg ste/ mgon po phag mo gru pas/ gsar ma'i rgyud bzhi rnying ma'i theg pa dgu// yang dag kun rdzob sa bcu'i rim pa ste// rdzogs pa chen po'i dpe ni khyung chen bzhin// phyag rgya chen po'i dpe ni mtshon du med// dpe yis mtshon na 'dus byas rkyang pa yin// zhes so// 'o na de gsum las gzhan pa'i sems nyid mngon par rtogs pa 'od gsal don dam pa'i bden pa de gang yin zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ snga ma de gsum ni blos byas las ma 'das pa dang chen po'i 'dzin stangs can dpe dang tshig gis gzhal bya blos byas kyi stong pa nyid yin pas sems kyi mngon rtogs la kha yang ma reg mod/

'dir blos ma byas| 'dzin stangs las bral/ dpe med tshig gi yul las 'das pa yin te/ slob dpon shan+ta de was/ don dam blo yi spyod yul min// blo ni kun rdzob yin par 'dod// ces blo las 'das pa de yang so ma ma bcos lhug pa gsum du bzhag pa ste/ tog tse pas/ so ma gnyug ma rang babs 'di// blo 'das phyag rgya chen po yin/ zhes dang*/ sa ra has/ tha mal shes pa snying gi dbus su sad// tshor drug dag na bde ba rgyun mi 'chad// ces dang*/ slob dpon rat+na kīrtis sbyor ba bzhis lha la bstod pa las/ smra bsam brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin| |ma skyes mi 'gag nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid// so so rang rig ye shes spyod yul ba// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes dang*/ rje sgam po pas/ rgya gar yang ma chad| ris gar yang ma lhung*/ sgo gar yang ma 'gags/ rten gar yang ma bcas/ phugs gar yang ma gtad/ phyogs gar yang ma gtogs/ dpe gang gis kyang mtshon par mi nus/ brjod pa gang gis kyang thog tu mi 'bebs/ ming ji skad kyang thogs la thong*/ sgom byung gi shes pa zhig gtsigs su che/ zhes gsungs pa sogs lung rigs du ma'i sgo nas gtan la phab ste/ don gyi cha nas chen po gsum yang mthon po'i 'dzin stangs dang ma bral bas bdag 'dzin dang ma bral ba'i phyir ro// 'dir 'ga' zhig gis/ la la grub thob ngan zhes zer// rtogs ldan bzang ba yin no lo// zhes pa nas/ nged kyi grub thob de 'dra yin// zhes pa'i bar dang*/ rtogs ldan mtshan nyid 'di yin zhes// mdo rgyud kun las gsungs pa med// des na rtogs ldan blun po la// grags kyi mkhas pa rnams la min// zhes pa nas// mdo rgyud kun dang 'gal bar 'gyur// zhes pa'i bar rmi lam nges bstan gyi lung yin rgyu ba dang bcas bshad mod/ rnam par 'khyams te/ grub thob ces pa rtogs pa dang ldan pas grub pa thob pa yin mod/ gtsang btsan dang pe har sogs grub pa la grub thob mi zer|

grub thob dang rtogs ldan ni phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi spyod pa la zhugs pa sogs gang du 'khor 'das phyag rgya chen por rtogs shing snang ba rang sems su rtogs pa la rtogs ldan zer/ des rtogs pa mthar phyin pas rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang grub pas grub thob zer gyi/ deng sang ri khrod du sdod nus pa tsam dang*/ bya ba cung zad 'bad nas btang ba tsam dang*/ sems ngo 'phrod pa'i ming tsam gyis stong lta had po'i rbad gam che ba dang*/ lha med 'dre med kyi spyod pa bya ba des 'gro ba rnams blo brid pa sogs la grub chen pa zhes deng sang yon bdag rnams kyis blun dad kyis btags pa la yul de rang yang bdag gir 'dzin cing zog po gya nom grub thob tu zhen pa'i mngon pa'i nga rgyal can mang po 'di ni kho bos kyang mig gis mthong zhing rna bas thos mod| 'on te 'di rnams ni khyi rgan sog po la seng ge dkar mo zhes btags pa dang khyad par rdul tsam yang med do// rtogs ldan gyi mtshan nyid mdo rgyud nas ma gsungs na/ zla ba sgron mas zhus pa'i mdo las kyang gsungs shing*/ glang po rtsal gyis zhus pa'i mdo las kyang*/ 'jam dpal rtogs pa zhes bya ba ni skye ba med pa la bzod pa'i tshig bla dwags so// zhes so| |khong dag /go nyams rtogs gsum la skad dod bo dhaḥ zhes pa byung bas rab 'bring tha ma gsum du 'jog mi thub gsungs pa skad dod de la bsams pa 'dra na yang*/ gzhan du na go ba'i skad dod bo dhaḥ zhes go ba dang yod pa byang ba dang blo la chub pa sogs la de ltar yang bshad don skabs thob tu bsgyur ba dang*/ nyams la ra sa zhes pa gar gyi nyams la nirtī ra sa zhes gar gyi nyams sam gar gyi ro zhes bsgyur ba dang*/ yang ga ti rtogs pa'i skad dod du snang ba sogs legs sbyar gyi skad la sgra gcig don mang dang*/ don gcig sgra mang sogs mtha' yas pa rnams lo tsā bas skabs thob tu gang bab bsgyur ba las 'khrul ba med de gsung rab rgya chen po la bltas pas shes par 'gyur la/

mdo du mar yang byang sems kyi yon tan smos pa'i tshe dran pa dang ldan pa/ blo gros dang ldan pa/ rtogs pa dang ldan pa sogs mang du gsungs pa'i phyir dang*/ mdo sde rgyan du/ de rnams byang chub sems dpa'i ming gi rnams grangs su bshad la/ bsgoms pa'i nyams myong zag bcas dang zag med du 'dod pa ni rgyud las kyang dpe don gyi ye shes su btags pa ltar yin la/ des na rtogs pa don gyi phyag rgya chen po de rgyud la ldan pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' de zag med kyi rtogs pa dang ldan pa'i phyir rtogs ldan zhes bzhed pa yin no// yang khong dag gis/ rnal 'byor bzhi sa lam dang sbyor ba chos mthun tsam bshad na 'gal ba med/ don du mi 'thad ces rmi lam nges bstan gyi lung drangs pa de'i dpe la bshad pa yang ches mi 'thad de/ rnal 'byor bzhi sa lam dang sbyor tshul lung rigs nyams myong du mas gtan la phab pa bla ma gong ma rnams kyi bzhed srol mtha' yas pa gsungs pa rnams la bsnyon du med pa'i phyir 'dir yi ges ngal bas ma spros so| |dgu pa/ thos bsam sgom gsum gyi stong nyid shor gol yin bya ba ni/ thos bsam sgom pas gzhal ba'i sgom nyams su ji lta ba gnad ldan du ma lon pas shor sa bzhi dang gol sa gsum du song ba ches mang ste/ dang po shes bya'i gshis la shor ba ni/ mtshan nyid phar phyin theg pa ba rnams/ rig pa sems pa'i shes rab kyis// phyi yi snang ba dkar dmar rnams| |gcig dang du bral gtan tshigs kyis// bshigs nas nam mkha'i dkyil lta bur// stong pa nyid du bsgom pa dang*// zhes pa'i don ltar bsgoms pas gshis la shor ba dang*/ gsang sngags pa 'ga' zhig /shū dz+nyā'i sngags kyis phyi nang rnams// stong nyid spros bral nam mkha' ltar// byas nas de la blo bzhag pas// zhes sogs brjod bya de'i yul gzung ba'i yul dang*/ 'dzin mkhan gyi shes pa dang rnal 'byor pa rang nyid dang gsum blos stong par byas nas gnyis med rdo rjes dag par byas pas gzung 'dzin yul yul can las ma 'das pas gshis la shor ba'o// gnyis pa rgyas 'debs su shor ba ni/

bka' gdams pa sogs 'ga' zhig gis/ dngos po rdzas kyi phung po lta bu zhig la/ dngos med de'i g.yogs lta bu zhig gis bkab pa dang 'dra bar/ 'di ni 'khor gsum yin pas dngos por byas na dngos med 'di 'dra zhig gis rgyas ma btab na mi 'ong snyam nas rgyas btab pas de yang dngos po dang dngos med gnyis su song zhing dngos po la dngos med kyis rgyas btab pas rgyas 'debs su shor ba'o// gsum pa gnyen por shor ba ni/ bsam sgom pa 'ga' zhig |nyon mongs skyes dus slar de la brtags shing de spong byed kyi gnyen por slar stong nyid bsgoms pas gar song cha med du song ba la 'di lta ste/ rnam rtog skyes byung yang dran rtsis gnyen po brgyab pas rang grol du song zer ba sogs/ rtsa ba'i nyon mongs kyi steng du gnyen po'i rnam rtog bsnan nas rtog pa'i rtsig pa brtsegs pas sgom spang gnyen gnyis med du ma song bar/ spang bya dang gnyen po gnyis su song bas sgom gnyen por shor ba'o// bzhi pa lam du shor ba ni/ lam dus su stong nyid bsgoms pas 'bras bu chos sku zer ba'i bzang po zhig logs nas thob tu re ba/ dper na yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che kar+sha pa ṇa dang bsdur ba lta bu ste/ sgom lam 'bras dbyer med du ma song bar lam 'bras tha dad du bzung bas lam du shor ba zhes bya'o| |gol sa dang po 'dod khams su gol ba ni/ nyams su blang ba'i tshe bde bas lus sems gang ba lta bu byung ba la zhen cing chags pas bskyangs pas 'dod khams su gol/ gnyis pa gzugs khams su gol ba ni/ nyams su blangs pas gsal ba nam mkha' lta bu phyi nang zla ba shar ba lta bu/ mig 'byed 'dzum khyad med pa byung ba la zhen chags kyis bskyangs pas gzugs khams su gol/ gsum pa gzugs med khams su gol ba ni/ nyams su blang ba'i tshe phyi nang gang du bltas kyang rtog pa phra ba tsam yang med par rdul bral chos skur rtogs pa 'dra ba yang 'ong bas de 'dra ba la chags zhen gyis bskyangs pas gzugs med pa'i khams su gol/

gol sa can gyi rtog pa de gsum la yun bskyangs nas bsgoms pas gol sa gsum du gol ba'i rjes su ngan song gsum sogs su skyes par gsungs la/ 'jig rten mgon po'i zhal nas/ mgon po phag mo gru pas zhen pa dang bral ba'i nyams gsum po bsgom na nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub kyang thob srid bya ba srid mtha' ma bkag par gda' ste/ ngas logs su zhus pa la ni gtan mi srid gsungs pas/ mdor na nyams byas pa'i chos yin mod/ nyan rang gi lam ni 'gog pa'i bden pa dang*/ rten 'brel lugs zlog yin pas de thob pa mi srid do// rgyas pa'ang srid ces pa de/ mdor na mi srid pa'i gsung du mchi'o/ zhes gsungs pa thos pas stong nyid bco brgyad byang bar byas shing*/ de la bsam pas rgyu mtshan du ma'i sgo nas stong tshul 'di 'dra'o snyam pa de nyid bsgoms pas rtogs bya dpyad sgom las gzhan med pas de ni blos byas kyi bdag 'dzin las ma 'das te/ slob dpon ye shes snying pos/ skye med ces dang stong zhes dang*// bdag med ces dang stong pa nyid| |dman pa'i yid kyis gang bsgoms pa// de ni 'di na bdag bsgom pa'o// zhes so// zab mo phyag rgya chen po mtha' bral gyi sgom ni de 'dra ba'i gzhal bya ma yin te/ mgon po byams pas/ phra phyir thos pa'i yul min te// don dam phyir na bsam pas min// chos nyid zab phyir 'jig rten pa'i// sgom pa la sogs yul ma yin// zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir ro| |bcu pa/ rtogs pa goms par byed pa sgom pa yin bya ba ni/ yon tan rgyud ldan gyi bla mas dad ldan gyi slob ma la nyams myong gi steng nas ngo sprad pa slob mas rtogs pa la rtogs pa zer| gang rtogs na chen po gsum sogs mthon po'i 'dzin stangs can gyi dri mas ma gos pa'i rang byung gi ye shes tha mal gyi shes pa de nyid yin te/ ji skad du/ gdod nas skye med rang bzhin yin pa la// de ring dpal ldan bla mas bstan te rtogs// zhes gsungs pa'i don yin/

de nyid rtogs na skyon med kyi ting nge 'dzin gsum sogs shor gol du ma song bar gong du rtogs pa'i ye shes de nyid la goms shing 'dris par byas nas bzo med du skyong ba la sgom zer ba ste/ mgon po 'bri gung pa chen pos/ sgom pa ma yin goms pa yin// goms pa klong du gyur pa yin// goms de bdag la rag lus pas// rgyun chad med par mnyam par gzhag /ces so// de lta bu'i sgom de ni bzo bcos dang bral ba'i gnyug ma de nyid skyong ba ste/ de la rtse gcig tu gnas na rnam par g.yeng ba'i dbus dang dben pa la khyad med de/ lung phran tshegs las/ 'phags pa kat+ya ya na lta bu dang*/ ma g.yeng bar nang du yang dag 'jog la gnas pa ni sems dran pa nye bar bzhag pa yin la/ 'di la gnas na gzhan gsum po 'di'i khongs su 'du'o// 'di la nang du yang dag 'jog pa zhes pa ni/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud las/ yid ni nang du chud gyur pas// gang 'dod pa yi dngos grub 'thob// ces so// des na ma yengs pa'i dran pa nye bar bzhag pa la brten nas yang dag pa'i spong ba bzhi sogs rgyud la skye zhing des byang phyogs so bdun sogs dkar po'i yon tan mtha' dag ting nge 'dzin 'dis bskyed pa yin te/ mgon po 'bri gung pa chen pos/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi gzhung lam de// dus rgyun chad med pa'i dran pa yin// zhes so// de'i phyir nag po'i phyogs 'joms shing spong ba dang*/ dkar po'i phyogs thams cad 'phel ba dang dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad sdud par byed pa ni ting nge 'dzin 'di nyid las gzhan nyams su blang bya ci yang med de/ rje phag mo gru pas/ mngon shes rdzu 'phrul la sogs pa// re 'dod spong la sems la ltos| |sems la lta dang ma bral na// stobs bcu ma 'dres bco brgyad dang*// mi 'jigs bzhi la sogs pa yi// sangs rgyas yon tan ma lus pa// bar do dang por 'ong bar nges| |zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// bcu gcig pa/

spyod pa blang dor dang bral ba tshul khrims rin po che yin bya ba ni/ chos nyid stong pa nyid rtogs pa de'i spyod pa blang dor dang bral ba ni tshul khrims rin po che yin te/ sdig pa mi dge ba thams cad blang du med pa ye nas dgag bcas/ dge ba thams cad dor du med pa ye nas sgrub bcas/ de 'dra ba'i tshul khrims ni chags sdang spang ba spyod pa blang dor dang bral ba'am/ 'khor ba dang ngan song gi rgyu kun 'byung mi len/ thar pa dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i lam bslab pa gsum mi 'dor ba dang*/ chags pa mi len sdang ba mi 'dor ba sogs kyi don yin pas na/ mgon po 'bri gung pas/ blang dor med pa'i spyod pa de// chags sdang med pa'i lus ngag yin// go ba 'dzol na 'khor bar 'khyams// zhes so// blang dor zhes pa ni chags sdang dang bral ba la dgongs pa ste/ zas gcig pu la mtshon na/ nyan thos rnams kha zas 'tsho ba'i sman gyi ched du ste/ kā ri kā las/ bru ba'i nad las ldog pa'i phyir// bza'o snyam pa'i sems kyis bza'// zhes chags sdang dang bral bar gsungs pa dang*/ byang sems kyi kha zas lus kyi srin bu stong phrag brgyad cu sogs la phan pa'i sems kyis bza' dgos par byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod rnams nas gsungs la/ gsang sngags pas ni lus kyi lha gdan gsum gyi dkyil 'khor ba rnams la nang gi sbyin sreg tu 'bul te/ ji skad du/ bza' bca' de bzhin btung ba dang*// ji ltar rnyed pa bsten par bya// yid 'ong mi 'ong rnam rtog phyir// zhen pa tsam du mi bya'o// zhes so// mdor dril na dge ba mi blang sdig pa mi 'dor zhes pa'i don min gyi/ mchog dman bar ma gang la yang dge ba la chags shing mi dge ba la sdang ba'i bsam pa med pa zhig yin la/ de yang lta ba rtogs pa dang ldan pa des sgrub pa'i spyod pa ni don snying por gyur pa bslab pa rin po che gsum chags sdang med pa'i sgo nas spyod pa yin te/

ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ gang zhig chos 'di thos nas chags byed cing*// chos ma yin pa mthong na khong khro skye// nga rgyal dregs pa bcom na legs pa ste// nga rgyal dbang gis sdug bsngal rjes su myong*// zhes gsungs pas mdor na zas spyod gnas mal nyams len gang la'ang dga' ba'i sgo nas chags pas blang ba dang*/ mi dga' ba'i sgo nas sdang zhing spang ba med par bya ba gang byed thams cad chos lnga'i skya bar nas bton te 'bad ces 'chad pa ni dgongs pa dpyis phyin pa yin no// bcu gnyis pa/ lta sgom spyod gsum gcig pa yin gsungs pa ni/ lta ba mtha' bral rtogs pa dang ldan pa/ rtogs pa de goms par byed pa sgom pa mtha' gnyis dang bral ba/ de dang mi 'gal zhing mthun par spyod pa ni gong du bshad ma thag pa'i spyod pa chags sdang gnyis kyi mtha' dang bral ba ste/ de gsum ngo bo dbyer med cing nyams su blang ba ni tshul khrims rin po che ches rmad du byung ba yin te/ rje phag mo gru pas/ lta ba sgom pa spyod pa gsum| |rtogs pa gcig la tshang gyur na// 'bras bu tshe 'di nyid la 'thob// ces dang*/ mgon po 'bri gung pas/ lta ba sgom pa spyod pa gsum// gcig tu rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor la// zhes gsungs pas de gsum dbyer med bsal bzhag med pa ni lta sgom spyod pa gcig cing phyin ci ma log pa yin la/ lta ba mtha' bral du khas blangs kyang sgom pa gzung 'dzin las ma 'das pa/ spyod pa chags sdang gi dbang du song ba la ni rdzogs byang gi skal ba yod pa ri bong gi rwa dang mtshungs par dgongs so// bcu gsum pa/ phyag rgya chen po dang tshul khrims gcig pa ni/ 'jig rten mgon po'i khyad chos bla na med pa yin bya ba ni/ rgyu mtshan bzhi ste/ dang po mtshungs par gcig pa ni/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i don ma go bas 'khor bar 'khor bas de'i rang bzhin shes dgos pa dang*/ bdag 'dzin spong ba dang*/

chags sdang spong ba dang*/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas srung ba sogs gcig par nges te/ ji skad du/ lus kyi sdom pa legs pa ste// ngag gi sdom pa legs pa yin// yid kyi sdom pa legs pa ste// thams cad du ni sdom pa legs// zhes gtso bor sems bsrung dgos ba'i lung rigs mang la/ gnyis pa phan tshun 'brel bar gcig pa ni/ slob dpon 'phags pas/ khrims ni rgyu dang mi rgyu'i sa bzhin du// yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten yin par gsungs/ zhes dang*/ ji skad du/ ji ltar 'di na shing rtsa gtso bo ste// rnam par 'phel dang kun 'dzin kun gyi gzhi// de bzhin chos rnams ma lus kun gyi yang*// gzhi dang rtsa ba 'dul ba yin par gsungs// zhes so// gsum pa byed pa'i las gcig pa ni/ spyir dug gsum gyis kun bslangs mi dge ba spong zhing dge ba'i las lam thams cad sgrub par gcig la/ khyad par stong nyid rtogs na rgyu 'bras su ldang ba'i gnad kas kyang gcig ste/ ji skad du/ ngag rnams bsrung zhing yid kyis rab bsdams te// lus kyis mi dge ba dag mi byed cing*// zhes sogs gsungs pas byed pa spang blang yang gcig /bzhi pa gshis stong nyid du gcig pa ni/ so thar sdom pa'i ngo bo rnam rig min pa dang*/ phyag rgya chen po mtha' bral yang gshis stong pa nyid du chu dang chab rom ltar gcig ste/ ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ ting 'dzin rgyal po stong pa 'di bsgoms pas// tshul khrims dag pa'i mgo la de 'dug ste// chos rnams rang bzhin stong par mnyam bzhag nas// byis pa mi rig brtson pas mi shes so// zhes gsungs pas gcig par bzhed la/ tshul khrims de nyon mongs pa'i spros dang bral bas chos sku dang*/ nyon mongs pa stong pas stong pa/ nyon mongs pa rnams dag pas rang bzhin rnam dag ces mdo sde rnams su gsungs pa'i phyir/ rnam pa tha dad pa med pa nyid do// bcu bzhi pa/ phyag rgya chen po yon tan thams cad kyi bdag nyid yin bya ba ni/

gzhi dus su khams rang bzhin rnam dag yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa/ lam dus su phar phyin lnga shes rab dang 'brel bas dge ba rgya chen po'i tshogs 'byung zhing mthong spang brgya rtsa bcu gnyis dang*/ sgom spang bzhi brgya bcu bzhi spong zhing*/ 'bras dus su sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i bdag nyid 'grub pa ste/ mgon po byams pas/ gal te sangs rgyas khams med na// sdug la'ang skyo bar mi 'gyur zhing*// mya ngan 'das la 'dun pa dang| |don gnyer smon pa'ang med par 'gyur// zhes dang*/ 'dus pa rin po che'i tog las/ skye dang 'jig grol chos 'di thams cad las// nam mkha' 'dra ba gang na sgom byed pa| |de dag 'chi med rga dang na ba'ang med// ngan 'gro med cing mi sdug 'phrad pa'ang med// ces dang*/ de nyid las/ bdag po med cing byed pa med gyur pa// chos 'di thams cad stong par bsgoms nas su// smon pa spangs nas bla na med pa yi// byang chub nam mkha'i rang bzhin rig par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// bco lnga pa/ mnyam bzhag las yon tan thams cad 'byung bya ba ni/ sems can rnams 'khor bar 'khor ba'i rtsa ba bdag 'dzin yin pas/ de bla ma mtshan ldan gyi byin rlabs dang slob ma'i mos gus kyi rten 'brel tshogs pas gdams pa'i gnad kyis spangs te/ de'i ngang la gnas pa la mnyam bzhag zer/ de las langs pa'i dus na nyon mongs dang rnam rtog skye ba rjes shes yin/ mnyam bzhag de bskyangs pa'i yon tan ni mthar thug mthong lam thob nas yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis sogs 'byung zhing*/ de las kyang mthar thug don gnyis 'grub pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa ste/ rje phag mo gru pas/ byang chub sems dpa' sa bcu dag /sems skye med du gnas pa'i yon tan yin// zhes gsungs so// bcu drug pa/ rgyu ma bsgrub na ni yon tan thams cad mi 'byung bya ba de sems ngo 'phrod tsam la lta ci smos/

sa la gnas pa rnams kyis kyang sems can gyi don mdzad pa'am bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yon tan rnams bsgrub pa'i rgyu tshogs gnyis kyi spyod pa rlabs po che la bsgrub dgos par gsungs la/ 'di dang mnyam bzhag kho na las yon tan thams cad 'byung ba 'gal lo snyam na mi 'gal te/ 'dir mnyam bzhag stong nyid dang rjes shes dngos 'dzin can du bsgrub pa ma yin gyi/ dper na nor bu rin po che la dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i mthu yod kyang phyi ba gsum sogs byas te rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mor btags te gsol ba 'debs dgos pa lta bu yin la/ rgyu bsgrubs na rjes shes su mi 'gyur ram snyam na mi 'gyur te/ 'phags pa sdud pa las/ bdag ni mnyam par bzhag ce'am langs zhes rlom sems med// ces so// des na mnyam bzhag las ma g.yos pa'i ngang nas bsgrub dgos te/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ nga la 'od zer yang yod de// de ming rnam dag mig ces bya// tshe dang longs spyod shes rab dang*// nad dang khe nyan spang sems dang*// sangs rgyas mar me mchod pas na// de phyir de las skyes pa yin// zhes gsungs pas/ mnyam bzhag las ma g.yos bzhin du tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i thabs bya bar gnad zab par dgongs so// bcu bdun pa/ stong nyid rtogs na stong nyid rgyu 'bras su ldang bar bzhed pa ni/ stong nyid rtogs na chos thams cad kyi gshis babs rtogs pa yin/ chos thams cad kyi gshis babs ni dge ba'i gshis las bde ba dang*/ mi dge ba'i gshis las sdug bsngal 'byung ba'i gnad kyis rgyu 'bras kho na'i spang blang du 'byung ste/ rje mi las sgam po pa la 'gro chos su gsungs pa/ yar sangs rgyas la re ba med kyang dkar po'i chos spyod rgyun mi bcad/ mar ngan song la dogs pa med kyang sdig pa phra zhing phra ba la 'dzem/ zhes dang*/ yang rje btsun mi las/ stong nyid kyi bshad pa lung rigs dang mthun mthun mo mang po byas rung stong nyid de bas kyang phra bas go ba dang yid ches pa dka'/

stong nyid la yid ches rting stong nyid rang rgyu 'bras su shar ba go nas rgyu 'bras kyi 'dor len dge sgrub sdig spong la brtson du rang 'gro ba yin/ chos kun gyi rtsa ba rgyu 'bras la yid ches pa 'di yin pas sdig spong dge sgrub kyi phyag len la zhib pa dang brtson pa gal che// zhes dang*/ ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ chos nyid las kyi rnam smin med shes kyang*// dge dang mi dge'i las ni chud mi za// zhi bar gnas pa rang rgyal theg pa de// nyan thos rnam par grol ba'i sgra phyir 'brang*// zhes dang*/ rje phag mo gru pas/ kha ta rkyang par ma song zhing*// snying nas rtsa ba chod gyur te// ro gcig gi ngang la 'byams gyur na// bu rgyu 'bras kun mngon du gyur pa yin// zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ stong nyid rtogs na chos thams cad rgyu 'bras nyid du rtogs pa ni gshis sam babs so// bco brgyad pa/ rtogs ldan la thabs lam la sogs pa lhag par dgos zhes gsungs pa ni/ rtogs ldan de mthong thos dran pas kyang 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal zhi zhing zhi lhag zung 'brel rgyud la skye nus pa'i rdzu 'phrul thams cad kyi rgyu bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi gtum mo bsgoms pas rtsa rlung thig le bsgom dgos par grub cing*/ sogs khongs kyi phar phyin bcus bsdus pa'i thabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa shes rab chen po dang zung 'brel du nyams su blangs pas stong nyid rgyu 'bras kyi yon tan phrin las dbang bcu sogs 'byung ba'i phyir yin te/ mgon po byams pas/ mgo la sems can khur chen khyer ba yi// sems dpa' mchog rnams dal gyis 'gro mi mdzes// zhes dang*/ rin chen them skas las/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi ma thob par// chos nyid rtogs kyang yon tan med// de bas gtum mo bsgom par bya| |zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ bdag don du phyag rgya chen po spros bral gyi rtogs pa mngon du gyur kyang*/

gzhan don du yon tan dang phrin las tshad med pa 'byung ba'i phyir gtum mo sogs chos drug dang phar phyin bcu sogs la 'bad par bya dgos so// bcu dgu pa/ tshul khrims la gces spras su byed pa rigs spyod khyad par du 'phags zhes gsungs pa ni/ nyon mongs rnam rtog gi mtshan 'dzin brtul nas ye shes kyi stobs la zhugs pa la rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa zhes bya la/ de ni brgyud pa 'di'i rnal 'byor bzhi'i rtogs pa gong nas gong du na 'pho ba tshul khrims la ltos pa dang*/ sa bcu pa man chad la sgrib pa phra ba yod pa spong byed du 'gyur ba dang*/ ngo tsha med pa tho co'i spyod rtsing ni sla'i/ dgag sgrub kyi bslab pa dka' bas khyad du 'phags pa dang*/ rgya gar gyi slob dpon klu sgrub sogs dang bod kyi rje sgam po pa sogs kyang rigs spyod 'di mdzad pas phrin las che bar byung zhing*/ rdo rje 'dzin pa la yang dge slong dge tshul dge bsnyen gyi dbye bas rab 'bring tha mar 'gyur tshul ltar dang*/ mgon po 'bri gung pas/ 'am 'bu rgya gar kyi grub thob brgyad cu dang mnyam pa'i rtogs ldan 'di da lta rab tu byung ba'i tshul du byon pa 'am 'bu pho rgod pa yin gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na nyams rtogs cher mnga' yang tshul khrims dang lhan gcig tu nyams su blang ba'i rigs spyod 'di bstan pa rnam dag gi nyams len du 'gyur gyi/ deng sang 'ga' zhig brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa yin par khas 'che ba'i rus rgyan gyon/ khyi lpags dkris/ mtshon cha thogs nas rgyu 'bras khyad du gsod cing lus srog thed la 'bor ba'i rtogs ldan spyod pa lha klu thams cad dkrugs shing phaṭ sgra dang ku sgras lung pa 'gengs pa'i jo chol can byas pa don med khyi ltar 'khyams pa rnams kyi spyod pa brtul zhugs las ches 'phags pa'i phyir tshul de ltar bur dgongs so// nyi shu pa/ bhu su ku chos gsum med na zhi ba nyan rang yin bya ba ni/

bhu su ku zhes pa/ bhuk+ta zas bza' ba/ susta gnyid log pa/ ku ṭhā ra bshang ba 'dor ba ste/ de gsum las gzhan pa'i rnam g.yeng med par nyams len gyis dus 'da' ba'i rnal 'byor pa zhi ba'i lha dang*/ grub chen lū hi pa lta bu yin yang chos gsum po 'di dang mi ldan na zhi ba nyan rang dang 'dra la/ chos gsum ni/ dang po nyes pa'i spu ris mthong ba'i tshul khrims dgos la| de med na yon tan mi 'thob pas slob dpon 'phags pa rdza bum la chags pa lta bu dang*/ slob dpon chos mchog gis phyag shing klad la bskor ba'i dpe lta bu yin pas tshul khrims bsrung dgos/ gnyis pa yon tan dgos par go ba'i bsgrub pa dgos pa ni/ bla ma mtshan ldan gyis gdams ngag rjes su gnang ba thob nas gnas ri khrod sogs brten cing sgrub pa'i brtul zhugs mchog tu 'dzin pa zhig dgos/ gsum pa tshad med snying rjes bskul ba'i gzhan phan ni gang la thug kyang sems can blos mi gtong zhing de'i don sgrub pa'i dam bca' brtan pos gzhan don 'ba' zhig las bdag don spu rtse tsam yang lus ngag yid gsum la mi dran pa zhig dgos/ de gsum med na ji ltar bzang yang zhi ba nyan rang dang mtshungs pa'i phyir/ des na chos gsum ni sangs rgyas bsgrub pa'i rgyu grung po med ka med kyi thabs yin pas cis kyang gal che/ de yang grub thob lu hi pa lta bu nges pa don gyi tshul khrims bsrung bya srung byed dang bral ba mngon du gyur cing stong nyid rgyu 'bras su mkhyen pa/ don sgrub pa'i spobs pa can stong nyid snying rjes gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa ste/ chos gsum nges pa don gyis tshang ba dang*/ slob dpon zhi ba lha ni chos de gsum ldan par khong rang gis brtsams chos de rnams kyis gsal ba yin la/ gzhan yang grub pa'i dbang phyug dam pa rnams ni chos de gsum ldan rung du yod pas don gnyis 'grub pa yin/ 'o cag rnams kyang phun sum tshogs pa ltar sems yang chos de gsum dang mi ldan na don gnyis 'grub pa'i thabs go chod po mi 'ong bas de gsum cis kyang gal che ba la dgongs pa yin no// zhes khyad par lta sgom spyod pa'i gnad bsdus kyi tshoms gsal bar byed pa ste spyi don drug pa'o/// /

༈ /spyi don bdun pa 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi sa'i gnad bsdus kyi tshoms 'chad pa la rdo rje'i gsung bco lnga mchis pa las/ dang po/ sangs rgyas kyi sar bden pa gnyis su med bya ba ni/ 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad sems yin la sems ni spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba nyid de/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni 'khor 'das kyi rang bzhin rtogs pas sangs rgyas pa yin la/ de yang chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid mtha' bral zung 'jug de'i ngo bor sangs rgyas pas/ bden pa gnyis/ dbyings dang ye shes/ chos dang chos can/ stong pa dang rten 'brel| yod pa dang med pa sogs mtha' thams cad dang bral zhing*/ gnyis bsdus kyi chos thams cad rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid can yin te/ des na sangs rgyas kyi sar 'di ni kun rdzob bo// 'di ni don dam mo zhes rnam par dbye ba med de/ mtshan brjod las/ gnyis med gnyis su med par ston// yang dag mtha' la rnam par gnas// zhes dang*/ bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng ba las/ kun rdzob dang ni don dam dag /rtog pa gnyis dang yang dag bral// gang du yang dag 'dres gyur pa// de ni zung du 'jug par bshad// ces so// 'ga' zhig gis/ chos thams cad kun rdzob tu yod don dam du med zer ba yang mi 'thad de/ 'khor ba dang myang 'das rtogs pa dang ma rtogs pa'i khyad par las med de/ slob dpon 'phags pas/ 'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das// gnyis su yod pa ma yin te// 'khor ba'i rang bzhin shes pa la/ mya ngan 'das zhes brjod pa yin// zhes dang*/ rje phag mo gru pas/ e ma hoḥsems kyi rgyal po de// rtogs par gyur na mya ngan 'das// ma rtogs 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ste// rtogs dang ma rtogs ma lags pa// 'bras bu thob dang mi 'thob med// ces gsungs so| |gnyis pa/ ye shes ni gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kho na zhes gsungs pa ni/ chad pa lnga dang bral ba ste/ stong nyid dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i rgya chad/
