nyan thos pa'i bcom chad/ mu stegs chad lta ba'i shi chad/ blos byas kyi stong pa phyal chad/ rdzogs chen pa'i gdod nas ye chad/ de lnga po ma yin pa/ ye gdod ma'i shes pa de nyid rtogs pas mtha' gnyis dang bral ba/ bden don gnyis su med pa zab mo'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba ches phra ba gzhom gzhig dang bral ba mtha' dbus dang bral ba mtshan ma las 'das pa mthar phyin pa ste/ brtag gnyis las/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing*// sogs dang*/ mtshan brjod las/ gnyis med ye shes tshul 'chang ba// rnam par shes pa'i chos nyid 'das| |zhes dang*/ slob dpon 'phags pas/ yod ces bya ba rtag par lta// med ces bya ba chad par lta// de phyir yod dang med pa gnyis// mkhas pas gnas par mi bya'o// zhes dang*| ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ yod dang med ces bya ba mtha' yin te// de bzhin gtsang dang mi gtsang 'di yang mtha'// de phyir mtha' 'di dag ni rnam spangs te// mkhas pas dbus la'ang gnas par mi bya'o// zhes so/ ye shes de ni ngo bo mtha' bral zab gsal gnyis su med pa yin la/ de yang zung 'jug don dam pa'i phyag rgya chen po blo las 'das pa blos byas dang bral ba yin la/ gong du bshad pa'i lta ba lnga po ni blos gzhal ba'i chos las ma 'das te/ spyod 'jug las/ don dam blo yi spyod yul min// blo ni kun rdzob yin par 'dod// ces sogs gsungs pa ni/ kho na zhes nges tshig kyang mdzad de don dam pa'i ye shes ni yod med sogs mtha' thams cad dang bral ba zab gsal gnyis med don dam phyag rgya chen po blo las 'das pa kho na yin gyi/ blos ni nam yang de'i phyogs yin pa mi srid do zhes gsungs pa'i don no// gsum pa/ sgyu ma lta bu'i chos las yang dag par 'das zhes pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das ni spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i ngo bor sangs rgyas pa yin la/ de'i gnad kyis ye shes de yang sgyu ma zhes pa med bzhin du snang ba/

snang la ma nges pa'i nying 'khrul da lta nyid du 'jig pa'i chos can mi rtag pa yin la/ ye shes bden don blo 'das zab gsal phyag rgya chen po ni yul de lta bu las 'das pa 'khrul ba rtsad gcod/ 'jigs bral rtag pa la sogs pa rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid ye shes chen po yin te/ ye shes snang ba rgyan gyi mdo las/ chos kun sgyu mar thugs su chud// sgyu ma nyid kyang mchis ma lags// sgyu ma'i chos las rnam grol ba// mi rten khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes gsungs pas ye shes de ni sgyu ma lta bu sogs dpe thams cad kyis gzhal du med pa zhig go// bzhi pa/ sangs rgyas dus rtag tu tshad mar bzhugs bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ji lta ji snyed kyi ye shes phul 'byung zhing*/ 'dus ma byas pa dang*/ lhun gyis grub pa dang*/ gzhan rkyen gyis mi rtog pa ste rang don du chos phun sum tshogs pa de gsum mnga' bas tshad mar bzhugs pa kho na las gzhan pa'i ma brtag pa'i btang snyoms med pa sogs kyi phyir/ phyag rdor dbang bskur ba'i rgyud las/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni gang gsungs pa de bzhin te gzhan du mi 'gyur bas/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi tshad ma ste des na mi bslu'o// zhes dang*/ phung po gsum pa'i mdo las/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ye shes su gyur pa/ spyan du gyur pa/ dpang du gyur pa/ tshad mar gyur pa/ zhes dang*/ slob dpon phyogs glang gis/ tshad mar gyur pa 'gro la phan bzhed pa// ston pa bde gshegs skyob la phyag 'tshal te// zhes gsungs so// sangs rgyas kyi thugs skad cig ma gnyis pa tshun chad sgro 'dogs chod pa'i dpyad shes tshad mar mi 'gyur zhes pa don min no// lnga pa/ bral ba'i 'bras bu ye shes kyi thugs can bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas skyon dag yon tan rdzogs pa'i bdag nyid spang bya dang bral ba'i 'bras bu chos nyid ji lta ba dang*/

chos can ji snyed mkhyen pa'i ye shes gnyis brnyes pas rtag tu mnyam bzhag las ma g.yos shing rnam rtog mi mnga' la/ cir yang sa ler mkhyen pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi las thams cad ye shes kyi sngon du 'gro zhing*/ rjes su 'jug pa thogs med du grub la/ bral 'bras kyi thugs la dri ma med pa'i sems su bzhag cing sems can chen po zhes sogs mtshan gyi rnam grangs su bgrang zhing*/ dri bcas rtog pa med pas sems med ces kyang btags te/ de 'dra ba'i thugs de nyid bral ba'i 'bras bu can te/ slob dpon dpa' bos/ rnam rtog mi mnga' ci yang sa ler mkhyen// zhes dang*/ gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa las/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ni sems dang yid dang rnam par shes pa dang bral/ ting nge 'dzin kyang mi 'dod do// zhes so/ des na sangs rgyas kyi thugs yang dag pa'i ye shes de la 'di dang 'dir rtog gi rnam rtog dang der 'dzin gyi shes pa med de/ rje phag mo gru pas/ rkang gnyis gtso bor snang ba med// ces so// 'o na thams cad mkhyen pa'i spyod yul gang la gang 'dul du ston pa dang 'gal lo zhe na/ mi 'gal te/ mgon po byams pas/ gang phyir gdul bya dag pa yi// chu yi snod ni thams cad la// bde gshegs nyi ma'i gzugs brnyan ni// dpag tu med pa cig car 'char// zhes gsungs so// drug pa/ chos sku yon tan mdzad pa dang bcas bya ba ni/ spyir gzhi dus kyi ma rig pa nyid ngo bo chos sku'i byang chub las ma 'das te// 'jam dpal rnam rol las/ gzhi'i dus su ma rig pa nyid byang chub ste byang chub nyid ma rig pa'o/ zhes gsungs la/ de 'dra ba'i rang bzhin rnam dag chos sku de sems can thams cad la yod pas sa bcu man chad du skyon spong zhing yon tan sgrub lugs mthun la/ sangs rgyas nas sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las 'byung tshul ni rnam pa thams cad du mi mthun te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis chos sku mthar thug brnyes pa'i tshe bral ba'i yon tan dang ldan pa las/

de'i rnam smin gyi yon tan longs sku dang*/ de'i phrin las sprul pa'i sku yin/ chos sku de'i yon tan ni/ theg pa chen po'i man ngag las/ bsdus na drug cu rtsa bzhi dang*/ de yang bsdus na yon tan bzhi ldan du gsungs te/ mgon po byams pas/ thog ma dbus mtha' med pa yi// rang bzhin yin phyir 'dus ma byas// zhi ba chos kyi sku can phyir// lhun gyis grub ces bya bar brjod// so so rang gi rtogs bya'i phyir// gzhan gyi rkyen gyis rtogs min pa// zhes chos sku'i yon tan dang*/ yang*/ de ltar rnam gsum rtogs phyir mkhyen// lam ston phyir na thugs brtse ba// nus pa ye shes thugs rje yis// sdug bsngal nyon mongs spong phyir ro// zhes mdzad pa rnams gsungs pa'i phyir dang*/ gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa'i spyod yul gyi thabs kyi rnam par 'phrul ba bstan pa'i mdo sogs nas rgyas par gsungs pa'i phyir chos sku zhes pa stong nyid ci med cang med du mi bzhed kyi/ chos sku yon tan mdzad pa dang bcas pa skyabs kyi mthar thug pa ste/ mgon po byams pas/ skyabs ni sangs rgyas nyag gcig ste// thub pa chos kyi sku can phyir// zhes sogs gsungs so// bdun pa/ sangs rgyas kyi sa na thugs bskyed yod bya ba ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de la rang don du thugs bskyed pa ni thugs dang po bskyed pa nas tha ma'i bar du med la/ gzhan don du thugs bskyed pa ni 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du yod de/ yab sras mjal ba las/ dpa' bo rnams ni thabs mkhas te| |bye ba brgyad cur rgyal ba nyid// sangs rgyas nyid du bsten gyur kyang*// da dung chog pa'i 'du shes bsal// dpa' bo chen po rnam par 'phrul// byang chub mchog tu thugs kyang 'jug |ces dang*/ mgon po byams pas/ de yang sa gser zla ba me// zhes sems bskyed dpe grogs kyi sgo nas dbye ba nyer gnyis gsungs pa'i phyi ma/

sgra snyan chu bo sprin rnams kyi| |zhes pa gsum sangs rgyas kyi sa'i sems bskyed du gsungs pa dang*/ yang mgon po byams pas/ sems bskyed sa mtshams kyis bzhir dbye ba'i phyi ma/ de bzhin sgrib pa spangs pa'o| |zhes pa'ang sangs rgyas kyi sa'i thugs bskyed du gsungs pa dang*/ 'dus pa'i bshad rgyud gnyis med rnam rgyal las/ sems can sna tshogs 'dul don du// sangs rgyas rnams ni yang dang yang*// sems bskyed 'gyur bas lam sbyong ste// mdzad pa du ma'i cho 'phrul rnams// rgyun mi 'chad par sems bskyed pa// byang chub sems ni mi zad phyir// de phyir phrin las rgyun mi 'chad// ces sangs rgyas kyi sa'i thugs bskyed de ni phrin las rgyun mi 'chad pa'i rgyur yang gsungs pa'i phyir ro// brgyad pa/ thugs gcig pu'ang rtag chad kyi lta ba tshun chad du 'byung bya ba ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo brnyes pas sems can rnams kyi rnam par rtog pa dang yid kyi 'jug pa'i bye brag ji snyed yod pa de snyed du 'dul byed sangs rgyas kyi thugs kyi 'jug pa yang sngon gyi smon lam rgya chen po'i mthus de snyed du 'byung ste/ mu stegs rtag pa dang chad pa'i lta bas 'dul ba la yang de dag gi sgor zhugs nas ye shes kyi gzigs pa dag pas de dag dang mthun pa ltar mdzad nas/ gzod lam rnam dag tu bkri bar mdzad pa yin la/ de 'dra ba dri za rab dga' 'dul ba'i gleng gzhis kyang shes shing*/ gzhan yang gsang bsam sogs las/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs sems kyi dmigs pa dang yang bral la/ sems can thams cad kyi sems kyi spyod pa dang bsam pa'ang rab tu shes so| |zhes dang*/ mya ngan 'das pa las/ long ba ma lags long ba ltar// zha bo ma lags zha bo ltar// byis pa ma lags byis tshul gyis// sems can rnams ni smin par mdzad// brgya byin tshangs pa'i cha byad dang*// la lar bdud kyi cha byad kyis// sems can rnams kyi don mdzad kyang*// 'jig rten rnams kyis rtogs mi nus// zhes gsungs shing*/

blo gros 'jug par rgyas par bshad pa bzhin gang la gang 'dul de la der ston gyi tshul gyis mu stegs byed kyi log lta la yang de 'dra bar bstan nas goms su bcug pa'i mthar sangs rgyas pa'i lam du gzhug pa'i blo gong nas gong du 'khrid par mdzad pa ni thabs mkhas pa'i mdzad pa rmad du byung ba'o// dgu pa/ shes bya la srid tshad kyis sangs rgyas kyi bya ba byed gsungs pa ni/ thams cad mkhyen pas gdul bya'i bsam pa dang*/ khams dang*/ dbang po dang bag la nyal ba mkhyen pas sems can gyi khams dang mnyam par sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa'ang de dang mnyam par ston cing*/ de yang so so'i las kyi bye brag gis sangs rgyas kho nar ston pa'i nges pa med pas gdul bya de nyid 'dul ba'i dus la bab pa'i tshe/ gdul bya dag pa la longs sku/ gzhan du mchog gi sprul sku/ dman pa rnams la bzo sprul sku/ skye ba sprul sku/ dman pa'i sprul pa/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas dang byang sems/ nyan thos/ rang rgyal/ tshangs pa/ brgya byin/ rgyal po chen po bzhi/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po dang*/ gzhan yang dgongs par gyur na ngan song gsum dang sa chu me rlung nam mkha' la sogs pa bem po'i rnam pas kyang de 'dul ba sangs rgyas kyi bya ba mdzad pa ni sngon gyi smon lam gang 'dul der ston gyi gshis babs yin la/ zas dang spos kyis sangs rgyas kyi bya ba mdzad pa dri ma med par grags pas bstan pa'i mdo las/ de bzhin gshegs pa spos mchog brtsegs kyi gleng gzhi lta bu dang*/ gos kyis sangs rgyas kyi bya ba byed pa klu'i rgyal po rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdo las gsungs pa lta bu dang*/ 'jig rten khams sna tshogs pa'i bkod pa dang ljon shing gis sangs rgyas kyi bya ba byed pa chos kun bgro ba nas gsungs pa lta bu dang*/ 'dod chags kyis sangs rgyas kyi bya ba byed pa dge slong brtan pa'i blo gros dang*/ sprul ba'i bud med lta bu dang*/

zhe sdang gis sangs rgyas kyi bya ba byed pa lho phyogs kyi sangs rgyas 'jig rten thams cad mthong na dga' ba mngon par 'phags pa brtson pa chen po zhes bya ba zhing der chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bzhin pa nas sor phreng can du sprul pa lta bu dang*/ gti mug gis sangs rgyas kyi bya ba byed pa 'od srung rdzogs byed lta bu dang*/ sam+bu ṭa'i rgyud nas/ rdul mun snying stobs gsum gyis kyang sangs rgyas kyi bya ba byed par gsungs pa dang*/ tha na mu stegs byed rnams kyang sangs rgyas kyi byin rlabs dang thabs la mkhas pa'i bya ba yin par byang sems spyod yul rnam 'phrul bstan pa'i mdo las gsungs shing*/ de ltar na sangs rgyas la don gyis 'gran pa'i gang zag 'byung mi srid de 'gran zla mi 'byung ba'i las bsags pa'i phyir dang*/ sangs rgyas dang dus mnyam par byung ba'i mu stegs byed de rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid kyi thugs rjes de ltar snang tshul du bstan gyi/ don gyis mu stegs byed sangs rgyas dang dus mtshungs su 'byung mi srid de/ mdo snga ma de nyid las/ gser gyi rgyal po yul gar byung gyur pa// de nas gyes pa'i phung po lcags mi 'byung*// gang du 'dren pa byang chub brnyes gyur pa// zhing der mu stegs can gyi tshogs mi 'byung*// yid bzhin nor bu rdo dang 'phrad gyur pa// bden pa'i tshul du nam yang 'byung ba med// de bzhin sangs rgyas rin chen mu stegs can// zhing gcig tu ni nam yang 'byung mi 'gyur// zhes gsal por gsungs pa'i phyir rdzogs byed sogs kyang snang tshul de 'dra na yang ngo bo sangs rgyas kyi byin rlabs las tshul de 'dra bar bstan pa ste/ mdo de nyid las/ 'jam dpal sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di na gzhan mu stegs can dang*/ spyod pa ba dang*/ kun tu rgyu gang dag snang ba 'di yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin rlabs dang thabs la mkhas pa'i yul bsam gyis mi khyab pa yin par rig par bya'o// zhes gsungs/

gzhan yang gsal rgyal gyi bya ba rgan po 'dul ba'i phyir sangs rgyas kyis bya ba gnyis pa mdzad nas 'dul ba sogs bsam gyis mi khyab cing*/ 'phags pa sdud pa las/ rgyal ba'i nyan thos pa dag ji snyed chos ston dang*// 'chad dang rigs pa dag dang ldan par brjod pa dang*// mchog 'phags bde ba byed dang de yi 'bras thob pa// de dag kun kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i skyes bu'i mthu// zhes dang*/ dkon mchog sgron me las/ de dag dgon par ljon shing chen por 'gyur// sman dang rin chen mi zad gter rnams dang*// yid bzhin nor bu 'dod sbyin snying po dang*// lam gol dong ba rnams la lam ston 'gyur// zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ shes bya la srid tshad kyis sangs rgyas kyi bya ba dus la bab na byed par 'gyur la/ sangs rgyas kyi bya ba zhes pa ni sems can la phan par mdzad pa yin la/ de yang grol ba chen po ye shes skad cig la 'char ba nas bsod nams cha mthun gyi las dang dge ba'i bsam pa cung zad bskyed pa yan chad sangs rgyas kyi bya ba yin par sdud pa'i lung gis grub pa ltar yin la/ des na shes bya la srid tshad kyis sangs rgyas kyi bya ba byed pa'i gtam 'di la blor mi tshud pa'i na tsha mi dgos kyi/ don du shes bya la srid tshad sangs rgyas nyid las ma 'das te/ rgyud gsang ba snying po las/ srid gsum ye nas sangs rgyas shing*// thams cad ma lus chos so cog /sangs rgyas nyid las gzhan ma yin// sangs rgyas nyid las gzhan pa'i chos// sangs rgyas nyid kyis mi rnyed do// zhes pa'i gtam ngo mtshar che ba de ltar yang yod la/ de la yid dngangs par mi dgos pa'i sman ni 'di lta ste/ mdo las/ gang dri ma mtha' dag gi sbubs las ma grol ba'i bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po la som nyi ma mchis pa de ni| de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi sku la som nyi ma mchis pa lags so// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na chos kyi sku nam mkha'i mthas klas pa'i rdul phra rab kyi bar la nye ring med par khyab pa'i phyir/

sems can gyi khams rgyud la lta ci smos/ chos skus gar khyab der sems can gyi don dus las mi g.yel ba'i thugs rje chen po'i ye shes kyi ngo bor bzhugs pas/ gdul bya dus la bab cing dgongs na sems ldan dang sems med dge ba'i bsam pa cung zad skyes pa yan chod yin la/ de skye ba'i rkyen du ma gyur pa'i shes bya ni gang yang med pa'i phyir dge sdig rnam pa gang gis kyang sems can sangs rgyas kyi bya ba mdzad do zhes bya ba gtam snga ma de gnyis thos pa'i tshe dbugs ma phyin pa rnams dbugs 'byin pa'i sman a gar brgyad pa lta bu'o| |de dag kyang dus la bab dgos pa ni/ chos kun bgro ba las/ 'di lta ste/ dper na me shing thams cad la yod mod kyi rkyen dang rtsol ba ma tshang na ni 'bar zhing rang gi dgos pa rnams mi byed/ de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyang shes bya thams cad la gnas mod kyi/ dad pa la sogs pa'i rkyen dang rtsol ba ma tshang na mi 'byung ste/ sangs rgyas kyi bya ba rnams kyang mi mdzad do// zhes rgya cher gsungs pas so// bcu pa/ chos kyi dbyings thams cad du sangs ma rgyas na sangs rgyas su mi 'gyur bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas sku gsum gyi chos sku dang longs sku gnyis lta zhog mchog gi sprul sku thub dbang 'di nyid byang chub kyi snying por sangs rgyas pa'i tshe/ chos kyi dbyings kyi mtha' klas pa'i dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas zhing gi rgyan ma lus pa bstan pa phyogs bcu'i sems can ma lus pas mthong bar mdo rgya cher rol par gsungs pa dang*/ phal po che las/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po rin chen mang 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho bcu'i rdul snyed la dbang bsgyur ba de'i bu grangs ji snyed kyis 'jig rten gyi khams grangs de dang mnyam pa la dbang byed pa'i so so'i 'khor tshogs grangs kyang de de tsam dang*/ 'khor re res 'jig rten ri rab kyi rdul phra ba'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po 'khor de snyed dang mnyam pas bskor ba 'khor de dag re re stong gsum dang stong gnyis dang stong spyi phud dang*/

gling bzhi'i 'gyur tshad sngar ltar bgrangs nas rgyal po re re la 'khor de snyed/ 'khor re la mi'i 'khor rgya mtsho lta bu zhes sogs gsungs la/ de yang tshad dang ris su ma chad pa chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid du sangs rgyas par gsungs te/ mdo las/ tshangs pa ngas yongs su chad pa'i rnam pas tshad dang ldan par sangs rgyas pa ma yin gyi/ tshangs pa nga ni tshad med cing ris su ma chad pa'i rnam pas chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so// zhes so// sangs rgyas de yang zhing 'dir 'tshang rgya tshul bstan pa yin gyi/ nges pa don dam du sangs rgyas pa ni dus tshod 'di tsam zhes tshad bzung bar mi nus te/ dbu ma la 'jug pa las/ bde bar gshegs pa ma lus phyogs zhing sangs rgyas yul rnams mtha' dag na// phra rab rdul gyi rdul rnams bdog par gyur pa ji snyed pa// dpa' bo byang chub mchog rab dam par gshegs pa'i bskal pa de snyed de// 'on kyang khyod kyi gsang ba 'di ni gzhan gyis bsnyad pa ma lags so// zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs so// bcu gcig pa/ rgyu med kyi sprul pa mi srid pas rang rgyud pa bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas rnams gdul bya 'dul ba'i tshe/ 'dul byed kyi rgyu ting nge 'dzin 'di zhes bya ba la snyoms par zhugs so zhes sogs gsungs pa ni/ yum rgyas par/ rab 'byor chos thams cad sprul pa ste kha cig nyon mongs pa dang*/ kha cig las dang*/ kha cig nyan rang dang*/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sprul par gsungs te/ des na rgyu med pa'i sprul pa mi srid pa'i phyir rang rgyud par mi 'ong kha med la/ rang rgyud pa zhes pa ni rgyu la ltos pa nyid du go bar bya yi/ tha mal pa'i rang rgyud pa dang 'di don mi gcig la/ rgyu zhes pa'ang rnam pa thams cad du 'gro 'ong dang bral ba'i byang chub chen po'i rang rtsal las gdul bya 'dul bar dgongs pa na de'i dbang po dang 'tsham pa'i 'dul byed kyi ting nge 'dzin la 'dir rgyu zhes btags pa ste/

mi'am ci'i rgyal po ljon pas zhus pa'i mdo las/ rgyu la brten pa'i mkhas pa bcom ldan 'das// mtha' gnyis lta ba rtag tu mi mnga' zhing*// las kyi 'bras bu rnam smin kho na gsungs// lta ba'i mun bral khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes dang*/ ma skyes dgra'i 'gyod pa bsal ba las/ chos thams cad ni rgyu'i rjes su 'gro ba/ rkyen la rag las pa/ srid pa'i rtsa ba can/ smon lam gyis thog drangs pa'o// zhes so// 'di dang spyod 'jug nas rgyu las 'bras bu 'byung bar mi rigs pa'i dpe zan dang mi gtsang ba la sbyar ba 'gal lo zhe na/ mi 'gal te 'di ni rnam pa kun tu dge sdig gi las su bzhed cing*/ cig shos ni rgyu de byed po gzhan gyis bsgyur bas rnam pa gzhan du 'gyur ba la dgongs pas so// bcu gnyis pa/ sangs rgyas rten 'brel gyi sku yin bya ba ni/ chos sku rang bzhin gyis rnam dag brnyes pa dang*/ sngon thugs bskyed pa'i dam bca'i mthu dang*/ gdul bya dad pa can gyi snang ba ste/ mdor bsdu na rten 'brel de gsum mam/ rang don gsum gzhan don gsum brnyes pa'i rten 'brel las byung ba yin la/ rgyu snga ma gsum po tshogs pa'i rten 'brel med na sangs rgyas 'jig rten du bzhugs kyang mi mthong la/ de gsum tshogs na mthong ba lha mo dpal phreng gis zhus pa'i mdo las gleng gzhi gsungs pa lta bu yin te/ mgon po byams pas/ ji ltar baiḍūr sa gzhi gtsang ma la// lha dbang lus kyi gzugs brnyan snang ba ltar// de bzhin 'gro sems sa gzhi gtsang ma la// thub pa'i dbang po'i sku yi gzugs brnyan 'char// zhes dang*/ yang de nyid kyis| dag pa baiḍūr+ya 'dra yi// sems la sangs rgyas mthong ba'i rgyu// de dag pa ni mi bzlog pa'i// dad pa'i dbang po brtas pa nyid// ces gsungs pas/ sangs rgyas ni tshogs pa de gsum gyi rten 'brel gyis mthong ba yin pa'i phyir ro// bcu gsum pa/

smon pa las longs sku dang 'jug pa las sprul sku 'byung bya ba ni/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad blo'i khongs su chud pa'i smon sems rgya shin tu che bas longs sku 'byung ba'i rgyu zhing khams thams cad du skus khyab cing sku la zhing khams thams cad snang ba nges pa lnga dang ldan pa de 'byung*/ sangs rgyas thob pa'i don du sgo gsum dge ba la bkol ba'i sems de las byung ba'i dge rtsa tha dad bsags pa las sprul sku tshad med pa 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan te/ bzang po spyod pa las/ nam mkha'i mthar thug gyur pa ji tsam par// sems can ma lus mtha' yang de bzhin te// ji tsam las dang nyon mongs mthar gyur pa// bdag gi smon lam mtha' yang de tsam mo// zhes dang*/ sdong po rgyan pa las/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa ni sems can gcig gi phyir ni ma yin pa nas/ sems can brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i phyir ma yin te/ sems can thams cad kyi don du'o// zhes so// gzhan yang rdza mkhan yangs pa'i 'od kyis smon lam btab pa dang*/ rtsibs kyi mu khyud kyis sangs rgyas mchod pa lta bu las sprul sku dang*/ 'jug pa'i dge tshogs kyis longs sku thob pa yang mi 'gal bas/ des na chos sku ye shes kyi tshogs dang*/ gzugs sku gnyis bsod nams kyi tshogs las 'byung ste/ chos sku ye shes kyi tshogs las 'byung bar klu sgrub kyis bzhed do// rdo rje'i gsung 'di dang*/ sangs rgyas rten 'brel gyi sku bya ba dang*/ sprul pa thams cad rang rgyud pa bya ba dang*/ chos dbyings thams cad du sangs rgyas pa dang*/ 'di rnams gnad gcig pa phan tshun 'brel ba can yin la/ de yang rdza mkhan dang rgyal po rtsibs kyi mu khyud kyis sangs rgyas mchod pa sprul sku dang*/ 'jug pas longs sku thob pa'i spyi bzhed dang*/ de gcig pu yang ma nges pas smon pa las longs sku dang 'jug pa las sprul sku thob pa bye brag khyad par gyi bzhed pa'o// bcu bzhi pa/

sku gsum tha dad med par bzhugs bya ba ni/ chos sku gtsang bdag bde ba rtag pa mgon po byams pas gsungs pa dang*/ longs sku mtshan dpe rdzogs pa 'khor 'das kyi yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa gser 'od kyi sku gsum ston pa'i longs sku'i skabs dang mngon rtogs rgyan las bshad pa dang*/ de gnyis dbyer med kyi phrin las sprul pa'i skur ston pa yang mngon rtogs rgyan las/ gang gis srid pa ji srid bar// zhes sogs dang sku gsum tha dad med pa ni/ mgon po byams pas/ chos kyi sku las ma g.yos par//

sprul pa'i rang bzhin sna tshogs kyis// zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ ngo bo chos sku las rnam pa gzugs sku gnyis su snang ba'i phyir chos sku nyid las med pas| des na nyon mongs dag pa'i rang gzugs chos sku/ de mtshan dpes brgyan pa longs sku/ gang la gang 'dul du snang ba sprul sku yin pas tha dad med pa nyid do// bco lnga pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad sems can gyi khams rgyud la bzhugs bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas thams cad dang por sems bskyed pa nas bzung*/ byang chub kyi spyod pa spyad de ye shes brnyes shing chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang*/ bstan pa gnas pa sogs thams cad sems can gyi don du mdzad pa las gzhan du med pas zhi ba'i dbyings su bzhugs pa mi srid la/ zhi ba'i dbyings las gzhan pa ni 'khor bar gnas pa'i sems can gyi khams rgyud de dkon mchog rjes su dran pa las/ mya ngan las 'da' ba la mi gnas pa/ yang dag pa nyid kyi mtha' la gnas pa/ sems can thams cad la gzigs pa'i sa la bzhugs pa zhes so// de yang khab mig gi nam mkha' ltar tshad brtsi ba min gyi/ sems can re re'i rgyud la yang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ma tshang ba med par tshul ji ltar bzhugs she na/ mgon po byams pas/ rdzogs sangs sku ni 'phro phyir dang*// de bzhin nyid dbyer med phyir dang*// rigs yod phyir na lus can kun| |rtag tu sangs rgyas snying po can// zhes dang*/ de'i snga 'grel las/ sangs rgyas ye shes sems can tshogs zhugs phyir// rang bzhin dri med de ni gnyis med phyir// sangs rgyas rigs la de 'bras nyer btags phyir// 'gro kun sangs rgyas snying po can du gsungs// zhes dang*/ 'o na bzhugs tshul ji lta bu snang tshul ji lta bu zhe na/ ji skad du/ 'gro ba 'di dag sangs rgyas lnga'i bdag nyid// gar mkhan mchog dang ri mo bzang ltar gnas// gang du bde chen zhes bya gcig pu nyid// gcig pu nyid la du ma'i brdar mdzad do// zhes so// de ni thog ma med pa nas sangs rgyas rang gi khams rgyud la bzhugs pa yang ma dag pa med pa dag pa gnyis ldan du bzhugs te/

mgon po byams pas/ sems can khams kyi nyon mongs sbubs| |ma 'brel thog ma med pa na// sems kyi rang bzhin dri med ni// thog ma med par yin par brjod// ces so// de nyid las nyon shes sgrib kyis bsgribs pas de nyid bsal bya ste/ rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa las/ sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas te// 'on kyang glo bur dri mas bsgribs// de bsal na ni sangs rgyas te// zhes so| |sangs rgyas kyi yul ni sems can gyi khams rgyud la dgongs kyi/ la la dag sangs rgyas spyan 'dren pa dang gshegs su gsol ba'i tshe bde ba can dang 'og min dang*/ mngon dga' sogs bzang po logs shig na spyan 'dren par sems mod/ de ni bdag gzhan tha dad du 'dzin pa'i dri ma las ma 'das mod/ dag pa'i zhing dang dmyal ba la sogs pa dge sdig gi rang gzugs las gzhan logs su med pa ni/ zhi ba lhas/ lcags sreg sa gzhi su yis byas// mo tshogs de dag ci las byung*// de 'dra de dag thams cad kyang*// sdig sems yin par thub pas gsungs// zhes pa dang*/ dri ma med par grags pa'i mdor/ zhing 'di shā ri'i bus mtho dman can sogs phal par mthong*/ sangs rgyas mya ngan med kyi zhing nas 'ongs pa'i tshangs pa ral pa can gyis gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi gnas kho na lta bur mthong ba la/ sangs rgyas kyis 'khor rnams la zhing 'di shar phyogs kyi sangs rgyas rin po che'i rgyan bkod pa'i zhing dang 'dra bar bstan nas rnam pa kun tu dag pa'i ngor de ltar yod tshul gsungs pa lta bu yin la/ gzhan yang rang bzhin gyi gnas zhes bya ba sems can gyi khams rgyud yin te/ rgyu mtshan rang bzhin gyis zhes bya ba 'dus ma byas pa lhun gyis grub pa sogs kyi don yin la/ de sems can gyi khams bde gshegs snying po'i ming las gzhan min la/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyang sems can gyi khams rgyud de nyid la bzhugs pa ste/ mtshan brjod las/

sems can kun gyi yid la 'jug /sems can kun gyi yid ltar mgyogs// sems can kun gyi dbang don shes// sems can kun gyi yid 'phrog pa// zhes dang*/ yang de nyid las/ sems can kun yid yul dang ldan// sems can kun gyi yid rig pa// sems can kun gyi yid la gnas// de dag sems dang mthun par 'jug /ces sogs gsungs pa'i phyir mdor na nga dang gzhan du 'dzin pa'i dri ma med pa zhig dgos kyi/ gnyis 'dzin can rnams rdzogs byang thob pa mi srid do// zhes 'bras bu sangs rgyas sa'i gnad bsdus kyi tshoms gsal bar byed pa ste spyi don bdun pa'o/// / ༈ /spyi don brgyad pa lhan thabs gsung bzhi bcu pa 'chad pa la rdo rje'i gsung bzhi bcu rtsa bdun mchis pa las/ dang po/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi rgyal ba thams cad kyi bstan pa gcig bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas thams cad thugs bskyed pa nas mya ngan las 'da' ba'i bar gzhan don kho na las gzhan gang du'ang mi 'da' ba'i gnad kyis yi ge dang*/ gsung dang*/ chos dang*/ sku mnyam zhing mtshungs pa kho na yin te/ laṅkar gshegs pa las/ blo gros chen po/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ni mtshungs pa rnam pa bzhi la dgongs nas 'khor gyi nang du gshegs nas 'di lta ste/ nga nyid de'i tshe de'i dus na log par dad sel dang*/ gser thub dang*/ 'od srung du gyur to// zhes so// mtshungs pa bzhi ni/ yi ge mtshungs pa bud+dha zhes pa khong du chud pa dang sangs rgyas zhes sogs la 'jug pa dang/ gsung mtshungs pa gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu/ chos mtshungs pa byang chub kyi phyogs chos sum cu rtsa bdun/ sku mtshungs pa chos kyi sku las mi g.yo bar gzugs skus 'gro don mdzad pa/ des na chos thams cad kyi babs kyi gnas lugs stong nyid rten 'brel zung 'jug tu gcig pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa/ theg pa dang grub mtha' thams cad sangs rgyas kyi rten 'brel bya ba ni/ gdul bya dang 'dul byed la sogs pa thams cad sangs rgyas tshogs gnyis goms pa phul du phyin pa'i rten 'brel kho na las ma 'das la/

de yang phyi nang gsang ba dang gang zag gi rten 'brel rnams yin te/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ rten cing 'brel 'byung ma gtogs pa'i// chos 'ga' yod pa ma yin no// zhes dang*/ dran pa nyer bzhag las/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i chos thams cad rten 'brel yin/ zhes dang*/ ji skad du/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung 'di rgyal ba yi// gsung gi mdzod kyi gces pa zab mo ste// zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir ro// gsum pa/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por gsungs bya ba ni/ chos kyi phung po'i rnam bzhag dang grangs nges ni gzhan gang gis kyang mi 'byed de/ nyon mongs pa'i grangs dang de'i gnyen por de'i grangs su gsungs te/ rnam snang mngon byang las/ nyon mongs rnams kyi gnyen por ni| |phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs// zhes so// des na spyir rags pa la nyon mongs brgyad khri bzhi stong gi gnyen por chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pa tsam byas kyi/ dbye na sems can gyi khams rgyud la nyon mongs phra rags grangs las 'das pa'i gnyen por chos phung yang grangs las 'das la/ des na nyon mongs thams cad kyi rtsa ba ma rig pa'i gnyen por chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba spros bral phyag rgya chen po bstan te/ ji skad du/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dang*// bzhi stong gsungs pa gang yin pa// chos nyid 'di la gzhol zhing 'bab// ces gsungs so// bzhi pa/ gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis po gcig gi nang du'ang bcu gnyis po thams cad ci rigs su tshang bya ba ni/ dper na mdo sde lta bu'i nang du thog mar gleng gzhi gsungs pa dang*/ de nyid kyi skabs 'ga' zhig tshigs su bcad pa dang*/ de dbyangs kyis bsnyad cing*/ ma 'ongs pa'i byang sems sogs lung ston pa dang*| dag pa'i zhing gzhan dang de'i ston pa la ched du brjod pa'i tshul dang*/ bdag gzhan gyi rtogs pa brjod pa dang*/

de 'dra ba gsungs pas de lta bu byung ba dang*/ rang dang gzhan gyi skyes rabs gsung pa dang*/ de nyid tshig don shin tu rgyas pa dang*/ don gtan la 'bebs pa dang*/ rmad du byung ba'i tshig sogs chol por 'dres can du tshang bas na ci rigs su tshang ba ste/ bskal pa bzang po sogs la yang don gyis ci rigs pa tshang ba'i phyir ro// lnga pa/ sde snod re re bzhin du sde snod gsum char 'dus bya ba ni/ ston pas sde snod gsum 'dres can du gsungs kyang sdud pa pos rnyed sla ba sogs rgyu mtshan 'ga' zhig la bsams nas so sor bsdu bar mdzad kyang*/ 'dul ba'i nang du mdo sde dang mngon pa'i tshig don ches mang ba bzhugs la/ de bzhin du mdo mngon gnyis la yang 'dul ba sogs ci rigs pa 'dres can du yod de/ rgyu mtshan 'khor lo gsum gyi tshig don 'dres can du gsungs pa sngar bshad pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis 'dres can du bzhugs pa go sla'o// drug pa/ bka' thams cad la phun sum tshogs pa lnga tshang ba dang*// bdun pa/ 'khor 'das thams cad phun sum tshogs pa lngas bsdus bya ba ni/ 'di la spyir 'khor 'das gnyis tha dad med par rtogs ma rtogs su bzhed pa dang*/ rdo rje gur las ye shes kyi bye brag 'gro ba rigs drug kar dngos bstan du gsungs pa dang*/ gsang sngags snga 'gyur ba rnams 'gro ba rigs drug so so'i gnas su ngo bo tha mi dad la snang tshul so sor snang ba'i thub pa drug tu sprul par gsungs pas thub pa drug dngos su gsungs rjes de dag gi chos 'khor dus gnas rnams shugs 'byung du gsal ba sogs rnam pa mang po'i sgo nas 'chad par spro na'ang yi ges ngal bas yan lag gi bshad pa'i spros pa rnams re zhig dor nas/ 'dir dgongs pa'i rtsa ba 'chad de/ 'khor ba 'gro ba rigs drug gam lnga dang*/ myang 'das byang chub gsum mam/ 'phags pa'i gang zag bzhi la sogs pa thams cad mthar thug 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi ye shes phun tshogs lnga'i bdag nyid las gang du yang ma 'das pa yin te/

rgyu mtshan ston 'khor chos sogs gcig las du mar snang ba ma gtogs ngo bo tha dad med par brtag gnyis las/ 'chad pa po nga chos kyang nga*// sogs gsungs pa'i phyir dang*/ gzhi 'khor ba'i gnas skabs su chos thams cad ye shes de'i ngo bor gdod nas grub pa/ kun rdzob tu las nyon gyis 'phangs pa'i 'bras bu sdug bsngal tsha grang bkres skom glen rmugs sogs myong ba phun tshogs lnga bsdus ma yin pa ltar snang yang*/ ye shes de 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad kyi ngo bor gsungs pas sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin yang rang rang gi ngo bos stong pa spros bral ye shes chen po las ma 'das pa don dam bden pa ste rnam pa kun tu bden gnyis zung 'jug las 'da' ba med pa'i gnad dang*/ stong dang rten 'brel dbyer med la dgongs shing*/ gzhan yang 'khor 'das dbyer med ces pa dge ba'i rang gzugs kyis mngon mtho dang nges legs gnyis dang*/ mi dge ba'i rang gzugs kyis 'gro ba rigs drug tu snang yang*/ snang cha de tsam las ngo bo de dang der 'dzin ltar ma grub pa thams cad chos nyid don dam pa'i bden pa spros bral zhi ba chen po las ma 'das pa sngar lung mang du drangs pa ltar dang*/ sems can thams cad la khams bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po sgrib med du yod pa mgon po byams pas rnam pa kun tu gsungs mod/ bde gshegs snying po de ni yon tan phun tshogs lnga ldan las mi 'da' ste/ dper na sa bon du bzhag pa'i nas la yang btags na rtsam pa 'byung la/ sa bon btab pa'i nas su smin pa yang btags na rtsam pa 'byung ba dang chos mtshungs pa'i phyir sogs lung rigs du ma'i cha nas legs par grub bo// da lta kun rdzob 'khrul ngor 'khor ba pa la phun tshogs lnga ldan mi 'dug pa 'dra ba 'di ni rang rang gi mi dge ba'i las kyi rang gzugs de rang gis mthong ba yin mod/ mkhris nad can gyis dung ser por mthong yang*/ dung gi gshis dkar po kho na las mi 'da' zhing rang mkhris nad las grol na dung gi mdog dkar po nyid du mthong ba ltar/

khams rang bzhin rnam dag gi gshis bde gshegs snying po phun tshogs lnga ldan las ma 'das kyang mi dge ba'i las kyi 'bras bus ngan song gi sdug bsngal myong ba ltar snang mod/ las de dang bral nas mya ngan las 'das pa phun sum tshogs pa'i bdag nyid gdod nas yongs grub tu rtogs par 'gyur ba ni dgongs pa dpyis phyin pa 'khrul pa'i rang bzos ma slad pa yin la/ lung rigs ni sngar mang du bshad pa rnams 'dir sbyor bar rigs so// gzhan yang ji skad du/ dmyal ba'i lcags sreg sa gzhi de// yang dag don gyi 'og min yin// zhes sogs kyang don 'di thog tu 'bab pas go bar bya dgos la/ rdo sher ma sogs su/ ston pa a wa glang mgo/ 'khor dmyal ba'i sems can/ chos tsha grang gi sdug bsngal/ dus de ka'i tshe tshad/ gnas dmyal ba sogs bshad pa yang gnas skabs su brjod bya rjod byed mi mdzes kyang shes bya la srid tshad kyis sangs rgyas kyi bya ba byed pa'i dgongs pa dang*/ srid gsum ye nas sangs rgyas yin pa'i lung dang*/ sangs rgyas dngos kyis chos gsung yang rgyu 'bras las gzhan med na dmyal bar rgyu 'bras dngos su gtan la phab pa chos rnam dag 'gyur ba sogs lung rigs mang pos dpyad na bshad pa de 'dra ba don gyi cha nas legs par thob cing rmad du byung ba'i go bar zad do// bka' thams cad kyi gleng gzhi la chos phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang zer yang 'dir bka' thams cad la phun sum tshogs pa lnga nges par tshang bar bzhed pa rtsa bar rdor gsung gcig tu byas pa rje zhwa dmar pa bzhi pas kyang der mdzad na'ang*/ rdo sher mar 'khor 'das thams cad phun sum tshogs pa lnga'i khongs su bsdus pas sa bcad drug pa dang*/ bdun pa gnyis gcig tu byas pas so// brgyad pa/ thun mong gi mdo dang sems tsam ston pa'i bka' ni mngon pa'i sde snod du bzhed pa ni/ 'dul ba ni spyi dang mthun/ mdo dang mngon pa thun mong du rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum sogs dang*/

mngon pa gong ma sems tsam ston pa'i mdo phal po che dang*/ gtan la dbab pa/ lang gshegs/ rgyan stug po bzhi sogs nges don ston pa rnams so// mngon pa 'og ma sde bdun gyi phyogs su 'dul ba dang*/ mngon pa 'og ma thun mong du 'ong ba'i mdo theg chung gi mdo rnams yin zhing*/ mdo sde'i ngos 'dzin ma byung yang*/ de las gzhan pa'i drang nges 'dres par ston pa'i mdo rnams la dgongs zhes rje zhwa dmar pa bzhi pas gsungs pa don la gnas pas so// dgu pa/ mu stegs dang bon gyi sgor zhugs pas bden pa mthong ba'i gnas med bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas pa lta ba mtha' bral du bzhed par/ mu stegs rnams rtag chad gang rung lta bar khas len cing dkon mchog gsum la log par lta ba dang*/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad dang bral ba sogs kyi rang rgyud kyi lta ba de ma dor bar du sangs rgyas mi 'thob la/ bon ni sangs rgyas ma byung ba sgro btags shing des bstan pa'i don zhes phyin ci log tu bsgyur bas gnad 'chug pa sogs log pa'i lam du zhugs pas chos de ma dor bar du 'tshang mi rgya ste/ mdo sde gtan la phab pa las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung rab log par bsgyur ba rnams bdud kyis byin gyis brlabs pa yin no// zhes dang*/ mgon po byams pas/ gang zhig yid ni chos la sdang ba de la thar pa ga la yod// ces gsungs so// bcu pa/ thar pa'i cha dang mthun pa 'ga' zhig ni yod par mi 'gal bya ba ni/ snga ma'i 'phro bon dang mu stegs 'tshang rgya ba mi srid kyang thar pa'i cha dang mthun pa 'ga' zhig ni yod de/ bsod nams cha mthun dge ba bcu spyod pa'i steng du thar pa zhes pa myang 'das yin pas| de'i cha shas 'khor ba la yid skyo zhing myang 'das thob 'dod kyi bsam pa tsam yod mod/ 'on kyang 'tshang mi rgya ba ni theg chen gyi skyabs sems dang rdo rje theg pa'i smin grol sogs lam gyi gnad rnams med cing*/ yod pa yang phyin ci log tu song bas 'tshang mi rgya ba yin no// bcu gcig pa/

sdom pa srung ba dang snying rje phyi rol pa la'ang yod bya ba ni/ dge ba bcus mi dge ba bcu bsdams pas sdom pa'i tha snyad tsam 'dogs rung bar rnam snang mngon byang nas bshad pas phyi rol pa la dge bcu tsam yod pa dang*/ sdug bsngal can la snying brtse ba ni lhag par khong la yod pas sngar ti ser mu stegs pa bcu gnas skor la phyin tshe dgu lhags pas shi/ gcig lus par brgya byin gyis bgam pa'i dpe sngar bshad pa ltar dang*/ 'dod yon spong zhing dka' thub spyod pa sogs sangs rgyas pa las phyi rol pa ches 'bad brtson che ba yin na'ang*/ mdzod kyi rang 'grel las/ phyi rol pa rnams la yang dag par blang ba'i tshul khrims yod dam zhe na/ yod mod kyi/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pa ni ma yin no// ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni srid pa la brten pa'i phyir sdig pa las so sor thar par byed pa ma yin no// zhes gsungs pas dbye ba phyed dgos so// bcu gnyis pa/ rgyu mtshan nyid kyi theg pas kyang tshe gcig gis 'tshang rgya bar bzhed pa ni/ rang gi skal ba dang bsod nams kyi mthu yod cing*/ bla ma mtshan ldan gyis bstan pa'i lam tshang la ma nor ba dang*/ rang gis nyams len brtson pa rmad du byung ba zhig ste/ rgyu tshogs de rnams 'dzom na mtshan nyid theg pas kyang tshe gcig la yang 'tshang rgya ba 'ong la/ rgyu tshogs de rnams ma 'dzom na sngags kyi theg pas kyang tshe gcig la 'tshang rgya ba mi 'grub la/ gtso bor rgyu tshogs de 'dra ba 'dzoms pa gal che ba ste/ zhib pa sngar sdom pa gsum 'chad pa'i skabs su bshad grub bo// bcu gsum pa/ chos dang nyams len gyi 'gros kyis sangs rgyas gcig bya ba ni/ skyabs yul de dag gi ngo bo la khyad med cing*/ sa'i grangs bcu gcig dang bcu gsum gnyis/ snga ma ni bcu gcig pas sangs rgyas kyi sa dang*/ phyi ma rtsa mdud grol ba dang las rlung 'pho ba bcu gnyis 'gags te bcu gsum pa sangs rgyas su bzhag pa ste/

de ni ngo bo sa bcur mthun zhing nang gses kyi dbye ba yin la/ chos thog mtha' bar gsum du dge zhing nyams len bslab pa gsum mam dge sgrub sdig spong du 'dra bar sangs rgyas ni de gnyis gang gis bsgrub kyang thob zin par mchog dman med pa gcig go// bcu bzhi pa// sdom pa gsum gong nas gong du dog tu 'gro bya ba ni/ so thar sdom pas nyon mongs rags pa spong zhing khrims nyis brgya dang lnga bcu rtsa gsum grangs kyang nyung la de nyid lus ngag yid gsum tha mal gyi ngang nas bsrung*/ byang sdom rnam pa thams cad du gzhan don kho na las mi 'da' zhing rtsa ltung yang so thar las grangs mang bas cung zad snga ma las dog /sngags sdom ni sgo gsum ga'i nyon mongs shin tu phra ba yang spong zhing de yang tha mal gyi snang zhen spangs nas lha sku sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin las mi 'da' bas snga ma gnyis ka las srung sdom dka' yang so thar la sdom pa gong ma gnyis kyi rmang rdo mi dgos la/ byang sems la so thar gyi rtsa ba skyabs 'gro sogs dgos shing*/ sngags sdom ni thog mar so thar ris bdun gang rung gi gzhi la/ theg chen sems bskyed dang ldan pa la gzod sngags sdom sbyin dgos pas ches dka'/ srung mtshams kyang jo bo chen po a ti shas/ kho bo la so thar gyi sdom pa la ni nyes ltung gtan mi 'ong*/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa la skabs skabs su tsag tsig tsam 'ong*/ gsang sngags kyi sdom pa la ni ltung ba char gcig nyar gcig tu 'ong*/ zhes gsungs pas kyang grub bo// bco lnga pa/ mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi sa tshun chad tshogs lam gyi ngo bos bgrod bya ba ni/ tshogs lam chung ngur bsgom pa'i dran pa nye bar bzhag pa'i ngo bos sangs rgyas kyi sa tshun chad bgrod pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi sar chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad la dran pa yongs su nyams pa med par gsungs shing*/ skabs brgyad kyi rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i skabs/

de la rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ dran pas dbang bsgyur ba zhi ba'i rnam pa can zhes gsungs pa dang*/ ma 'dres pa'i dran pa nyer bzhag gsum po'ang dran pa'i na rim pas 'phar nas/ dbang po stobs byang chub yan lag 'phags lam brgyad rnams su ngo bo dag cing yon tan 'phel ba'i mthar thug yin pa'i phyir dang*/ tshogs lam chung ngur bsgom pa'i dran pa nyer bzhag de nyid kyi ngo bo gong nas gong du na 'phar ba sangs rgyas kyi sa bgrod pa yin te/ mgon po 'bri gung pa chen po ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi spyan mnga' ba de'i zhal snga nas/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi gzhung lam de// dus rgyun chad med pa'i dran pa yin// dran pa yengs med ma shes na// lus ngag tab tab kyi kha na med// ces gsungs so// dran pa nye bar bzhag pa'i ngo bo na 'phar ba'i thabs khyad par can gyi theg chen sems bskyed dang ldan pa'i tshogs gnyis zung 'jug tu rdzogs pa nyid yin no// bcu drug pa/ nyan rang sangs rgyas kyi rgyu dang ldan pas mthar thug byang chub snying por 'gyur bya ba ni/ 'ga' zhig gis/ dmyal bar 'gro ba sangs rgyas pa'i// gtan gyi gegs byed ma yin te// nyan thos dang ni rang rgyal gyi// sa ni gtan gyi gegs yin no// zhes pa'i tha mar gegs zhes bya ba la go don ma 'phrod pas sangs rgyas pa mi srid ces 'dod pa de 'gog pa ste/ nyan rang yang lam de las slar theg chen du sems bskyed pas 'tshang rgya ba yin la/ nyan rang de yang smon lam gyi mthus theg chen du sems mi bskyed pa mi srid pa la dgongs te/ ji skad du/ ji ltar mi dag ra ro pa// chang gis bral ba sad pa bzhin// de nas de dag nga yis kyang*// ye shes dam pa skye bar 'gyur// zhes dang*/ dpal phreng gi mdo las/ me'i dpes nyan thos su gyur nas rang sangs rgyas su 'gyur ro// phyis ni sangs rgyas su'ang 'gyur zhes sogs gsungs so// bcu bdun pa/

'khor ba mtha' med spros pa med bya ba ni/ 'khor ba dang myang 'das rtogs ma rtogs kyi dbye ba las gzhan med pa'i phyir/ 'khor ba la thog mtha' bar gsum med de de spros pa dang bral bas so// slob dpon zla ba grags pa'i dbu ma la 'jug pa las/ thog ma dang po tha ma mtha'// de dag med pas 'khor ba ni// thog ma tha ma med par brjod// 'gro 'ong bral phyir rmi lam lta'i// srid 'di de yis dben nyid gang*// de ni thog ma dang tha ma| |med pa stong pa nyid do zhes// bstan bcos las ni nges par bsnyad// ces rgya cher gsungs so// bco brgyad pa/ chos kun so sor thar sdom re rer 'du bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad sdom pa gsum gang rung re re la yang 'du ste/ 'dul ba la mtshon na yang*/ bsrung thabs kyi yan lag thams cad rgyu bsod nams kyi tshogs dang sdom pa'i ngo bo rnam rig min pa 'bras bu ye shes kyi tshogs yin la/ de bzhin du mdo sde'i nyams len byang sems rnam pa gnyis su 'dus pa dang*/ sngags su thabs shes gnyis su 'du ba sogs nas chos thams cad sdom gsum re rer 'du ba yang bzhed de/ gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdo las/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i chos thams cad ni bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis kyi nang du 'dus pa rig par bya'o zhes dang*/ gzhan yang chos thams cad stong nyid spros bral gyi steng du gzhol zhing 'bab pa dang yang mthun no// bcu dgu pa/ sde pa bzhi char gyi rtsa ba lung sde bzhi 'di nyid kho na yin bya ba ni/ mdo las/ kun dga' bo nga 'das nas ston pa so sor thar pa la zhus zhes sogs gsungs pas/ sde ba bzhi dang de las gyes pa bco brgyad po thams cad 'dul ba lung sde bzhi 'di nyid las sde pa re la lung sde bzhi mi 'dra ba re med pa yin te/ ston pas mtha' gnyis su mi gsung ba'i phyir dang*/ ston pas lung sde bzhi gsung ba'i tshe sde pa so so la gyes pa'i phyir/

phyis sde pa rnams rtags cha lugs dang lag len cung zad mi 'dra ba ltar snang ba ni rtsa bar go lugs dang bla ma'i phyag bzhes kyi khyad par tsam las 'dul lung la khyad ci yang med do// kha cig gis/ nyan thos sde pa bco brgyad la// 'dul ba mi 'dra bco brgyad yod// sogs zer zhing de'i shes byed du/ byin len/ nub lhag snam sbyar gyi rtags sogs mi 'dra ba 'dren pa dag ches 'khrul te/ de las gzhan pa'i 'dul ba tha dad du yod pa'i lung dang yid ches khong la ci yang med pa'i phyir/ 'di dag gi skor gyi spros pa sdom gsum gyi tshoms so so'i skabs su bgyis yod pas 'dir ma spros so// des na nyan rang min pa'i theg chen sa bcu pa rnams kyis kyang bslab gzhi bca' bar mi nus pas bslab pa'i gzhi bca' ba ni sangs rgyas kho na'i spyod yul yin pa'i phyir lung sde bzhi sde pa bzhi char la gcig po 'di las gzhan pa tha dad med do// nyi shu pa/ bsgrub par mi nus pa las rmi lam du nyams kyang nyes pa 'byung bya ba ni/ lung las/ rmi lam ni med pa dang 'dra'o// de'i nyes pa ni ma byas nyid do// zhes gsungs pa ni/ yang lung las| shes gtso 'du shes gzhan du gyur pa nyid na'o// zhes dang*/ yang de nyid las/ smyo ba dang sems 'khrugs pa la ltung ba med do// zhes gsungs pa la dgongs te bsgrub par mi nus pa zhes 'du shes 'khrul ba rmi lam sogs su chags pa'i 'du shes dang*/ yul bud med dang khye'u sogs la ma spyad par dbang med du nad gdon sogs kyis 'dzag pa la nyes med du dgongs shing*/ de las yul yul can la chags sems kyis spyad pa'i rmi lam dang bcas nyams pa la ni shes pa mngon sum dang 'dra ste/ ci'i phyir na kun rdzob tu ni mngon sum dang rmi lam gnyis ka yod par grub cing*/ don dam du ma grub pa lam gyi skabs su bzhed dgos te/ rje mi las/ kun rdzob bden pa'i dbang du ni// thams cad yod ces thub pas gsungs| |don dam bden pa'i dbang du ni// gegs las sangs rgyas nyid kyang med// ces gsungs pa yang lam dus la dgongs kyi/

lta ba'i skabs su 'di 'dra la dgongs zhes 'chad na rnam par ma dag par 'gyur bas skabs thob kyi dgongs pa shes dgos so// nyer gcig pa/ dag pa'i sa thob kyang ngan 'gror song ba'ang yod bya ba ni/ dag pa'i sa gang rung thob pas gzhi bsam sbyor ba mthar thug gi yan lag tshang ba'i mi dge ba spyod pa mi srid snyam pa bden mod/ 'on kyang de'i rgyud kyi kun gzhi'i rnam shes dri bcas/ shes sgrib bag nyal du yod pa des mi dge ba chung 'bring chen po gang spyad kyang de'i 'bras bu ngan song gsum du 'gro ste/ bdag cag gi ston pa byang sems gzhon nu chu skyes su gyur pa'i tshe de'i skye ba snga ma rgyal por skyes pas mi dge ba spyad pa'i mthus dmyal bar skyes pa dang rgyal po dpa' bas byin gyis me tog zla mdzes bsad pas ngan song du skyes pa dang*/ sor phreng can shar phyogs kyi zhing du sangs rgyas kyang bdag cag gi ston pa'i spyan sngar sor phreng can du sprul pa dgra bcom thob kyang las 'bras kyis lus la dmyal mes gdungs pa dang*/ rgyal po ma skyes dgras mtshams med byas pa'i sgrib pa sbyangs nas mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob kyang dmyal bar yud tsam skyes pa sogs gleng gzhis kyang shes la/ byang chub sems dpa' de 'dra bas tshogs gnyis bsags nas rdzogs byang thob dgos na/ mi dge ba spyad na ngan 'gror 'gro ba rigs pas kyang grub la/ sangs rgyas nyid kyang rgyu 'bras las gzhan pa longs mi spyod cing mi gsung na byang sems la lta ci smos/ bdag cag gi ston pa'i 'khrungs rabs las/ so gsum pa ma he'i skyes pa'i rabs las/ ji skad du/ de dud 'gro'i skyes gnas chos kyi 'du shes dkon pa gti mug che ba'i gnas su skyes pa yang rnam par shes pa gsal bas chos spyod pa la mi brtson par ma gyur to// 'dris phyir de yi snying rje mi 'dor ba// de ltar snying rjes kyang ni de ma dor// las kyi dbang gis de ltar der gyur tam// de nyid mthu yis de ni de ltar gyur// de yi phyir na bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang*// las kyi rnam par smin pa bsam mi khyab// snying rje'i bdag nyid can yang dud 'gror skyes// de yang chos kyi 'du shes skye bar 'gyur// las med na ni skye ba'i mtshams mi sbyor// dge ba'i rnam par smin pas mi bde med// chos kyi 'du shes yod kyang las dbang gis// de dang de rten de ltar 'gyur bar gsungs// zhes lung gis kyang gsal por grub pa yin pas ham stobs kyis bsnyon du med do// nyer gnyis pa/

rgyu spyad na sa bcu pa'ang ngan 'gror ltung bya ba ni/ snga ma dag pa'i sar ma zad sa bcu pas rgyu mi dge ba mi spyod mod/ spyad na de yang ngan 'gror ltung ste rgyu 'bras mi bslu ba'i phyir zhes tha tshig la dgongs nas slar gsungs te/ rgyu mtshan mu bzhir nges te/ dang po sangs rgyas rnams kyis thugs bskyed tshul dang*/ gnyis pa rgyu 'bras kyi rten 'brel 'khor 'das gnyis ka la 'gyur ba med pa dang*/ gsum pa sangs rgyas kyi phrin las sems can la 'jug tshul rgyun mi 'chad par lhun gyis grub pa dang*/ bzhi pa bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kyi gsang ba ste bzhi po 'di go dgos pa'i gnad dang*/ sa thob pas mi dge pa spyad na de'i 'bras bu ngan song du 'gro na yang so skye mi shes pa can las ni ches yang ste/ ji skad du/ mkhas pas sdig pa byas pa mod la byang*// blun pos sdig pa byas pa lci bar 'gyur// lcags kyi gong bu chung yang gting du 'gro// de nyid snod du byas pa mkha' la 'phyo// zhes so// rgyu ma spyad kyang smon lam gyi dbang gis byang sems ngan 'gror 'gro ba yang yod mod/ de la ches sdug bsngal gyi bsam pa ni med de/ theg pa chen po la dad pa rab tu sgom pa'i mdo las/ byang chub sems dpa'i bde 'gro yang ngan 'gro yin la/ ngan 'gro yang bde 'gror rig par bya'o// zhes dang*/ de nyid las/ gsol ba/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ byang chub sems dpa' smon lam gyi dbang gis sems can dmyal ba dang*/ dud 'gro dang yi dwags rnams su skye ba yang*/ de gzhan du sdug bsngal ba'i rmongs pa lags sam/ bka' stsal pa/ de ni de ltar mi lta'o// byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam gyi dbang gis ngan 'gro rnams su skye ba ni/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i sa pa'i bde ba las shin tu 'das nas bde ba dang ldan te/ 'jig rten pa thams cad dang 'jig rten las 'das pa dman pa'i shes rab kyang shin tu 'das nas shes rab kyi rgyu ba la 'jug go// zhes gsungs pa sogs go dgos so// nyer gsum pa/

nyams len rmad du byung ba rnal 'byor nang gi tshogs gsog bya ba'i spyod pa 'di ni/ bdag cag gi ston pa bzod pa dang brtson 'grus phun sum tshogs pas brgyan pa de'i lam bgrod pa'i lugs yin la/ de ni grangs med pa gsum la 'di tshod ces pa'i grangs 'dul lung sman gzhi sogs na bzhugs/ 'dir tshogs gsog la zhing bsam dngos po rnam par dag pa gal che/ de la ni 'di ni bla ma gong ma'i thugs nyams su bzhes pa'i chos khyad par du 'phags pa ku sā la'i nyams len nang gi tshogs gsog rmad du byung ba yin te/ 'di la tshogs zhing khyad par 'phags pa mchog dman thams cad gdan 'dzoms pa/ dmigs yul khyad par du 'phags pa 'gro drug gi sgrib sbyong*/ dngos po khyad par du 'phags pa rang lus sha khrag gi tshogs 'khor sogs gnad mang du yod pas chos khyad par du 'phags shing*/ sgrub pa'i dus kyang nad gdon bar chad la sogs pa gang la yang gegs sel gyi mchog dam pa yin la/ rdo sher ma sogs na mi bzhugs kyang*/ rtsa bar sgrub pa byed pa la sogs pa'i dus su nad dang gnod pa sogs byung na phyi nang gi rten 'brel gyis phan par 'dod pa yin mod kyi/ 'dir ni de rnams sel ba'i thabs lam gtong dang dmigs pa yin par bzhed do// zhes bya ba yod pa yang 'di'i khongs su bsdu zhing 'du lugs ni go sla bas ma spros so// nyer bzhi pa/ ting nge 'dzin gyis bsdus tshad rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin du gcig bya ba ni/ tshogs sbyor nas sa bcu pa'i bar du ting nge 'dzin mi 'dra ba du ma 'byung la/ rgyun mtha'i tshe rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin brnyes par bshad pa de yang yin te/ 'dir sems gsal stong zung 'jug tshogs drug gi rtog pas mi g.yo bar gnas pa la zhi gnas dang*/ de'i ngo bo gsal rig stong pa sogs la brtag dpyad byed pa lhag mthong gi shes rab tu deng sang bzhed pa ni mtshon byed kyi dpe tsam la btags kyi/

don dam du zhi gnas mtshan nyid pas tshogs sbyor gnyis bgrod nas/ mthong lam thob pa dang lhag mthong mtshan nyid pa rgyud la skye zhing sa dang po rab dga' thob ces ming btags la/ de'i ting nge 'dzin gyi ngo bo ni rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin yin/ 'di la rdo rje lta bu zhes 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan mya ngan las 'das pa chen po'i mdo las/ rigs kyi bu dper na nor bu rin po che thams cad kyi nang na rdo rje mchog ste/ de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' chen po rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin thob pa yang de dang 'dra ste/ ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi gtso bor gyur to// de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ting 'dzin de bsgom na ting 'dzin thams cad 'dir 'dus par 'gyur ro// zhes dang yang de nyid las/ ting nge 'dzin thams cad rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis dbang bsgyur ro// zhes gsungs pas/ spyir ting nge 'dzin thams cad la rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyis mi khyab pa med pa dang*/ khyad par du sa bcu'am bcu gsum man chad sa dang po'i rtogs pa na 'phar bas bgrod dgos pas des na ting nge 'dzin thams cad rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin yin pas khyab pa'i phyir ro// nyer lnga pa/ sngags ni sde snod gsum ga dang gsum char gyi snying por bzhed pa ni/ 'chad tshul mang yang go sla ba mdo'am phar phyin theg pa gang zer yang des nyon mongs rags pa spong zhing*/ sngags kyis nyon mongs phra ba ches phra ba spong*/ so thar dang byang sems kyis kyang nyon mongs phra rags tsam spong*/ yang ches shin tu phra ba ni rdo rje theg pa'i lam kho nas spong bar gsungs/ nyon mongs phra rags spangs pas ches phra ba bag nyal dang bcas pa spong dka' la/ ches phra ba bag nyal dang bcas pa spangs na rags pa dang phra ba gzhan spang ba lta ci smos/ yang sdom pa gong ma la 'og ma'i rten dgos pas kyang sngags ni sde snod thams cad kyi snying por yang grub cing sdom pa gsum gnad mi gcig ka med du 'ong ba yin no// nyer drug pa/

rgyud la skyes kyang brgyud pa'i chos zab pas cho ga dgos bya ba ni/ rgyud la ye shes skyes kyang dbang po rab 'bring tha ma gsum la brgyud pa dang ldan pa'i dbang bskur nges par dgos te/ dbang don cha 'dra rgyud la skyes kyang dbang ma bskur na tshogs ma smin pa dang*/ gzhan don dbang rgyun med pa dang*/ cho ga sangs rgyas kyi mkhyen pa'i ye shes yin pa sogs dang*/ tha ma la yang dbang bskur bas rgyud la bag chags 'jog pa dang*/ thun mong du*/ ji skad du/ smin pa dang ni grol ba'i lam// sangs rgyas byang chub bstan pa'i mchog /ces smin grol gnyis sngags lam gyi dngos gzhi yin pas rgyud la sngags lam yongs rdzogs ma tshang ba dang*/ sngags sdom mi skye ba sogs nyes pa mang po'i sgo 'gags shing rten 'brel rmad byung mang du mchis pa la dgongs pa 'di'i skabs don yin la/ gzhan rang byung rnams la 'jug chog dgos pa dang 'di mtshungs pa'i phyir ro// nyer bdun pa/ lha gcig gis kyang phrin las thams cad 'grub par byed bya ba ni/ lha pho reng mo reng zhig yin yang de'i sku gsung thugs dang phung khams skye mched 'byung ba bzhi sogs kyi cha nas rigs gsum dang*/ lnga dang*/ brgya sogs don gyis nges par tshang bas phrin las kyang bzhi dang*/ bcu bzhi dang*/ nyer bzhi/ drug cu rtsa bzhi sogs las rab 'byams gang bsgrubs kyang lha gtso 'khor brgya stong yod pa dang rkyang pa la khyad med de/ zla gsang gi rgyud las/ rigs ni rnam pa brgyar bstan te// re re las kyang dpag med pa// sems can 'dul don rab tu bstan// mdor bsdus na ni rnam pa lnga// lus dang ngag yid sbyor ba yis// gsum du yang ni 'gyur ba yin// zhes dang*/ brtag gnyis las/ sems ni chen po gcig nyid las// lnga yi gzugs kyis rnam par mtshon// rigs ni lnga po de nyid la// stong phrag du ma skye ba nyid// de phyir 'di dag rang bzhin gcig

/ces gsungs pa rigs thams cad bsdu na thugs rdo rje'i rigs gcig pur 'du ste/ ji skad du/ sngags rnams kun gyi mtshan nyid ni// bde bar gshegs pa'i thugs la gnas// zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir sgrub pa pos ting nge 'dzin la drod thob ma thob dang mtshan ma brtan po brnyes ma brnyes kyis las 'grub mi 'grub yin gyi/ lha gtso 'khor mang nyung dang cho ga'i brjod bya legs nyes dang lha la bzang ngan ltar gdam ga byed pa ni shin tu rmongs so// nyer brgyad pa/ lha thams cad kyi mtshan lhag pa'i lhas bzung bya ba ni/ rgyu dus su nyon mongs pa rnams lam dus su sbyangs pas bral ba dang rnam smin gyi 'bras bu de'i yon tan gyi ngo bor sangs rgyas pa dang*/ sku gang 'dul yin yang rnam smin gyi mtshan dpe can dang*/ thugs stobs sogs bral 'bras dang ldan la/ mtshan bcom ldan 'das zhes par yang gcig cing*/ gsol ba btab na byin rlabs 'byung bar yang gcig par mtshungs pa'i phyir/ rab tu gnas pa'i rgyud las/ sku gang rab tu gnas bya ba// de la de yi dkyil 'khor yin// yang na slob dpon rang nyid kyi// slob dpon rang gi lhag pa'i lha// zhes gsungs la/ jo bo rjes kyang*/ bod lha mang bas phongs pa yin/ lhag pa'i lha gcig gi nyams len gyi rkang tshugs shing de'i ye shes sems dpa' spyan 'dren gyi dus rang gang 'dod pa'i lha rnams lhag pa'i lha de'i rnam par spyan drangs nas bstims pas lha de 'grub dus thams cad 'grub 'ong ba zhig yin te/ zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir ro// nyer dgu pa/ dus bzhir rtsa ba'i dam tshig ni gnang ba'i dus skabs med par bzhed pa ni/ bum dbang sogs dbang gi dus bzhi las/ sher dbang gi skabs slob dpon dang slob ma rtsa rlung la rang dbang thob pas byang sems 'dzin nus pa'i brtan pa thob na ma gtogs/ rtsa ba'i ltung ba bzhi'i ya gyal dbang po gnyis sbyor gyi dngos dbang gnang ba'i go skabs med de/

brtag gnyis las/ khu ba med na bde med 'gyur| |bde ba med na de med 'gyur// zhes dang*/ in+d+ra bhū tis/ dbang po gnyis sbyor bde ba ni// de nyid yin zhes skye ngan smra// de ni bde ba che yin zhes// rgyal ba mchog gis ma gsungs so// zhes dang*/ jo bo rjes/ dang po'i sangs rgyas rgyud chen las// rab tu 'bad de bkag pa'i phyir// gsang ba shes rab dbang bskur ni| |tshangs par spyod pas blang mi bya// gal te dbang bskur de 'dzin na// dka' thub can de pham par 'gyur// zhes so// 'o na ji ltar bya zhe na/ slob dpon dge slong sogs yin na gsang dbang dang*/ slob ma dge slong sogs sam rtsa rlung la rang dbang ma thob na sher dbang grol ba'i lam ltar sbyin gyi/ chags lam ltar mi byed/ dmigs pa dang tshig gis sbyin te/ ji skad du/ yang na grol ba'i lam gyis ni// tshig gi dbang bskur sbyin bya ste// zhes sogs gsungs pas rnam dbyer phyed dgos so// sum cu pa/ lha la cig car du 'jug pa gnad zab bya ba ni/ bskyed rim gdod nas yongs grub kyi gnad kyis rang gi phung khams lha dang dbyer med du dang po nyid nas bsgom pa ni bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug gam zab mo bskyed pa'i rim pa zhes gnad zab ste/ mgon po 'bri gung pa chen pos/ tha mal lus ngag yid gsum du// skad cig tsam yang ma shor ba// rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pa yin// gar dgu'i rnam par rol mdzad pa| |dus gsum sangs rgyas ngo bo nyid// he ru ka dpal rdo rje'i sku// byang chub mchog tu 'tshang rgya ba// e ma ngo mtshar mi che'am// zhes gsungs pas/ thog mar rang gi lus kyi phung khams skye mched sbyong zhing byin gyis rlabs pa ltar byed/ gzod bskyed rim la 'dris su bcug pa mi zab kyi/ rang nyid gdod nas lhar yongs su grub pa la grub par shes pa'i gsal 'debs kyi tshul du cig car skad cig la 'jug pa ches gnad zab pa yin no// so gcig pa/

lha ni rten 'brel gyi tshogs pas grub par shes dgos bya ba ni/ rang gi phung po lnga rgyal ba lnga/ 'byung ba bzhi yum bzhi/ mig sogs nang gi skye mched sems dpa'/ gzugs sogs phyi'i skye mched sems ma/ tshigs sogs khro bo khro mo ste gdan gsum tshang ba'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa gdod nas yongs su grub pa/ rgyu dang lam dus su smin byed bum dbang sogs kyis ngo sprad cing mngon byang lnga la sogs pa'i rten 'brel tshogs pas bsgoms pa las| 'bras dus su tshogs gnyis rdzogs shing sngar gyi bsgom bya las bsam pa'i rang gzugs kyi 'khor lo'i dbang phyug gi go 'phang thob pa ni gsang sngags rgyu rkyen rten 'brel gyi tshogs pa las grub pa yin te/ 'dus pa las/ mdor na phung po lnga rgyal ba// mig la sogs pa byang chub sems// sa ni sangs rgyas spyan ma'o// zhes sogs dang*| ji skad du/ 'gro ba 'di dag sangs rgyas lnga'i bdag nyid// ces sogs rgya cher gsungs pa'i phyir ro// so gnyis pa/ dka' thub la sogs pa ni tha mal gyi lus su btags pas smad bya ba ni/ spyir so thar nas kyang 'tsho ba'i sman dang nad gso ba'i sman sogs gnang zhing bsrung bya 'ga' zhig kyang srog gi bar chad du 'gro na gnang la/ byang sems nas kyang sman myu gu'i dpes thog mar lus sogs srung ba gtso bor mdzad la/ bye brag gsang sngags pas ni lus lha dang lha mo'i rang bzhin yin pas dka' thub kyis gdungs shing ngal bar mi bya ba lta ci smos| nang gi sbyin sreg sogs la gnad du bsnun pas tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i thabs rmad du byung bar gsungs shing*/ lus la smad na rtsa ba'i ltung ba brgyad pa 'byung ba yang*/ slob dpon dpa' bos/ phung po sangs rgyas lnga bdag nyid// de la brnyas byed brgyad pa yin// zhes sogs gsungs la/ sangs rgyas kyis lo drug tu dka' ba spyad pa ni/ las kyi rgyu ba'ang yin|

mdo gsang bsam dang*/ dkon brtsegs sogs su dgongs te gsungs pa dang*/ thabs mkhas pa'i mdor sems can bskul ba'i thabs mkhas su gsungs pa dang*/ 'dul lung na rgyu 'bras su gsungs pa sogs dgongs pa ches mang la/ dka' thub des 'tshang mi rgya bas lha la sogs pas bskul nas slar byang chub shing drung du mnyam par bzhag pas 'tshang rgya tshul bstan pa dang*/ nā ro dang mi las dka' ba spyad pa ni bla ma'i bka' sgrub pa las/ phyis nyams su blangs pas grub pa thob kyi dka' ba spyad pas min pa dang*/ nyams len gyi gtso bo yang sems 'dul ba las/ lus ngag la gnad du bsnun pa gtso mi che ste/ rgyal sras zhi ba lhas/ sems bsrung brtul zhugs ma gtogs pa// brtul zhugs mang pos ci zhig bya// zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir rdo rje theg pa'i lam du zhugs zin rnams kyis dka' thub dang smyung bar gnas pa sogs ni rtsa ltung brgyad pa dang*/ yan lag gi ltung ba'ang 'ga' zhig nyams su myong bas/ lam gyi lam rim pa gnyis byang chub sems kyi dran gso dang ma bral ba zhig ma byung na/ lus ngag gi 'jab 'job btsun po dang dka' thub smyung gnas sogs kho na yang sha thang ngo*// so gsum pa/ drang don nges don med par cho ga rgyas pa thams cad la dgos bya ba ni/ rang nyid gdod nas phung khams skye mched dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo grub pa nyid rtogs byed kyi thabs cho ga la rag las pa dang*/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam pa kun tu thabs mkhas shing thugs rje che bas cho ga'i yan lag phra mo tsam re la yang rten 'brel rmad du byung ba re re dgos pa yod pas mdor na sa chog nas brtsams bzhi pa'i bar du smin lam gyi dbang cho ga rgyas shing zur yang ma nyams pa thob dgos/ de thob nas grol lam bskyed rdzogs nyams su len pa'i tshe yang des chog des 'ong mi bya bar cho ga rgyas pa dmigs pa gsal ba gal che ste sangs rgyas kyi mkhyen pa'i ye shes sgrub byed kyi rkyen cho ga yin pa la dgongs so| |so bzhi pa/

gang gis 'dul ba gtso bor gyur pa la bsdus par yang bzhed bya ba ni/ sngar cho ga rgyas pa spyir btang med mi rung du gsungs nas/ 'dir dmigs bsal cig car ba la ni cho ga rgyas pa nyid ma byung yang bsdus pa tsam gyis kyang chog ste/ de la ni bla ma rab sangs rgyas lta bu/ 'bring mngon shes thob pa/ tha ma yang slob ma de'i rigs shes pa/ slob ma yang cig car ba zhig dgos te/ sngon sangs rgyas kyis legs 'ong gi rgyud mkhyen nas dge slong rnams ut+pala'i dri mig la phan zhes gsungs pas/ dge slong rnams kyis ut+pa la re re'i dri ma mnam pa'i phyir thogs pa sngo zings kyis byung ba legs 'ong gis mthong bas kho snga ma zad pa sngon po la goms pas de mthong bas sad de dgra bcom thob cing klu a mṛ'i chu ngogs gzhan gyis ma thub pa khong gis btul ba lta bu dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dga' byed lta bu dang*/ slob dpon 'phags pas klu'i byang chub la gdams pa bstan pa lta bu dang*/ rga rgyal ba'i bla ma de gu ru lo tsā bas btul ba lta bu yin pas/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rten 'brel rgyu 'bras tshogs pa las byung ba yin pas/ gong gi cho ga mang po la brten dgos par bzhed pa yang thabs rgyu rkyen gyi rten 'brel 'grig pa'i phyir dgongs pa yin no// so lnga pa/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo rmad du byung ba ni byang chub kyi go cha yin par bzhed bya ba ni/ gdon bgegs la sogs par snang ba rnams rang gi gnyis 'dzin gyi rtog pa las byung ba'i phyir dang*/ theg pa chen po la zhugs nas sems can thams cad kyi don du byang chub sgrub par khas blangs nas bdag dang bgegs zhes gnyis su bzung nas bgegs la sdang sems kyis rdo rje rwa gur sogs bsgoms kyang nges par mi 'tshe ba'i rgyu med pas/ des na sems bskyed nas bsngo ba'i bar yang sems can gyi don du byed na bgegs kyang sems can las ma 'das pa'i phyir don des na mgon po 'bri gung pa chen po'i bzhed pa skyabs 'gro nas bzung*|

bdag la sdang bar byed pa'i dgra/ gnod par byed pa'i bgegs/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa la bar du gcod par byed pa thams cad kyis gtso byas pa'i ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan sogs tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgoms pas/ gnod byed la phan btags pa byang chub sems dpa'i chos kyi mchog tu gyur pa dang*/ bgegs de rnams kyis kyang gnod bya gnod byed dang bral ba'i phyir gnad yang dag par zab cing*/ gzhan yang don dam byang sems bgegs kyang ma grub pa rang sems kyi snang cha tsam las med de/ rje btsun mi las/ don dam bden pa'i dbang du ni// bgegs las sangs rgyas nyid kyang med// ces sogs gsungs pa'i phyir ro// 'o na rdo rje theg par bsrung ba'i 'khor lo rdo rje rwa gur khro bcu sogs bsgom pa mi 'thad dam zhe na min te/ de rnams ni sangs rgyas pa'i tshe bdud btul ba la sogs pa'i rten 'brel dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i phyi'i khor yug sogs dgos pa 'ga' zhig la dgongs kyi/ 'dir bsrung ba'i 'khor lo ches rmad du byung ba ni byang chub kyi go cha tshad med bzhi las byung ba'i stong nyid snying rje zung du 'jug pa 'di kho na yin par bzhed do// so drug pa/ rtsa rlung gi gnad lhag par yang 'dul bar che ba bzhed pa ni/ rtsa rlung gi gdams pas kyang lus ngag yid gsum/ rtsa thig rlung gsum dag par byed pa las gzhan med pa/ 'dir thugs kyi dgongs pas/ 'dul bar lus rtsa 'dag par bya ba'i phyir/ kun spyod bag yod pas mi tshangs par spyod pa spong ba dang srog gcod spong ba sogs pham lhag spang ltung sor bshags nyes byas dang bcas pa ma gos par bsrungs pas lus rtsa'i sgrib pa dag /ngag rlung gi rang bzhin 'dag par bya ba'i phyir ngag 'chal mi chos bla ma'i rdzun nas bzhad gad kyi dngos po yan chad spangs pas ngag rlung gi sgrib pa dag /yid thig le'i sgrib pa 'dag par bya ba'i phyir yid kyi spong sems brtan pos legs par bsdams pas yid thig le'i sgrib pa dag

/de ltar sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag nas sangs rgyas las 'os med pas kyang gnad zab cing*/ gzhan yang lus ngag yid gsum bag chags dang bcas shing sems bsrung gi brtul zhugs las mi g.yo ba'i phyir dang*/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi las mi dge ba bcu dang pham par gyur pa bzhi spong zhing gtso bor pham pa dang po spangs pas thig le las su rung zhing rnam par dag nas dwangs ma 'phel bas yon tan rgyas par 'gyur ba'i phyir rtsa rlung gi gnad 'dul ba ches zab bo// so bdun pa/ byin rlabs dang ldan pas kun gzhi dus gzhan du'ang mthong bya ba ni/ gsang sngags kyi lam sgom pa sogs byin rlabs kyis mthong ba'i kun gzhi'i ye shes so so'i skye bos yin min mi shes pa dang*/ sa dang por mngon sum du mthong ba dang*/ so skye tshogs sbyor gyi lam pa yin pas dri ma dang bcas pa dang*/ dri ma rim pas dag pas 'phags pa sa dang po sogs gsum gyis mngon du 'gyur ba'i kun gzhi dag pa dang*/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes dag pa'i bral 'bras chos dbyings ye shes sogs lnga sangs rgyas kyi thugs rgyud la ldan pa shugs bstan dang*/ kun gzhi la dbye na/ sa bcu pas kyang mun khung du glang po che rtogs pa tsam las mi shes pa'i kun gzhi dang*/ sa bdun pas ji lta ba bzhin du mthong ba'i kun gzhi dang*/ sa dang po pas mngon sum du mthong ba'i kun gzhi dang*/ yin min ma shes pas ma rtogs pa so so skye bos mngon sum du mthong ba'i kun gzhi zhig kyang yod pas/ de rnams yon tan skye ba shas chung 'bring chen po'i dbye bas mthong la/ kun gzhi'i dbye ba 'di rnams go na lam mtho dman du rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi khyad par khong du chud sla bas chos spong ba'i sdig pas mi gos pa'i gnad gcig kyang yod la/ de dag gi don ni/ mgon po byams pas/ dri 'di dag gis byis rnams dang*// dgra bcom slob pa blo ldan rnams// rim bzhin bzhi dang gcig dang ni// gnyis dang gnyis kyi ma dag nyid// ces pa spyir btang du bshad nas bla ma'i byin rlabs dang*/

rang gi nyes pa dag che chung gi khyad par gyis kun gzhi'i ye shes ni sa lam kho na'i bshad pa ltar 'byung ba'i nges pa yang mtha' gcig tu med pas dus gzhan du'ang mthong zhes bye brag tu bzhed do// so brgyad pa/ snyigs ma dug bcas kyi rtsa rlung thig le khyad par du zab bya ba ni/ rgyu ma dag pa med par 'bras bu dag pa mi 'byung ba dang*/ dag par byas zin pas gang zag gi bya ba grub pa dang*/ 'di ltar ma dag pa nyid la gnad du bsnun pas lam gyi yon tan ma lus pa skye ba ste rgyu mtshan gsum gyis snyigs ma dug bcas la gnad du bsnun pa nyid zab ste/ ji skad du/ ji ltar grong khyer dbus kyi mi gtsang lud// de ni bu ram shing pa'i zhing la phan// de bzhin byang chub sems dpa'i nyon mongs lud/ /rgyal dang rgyal ba'i chos la phan par byed/ /ces dang*/ rdo rje gur las/ 'dod chags kyis bskyed 'jig rten pa// 'dod chags spang na brlag par 'gyur| |rdo rje chags pa yongs shes na// yid ni rdo rje sems dpar 'gyur// chags pa'i zhags pas rnam bcings pas// 'jig rten chags pas myos par byed// chags dang bral ba'i byang chub ni// chags pa mchog ldan rnams kyis smad// ces dang*/ rgyud dgongs pa lung ston las/ rnam rtog sna tshogs lcags zhes bya// nyes pa gsum tshogs bdag nyid las| |gsang sngags skyes bu'i sbyor ba yis// de ni mi mchog dag tu 'gyur// gser 'gyur rtsi yi rnam pa yis// lcags ni gser du byed pa yin// de bzhin sngags kyi de nyid kyis| |mi ni bde gshegs byed pa yin// zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir ro// so dgu pa/ bslab pa gsum gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i yang lam rim bya ba ni/ gsang sngags sdom pa'i lam yang bslab pa gsum la brten dgos te/ rdo rje rtse mo sogs rgyud 'ga' zhig mthun par/ tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// zhes sogs dang brtag gnyis las// dang por gso sbyong sbyin par bya// zhes sogs gsungs pas/

sngags sdom man chad la bslab pa gsum lam rim spyi khyab tu dgos pa kho na yin no// bzhi bcu pa/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug theg pa gsum char gyi lam bya ba ni/ spyir sbyin pa tshul khrims bzod pa gsum ni bsod nams kyi tshogs/ bsam gtan shes rab gnyis ni ye shes kyi tshogs yin la/ brtson 'grus ni de gnyis char gyi grogs yin pas theg pa gsum char gyi lam yin te/ dpal mgon klu sgrub kyi dbu ma rin chen phreng ba las/ mdor na sangs rgyas bstan 'di dag /pha rol phyin drug khong na yod| |de bas 'di ni sangs rgyas bka'// byang chub lam chen bsod nams dang*// ye shes rang bzhin sangs rgyas kyis// gang la bstan pa'i theg chen 'di// mi shes ldongs rnams mi bzod do// zhes so// phyin drug ni theg chen sngags sdom gyi lam kho nar yang nges la/ ngo bo rdzogs byang gi spyod yul te/ theg bsdus kyi 'grel par bstod tshogs kyi lung drangs pa/ bse ru lta bu rnams la ni// pha rol phyin drug ming yang med// bcom ldan nyag cig pha rol phyin// drug gi spyi la bzhugs pa lags// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro| |'di'i bslab pa gsum gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lam rim bya ba dang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug theg pa gsum gyi lam bya ba 'di gnyis gsang sngags la tshul khrims med thabs med bya ba'i khongs su 'du bas go bar byos shig /zhe gcig pa/ dpon slob gnyis kas phan tshun dam tshig mnyam par bya gsungs pa ni/ rdo rje slob dpon yul ches gnyan pas de'i dam tshig ni rdo rje theg pa'i dngos grub thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin pas ches shin tu bka' gnyan mod/ 'on kyang slob dpon gyis kyang slob ma la dam tshig bsrung ba ches mang ste/ slob ma sun phyung na slob dpon la rtsa ltung bcu gnyis pa 'byung ste/ slob dpon dpa' bos/ sems can dad dang ldan pa la// sems sun 'byin pa bcu gnyis pa// zhes dang*/

slob ma la rdo rje theg pa'i chos mi ston par theg pa chung ngu ston na/ ji skad du/ dad ldan la gzhan chos ston dang*// zhes sbom po dang*/ yang slob mas dam tshig nyams nas bshags pa phul na bshags pa tshad las 'das kyang gnang ba mi ster na bde gshegs bka' 'das rtsa ltung gnyis pa 'byung ba sogs ches mang ba'i phyir de 'dra bar dgongs so// zhe gnyis pa/ phyag rgya chen po la dge ba'i ngo bos sgrib mi srid bya ba ni/ don dam pa'i dge ba ni phyag rgya chen po rang dang dbyer med yin pa'i phyir dge ba'i ngo bos zer ba'i tshig don de 'dra bar 'dzin dgos shing*/ de lta na mi dge ba'i ngo bos ni ngan song du ltung ba'i phyir bsgribs la/ de bzhin nyid la bsams nas mi dge bas mi bsgrib zer na de 'dra ba'i phyag rgya chen po dge med sdig med du thal bas mu stegs las kyang smad par 'gyur ro// de yang gzhi'i dus su mtsho dang mtsho'i rlabs dang 'dra ste dge ba'i ngo bos mi bsgrib/ lam dus su byang chub kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun la sogs pa rang nyid las byung ba dang*/ rang gi ngo bo gong 'phel du byed pa dper na me tog dang me tog gi dri bzhin du yod pas mi bsgrib/ 'bras bu'i dus gzhi dus kyi dge ba dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba sogs byas pa de 'bras bu phyag rgya chen po'i ngo bor sangs rgyas pa'i dus su dkon mchog gsum gyi 'khor lo 'ba' zhig tu 'byung ba dpe nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang de'i 'od zer gyi dra ba lta bu yin pas mi bsgrib la/ des na gzhi'i dus su kun gzhi ma bcos gnyug ma don dam bden pa des lam gyi dus su tshogs gnyis kyis rdzogs par byas pas| 'bras bu sku dang ye shes zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po'i ngo bor sangs rgyas nas/ ma 'dres pa gcig gis gcig mi bsgribs shing tshang la yongs su rdzogs pa gdul bya dus la bab pa'i tshe/

de re res kyang sems can gyi khams rgyud tshad med pa la rgyun mi 'chad du 'jug cing 'gro ba'i don 'bad med lhun grub tu 'byung ba'i phyir ro// zhe gsum pa/ bral 'bras thams cad rgyu dang bcas pa bya ba ni/ rgyu med pa'i 'bras bu ni gshis la mi gnas pas bral 'bras kyang rgyu can du 'ong ste/ bu mo rin chen gyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ thub pa'i stobs bcu'i thog mar gnas dang gnas ma yin pa sna tshogs pa mkhyen pa'i stobs thob pa'i rgyu/ bcom ldan 'das la bu mo rin chen nas zhus pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu po 'di dge ba'i rtsa ba gang lags/ bka' stsal pa/ bu mo byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa spyad pa ni/ theg pa dman pa 'di ni gnas ma yin te/ skabs med do// de brtan pa'i stobs dang ldan pa/ sangs rgyas pa'i dus na gnas dang gnas ma yin pa mkhyen pa'i stobs thob par gsungs te/ zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir bral 'bras sad byed kyi rgyu gsungs pa yin la/ bral 'bras dngos ni khams de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po yon tan rang bzhin lhun grub kyis bzhugs pa la bzhed pa ni sngar skabs mang por bshad pa ltar go bar byos shig /zhe bzhi pa/ bsgom bya sgom byed gnyis med na nam mkha' gnyis 'dres ni nyan thos kyi mngon rtogs bya ba ni/ nyan thos dgra bcom gyi mngon rtogs mar me snum zad skye ba rgyun chad du 'dod pa de phyin chad skye ba'i rgyun mi len par 'dod pa sogs ni rgyu 'bras la 'phrig ma tshud pas don dang mi ldan la/ yul yul can gnyis 'dres kyi rtogs pa shar ba'i tshe/ bla ma la mos gus drag po byas pas rgyu 'bras rten 'brel du go nas gzod stong nyid rgyu 'bras su ldang ba zhig 'byung ba ni bzhed pa rnam par dag pa yin no// zhe lnga pa*/ rlung mi 'dzin pa lhug par 'jog pa gdams ngag zab bya ba ni/ rlung sems tha dad med pas rlung la rtsol 'bung 'don pa'i rtsar rtsir g.yo 'gul mang po la 'khrul 'khor skad du btags nas byas kyang*/

sems dngos po'i gnas lugs ma mthong na gnas skabs ltar snang kun rdzob pa'i yon tan phran bu skye srid kyang mthar thug gi sa chod che ba'i go chod po mi 'byung bas/ rlung sems dbyer med mi rtog pa'i ye shes bskyed pa'i rlung gi gnad 'ching ba ma byas byar med du nyams su len pa ni bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng ba nas gsungs pa ltar nyams su len pa gnad che ste de'i tshul ni gtum mo gsum khrid du rtogs par byos shig /zhe drug pa/ mchog gi 'pho ba rnam shes bla ma 'od gsal bya ba ni/ rang gi rnam par shes pa dang*/ lam dus su bla mas ngo sprad pa'i 'od gsal dang*/ rtsa ba'i bla ma zhes logs su ma chad pa bla ma'i thugs zab gsal gnyis med kyi ye shes de nyid dang gsum po dbyer med ro mnyam du bzhag pa ste/ de yang rang sems gzhi'i 'od gsal dang*| lam dus su ngo sprad pa'i 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po ma pang du bu 'jug pa'am chab rom chur zhu ba lta bu de nyid kyang lha sku yig 'bru rlung dang rtsol ba la ltos mi dgos par bla ma'i thugs zab gsal spros pa med pa dang dbyer med du 'pho ba ste/ ji skad du/ 'pho bya 'pho byed kyi rten dang bral// 'pho rgyu byung na rnal 'byor min// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir tshul de lta bu ni rnal 'byor pa rab kyi 'pho ba'o// zhe bdun pa/ sangs rgyas ni byang chub sems kyi rang gzugs yin bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas zhes pa rgyu mtshan gzhan dang gzhan gyis bskyed pa min gyi/ lam dus su byang chub kyi sems smon pa dang 'jug pa kun rdzob pa'i tshul gyis nyams su blangs shing tshogs gnyis goms pa mthar phyin pa las/ 'bras dus su don dam byang chub kyi sems stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can gyi rang gzugs chos sku yon tan mdzad pa dang bcas pa sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo rtag pa dang chad pa la sogs mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i ngo bo can de la ming sangs rgyas zhes btags te/

mi'am ci'i rgyal po ljon pas zhus pa'i mdo las/ rgyu la brten pa'i mkhas pa bcom ldan 'das// mtha' gnyis lta ba rtag tu mi mnga' zhing*// las kyi 'bras bu rnam smin kho na gsungs// lta ba'i mun bral khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes so// de lta bu'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das des gdul bya 'dul ba'i phyir sngon gyi smon lam dang dam bca' ba las mi 'da' ba'i tshul gyis 'gro ba'i snang ngor snang ba'i tshul ni ci 'dra zhe na/ mgon po byams pas/ sangs rgyas gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// dbyangs dang mi ldan de 'dra min// lha yi rnga bzhin thams cad du// don byed min pa de 'dra min// sprin chen dang mtshungs don med pa'i// sa bon spong min de 'dra min| |tshangs chen bzhin te gtan du ni// smin par byed min de 'dra min// nyi ma'i gzugs bzhin gtan du ni// mun pa 'joms min de 'dra min// yid bzhin nor 'dra 'byung ba ni| |rnyed par mi dka' de 'dra min// sgra brnyan bzhin te rkyen las ni// 'byung ba de dang 'dra ba'ang min// nam mkha' dang 'dra dge ba yi// gzhi min de dang 'dra ba'ang min// 'jig rten 'jig rten las 'das pa// 'gro ba'i phun tshogs ma lus pa// de gnas pa yi rten yin phyir// sa yi dkyil 'khor dag dang 'dra// zhes dpe thams cad dang bral ba'i sangs rgyas de 'dra ba 'byung zhing*/ de'i phrin las ni nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par lhun grub rgyun mi chad du 'byung bar 'gyur ba yin no// zhes pa lhan thabs gsung bzhi bcu pa'i gnad rnams gsal bar byed pa ste spyi don brgyad pa'o/// /smras pa/ ji lta ji snyed ye shes gzigs pa'i phul// dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi rang gzugs ni// gcig gyur mgon po 'bri gung par grags pa'i| |bka' drin dran pas slar yang phyag bgyi'o/ 1 /'jig rten gsum gyi bla na 'dren pa'i gtso// gang de'i mkhyen brtse ye shes byin rlabs tshogs// snying la zhugs pas kun rmongs bdag gis kyang/

/mdo sngags rgya mtsho'i de nyid skad cig mthong*/ 2 /gang gi rang bzhin shes bya'i gnas la blo gros kun+da cher bzhad cing*/ /gang gi thub pa'i gsung rab pad tshal rnam pa kun tu nges mthong bas/ /gang gi 'dren pa mnyam med mchog de'i gsung gi gsang ba ji snyed pa/ /gang gi rnam bshad gsal por byas 'di blo ldan dga' ba'i dpal du gyur| 3 |lung dang rig pa'i kha lo pas// legs par drangs pa'i rdo rje'i gsung*// nyi gzhon legs bshad 'od ris can// blo ldan pad tshal rgyas par byas/ 4 /lhag pa'i lha dbang byin rlabs mchog gi mig thur rnon po'i 'phrul sbyor dang*// dad ldan lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i mig sman sbyor ba nyer tshogs pas// rmongs pa'i rab rib nyes brgya bsal nas chos kun lta ba'i blo gros kyi// mthong byed rab tu brtas pa'i mthu las gang yin chos tshul ma lus mthong*/ 5 /thub dbang klu sgrub zhabs dngos 'bri gung pa'i| |gsung gi gsang ba ches brling rtogs dka' ba// gsung rab kun gyi de nyid gcig bsdus pa'i// bzhed srol sgrogs pa'i rnga sgra ches gsal mod/ 6 /snyigs dus mkhas rlom phal gyi spyi brtol gyis// ma rtogs log par rtog pa'i zhe 'dod dang*// 'khrul ba'i dri mas sbags pa'i nag nog gis// rdo rje'i gsung rnams cung zad rnying par byas/ 7 /kye ma/ gangs can ljongs 'dir 'gran pa'i zla bral mgon po 'bri gung pa zhes grags pa'i gsung gi gsang ba rtogs dka' ba// 'khrul med dgongs pa'i snying po blangs nas gsal bar bshad cing lung dang rig pa'i lang tsho can// gzhan gzhung dregs pa'i log smra tshar bcad don dam snying po rdo rje'i gsungs rnams gsal byas kyi// sgrub brgyud snying po'i bstan la zhugs pa'i blo gsal tshogs rnams blo mig mgrin pa'i 'dod pa 'jo ba'i rgyan du mdzes/ 8 /sngon dus nga rgyal khengs rlom cher brtsegs pa'i// phrag dog so can rtse nas rab shar ba'i// nyes bshad rta dkar 'od kyi gtam gyi nas// zab don pad+ma'i tshal rab nyams par byas/

9 /gsung rab rgya mtsho'i 'jing las legs thon cing*// lhag bsam shar ri'i phrag pa la 'dzegs te// blo gros rta bdun shugs kyis nyer drangs pa'i// legs bshad 'od stong 'dzin pa 'di shar tshe/ 10 /klu sgrub klu dbang gnyis pa 'bri gung pa'i// thugs kyi gsang ba'i chu ngogs las thon pa| |zab don gti ma'i bcud rab cher rgyas pa'i// legs bshad zur brgya dod pa'i ke sa ra/ 11 /don bzang bā dhu'i dga' ston deng mchis kyi// blo gros gshog yangs dkar po'i rol rtsed dang*// don bzang snying po len pa'i snying stobs kyis// blo ldan sbrang rtsi skyong rnams dga' bar byos/ 12 /gzhan dag bstan la dad cing phrag dog pa'i// chags dang sdang ba med par khas blangs nas// 'dren pa zhabs kyi dpal la phrag dog pa'i// skyo ngogs brlang po'i ngag gi nyes bshad la/ 13 /chos dang chos min 'byed ces rdzu bag can// kye ma dam pa'i rnam thar lta zhog gi /phal pa bag dang ldan yang de 'dra ba'i// spyod pa'i tshul la g.yar tsha ma mchis sam/ 14 /legs nyes dpyod pa'i rnam dbye'i mig long bas// gyi na'i grags pa brag cha stong pa'i sgra// snyan pa'i phyir 'brang don gyi ngo bo la// mi rtog skye bo'i bsod nams skal re zhan/ 15 /rigs 'khor longs spyod dbang dang dregs pa yis// rab myos blun po'i tshogs nang mkhas pa'i blo// skyor 'byin gtam gyis rang gzhan rgyud bsregs pa/ /dge ba'i chos su rlom dang 'di mi mnyam/ 16 /sa gsum 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig klu sgrub zhabs/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug 'bri gung par sprul nas/ /sa gsum grags pa'i gdugs dkar rab g.yo bas/ /sa steng skye bo'i don rab rmad du byung*| 17 |sa 'dir skye bo'i bsod nams dman pas zas bzang dug gis sbags pa lta'i// skya bo'i tshon gyis legs par bsgos pa'i mang 'dzin bsam pa'i par+pa tas// sngon byon mkhas pa'i khri can bsgribs pas sa steng rgyal ba'i bstan pa ni// nam mkha'i 'byor pa kho nar byas mod sa steng skye bo bsod nams dman/
