18 /kha zas bzang po dug can gyis// sbags pas gzhan srog 'phrog pa ltar// chos ltar bcos pa'i ltar snang gis// skye bo phal cher nongs par byas/ 19 dus gsum rgyal ba kun yab 'bri gung pa'i// ji snyed chos kyi 'khor lo rmad byung ba// bgrang ba'i yul dang tshad bzung ma mchis kyang*// bzhed pa'i gtso bo che long tsam smos pa/ 20 /rdo rje'i gsung tshig brgya dang go bdun zhes// sa gsum khong du grags pa'i 'od zer 'bar// de yi rnam bshad rgyas dang bsdus la sogs// mkha' la skar tshogs ji bzhin grangs mang yang*/ 21 /'khrul med dgongs pa lung rig gis brgyan nas// zur brgya dod pa'i dgongs don gang dang gang*/ /dpyad shes rang gzhan lugs gnyis sgrub dgag pa/ /gsal por bshad 'di yid bzhin nor dang mtshungs/ 22 /rgyal kun dgongs pa gcig 'doms bstan bcos che/ /mdo sngags gzhung brgya'i de nyid rtag 'char ba/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa'i snying po kun 'dus pa'i/ /legs bshad snang ba'i 'od stong 'di rmad do| 23 |deng sang rang lugs yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal// dgos dgu stsol ba'i legs bshad rgyang bsrings nas// gzhan gzhung mching bu'i do shal la dga' ba'i// mgo 'khor 'khrul ba can rnams sha thang ngo*/ 23 /rgyal dang bla ma'i thugs dgongs 'khrul med dpyid// bshad sgrub snying po nyams su blang rigs kyang*// deng sang zang zing las gzhan mi bsam phyir// bstan bcos 'di yang ngal ba don med snyam/ 25 /'on kyang phyogs bcu'i rgyal dang de sras dang*// rgyal ba kun 'dus mgon po 'bri gung pa// sras dang brgyud pa bcas pa rab dgyes pa'i// mchod sprin snying por 'gyur ba gdon mi za/ 26 /de lta nyid na 'bad pa'i snying po 'di// 'bras med ma yin 'bad pa don chen du// 'gyur snyam bdag nyid gnyis skyes gtsug phud can// kun dga' brtas pa'i zlos gar 'bum gyis rol/ 27 /tshul 'di mos 'dun snying stobs 'bad bskyed de// ngal ba bor nas 'byor ba'i khur 'khyer ba'i// dngos de'i dge tshogs ston zla ltar dkar ba// bdag gzhan sems can thams cad spyir bgyis nas/

28 /thub pa'i bstan pa rnam pa kun gnas shing*// de 'dzin byed pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams// bskal brgya'i bar du 'tsho zhing gzhes pa dang*// bzhed dgongs bshad sgrub 'dzin pa mtha' khyab gyur/ 29 /gang yang nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam 'gro ba kun| |mi dge sdig pa'i las rnams kun spong zhing*// dge ba'i las lam mtha' dag myur rdzogs nas// don gnyis mthar phyin rdzogs byang myur thob shog 30 /bdag kyang deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du// rgyal ba kun 'dus mgon po 'bri gung pa'i// gsung gi gsang ba sdud dang 'grel pa la// gsang ba'i bdag po ji bzhin 'gyur bar shog 31 /bstan bcos 'di yang bstan dang 'gro ba'i slad// nam mkha' ji bzhin yun du gnas pa dang*// bshad dang sgrub pa'i ring lugs rnam dag 'di// nyi zla ji bzhin kun la gsal bar shog 32 /de ltar gangs can ljongs kyi 'dren pa thams cad kyi rigs kyi bdag po gcig tu gyur pa mgon po klu sgrub nyid dpal 'bri gung pa chen po 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po zhes par sku sprul pa de nyid kyi gsung gi gsang ba che long tsam bsdus pa dam pa'i chos dgongs pa gcig pa'i rnam par bshad pa lung don gsal byed nyi ma'i snang ba zhes bya ba 'di yang*/ skyes sbyangs kyi yon tan du ma'i phul du gyur pa sprul pa'i sku bstan 'dzin phun tshogs kyi bka' nan gyis bskul ba la brten/ spyan snga shes rab 'byung gnas kyi gsung dang*/ 'grel pa rdo sher ma/ rin byang ma/ mgar dgongs/ rje zhwa dmar ba bzhi pas mdzad pa'i gsal byed/ lta ba rdo rje'i mig /dge slong chos tshul khrims kyis mdzad pa sogs kyi tshig don gyi cha la legs par dpyad cing 'thad pa rnams bsdus/ gtso bor mgon po 'bri gung pa nyid kyi bka' 'bum dang zab chos rnams la legs par gzhigs pa btsud de/ de rnams kyi dgongs pa rdo rje'i gsung gi ngo bor bzhugs pa rnams gsal bar byas shing*/

lung dang rig pa'i tshogs du mas brgyan te/ skyu ra'i gdung las bcu gnyis pa'i thog tu gnas pa rig pa'i gnas lnga smra zhing bskyed pa dang rdzogs pa'i lam gyi rnal 'byor la dbang bsgyur ba rdo rje 'dzin pa rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa phrin las rnam par rgyal ba'i sdes/ dpal sdong zhes pa chu mo bya lo rang lo so dgu pa'i steng*/ snron gyi zla ba'i dus tshes dge ba nas brtsams khrums kyi nya ba'i dkar phyogs kyi bzang po gnyis pa'i dus dge bar/ lugs gnyis kyi 'dun sa chen po bye ri stag rnam par rtse ba'i gzhal med khang chen po'i re'u mig kun gsal gsang sngags pho brang du grub par bgyis pa'i yi ge pa ni mnga' ris pa dkon mchog lhun grub ste/ 'dis kyang snying po'i bstan pa rin po che 'di phyogs dus thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ //maṅga laṃ//
